papers.title: A Causal Schr\"odinger-Newton Theory that Conserves Energy and Momentum
papers.abstract: This paper provides a theoretical justification for using the Causal-Conditional Schr\"odinger-Newton theory (CCSN) as a phenomenological model for classical gravity sourced by quantum matter. In CCSN, the gravitational field is driven not by expectation values in the global quantum state, but by conditional expectation values of the stress-energy tensor evaluated on local states determined by measurement records in the causal past. Because these local states are defined operationally from measurement records, the formulation is independent of any particular interpretation of quantum measurement while leading to unambiguous phenomenological dynamics. We apply this framework to a self-gravitating optomechanical system under continuous measurement and show that the resulting stochastic Schr\"odinger evolution, augmented by a classical gravitational field sourced by local conditional stress-energy expectations, can be made consistent with energy-momentum conservation by introducing a corrector tensor. The corrector restores the conservation law without altering the leading Newtonian predictions of CCSN, contributing only negligible post-Newtonian corrections in current experimental regimes. These results place CCSN on firmer theoretical footing and clarify its role as a viable phenomenological model for ongoing and future tests of classical gravity coupled to quantum matter.

classification.title_zh: 一种守恒能量与动量的因果薛定谔-牛顿理论
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为因果条件薛定谔-牛顿理论（CCSN）作为由量子物质 sourced 的经典引力现象学模型提供理论依据。在 CCSN 中，引力场不由全局量子态的期望值驱动，而由因果过去测量记录所确定的局域态上的应力-能量张量条件期望值驱动。作者将该框架应用于连续测量下的自引力光机械系统，并表明通过引入修正张量，可使由局域条件应力-能量期望值 sourced 的经典引力场与随机薛定谔演化满足能量-动量守恒；该修正不改变 CCSN 的主导牛顿预言，在现有实验区域仅贡献可忽略的后牛顿修正。

papers.title: Elastic polar oscillations and nuclear parameters
papers.abstract: Owing to the elasticity of a neutron star, the shear and interface modes are excited, in addition to the fundamental, pressure, and gravity modes. While direct observations of the oscillation spectrum remain challenging, potential resonance signatures from these modes could be manifested in the precursors of short gamma-ray bursts from binary neutron star mergers. If the oscillation spectrum is observed, this is a good opportunity to extract the physical properties through the technique of asteroseismology. In particular, we focus on the crustal elasticity and examine the $s$- and $i$-mode frequencies. We find that, for a given EOS specified by the nuclear saturation parameters, the radius-scaled $s$-mode frequencies and the mass-scaled $i$-mode frequencies can be expressed as a function of the stellar compactness, independently of the stiffness of the core EOS, at least when the EOS in a higher-density region can be characterized only by the specific constant sound velocity. Then, we could derive the fitting formula for the $s_i$-mode for $i=1-4$ and $i_1$-mode frequencies as a function of the stellar compactness and the combination of the incompressibility of symmetric nuclear matter, $K_0$, and the slope parameter for the nuclear symmetry energy, $L$. If the $s$- and/or $i$-mode oscillation frequencies were observed, one may get the relation between these properties by identifying the observed frequencies with specific modes, using our fitting formula, which offers useful insights into the nuclear saturation parameters and stellar properties. By combining the other observational data, it may be possible to narrow the parameter space of EOS parameters and stellar properties. We emphasize that this article summarizes the results presented in our previous studies and discusses their implications for neutron star seismology.

classification.title_zh: 弹性极向振荡与核参数
classification.abstract_zh: 由于中子星具有弹性，除基频模、压强模和引力模外，还会激发剪切模和界面模。直接观测振荡谱仍具挑战性，但双中子星并合产生的短伽马暴前兆可能显现这些模式的共振特征。若振荡谱被观测到，则可通过星震学提取物理性质。本文重点关注地壳弹性和 s 模、i 模频率。研究发现，对于由核饱和参数给定的状态方程，在高密度区仅用恒定声速表征时，半径标度的 s 模频率和质量标度的 i 模频率可表示为恒星致密度的函数，且不依赖核心状态方程的硬度。随后给出 s_i 模（i=1-4）和 i_1 模频率的拟合公式，将其表示为恒星致密度以及对称核物质不可压缩性 K0 与核对称能斜率参数 L 组合的函数。若观测到 s 模和/或 i 模振荡频率，可通过拟合公式识别具体模式，从而获得这些性质之间的关系，为核饱和参数和恒星性质提供有用线索；结合其他观测数据，还可能缩小状态方程参数与恒星性质的参数空间。本文强调，文章总结了作者此前研究的结果，并讨论其对中子星星震学的意义。
classification.one_liner: 总结中子星地壳弹性 s/i 模频率与核饱和参数 K0、L 及恒星致密度的拟合关系，并讨论其星震学意义。

papers.title: Analyzing Fermionic Dark Matter Scenarios with Anomalous Compact Objects
papers.abstract: In this paper, we consider three compact objects (HESS J1731-347, PSR J1231-1411, XTE J1814-338) with anomalous mass-radius relations to analyze the possibility of their being dark matter admixed neutron stars. We try to infer the properties of the dark matter particles, under the assumption of behaving as a free Fermi gas. The main novelty relies on the use of a baryonic equation of state obtained from first principles over the whole density range, which allows the model dependence of the baryonic part of the calculation to be eliminated. Once the possible dark matter admixed neutron star configurations are obtained, we check their stability and whether it is feasible for a neutron star to capture the necessary dark matter fraction. Our analysis shows that our dark matter model favours the dark matter admixed neutron star hypothesis over the pure baryonic neutron star one, with the most favoured dark matter mass of $m_{DM} = 1$~GeV, although the necessary dark matter content cannot be explained in a standard galactic environment.

classification.title_zh: 用异常致密天体分析费米子暗物质情形
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考察三个具有异常质量-半径关系的致密天体（HESS J1731-347、PSR J1231-1411、XTE J1814-338），分析它们作为暗物质混合中子星的可能性。作者假设暗物质为自由费米气体，并采用覆盖整个密度范围的第一性原理重子物态方程，以消除重子部分计算的模型依赖性。得到可能的暗物质混合中子星位形后，作者检验其稳定性以及中子星能否捕获所需暗物质比例。分析表明，该暗物质模型更倾向于暗物质混合中子星假说而非纯重子中子星，最受青睐的暗物质质量为 m_DM=1 GeV，但所需暗物质含量无法在标准星系环境中解释。
classification.one_liner: 用第一性原理重子物态方程检验费米子暗物质混合中子星对三个异常致密天体的解释。

papers.title: Attractors and initial-condition sensitivity in Horndeski cosmologies
papers.abstract: We study whether nearby homogeneous cosmological histories approach or move away from the Genesis and contracting solutions. We also determine how an uncertainty in the scalar velocity at a later stage affects the inferred initial velocity. In the Genesis models, including the gravitational dynamics can substantially change this relation. We find that convergence of homogeneous solutions can occur even around backgrounds with unstable perturbations, and therefore attraction of the background is not sufficient to establish that a cosmological solution is physically viable. In the contracting model, one power-law solution attracts nearby trajectories, whereas another repels them. The strength of these effects depends on how the cosmological state is parametrized. Their evolution through the subsequent bounce is not considered here.

classification.title_zh: Horndeski 宇宙学中的吸引子与初条件敏感性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究近邻均匀宇宙历史是否会趋近或远离 Genesis 解与收缩解，并考察后期标量速度的不确定性如何影响反推的初始速度。在 Genesis 模型中，引入引力动力学可显著改变这一关系。作者发现，即使背景附近的扰动不稳定，均匀解也可能出现收敛，因此背景的吸引性不足以证明宇宙学解在物理上可行。在收缩模型中，一个幂律解吸引近邻轨迹，而另一个则排斥它们；这些效应的强度取决于宇宙学状态的参数化方式。文中未考虑这些演化经过随后反弹的过程。

papers.title: Shadow and Polarized Images of Schwarzschild-MOG Black Hole Illuminated by Thick Accretion Disk
papers.abstract: Recent EHT polarimetric observations provide a powerful probe of near-horizon physics and modified gravity. We investigate the shadow and polarization images of a static Schwarzschild-MOG black hole illuminated by geometrically thick, optically thin accretion flows. Adopting a phenomenological model and the Hou disk model, and solving null geodesics and relativistic radiative transfer, we study how the MOG parameter, inclination angle, anisotropic synchrotron emission, and flow geometry affect the total intensity and linear polarization. It is found that the MOG parameter mainly enlarges and brightens higher-order photon rings and broadens the shadow, while the inclination angle breaks axial symmetry and enhances polarized emission inside the shadow. The Hou disk model suppresses off-equatorial radiative interference and localizes polarization signals within higher-order rings. Electric vector position angle (EVPA) patterns are mostly azimuthal but vary rapidly near lensed images. These results provide theoretical diagnostics for constraining MOG with EHT/ngEHT polarimetric observations.

classification.title_zh: 厚吸积盘照射下 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞的阴影与偏振图像
classification.abstract_zh: 近期 EHT 偏振观测为近视界物理和修改引力提供了有力探针。我们研究由几何厚、光学薄吸积流照亮的静态 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞的阴影与偏振图像。采用唯象模型和 Hou 盘模型，并求解零测地线与相对论辐射转移，我们研究 MOG 参数、倾角、各向异性同步辐射和流几何如何影响总强度与线偏振。发现 MOG 参数主要增大并增亮高阶光子环、展宽阴影，而倾角破坏轴对称性并增强阴影内部的偏振辐射。Hou 盘模型抑制赤道外辐射干涉，并将偏振信号局域在高阶环内。电场矢量位置角（EVPA）图样主要为方位角向，但在透镜像附近快速变化。这些结果为利用 EHT/ngEHT 偏振观测限制 MOG 提供理论诊断。
classification.one_liner: 用厚吸积盘模型计算 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞阴影与偏振图像，分析 MOG 参数和倾角对光子环及 EVPA 的影响。

papers.title: Sourced stationary Dirac bound states around Kerr black holes
papers.abstract: Ultralight bosonic fields can form macroscopic clouds around rotating black holes, whereas the existence of analogous stationary fermionic configurations is constrained by their intrinsic spin. Here we study stationary bound states of massive Dirac fields supported by an external source on Kerr backgrounds, in the test-field approximation, with a kinematic extension to Kerr--Newman, they are not fermionic condensates in the many-body sense. By mapping the Kerr--Dirac system to a globally integrated sourced radial problem, we isolate the boundary constraints dictated by horizon causality. The angular sector shows that for $|m|=1/2$ the regular boundary branches prevent the field density from vanishing on the rotation axis, whereas modes with $|m|\ge3/2$ vanish there, the reconstructed Kerr density is only mildly oblate. Precisely at the kinematic synchronization locus, the Frobenius matrix of the Dirac operator is non-defective and devoid of logarithmic divergences. Regularity on the future horizon nevertheless selects the ingoing solution, and an exact radial flux identity shows that this solution carries a positive flux, which excludes source-free normalizable states at all frequencies. The exclusion of source-free synchronized states demonstrates that a black hole's capacity to support macroscopic stationary fields is governed not merely by superradiant kinematics, but by the interplay between horizon regularity and the positivity of the Dirac flux.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞周围带源稳态Dirac束缚态
classification.abstract_zh: 超轻玻色场可在旋转黑洞周围形成宏观云，而类似稳态费米子位形因内禀自旋受到限制。本文在试探场近似下研究Kerr背景上由外源支持的大质量Dirac场稳态束缚态，并运动学推广到Kerr-Newman；这些态不是多体意义上的费米子凝聚。通过将Kerr-Dirac系统映射为整体积分的带源径向问题，作者分离出视界因果性所要求的边界约束。角向部分表明，|m|=1/2时正则边界分支阻止场密度在旋转轴上消失，而|m|≥3/2的模式在轴上消失，重建的Kerr密度仅轻微扁率。恰在运动学同步轨迹处，Dirac算符的Frobenius矩阵非亏损且无对数发散。然而未来视界上的正则性选择入射解，精确的径向通量恒等式表明该解携带正通量，从而在所有频率下排除无源可归一化态。无源同步态被排除表明，黑洞支持宏观稳态场的能力不仅由超辐射运动学决定，还由视界正则性与Dirac通量正性之间的相互作用决定。
classification.one_liner: 研究带外源的大质量Dirac场在Kerr背景上的稳态束缚态，并证明无源同步态因视界正则性与正Dirac通量而被排除。

papers.title: Spiral Density Waves and Torque Balance in the Kerr Geometry
papers.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) in relativistic accretion discs are a key science target for the upcoming LISA mission. Existing models of disc-EMRI interactions typically rely on crude dynamical friction or Newtonian planetary migration prescriptions, which fail to capture the relativistic fluid response induced by the binary potential. In this work we address this gap by providing the relativistic calculation. We apply standard methods from self-force theory, black hole perturbation theory, and relativistic stellar perturbation theory to compute the relativistic analogue of the spiral density wave and torque-balance results underlying planetary migration. Specifically, we calculate the response of a perfect fluid disc to the perturbing potential of an EMRI, consistently incorporating pressure effects. Using a master enthalpy-like variable and linearised fluid theory, we present a set of proof-of-principle calculations that reconstruct the fluid perturbations and relativistic spiral arm structure for a range of spin values in the Kerr geometry. We derive a relativistic torque-balance equation that enables us to compute and compare local torques with the angular momentum advected through the disc, finding striking agreement when applied to our relativistic disc-EMRI solutions. This opens a promising route towards establishing torque-balance relations between integrated disc torques arising from fluid perturbations and the forces acting on EMRIs embedded in matter.

classification.title_zh: Kerr几何中的螺旋密度波与力矩平衡
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）在相对论性吸积盘中的相互作用是LISA的关键科学目标。现有盘-EMRI相互作用模型通常依赖粗糙的动力学摩擦或牛顿行星迁移方案，难以刻画双星势所引发的相对论流体响应。本文用自力理论、黑洞微扰论和相对论恒星微扰论的标准方法，计算行星迁移所依据的螺旋密度波与力矩平衡结果的相对论类比。具体而言，我们计算完美流体盘对EMRI微扰势的响应，并一致地纳入压强效应。利用类焓主变量和线性化流体理论，给出一组原理性计算，在Kerr几何中不同自旋取值下重构流体微扰与相对论螺旋臂结构。我们导出相对论力矩平衡方程，用以计算并比较局部力矩与通过盘输运的角动量，并在相对论盘-EMRI解中发现显著吻合。这为建立流体微扰产生的积分盘力矩与嵌入物质中的EMRI所受作用力之间的力矩平衡关系提供了有希望的途径。
classification.one_liner: 在Kerr时空中计算EMRI对相对论吸积盘的流体响应、螺旋密度波与相对论力矩平衡。

papers.title: Exact general solutions for cosmological scalar field evolution in a vacuum-energy dominated expansion
papers.abstract: We derive exact general solutions (as opposed to attractor particular solutions) for the evolution of a scalar field $\phi$ in a universe dominated by a background fluid with equation of state parameter $w_B = -1$, extending earlier work on exact solutions with $w_B > -1$. Straightfoward exact solutions exist when the evolution is described by a linear differential equation, corresponding to constant, linear, and quadratic potentials. In the nonlinear case, exact solutions are derived for $V = V_0\ln \phi$, $V = V_0 \phi^{1/2}$ and $V = V_0/\phi$, and the logarithmic potential also yields an exact first integral. These complicated parametric solutions are considerably less useful than those derived previously for a universe dominated by a barotropic fluid such as matter or radiation with $w_B > -1$. However, we generalize the slow-roll approximation and show that it applies to all sufficiently flat potentials in the case of a vacuum-dominated expansion, while it never applies when the universe is dominated by a background fluid with $w_B > -1$.

classification.title_zh: 真空能主导膨胀下宇宙标量场演化的精确通解
classification.abstract_zh: 本文推导了在背景流体状态方程参数 w_B=-1 的宇宙中，标量场 φ 演化的精确通解（而非吸引子特解），扩展了此前 w_B>-1 的精确解工作。当演化由线性微分方程描述时（对应常数、线性和二次势），存在直接的精确解。在非线性情形，针对 V=V0 ln φ、V=V0 φ^{1/2} 和 V=V0/φ 导出了精确解，对数势还给出精确首次积分。这些复杂参数化解不如先前在物质或辐射等 w_B>-1 的 barotropic 流体主导宇宙中得到的解有用。然而，作者推广了慢滚近似，并表明在真空能主导膨胀下它适用于所有足够平坦的势，而在 w_B>-1 背景流体主导时则从不适用。
classification.one_liner: 推导真空能主导宇宙中标量场的精确通解，并推广慢滚近似。

papers.title: Investigating tidal heating in neutron stars via gravitational Raman scattering
papers.abstract: We present a scattering amplitude formalism to study the tidal heating effects of nonspinning neutron stars incorporating both worldline effective field theory and relativistic stellar perturbation theory. In neutron stars, tidal heating arises from fluid viscosity due to various scattering processes in the interior. It also serves as a channel for the exchange of energy and angular momentum between the neutron star and its environment. In the interior of the neutron star, we first derive two master perturbation equations that capture fluid perturbations accurate to linear order in frequency. Remarkably, these equations receive no contribution from bulk viscosity due to a peculiar adiabatic incompressibility which arises in stellar fluid for non-barotropic perturbations. In the exterior, the metric perturbations reduce to the Regge-Wheeler (RW) equation which we solve using the analytical Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi (MST) method. We compute the amplitude for gravitational waves scattering off a neutron star, also known as gravitational Raman scattering. From the amplitude, we obtain expressions for the electric quadrupolar static Love number and the leading dissipation number to all orders in compactness. We then compute the leading dissipation number for various realistic equation-of-state(s) and estimate the change in the number of gravitational wave cycles due to tidal heating during inspiral in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) band. We find that the shear-viscous contribution is small. Even for cold ($T\sim 10^5$K) and weakly compact stars it changes the number of cycles by less than $10^{-2}$, about an order of magnitude below the other conservative 4PN contributions, and it decreases as $T^{-2}$ for hotter stars.

classification.title_zh: 通过引力拉曼散射研究中子星潮汐加热
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种散射振幅形式体系，结合世界线有效场论和相对论恒星微扰理论，研究非自转中子星的潮汐加热效应。在中子星中，潮汐加热源于内部各种散射过程导致的流体粘性，它也是中子星与环境之间交换能量和角动量的通道。在中子星内部，我们首先推导了两个主微扰方程，能在线性频率阶精确描述流体微扰。值得注意的是，由于非正压微扰下恒星流体出现一种特殊的绝热不可压缩性，这些方程不受体粘性贡献影响。在外部，度规微扰约化为 Regge-Wheeler 方程，我们用解析 Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi 方法求解。我们计算引力波被中子星散射的振幅，也称为引力拉曼散射。由振幅得到电四极静态 Love 数和主导耗散数的表达式，精确到致密度的所有阶。然后对多种真实状态方程计算主导耗散数，并估计在 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 频带内并合旋进过程中潮汐加热导致引力波周期数的变化。我们发现剪切粘性贡献很小。即使对冷（T~10^5K）且弱致密星，它改变周期数小于10^-2，约比其他保守的4PN贡献低一个量级，并且对更热恒星按 T^-2 减小。
classification.one_liner: 用引力拉曼散射振幅结合世界线EFT与恒星微扰，计算中子星潮汐加热及其对引力波旋进周期数的影响。

papers.title: Higher Spin Lagrangians for Black Holes in Arbitrary Dimension
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the classical gravitational multipolar structure of rotating objects studying higher-spin Lagrangians coupled to gravity in arbitrary dimensions $D=d+1$. We first consider fields described by totally symmetric tensors with $s$ indices. At finite spin, the minimal coupling depends on both the spin and spacetime dimension. We show that, in the high-spin limit $s\gg 1$, the minimal multipolar expansion becomes dimension independent and it corresponds to the one which reproduces the Kerr solution in four dimensions. Furthermore, we identify a dimension independent relation among the non-minimal coupling coefficients that allows us to reproduce the Myers-Perry multipolar structure in arbitrary dimensions. We then extend our analysis to Lagrangians involving fields with different Young representations, which are allowed in higher dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 任意维度黑洞的高自旋拉格朗日量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究任意维度 D=d+1 中与引力耦合的高自旋拉格朗日量，并考察旋转天体的经典引力多极结构。作者首先考虑由全对称张量描述的场，其具有 s 个指标。在有限自旋下，最小耦合同时依赖于自旋和时空维度。作者表明，在高自旋极限 s≫1 下，最小多极展开变得与维度无关，并对应于在四维中再现 Kerr 解的多极展开。此外，作者识别出非最小耦合系数之间一个与维度无关的关系，使其能够再现任意维度中的 Myers-Perry 多极结构。随后，作者将分析推广到涉及不同 Young 表示场的拉格朗日量，这些场在高维中是允许的。
classification.one_liner: 研究耦合引力的高自旋拉格朗日量如何再现任意维度旋转黑洞的 Kerr/Myers-Perry 多极结构。

papers.title: Superstars, quantum wormholes and von Neumann algebras
papers.abstract: We entangle heavy 1/2-BPS states in two copies of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SU($N$) Super-Yang-Mills (SYM) theory. Each copy is separately dual to an extremal, supersymmetric, singular black hole geometry, in which the horizon coincides with a singularity. General ideas in the AdS/CFT correspondence suggest that the entanglement between the two copies should lead to some form of connectivity between the two geometries---a kind of wormhole. We use von Neumann algebra methods in the SYM theory to diagnose the possible existence of such wormholes.

classification.title_zh: 超星、量子虫洞与冯·诺依曼代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在两份 N=4 SU(N) 超杨-米尔斯理论的副本中，将重的 1/2-BPS 态纠缠起来。每一份副本分别对偶于一个极端的、超对称的、奇异的黑洞几何，其视界与奇点重合。AdS/CFT 对应的一般思想表明，两份副本之间的纠缠应当在两个几何之间导致某种连通性——一种虫洞。我们使用 SYM 理论中的冯·诺依曼代数方法来诊断这种虫洞的可能存在。
classification.one_liner: 该文用 SYM 中的冯·诺依曼代数方法研究两份 N=4 SYM 中重 1/2-BPS 纠缠态是否对应对偶几何间的量子虫洞连通性。

papers.title: Imaging the two-sided black hole interior with four-point correlators
papers.abstract: We propose a boundary four-point function smeared with wavepackets, which probes local physics behind the horizon of a two-sided AdS black hole. At high frequencies, boundary wavepackets aimed at an interior bulk point travel along geodesics and scatter locally about the bulk point, factorizing the correlator into a flat-space like scattering amplitude. To obtain this configuration, we utilize a non-trivial time ordering of operators, and also use one state-dependent operator insertion moved halfway across the thermal circle. An interesting property of this observable is that it also probes features of nontrivial states: null shocks and matter shells behind the horizon show up as jumps in the observed signal as the bulk point crosses them, thereby imaging the black hole interior.

classification.title_zh: 用四点关联函数成像双侧黑洞内部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种用波包涂抹的边界四点函数，用于探测双侧 AdS 黑洞视界后的局域物理。在高频下，瞄准内部体空间点的边界波包沿测地线传播，并在该体点附近局域散射，使关联函数分解为类平空间散射振幅。为获得该构型，我们利用算符的非平凡时间排序，并使用一个跨热圆移动一半的态依赖算符插入。该可观测量还可探测非平凡态特征：当体点穿过视界后的零冲击波和物质壳时，信号出现跳变，从而对黑洞内部成像。
classification.one_liner: 提出用波包涂抹的边界四点函数，通过局域散射和信号跳变成像双侧 AdS 黑洞视界后区域。

papers.title: Black Hole Entropy and Holographic Entanglement Entropy in DGP Brane Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity with gravitational dynamics localized on the brane. We first consider the DGP brane model, in which an Einstein-Hilbert term is included in the brane action, and demonstrate that the gravitational entropy of a braneworld black hole agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy for general stationary spacetimes. We then generalize the brane-localized Einstein-Hilbert term to higher-curvature gravitational theories. For Lovelock gravity and $f(R)$ gravity on the brane, we derive the corresponding expressions for gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy and show that the two entropies also coincide for general stationary spacetimes. These results establish the equivalence between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity for a broad class of gravitational theories and contribute to a deeper understanding of holography in braneworld settings.

classification.title_zh: DGP膜引力中的黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究膜世界引力中，当引力动力学局域在膜上时，引力熵与全息纠缠熵之间的关系。作者首先考虑DGP膜模型，其中膜作用量包含Einstein-Hilbert项，并证明膜世界黑洞的引力熵在一般稳态时空中与全息纠缠熵一致。随后将膜上局域的Einstein-Hilbert项推广到高阶曲率引力理论；对于膜上的Lovelock引力和f(R)引力，推导了相应的引力熵与全息纠缠熵表达式，并证明这两种熵在一般稳态时空中也一致。这些结果在广泛一类引力理论中建立了膜世界引力中引力熵与全息纠缠熵的等价性，有助于加深对膜世界全息的理解。
classification.one_liner: 在DGP及膜上Lovelock/f(R)引力中，稳态膜世界黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵一致。

papers.title: Modular flow and the area operator
papers.abstract: In the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence, the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula relates the boundary modular Hamiltonian to the HRT area operator and the corresponding bulk modular Hamiltonian. In standard discussions of a holographic code built from perturbative excitations on a fixed classical background, the $A/4G$ term dominates over the bulk modular Hamiltonian in the limit $G \to 0$. However, this setup is insufficient to describe the action of boundary modular flows that change the classical background. In contrast, our recent discussion of `large' codes provides a useful framework to obtain a JLMS formula that relates bulk and boundary modular flows acting on appropriate states in the code. Here, one sees that the bulk modular Hamiltonian is not in fact subdominant when the modular flow defined by one state acts on another state peaked around a sufficiently different classical background. Instead, the bulk modular Hamiltonian can be of order $1/G$ and can dominate over the $A/4G$ term. Nevertheless, we show that if the two states have the same classical background except for data conjugate to the HRT area then, under mild assumptions and over a large range of flow parameters, the modular-flowed state is described by a classical background given by the HRT-area flow alone.

classification.title_zh: 模流与面积算符
classification.abstract_zh: 在 AdS/CFT 对应中，JLMS 公式将边界模哈密顿量与 HRT 面积算符以及相应的体模哈密顿量联系起来。在固定经典背景上的微扰激发所构成的全息码的标准讨论中，当 G→0 时，A/4G 项主导体模哈密顿量。然而，这一设置不足以描述改变经典背景的边界模流作用。相比之下，我们最近关于“大”码的讨论提供了一个有用框架，可获得联系码中适当态上体与边界模流的 JLMS 公式。在这里可以看到，当一个态定义的模流作用于围绕足够不同经典背景的另一个态时，体模哈密顿量实际上并非次主导；相反，体模哈密顿量可以达到 1/G 量级，并主导 A/4G 项。尽管如此，我们证明，如果两个态具有相同的经典背景，除了与 HRT 面积共轭的数据不同，那么在温和假设下并在很大范围的流参数内，模流后的态由仅由 HRT 面积流给出的经典背景描述。
classification.one_liner: 该文用“大”全息码框架推广 JLMS 公式，说明改变经典背景时体模哈密顿量可主导 A/4G 项，并给出 HRT 面积流单独描述模流后经典背景的条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与全息字典方向，涉及模流、JLMS 公式和 HRT 面积算符，与全息量子信息基础相关；但未直接涉及用户重点列出的超流超导、探针膜、QNM、气泡成核等具体支线。

papers.title: Comments on holographic spread complexity
papers.abstract: We revisit the holographic proposal relating the growth rate of spread complexity to the radial momentum of a bulk probe, aiming to identify its underlying assumptions and clarify how classical probe dynamics emerges from quantum dynamics. By quantizing AdS probes directly and using the extrapolation dictionary, we provide a more general derivation of the proposal within the probe approximation for the specified class of states. In particular, we discuss a probe analogue of the classical complexity observables appearing in the ``complexity=anything'' (CAny) framework and examine how such an observable can be quantized. Since probe dynamics is not intrinsically tied to the AdS/CFT correspondence, we also examine the proposal in flat and de Sitter spacetimes. In flat spacetime, the physical Hamiltonian does not preserve the coherent-state structure, and spread complexity measures the dispersive broadening of the wave packet rather than classical momentum. In de Sitter space, generic semiclassical wave packets in the static-patch energy representation show the same dispersive behavior. By contrast, coherent states adapted to the principal-series representation can exhibit exponential growth of spread complexity, with a growth rate that has the same time dependence as the classical radial momentum. These examples indicate that a semiclassical limit alone is not sufficient for a momentum--complexity relation.

classification.title_zh: 关于全息展布复杂度的评论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视将展布复杂度增长率与体探针径向动量联系起来的全息提案，旨在识别其基本假设并阐明经典探针动力学如何从量子动力学中涌现。通过直接量子化 AdS 探针并使用外推字典，我们在探针近似下针对特定一类态给出该提案的更一般推导。特别地，我们讨论出现在“复杂度=任意量”（CAny）框架中的经典复杂度可观测量的探针类似物，并考察此类可观测量如何被量子化。由于探针动力学并非本质上与 AdS/CFT 对应绑定，我们也在平直和 de Sitter 时空中检验该提案。在平直时空中，物理哈密顿量不保持相干态结构，展布复杂度测量的是波包的色散展宽而非经典动量。在 de Sitter 空间中，静态补丁能量表示下的一般半经典波包显示出相同的色散行为。相反，适配主系列表示的相干态可以表现出展布复杂度的指数增长，其增长率与经典径向动量具有相同的时间依赖。这些例子表明，仅靠半经典极限不足以建立动量—复杂度关系。
classification.one_liner: 该文澄清全息展布复杂度—径向动量提案的假设，并通过量子化 AdS、平直和 dS 探针说明半经典极限不足。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论全息展布复杂度与体探针径向动量的关系，属于全息复杂度/量子信息方向；不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力。

papers.title: Conformal line defects from matter-coupled 5D N=4 gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: We study a number of holographic solutions describing conformal line defects within $N=2$ SCFTs from matter-coupled $N=4$ gauged supergravity in five dimensions. For $SO(2)_D\times SO(3)$ gauge group, the gauged supergravity admits two supersymmetric $AdS_5$ vacua with $N=4$ and $N=2$ unbroken supersymmetries. It turns out that only solutions that are asymptotic to the $N=4$ vacuum are possible leading to line defects within the dual $N=2$ SCFT. In gauged supergravity with $SO(2)\times ISO(3)$ gauge group, we find similar solutions with the $N=2$ SCFT appearing in the IR while the UV field theories correspond to six-dimensional $N=(0,2)$ field theories arising from M5-branes wrapped on a hyperbolic space $H^2$. The solution with $SO(2)\times SO(3)$ symmetry is also uplifted to eleven dimensions via a consistent truncation on $H^2\times S^4$. Finally, for gauged supergravity with $SO(2)\times SO(3)\times SO(3)$ gauge group that admits two $N=4$ supersymmetric $AdS_5$ vacua, we find a solution describing a line defect that interpolates between these two vacua as well as a solution with only one asymptotic $AdS_5$ geometry.

classification.title_zh: 物质耦合的五维 N=4 规范超引力中的共形线缺陷
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在五维物质耦合 N=4 规范超引力中研究若干全息解，这些解描述 N=2 SCFT 中的共形线缺陷。对于 SO(2)_D×SO(3) 规范群，该规范超引力有两个保持 N=4 和 N=2 超对称的 AdS5 真空。结果表明，只有渐近于 N=4 真空的解可能存在，并对偶 N=2 SCFT 中的线缺陷。对于 SO(2)×ISO(3) 规范群，我们找到类似解，其 IR 出现 N=2 SCFT，而 UV 场论对应 M5 膜包裹双曲空间 H^2 得到的六维 N=(0,2) 场论。具有 SO(2)×SO(3) 对称性的解还通过 H^2×S^4 上的一致截断提升到十一维。最后，对于具有 SO(2)×SO(3)×SO(3) 规范群且有两个 N=4 超对称 AdS5 真空的规范超引力，我们找到一个描述在这两个真空之间插值的线缺陷的解，以及一个只有一个渐近 AdS5 几何的解。
classification.one_liner: 在五维 N=4 规范超引力中构造全息共形线缺陷解，并讨论其 SCFT/M5 膜对偶与十一维提升。

papers.title: Generalised Symmetries and Manifest Duality II: Curved Spacetime
papers.abstract: We extend the potential-based formulation of self-dual and duality-symmetric gauge theories developed in \cite{Chakrabarti:2025gyt} to curved spacetime. The gravitational coupling is encoded by the same metric-dependent linear map of Sen's formalism. The parent new action retains the higher-form $h$-gauge symmetry, and different gauge choices reproduce either Sen's flux-based formulation or a potential-based description in which the shadow sector decouples directly at the level of the action. We also derive explicit form of the gravitational map for the toroidally reduced theory in $D=4n$ and for a polyform formulation in arbitrary dimension, both of which apply equally to ours as well as Sen's formalism. As non-trivial checks, we reproduce the \'Alvarez-Gaum\'e-Witten gravitational anomalies of the two-dimensional chiral boson without fermionisation, and of the ten-dimensional self-dual five-form. Finally, on $\mathrm{AdS}_5\times S^5$ the physical on-shell action yields the non-vanishing boundary contribution required by holography without adding a boundary term by hand. We also establish a local on-shell identification with the textbook supergravity RR four-form potential.

classification.title_zh: 广义对称性与显式对偶 II：弯曲时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将 Chakrabarti:2025gyt 中发展的基于势的自对偶与对偶对称规范理论表述推广到弯曲时空。引力耦合由 Sen 形式中同一个依赖度规的线性映射编码。新的母作用量保留高阶形式 h-规范对称性，不同规范选择可重现 Sen 的基于通量的表述，或一种影子部门在作用量层面直接解耦的基于势的描述。我们还推导了 D=4n 中环面约化理论以及任意维多形式表述的显式引力映射，这些结果同样适用于我们的形式以及 Sen 的形式。作为非平凡检验，我们在不引入费米化的情况下重现了二维手征玻色子和十维自对偶五形式的 Álvarez-Gaumé-Witten 引力反常。最后，在 AdS5×S5 上，物理在壳作用量给出全息所要求的非零边界贡献，而无需手动添加边界项。我们还建立了与教科书超引力 RR 四形式势的局部在壳识别。
classification.one_liner: 将基于势的自对偶/对偶对称规范理论推广到弯曲时空，并用引力反常与 AdS5×S5 全息边界项作检验。

papers.title: Supergravity flows, wormholes and their pseudo-Hermitian holographic duals
papers.abstract: We find solutions to consistent truncations of supergravity where some real scalars are analytically extended to imaginary values, ensuring the metric remains real-valued. Among the solutions there are Lorentzian traversable wormholes connecting two asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes and flows that have a real metric also when uplifted to ten or eleven dimensions. We argue that the holographic duals are pseudo-Hermitian and $PT$-symmetric theories. Wormhole solutions also admit an interpretation as the low-energy theory of two stacks of branes and anti-branes after tachyon condensation. The wormhole is then dual to an entangled state of two copies of the theory that lives on a stack of branes. We present some evidence by computing the mutual information between the theories at each boundary and by identifying the Goldstone bosons associated with the breaking of the two copies of Poincar\'e symmetry to their diagonal subgroup.

classification.title_zh: 超引力流、虫洞及其伪厄米全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们找到了超引力一致截断的解，其中一些实标量被解析延拓到虚数值，同时保证度规保持实值。在这些解中，有连接两个渐近AdS时空的洛伦兹可穿越虫洞，以及在提升到十维或十一维时度规仍为实的流。我们认为其全息对偶是伪厄米且PT对称的理论。虫洞解也可解释为两叠膜与反膜在快子凝聚后的低能理论。此时虫洞对偶于生活在一叠膜上的两份理论的一个纠缠态。我们通过计算每个边界上理论之间的互信息，并识别将两份庞加莱对称性破缺到其对角子群的Goldstone玻色子，给出了一些证据。
classification.one_liner: 构造超引力流和可穿越虫洞解，并论证其全息对偶为伪厄米PT对称理论及膜/反膜快子凝聚后的纠缠态。

papers.title: Quantum channel capacity of traversable wormholes
papers.abstract: We formulate the Gao-Jafferis-Wall traversable wormhole protocol as a quantum channel and compute its quantum channel capacity. We show that this capacity is governed by the time derivative of an out-of-time-ordered correlator, hence by operator size growth in the holographic dual, and that its growth is bounded above by the Einstein gravity limit. The channel capacity therefore provides a natural benchmark for quantum simulations of traversable wormholes.

classification.title_zh: 可穿越虫洞的量子信道容量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将 Gao-Jafferis-Wall 可穿越虫洞协议表述为一个量子信道，并计算其量子信道容量。我们表明，该容量由乱序关联函数的时间导数控制，因而在全息对偶中由算符尺寸增长控制，并且其增长受爱因斯坦引力极限的上界约束。因此，该信道容量为可穿越虫洞的量子模拟提供了一个自然基准。
classification.one_liner: 将GJW可穿越虫洞协议视为量子信道，发现容量由OTOC时间导数和全息算符尺寸增长控制，并受Einstein引力上界约束。

papers.title: Spin chains for ADE quiver theories
papers.abstract: The spectral problem of four-dimensional superconformal quiver gauge theories can be mapped to one-dimensional spin chains with restricted Hilbert spaces, where the composition of neighbouring spins follows the path algebra of the quiver. To better understand such spin chains, we compute the one-loop planar dilatation operator for the 4d N=2 ADE quiver gauge theories obtained by orbifolding the N=4 Super-Yang-Mills theory and marginally deforming by independently varying the gauge couplings. This extends previous work which was mainly focused on the Z2 quiver. We characterise the general features of the resulting ADE spin-chain models and construct the 2-magnon Bethe ansatz for holomorphic states. We also evaluate, at large N, the N=2 superconformal index of these gauge theories and use it to study their protected spectrum in specific sectors.

classification.title_zh: ADE 箭图理论的自旋链
classification.abstract_zh: 四维超共形箭图规范理论的谱问题可以映射到希尔伯特空间受限的一维自旋链，其中相邻自旋的复合遵循箭图的路径代数。为更好理解这类自旋链，我们计算由 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论 orbifold 并独立变化规范耦合进行边缘形变所得到的四维 N=2 ADE 箭图规范理论的一圈平面膨胀算符。这扩展了此前主要关注 Z2 箭图的工作。我们刻画所得 ADE 自旋链模型的一般特征，并为全纯态构造 2-magnon Bethe ansatz。我们还在大 N 下计算这些规范理论的 N=2 超共形指标，并用它研究特定扇区中的受保护谱。
classification.one_liner: 计算 N=2 ADE 箭图规范理论的一圈平面膨胀算符，构建对应的受限自旋链与 2-magnon Bethe ansatz，并用大 N 超共形指标研究受保护谱。

papers.title: A JT/KPZ correspondence
papers.abstract: We point out a correspondence between the Jackiw--Teitelboim (JT) gravity and the stationary measure of the Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) equation on an interval. By relating the Schwarzian limit of the double-scaled SYK to the weakly asymmetric limit of the open ASEP, we establish that the path-integral measure defining the Euclidean evolution between two end-of-the-world branes in JT gravity can be interpreted as the stationary measure of the KPZ equation on an interval with Neumann boundary conditions. We also establish the match between correlation functions.

classification.title_zh: 一种 JT/KPZ 对应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文指出 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力与区间上 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) 方程的稳态测度之间存在对应。通过将双标度 SYK 的 Schwarzian 极限与开放 ASEP 的弱不对称极限相联系，作者证明：定义 JT 引力中两个宇宙尽头膜之间欧几里得演化的路径积分测度，可解释为具有 Neumann 边界条件的区间上 KPZ 方程的稳态测度；并建立了关联函数之间的匹配。
classification.one_liner: 建立 JT 引力中膜间欧几里得路径积分与区间 KPZ 方程稳态测度及关联函数的对应。

papers.title: $QQ\bar Q\bar Q$ Quark System and Gauge/String Duality II: String Breaking
papers.abstract: This is the second of two companion papers in which we continue developing the construction of the fully heavy tetraquark system using the gauge/string duality. Here, we extend this construction to model $SU(3)$ gauge theory with two light flavors of equal mass. As an application, we analyze the two lowest Born-Oppenheimer potentials, both analytically and numerically, for rectangular and collinear geometries. Our analysis reveals several critical scales associated with string reconnection and breaking, as well as junction annihilation and pinching. In addition, we find that the string tension is universal, whereas the string breaking distance is not.

classification.title_zh: $QQ\bar Q\bar Q$ 夸克系统与规范/弦对偶 II：弦断裂
classification.abstract_zh: 本文是两篇姊妹论文中的第二篇，继续利用规范/弦对偶发展全重四夸克系统的构造。这里将构造推广到具有两个等质量轻味夸克的 SU(3) 规范理论模型。作为应用，我们解析和数值分析了矩形与共线几何下两个最低的 Born-Oppenheimer 势。分析揭示与弦重联和断裂、以及弦结湮灭和夹断相关的若干临界尺度。此外，我们发现弦张力是普适的，而弦断裂距离不是。
classification.one_liner: 用规范/弦对偶构造含两个轻味的全重四夸克系统，并研究其最低 Born-Oppenheimer 势中的弦重联、弦断裂与弦结效应。

papers.title: Scalar-tensor interactions selected through their first-order thermodynamic dynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate the restrictive capability of first-order thermodynamics on scalar-tensor gravity. Starting from a general action containing nonlinear curvature dependence, an Einstein-tensor-Hessian coupling, and independent quadratic and cubic scalar-Hessian interactions, we derive the complete effective-fluid quantities. Simultaneously imposing Eckart's heat-conduction and shear-viscosity equations, while accounting for cancellations between interactions, substantially reduces the original operator basis and determines the geometric shear viscosity. Retaining the complete heat-conduction law, we establish an integrability condition that constrains the nonlinear Hessian interactions without prescribing the temperature and thermal conductivity. We construct explicit constitutive pairs and derive the associated thermal evolution, revealing contributions beyond the usual acceleration-aligned description. Remarkably, the thermodynamic integrability condition simplifies the scalar-metric kinetic structure such that imposing covariant degeneracy excludes the remaining nonlinear interactions, recovering the established luminal Horndeski subclass. Nonlinear thermodynamically compatible interactions nevertheless survive when degeneracy is restricted to the scalar-unitary gauge. These results establish a connection between thermodynamic integrability and dynamical degeneracy, demonstrating the potential of first-order thermodynamics as an independent and complementary criterion for selecting gravitational interactions.

classification.title_zh: 由一阶热力学动力学筛选的标量-张量相互作用
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究一阶热力学对标量-张量引力的限制能力。从包含非线性曲率依赖、Einstein-张量-Hessian耦合以及独立二次和三次标量-Hessian相互作用的通用作用量出发，推导完整的有效流体量。同时施加Eckart热传导和剪切黏性方程，并考虑相互作用间的抵消，显著约化原算符基并确定几何剪切黏性。保留完整热传导定律，建立不预设温度和热导率的可积条件，以约束非线性Hessian相互作用。构造显式本构对并推导相应热演化，揭示超出通常沿加速度描述的新贡献。热力学可积条件简化标量-度规动力学结构，使得施加协变退化排除剩余非线性相互作用，恢复已知的光速Horndeski子类；当退化仅限制在标量幺正规范时，非线性热力学相容相互作用仍可存活。这些结果建立热力学可积性与动力学退化之间的联系，表明一阶热力学可作为选择引力相互作用的独立且互补判据。
classification.one_liner: 利用一阶热力学可积条件与退化条件筛选标量-张量引力中的非线性Hessian相互作用，并联系到Horndeski子类。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典标量-张量引力与引力热力学，直接对应‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子信息。

papers.title: Strong hyperbolicity of puncture-gauge formulations of gravitational theories with second order equations of motion
papers.abstract: We prove that the modified CCZ4 (mCCZ4) formulation, used in nonlinear puncture-gauge simulations of (d+1)-dimensional Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity and four-derivative scalar-tensor theory in four dimensions, is strongly hyperbolic for both theories at sufficiently weak coupling, provided that the gauge parameters are chosen to satisfy a cone-separation condition. The proof applies to the full principal symbol of the theories, extending previous analyses based on first-order perturbation theory about the Einstein limit. We establish strong hyperbolicity by recasting the mCCZ4 equations into a formally equivalent second-order system whose derivative structure resembles that of the modified harmonic formulation of Kov\'acs and Reall. This allows us to adapt their covariant characteristic analysis and continuity argument, without assuming that individual eigenvalues or eigenvectors depend analytically on the coupling. We also show that standard CCZ4 in general relativity is strongly hyperbolic in puncture gauge away from two defective degeneracies.

classification.title_zh: 具有二阶运动方程的引力理论中穿刺规范表述的强双曲性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，修正CCZ4（mCCZ4）表述——用于(d+1)维Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet引力以及四维四导数标量-张量理论中的非线性穿刺规范模拟——在耦合足够弱时对两种理论都是强双曲的，前提是规范参数满足锥分离条件。该证明适用于理论的完整主符号，扩展了此前基于Einstein极限附近一阶微扰分析的结果。我们通过将mCCZ4方程重写为形式上等价的二阶系统来建立强双曲性，该系统的导数结构与Kovács和Reall的修正谐和表述相似。这使我们能够采用他们的协变特征分析和连续性论证，而不假设单个本征值或本征矢量解析依赖于耦合。我们还表明，广义相对论中的标准CCZ4在穿刺规范下、远离两个缺陷简并时是强双曲的。
classification.one_liner: 证明mCCZ4在弱耦合和锥分离规范条件下对Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet与四导数标量-张量理论强双曲，并表明标准CCZ4在穿刺规范下远离两个缺陷简并时强双曲。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力理论的规范表述与强双曲性，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Horizon dynamical entropies and phase space topology
papers.abstract: We study phase space topologies induced by infinite-dimensional norms as a means to solve the problem of 'integrability' of Hamiltonian generators corresponding to diffeomorphisms of a null hypersurface, with the specific goal in mind to compare different prescriptions for the dynamical entropy of black holes, which replaces the area in non-stationary regimes. We first show that for a scalar field, there exists a family of norms that would provide integrability for different polarizations. We then show that a single member of this family applies to the gravitational field, and it is given by the Sobolev norm already considered in the literature. The obstruction to the other candidates lies in the semi-positivity of the metric.

classification.title_zh: 视界动力学熵与相空间拓扑
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究由无穷维范数诱导的相空间拓扑，用以解决零类超曲面上微分同胚对应的哈密顿生成元的“可积性”问题，目标是比较黑洞动力学熵的不同方案——在非定常情形下替代面积。首先对标量场表明，存在一族范数可为不同极化提供可积性；随后表明其中单一成员适用于引力场，即文献中已考虑的 Sobolev 范数。其他候选方案的障碍在于度规的半正定性。
classification.one_liner: 用无穷维范数诱导的相空间拓扑分析零视界微分同胚生成元可积性，并比较黑洞动力学熵方案。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及经典引力中的黑洞视界、相空间与动力学熵，但未涉及全息对偶或用户所列全息超流、探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: The double copy and perturbative teleparallel gravity
papers.abstract: In this paper we analyze the double copy between gluon and graviton amplitudes within the context of teleparallel gravity. We first set up an effective Lagrangian based on minimal assumptions which reproduces the on-shell amplitudes stemming from the double-copy procedure. By straightforwardly computing the three- and four-point amplitude, this double-copy Lagrangian can be constrained up to a few real parameters when expanding to quartic order. For a specific choice of parameters, we find an exact equivalence with perturbative teleparallel gravity. This suggests that the teleparallel formulation might be well suited to make the double copy more transparent from a Lagrangian viewpoint.

classification.title_zh: 双重拷贝与微扰远平行引力
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在远平行引力框架内分析胶子与引力子振幅之间的双重拷贝。作者先基于最小假设构造一个有效拉格朗日量，使其重现双重拷贝过程得到的在壳振幅。通过直接计算三点和四点振幅，该双重拷贝拉格朗日量在展开至四次阶时可被少数实参数约束。对于特定参数选择，发现它与微扰远平行引力精确等价。这表明远平行表述可能有助于从拉格朗日视角更清晰地理解双重拷贝。
classification.one_liner: 在远平行引力框架中构造双重拷贝有效拉格朗日量，并证明特定参数下与微扰远平行引力精确等价。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究引力振幅与远平行引力表述，属于经典引力/广义相对论相关方向；不涉及全息、AdS/CFT、纠缠或黑洞信息，因此与全息重点关联较弱。

papers.title: Scalar perturbations in extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om geometry: new methods at work
papers.abstract: We study scalar radiation emitted by a particle moving along a circular orbit around a four-dimensional extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole. In particular, we calculate the energy fluxes carried by scalar waves to infinity and across the event horizon, as well as the scalar self-force acting on the particle, and express all these quantities as post-Newtonian expansions. Our results for the energy fluxes are in agreement with previous numerical findings in the literature. To solve the radial wave equation, we employ and test two distinct analytic approaches: the first is the so-called \textit{kink method}, a novel alternative stemming from quantum integrability and the second is the Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi method. The perfect agreement of the results highlights the potential of the kink method as a complementary tool for studying wave propagation in black-hole spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 极端 Reissner-Nordström 几何中的标量微扰：新方法的应用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究粒子沿四维极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞圆轨道运动时发出的标量辐射。特别地，我们计算标量波传播到无穷远和穿过事件视界的能流，以及作用在粒子上的标量自作用力，并将所有这些量表示为后牛顿展开。我们的能流结果与文献中已有数值结果一致。为求解径向波动方程，我们采用并检验两种不同的解析方法：第一种是所谓 kink 方法，一种源自量子可积性的新替代方法；第二种是 Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi 方法。结果完全一致，突显了 kink 方法作为研究黑洞时空中波传播的补充工具的潜力。
classification.one_liner: 用 kink 方法与 MST 方法计算极端 RN 黑洞圆轨道标量辐射能流与自作用力，并给出后牛顿展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属经典黑洞时空中的标量微扰与自作用力计算，直接对应经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Holographic ensembles and giant gravitons at the Leigh--Strassler fixed point
papers.abstract: Finite-rank observables in holographic quantum field theories provide stringent tests of string and M-theory, but remain challenging to compute when supersymmetry is non-maximal. In this paper, we study the finite rank partition function of the $\mathcal N=1$ Leigh-Strassler CFT, which admits an interacting Fermi-gas description. We compute the partition function explicitly in two ensembles: the canonical ensemble at fixed rank $N$, and the grand canonical ensemble, where $N$ is summed over while its conjugate chemical potential $\mu$ is held fixed. In line with recent proposals, we find that the perturbative large-$N$ and large-$\mu$ expansions in both ensembles are reproduced by the on-shell action and one-loop determinant over Kaluza--Klein modes of type IIB supergravity, with appropriate ensemble-dependent boundary terms. Furthermore, the one-loop partition function of a D3-brane giant graviton precisely matches the leading nonperturbative correction to the boundary partition functions.

classification.title_zh: Leigh–Strassler 不动点处的全息系综与巨引力子
classification.abstract_zh: 全息量子场论中的有限秩可观测量为弦论和 M 理论提供了严格检验，但在超对称非极大时仍难以计算。本文研究 N=1 Leigh-Strassler CFT 的有限秩配分函数，该理论具有相互作用的费米气体描述。我们显式计算两种系综中的配分函数：固定秩 N 的正则系综，以及将 N 求和而保持其共轭化学势 μ 固定的巨正则系综。与近期提议一致，我们发现两种系综中微扰大 N 和大 μ 展开可由 IIB 型超引力的 Kaluza-Klein 模上的在壳作用量和单圈行列式，配合适当的系综依赖边界项来重现。此外，D3 膜巨引力子的单圈配分函数精确匹配边界配分函数的主导非微扰修正。
classification.one_liner: 在 N=1 Leigh-Strassler CFT 中计算有限秩正则/巨正则配分函数，并用 IIB 超引力 KK 模与 D3 巨引力子单圈结果匹配微扰和非微扰修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息对偶、有限秩配分函数与巨引力子方向，与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜及经典引力等具体支线无直接重合。

papers.title: Cosmological Constant Screening from Quantum Horizon Chaos
papers.abstract: We propose a microscopic mechanism for screening the cosmological constant through quantum chaos of the horizon degrees of freedom. We show that in a recently proposed quantum-horizon matrix model arXiv:2406.01466, the Schwarzschild--de Sitter junction completion arXiv:2608.21178 supports a gravitationally dressed soft mode that approaches the massless minimally coupled scalar of de Sitter gravity. Interactions among the microscopic horizon degrees of freedom provide a mechanism for force relaxation. Assuming a finite-memory force spectrum with nonzero regular low-frequency weight, the gravitationally dressed soft mode undergoes Brownian diffusion after momentum relaxation. The resulting bosonic coarse-grained entropy supplements the background entropy arising from fermionic parton microstates. We propose that their sum defines the total thermodynamic entropy, which can be identified with the Gibbons--Hawking entropy of the backreacted causal horizon. Entropy generation during the diffusion regime then leads to infrared screening of the effective cosmological constant, with a universal entropy--variance coefficient agreeing with that of Kitazawa and collaborators. Radiative lifting of the soft mode provides a possible mechanism for terminating the screening regime.

classification.title_zh: 来自量子视界混沌的宇宙学常数屏蔽
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种通过视界自由度的量子混沌来屏蔽宇宙学常数的微观机制。我们表明，在近期提出的量子视界矩阵模型（arXiv:2406.01466）中，Schwarzschild–de Sitter 连接补全（arXiv:2608.21178）支持一个引力 dressing 的软模，该软模趋近于 de Sitter 引力中的无质量最小耦合标量。视界微观自由度之间的相互作用提供了力弛豫机制。假设力谱为有限记忆且具有非零正则低频权重，引力 dressing 的软模在动量弛豫后经历布朗扩散。由此产生的玻色粗粒化熵补充了来自费米子部分子微观态的背景熵。我们提出二者之和定义了总热力学熵，并可等同于反作用因果视界的 Gibbons–Hawking 熵。扩散阶段的熵产生导致有效宇宙学常数的红外屏蔽，其普适熵–方差系数与 Kitazawa 等人一致。软模的辐射抬升为终止屏蔽机制提供了一种可能途径。
classification.one_liner: 量子视界矩阵模型中的软模布朗扩散与熵产生可为有效宇宙学常数提供红外屏蔽。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦 de Sitter 视界量子混沌、矩阵模型与宇宙学常数屏蔽，与用户重点标签（全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM非线性演化、冷原子/BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力）无直接交集。

papers.title: Holographic Mutual Information in an Anisotropic Field Theory
papers.abstract: We investigate holographic mutual information in an anisotropic strongly coupled plasma within the framework of gauge/gravity duality. Considering both parallel and perpendicular strip configurations, we analyze the effects of temperature, anisotropy, strip lengths, and separation distance on the correlation structure between subsystems. For strips with equal lengths, we show that increasing temperature suppresses mutual information and reduces the size of the correlated region in the phase diagram. We find that the parallel configuration exhibits a monotonic behavior. However, the perpendicular configuration displays a more complex behavior resulting from the competition between the effects of energy density and pressure. Similar qualitative features are observed for strips with unequal lengths. Our results suggest that the directional dependence of the energy density and pressure plays an important role in the behavior of mutual information and may explain the nontrivial directional effects observed in the phase structure.

classification.title_zh: 各向异性场论中的全息互信息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在规范/引力对偶框架下研究各向异性强耦合等离子体中的全息互信息。考虑平行和垂直条带构型，分析温度、各向异性、条带长度和间隔距离对子系统间关联结构的影响。对于等长条带，我们表明温度升高会抑制互信息并缩小相图中关联区域。我们发现平行构型呈现单调行为；而垂直构型由于能量密度与压力效应之间的竞争而表现出更复杂的行为。非等长条带也观察到类似的定性特征。我们的结果表明，能量密度和压力的方向依赖在互信息行为中起重要作用，并可能解释相结构中观察到的非平凡方向效应。
classification.one_liner: 用规范/引力对偶计算各向异性强耦合等离子体中的全息互信息，揭示能量密度与压力的方向依赖对关联结构的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于全息纠缠/互信息研究，但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜或经典引力。

papers.title: Holographic Spread Complexity of a Probe Particle with General Initial Data
papers.abstract: We investigate the holographic spread complexity of a massive particle probing global AdS$_3$ with general initial data. By constructing an adapted Hamiltonian, we map each bulk geodesic to a boundary Krylov dynamical pair, whose dynamics are governed solely by the conserved chiral charges. We find that, for generic initial data, the original identification $\dot{C}\sim p_\rho$ fails; instead, both the complexity and its growth rate depend nonlinearly on the bulk Noether charges. We systematically analyze this nonlinear encoding via several perturbative expansions. We further investigate two refined variants: the symmetry-resolved spread complexity, which restores the bulk radial $\pi$-periodicity, and the chiral spread complexity, which admits an exact closed form approaching the standard complexity at small angular momentum. Finally, by directly quantizing an effective AdS$_2$ theory, we obtain a new holographic interpretation of spread complexity in terms of the lapse function.

classification.title_zh: 具有一般初始数据的探针粒子的全息扩散复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个探测整体 AdS$_3$ 的大质量粒子在一般初始数据下的全息扩散复杂度。通过构造适配的哈密顿量，我们将每条体测地线映射为一个边界 Krylov 动力学对，其动力学仅由守恒的手征荷支配。我们发现，对于一般初始数据，原先的识别 $\dot{C}\sim p_\rho$ 失效；相反，复杂度及其增长率都非线性地依赖于体 Noether 荷。我们通过若干微扰展开系统分析这种非线性编码。我们进一步研究两个改进变体：对称分辨扩散复杂度，它恢复了体径向 $\pi$ 周期性；以及手征扩散复杂度，它具有精确闭式并在小角动量下趋近标准复杂度。最后，通过直接量子化一个有效 AdS$_2$ 理论，我们得到扩散复杂度以 lapse 函数表示的新全息解释。
classification.one_liner: 将探针粒子测地线映射为边界 Krylov 动力学，揭示全息扩散复杂度对体 Noether 荷的非线性编码及 AdS$_2$/lapse 解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息扩散复杂度与 AdS/CFT 字典，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D-brane 探针等重点支线；仅与 AdS/CFT 基础及 AdS2 有效理论有一般关联。

papers.title: The DBI critical electric field in stationary non-diagonal geometries
papers.abstract: We investigate the critical electric field for the holographic Schwinger effect in general stationary non-diagonal geometries. We show that, in such backgrounds, the DBI reality condition must be formulated in terms of the electric field measured in a local orthonormal frame, since the coordinate components of the field strength need not represent a purely electric field in that frame. The critical field measured in the orthonormal frame takes the universal value \(E_{\mathrm{proper},c}=T_F\), while its coordinate expression depends on the background geometry. The resulting critical field is independently confirmed by the holographic potential analysis, through the disappearance of the potential barrier. We further illustrate the general prescription using the planar limit and the global rotating Myers--Perry--AdS geometry, which exhibit different types of metric mixing.

classification.title_zh: 稳态非对角几何中的DBI临界电场
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一般稳态非对角几何中全息Schwinger效应的临界电场。我们表明，在此类背景中，DBI实条件必须用局部正交标架中测得的电场来表述，因为场强的坐标分量在该标架中不必代表纯电场。在正交标架中测得的临界场取普适值 E_proper,c = T_F，而其坐标表达式依赖于背景几何。通过势垒消失，全息势分析独立确认了所得临界场。我们进一步用平面极限和全局旋转 Myers--Perry--AdS 几何说明该一般方案，它们表现出不同类型的度规混合。
classification.one_liner: 在稳态非对角时空中，全息Schwinger效应的DBI临界电场应以局部正交标架电场表述，并取普适值T_F。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息探针膜/DBI强场方法，与探针膜研究支线相关；但摘要未直接涉及所列重点标签中的全息超流超导、相变气泡成核、QNM或Floquet驱动等具体方向，因此相关性为中等。

papers.title: D0-brane bound states in Matrix theory: nonperturbative bounds on matrix extent, noncommutativity and spatial shape
papers.abstract: In Matrix theory, a single eleven-dimensional supergraviton is associated with a BPS bound state of D0-branes. Assuming the existence of a normalized physical BPS state, we derive nonperturbative bounds on its matrix extent, noncommutativity and spatial shape from supersymmetry in the BFSS model. The probability of matrix configurations smaller than a fixed fraction of an explicit extent scale is exponentially suppressed in the square of the number $N$ of D0-branes. In Yang-Mills variables, this scale for the trace-normalized extent is of order the cube root of the 't Hooft coupling. Relative noncommutativity, measured by a dimensionless commutator ratio, has an expectation bounded by a quantity of order the inverse of $N$, and its probability of exceeding a sufficiently large fixed multiple of the inverse of $N$ vanishes at large $N$. Concentration of the matrix extent along a fixed number of principal directions fewer than nine at large $N$ requires the total extent relative to a corresponding reference scale to diverge in probability. It also requires relative noncommutativity to be suppressed more strongly than the inverse of $N$, in every fixed finite moment of order at least one. These bounds apply to the full quantum wave function, including off-diagonal matrix degrees of freedom, and constrain the quantum structure of D0-brane bound states and the possible large-$N$ matrix geometries in Matrix theory.

classification.title_zh: Matrix理论中的D0膜束缚态：矩阵延展、非对易性与空间形状的非微扰界
classification.abstract_zh: 在Matrix理论中，单个十一维超引力子对应于D0膜的BPS束缚态。假设存在归一化的物理BPS态，我们由BFSS模型中的超对称性导出其矩阵延展、非对易性和空间形状的非微扰界。矩阵构型小于某一显式延展尺度固定比例的概率随D0膜数N的平方指数压低。在Yang-Mills变量下，迹归一化延展的这一尺度约为't Hooft耦合的立方根量级。以无量纲对易子比值衡量的相对非对易性，其期望值受N的倒数量级上界限制；超过N的倒数足够大固定倍数的概率在大N下消失。若在大N下矩阵延展集中于少于九个固定主方向，则需要总延展相对于相应参考尺度以概率发散，并且每个固定有限阶矩中相对非对易性都要比N的倒数更强地压低。这些界适用于包括非对角矩阵自由度在内的完整量子波函数，并约束D0膜束缚态的量子结构及Matrix理论中可能的大N矩阵几何。
classification.one_liner: 在BFSS矩阵模型中，利用超对称给出D0膜BPS束缚态的矩阵延展、非对易性与空间形状的非微扰限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为BFSS矩阵理论与D0膜束缚态的量子几何，不属于用户重点的全息凝聚态/超流超导、探针膜、QNM或经典引力支线。

papers.title: Holographic Entanglement Entropy of Network CFT
papers.abstract: Miao et al. \cite{Guo:2025sbm, Guo:2026prm} proposed the AdS/NCFT correspondence, which explores the gravity dual of conformal field theories defined on networks. While previous studies investigated this model within Einstein and Gauss-Bonnet gravity (first- and second-order Lovelock gravity), in this paper, we generalize the framework to higher-order Lovelock gravity and more complex network structures. We derive the extremal and junction conditions for generalized Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) surfaces in third-order Lovelock gravity, which can be naturally extended to arbitrary higher-order Lovelock theories. Focusing on a network model comprising one node and three branches, we numerically investigate the relationship between the network holographic entanglement entropy (HEE) and gravitational coupling coefficients. Furthermore, by analyzing the HEE across various network configurations, we find that the primary structural feature affecting the network HEE is the presence of internal nodes within line-shaped networks. Our results indicate that the network HEE decreases as the number or depth of internal branches increases.

classification.title_zh: 网络共形场论的全息纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: Miao 等人提出了 AdS/NCFT 对应，研究定义在网络上的共形场论的引力对偶。此前的工作已在 Einstein 引力和 Gauss-Bonnet 引力（一阶与二阶 Lovelock 引力）中研究该模型；本文将框架推广到高阶 Lovelock 引力和更复杂的网络结构。我们推导了三阶 Lovelock 引力中广义 Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）曲面的极值条件与连接条件，并可自然推广到任意高阶 Lovelock 理论。以一个包含一个节点和三条分支的网络模型为重点，我们数值研究了网络全息纠缠熵（HEE）与引力耦合系数之间的关系。进一步通过分析不同网络构型下的 HEE，我们发现影响线状网络 HEE 的主要结构特征是内部节点的存在。结果表明，随着内部支路数量或深度的增加，网络 HEE 减小。
classification.one_liner: 该文将 AdS/NCFT 的全息纠缠熵研究推广到高阶 Lovelock 引力与更复杂网络结构，并分析网络结构对 HEE 的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为 AdS/NCFT 对应下的网络全息纠缠熵及高阶 Lovelock 引力中的 RT 曲面条件，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p 波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或 Floquet 驱动等支线；与经典引力/广义相对论重点支线也仅为方法层面的 Lovelock 引力背景。

papers.title: Entanglement structure in conformal Y-junctions
papers.abstract: We study how entanglement constrains energy transmission in conformal Y-junctions using holographic and free-field models. We define pairwise effective central charges from mutual information as a natural extension of the interface entanglement coefficient. For holographic junctions, we formulate a branched RT prescription and show that the resulting entropies satisfy monogamy of mutual information. We find that the pairwise effective central charge does not always bound the corresponding energy transmission, but a correction involving finite tripartite information restores the bound, with a sharp coefficient determined by limiting saturation. Free-boson and Dirac-fermion junctions also violate the pairwise bound, but the tripartite correction fails because the tripartite information is positive or vanishing, respectively. Analytic limits and numerical results instead support a candidate square-root correction based on L-entropy, which vanishes in the holographic complete-leg prescription considered here. We discuss the possibility of a common multipartite information bound in general conformal junctions.

classification.title_zh: 共形 Y 型结中的纠缠结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用全息模型和自由场模型研究共形 Y 型结中纠缠如何约束能量传输。由互信息定义成对有效中心荷，作为界面纠缠系数的自然推广。对全息 Y 型结，我们提出分支 RT 方案，并证明所得熵满足互信息单配性。我们发现成对有效中心荷并不总能界定相应的能量传输，但引入有限三分信息修正后可恢复该界，其精确系数由极限饱和确定。自由玻色子和狄拉克费米子 Y 型结也违反成对界，但三分信息修正失效，因为其三分信息分别为正或为零。解析极限和数值结果转而支持基于 L-熵的平方根修正候选；该修正在我们考虑的全息完整腿方案中为零。我们讨论了在一般共形结中是否存在共同的多分信息界。
classification.one_liner: 共形 Y 型结中，成对有效中心荷对能量传输的约束需由三分信息（全息）或 L-熵型多分信息（自由场）修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息纠缠与 AdS/CFT 基础研究，涉及分支 RT 方案和多分量子信息；但未直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: M5-branes wrapped on topological disks from maximal 7D gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: We study new supersymmetric $AdS_5 \times \Sigma$ solutions for $\Sigma$ being a topological disk from the maximal gauged supergravity in seven dimensions with $CSO(p,q,5-p-q)$ gauge groups. These gauged supergravities can be obtained from consistent truncations of eleven-dimensional supergravity on $H^{p,q} \circ T^{5-p-q}$. We find a number of solutions with $SO(2)\times SO(2)$ and $SO(2)\times SO(3)$ symmetries from $SO(5)$ and $SO(3,2)$ gauge groups as well as $SO(2)_{\textrm{diag}}$ symmetric solutions from $SO(5)$ and $SO(4,1)$ gauge groups. Solutions with $SO(2)\times SO(3)$ symmetry preserve $16$ supercharges while the other solutions preserve only $8$ supercharges. Although some of the solutions give a holographic description of the dual $N=1$ SCFTs in four dimensions with finite central charges, most of the solutions describe codimension-2 defects within $N=(2,0)$ theories in six dimensions. For solutions with $SO(2)\times SO(2)$ and $SO(2)_{\textrm{diag}}$ symmetries from $SO(5)$ gauge group for which a complete truncation ansatz of eleven-dimensional supergravity on $S^4$ is known, we also uplift the solutions to eleven dimensions and compute the holographic central charge of the dual four-dimensional $N=1$ SCFT with $SO(2)_{\textrm{diag}}$ symmetry.

classification.title_zh: 最大七维规范超引力中包裹拓扑圆盘的 M5 膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究来自七维最大规范超引力的新超对称 AdS5×Σ 解，其中 Σ 为拓扑圆盘，规范群为 CSO(p,q,5-p-q)。这些规范超引力可由十一维超引力在 H^{p,q}∘T^{5-p-q} 上的一致截断得到。我们从 SO(5) 和 SO(3,2) 规范群找到若干具有 SO(2)×SO(2) 与 SO(2)×SO(3) 对称性的解，并从 SO(5) 和 SO(4,1) 规范群找到具有 SO(2)_diag 对称性的解。具有 SO(2)×SO(3) 对称性的解保持 16 个超荷，而其他解只保持 8 个超荷。尽管部分解给出四维有限中心荷对偶 N=1 SCFT 的全息描述，大多数解描述六维 N=(2,0) 理论中的余维二缺陷。对于来自 SO(5) 规范群、具有 SO(2)×SO(2) 与 SO(2)_diag 对称性的解——其十一维超引力在 S^4 上的完整截断拟设已知——我们还将这些解提升到十一维，并计算具有 SO(2)_diag 对称性的对偶四维 N=1 SCFT 的全息中心荷。
classification.one_liner: 在七维最大规范超引力中构造包裹拓扑圆盘的超对称 AdS5×Σ 解，并讨论其四维 N=1 SCFT 与六维余维二缺陷对偶，部分解计算了全息中心荷。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于 AdS/CFT 与超引力解构造，涉及全息中心荷和缺陷对偶；但未直接匹配用户列出的全息超流、p波、multi-trace、QNM 等重点支线。

papers.title: Beyond the Thermodynamic-Volume Limit in Holographic Complexity
papers.abstract: In the large black hole regime, holographic complexity obeys a thermodynamic-volume scaling law, while the finite-size approach to this limit remains unresolved. In this Letter, we develop an analytic description of finite-size corrections to this scaling for complexity of formation in the complexity=volume (CV) proposal of odd-dimensional equal-spinning Myers-Perry-AdS black holes. We find that the leading finite-size correction retains state dependence that is absent from the limiting thermodynamic-volume law. This correction changes sign at a distinguished Critical Horizon Ratio (CHR), where the generic leading finite-size contribution vanishes and convergence to the thermodynamic-volume law is correspondingly accelerated. We further determine the dimension dependence of the CHR analytically, showing that it approaches a finite nonextremal value at large dimension with a calculable leading finite-dimensional correction. These results show that the finite-size approach can provide a new probe of holographic structure, motivating its exploration across different realizations of holographic complexity and its eventual characterization in the dual field theory.

classification.title_zh: 超越全息复杂度中的热力学体积极限
classification.abstract_zh: 在大黑洞区域，全息复杂度遵循热力学体积标度律，但趋近该极限的有限尺寸行为仍未解决。本文针对奇数维等自旋 Myers-Perry-AdS 黑洞的复杂度=体积（CV）提议中的形成复杂度，发展有限尺寸修正的解析描述。我们发现，领头有限尺寸修正保留了极限热力学体积律中不存在的态依赖。该修正在一个特殊的临界视界比（CHR）处变号；在该处一般领头有限尺寸贡献消失，收敛到热力学体积律相应加速。我们进一步解析确定 CHR 的维度依赖，表明在大维度下它趋近一个有限非极端值，并带有可计算的头阶有限维修正。这些结果表明有限尺寸趋近可作为一种探测全息结构的新手段，值得在不同全息复杂度实现中探索，并最终在对偶场论中刻画。
classification.one_liner: 解析研究等自旋 Myers-Perry-AdS 黑洞形成复杂度的有限尺寸修正，发现领头修正保持态依赖并在临界视界比处变号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息复杂度与 AdS 黑洞几何的专门研究，不涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: A cubic theory of gravity with quasitopological-like properties for compactified cosmologies
papers.abstract: We identify a cubic combination of curvature invariants in dimension $D=7$ that when added to the Einstein-Hilbert action, yields a healthy cosmological evolution in four dimensions after compactification on a constant-curvature internal space of dimension three. For generic backgrounds it leads to fourth-order field equations, nevertheless, on a warped product of a spatially flat, homogeneous and isotropic four-dimensional universe with a constant-curvature space of radius $b(t)$, the constraint is of first order in the scale factor $a(t)$ and in $b(t)$, while the remaining equations are of second order. Requiring this property uniquely singles out the cubic theory. We study the solutions describing a four-dimensional de Sitter Universe in direct product with an internal space of stabilized radius and evaluate its linear stability under time-dependent perturbations, showing that for a given sign of the curvature of the internal space, stability of the static solution fixes the sign of the higher curvature coupling. We also argue that linearized scalar perturbations depending on the spatial coordinates obey equations with at most two time derivatives. Finally, we numerically evolve the homogeneous and isotropic system non-linearly and present evidence that for a positive bare cosmological term $\Lambda_0$ and a hyperbolic compact space, the singularity formation present in GR in this ansatz is pushed into the future by increasing the higher-curvature coupling.

classification.title_zh: 用于紧致化宇宙学的具有准拓扑类性质的三次引力理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 D=7 维中识别出一个曲率不变量的三次组合；将其加入 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量后，在三维常曲率内空间上紧致化可在四维得到健康的宇宙学演化。对一般背景它给出四阶场方程，但在空间平坦、均匀各向同性的四维宇宙与半径为 b(t) 的常曲率空间的 warped product 上，约束对尺度因子 a(t) 和 b(t) 为一阶，其余方程为二阶；要求这一性质会唯一筛选出该三次理论。我们研究四维 de Sitter 宇宙与半径稳定内空间直积的解，并在含时扰动下评估线性稳定性，表明对给定内空间曲率符号，静态解的稳定性固定了高曲率耦合的符号。我们还论证依赖空间坐标的线性标量扰动满足至多含两个时间导数的方程。最后，我们对均匀各向同性系统进行非线性数值演化，并给出证据：对于正裸宇宙学项 Λ0 和双曲紧致空间，增大高曲率耦合会把该拟设下 GR 中出现的奇点形成推后到未来。
classification.one_liner: 在 7 维构造三次曲率引力理论，紧化到 4 维后得到二阶宇宙学方程，并研究 de Sitter 稳定性与奇点演化。
