papers.title: $AdS$ Leading Regge Trajectory from String Field Theory
papers.abstract: We determine the $AdS$ mass of the leading Regge trajectory in superstring backgrounds $AdS_5\times S^5$, $AdS_4\times\mathbb{CP}^3$, and $AdS_3\times S^3\times{\cal M}_4$ with pure Ramond-Ramond (RR) flux for both ${\cal M}_4=S^3\times S^1$ and ${\cal M}_4=T^4$, to the second order in the expansion with respect to the background RR flux by solving the linearized equations of motion in closed superstring field theory. The $AdS_5$ and $AdS_4$ results are in a complete agreement with those obtained from the integrability approach to dual gauge theories, thereby providing a nontrivial check of the holographic duality beyond supersymmetry-protected quantities.

classification.title_zh: 从弦场论看 AdS 领头 Regge 轨迹
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过在闭弦场论中求解线性化运动方程，计算了纯 Ramond-Ramond 通量背景 AdS5×S5、AdS4×CP3 以及 AdS3×S3×M4（M4=S3×S1 和 T4）中领头 Regge 轨迹的 AdS 质量，精确到背景 RR 通量展开的二阶。AdS5 和 AdS4 结果与对偶规范理论的可积性方法一致，从而在超对称保护量之外对全息对偶提供了非平凡检验。
classification.one_liner: 用闭弦场论计算 AdS 背景下领头 Regge 轨迹质量，并与对偶规范理论可积性结果对照以检验全息对偶。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与弦场论基础及谱学检验，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、探针膜、QNM 或经典引力等方向。

papers.title: Second-order localization and intersecting O6-planes in scale-separated AdS vacua
papers.abstract: We construct explicit periodic second-order localization corrections to scale-separated AdS$_4$ vacua of massive type IIA supergravity on $T^6/(\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2)$. At first order, the corrections from different O6-plane families simply add. The interactions between intersecting families first enter at second order and could obstruct the continuation of the solution. We find explicit solutions for the warp factor, dilaton, full internal metric and required form fields, including the terms generated by these interactions. The metric at second order contains off-diagonal components. With a common regularization of the singular source terms, we verify the full field equations and the conditions required for a solution on a compact space. Using the pure-spinor formalism, we find that the second-order fields satisfy the supersymmetry conditions accessible at the retained orders.

classification.title_zh: 尺度分离 AdS 真空中的二阶局域化与相交 O6-平面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在大质量 IIA 型超引力于 T^6/(Z2×Z2) 上的尺度分离 AdS4 真空中，构造了显式的周期性二阶局域化修正。一阶时，不同 O6-平面族的修正简单相加。相交族之间的相互作用首次在二阶进入，并可能阻碍解的延拓。我们给出了翘曲因子、伸缩子、完整内部度规以及所需形式场的显式解，包括由这些相互作用产生的项。二阶度规包含非对角分量。采用对奇异源项的常用正则化，我们验证了完整场方程以及紧致空间上解所需的条件。利用纯旋量形式，我们发现二阶场满足在所保留阶数下可及的超对称条件。
classification.one_liner: 在 massive IIA 型超引力的尺度分离 AdS4 紧致化中构造二阶局域化修正，并验证相交 O6-平面相互作用下的场方程和超对称条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要聚焦于 massive IIA 超引力通量紧致化中的尺度分离 AdS4 真空与 O6-平面二阶修正，未涉及用户重点的全息超流/超导、p波序参量、multi-trace、QNM或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: The Matrix in Pieces: Complete BFSS Scattering at Finite Rank
papers.abstract: As two matrix blocks separate in Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind matrix quantum mechanics, the modes connecting them develop a growing excitation gap. Supersymmetry cancels their leading vacuum energy, so blocks in internal bound states can scatter as composite particles. We prove that these particle channels are asymptotically complete for the physical relative Hamiltonian at each fixed finite rank $N\ge 2$. Because a block can itself break up as its center moves away from the others, the proof must control motion on both scales. Inverse powers of the matrix radius control derivatives along internal flat directions, while the growing gap suppresses excitations between blocks. Propagation estimates then allow us to resolve successive breakups by induction on the block rank. The incoming and outgoing wave operators each have range equal to the absolutely continuous subspace, and the singular-continuous subspace vanishes. The scattering operator is thus unitary when each constituent can occupy any of its internal bound states. For a normalized incoming state of zero-energy constituents, the outgoing probability missing from the zero-energy channels equals the inclusive probability of producing at least one constituent with positive internal energy.

classification.title_zh: 分块矩阵：有限秩下完整的 BFSS 散射
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind 矩阵量子力学中，当两个矩阵块分离时，连接它们的模式会出现逐渐增大的激发能隙。超对称抵消了这些模式的领头真空能，因此处于内部束缚态的块可以作为复合粒子散射。我们证明，在每个固定有限秩 N≥2 下，物理相对哈密顿量的这些粒子通道是渐近完备的。由于一个块在中心远离其他块时自身也可能分裂，证明必须同时控制两个尺度上的运动。矩阵半径的逆幂控制沿内部平坦方向的导数，而增大的能隙抑制块之间的激发。传播估计随后允许我们通过对块秩的归纳来逐次解析分裂。入射和出射波算子的值域都等于绝对连续子空间，奇异连续子空间消失。因此，当每个组分可以占据其任意内部束缚态时，散射算子是酉的。对于由零能组分构成的归一化入射态，零能通道中缺失的出射概率等于产生至少一个具有正内部能量组分的包容概率。
classification.one_liner: 该文严格证明有限秩 BFSS 矩阵量子力学中复合块粒子通道的渐近完备性与散射算子酉性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 BFSS 矩阵模型散射的严格数学结果，与所列全息超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜及经典引力等标签无直接交集。

papers.title: Radiation from periods: Bremsstrahlung functions, wound loops, latitudes and integral constraints in ABJM
papers.abstract: The Bremsstrahlung functions of the 1/2BPS and 1/6BPS Wilson lines of ABJM theory measure their response to small deformations. We show that a single geometric object, the spectral curve of the localisation matrix model, captures both of them in closed form, together with the planar wound and latitude Wilson loops at any complex winding and framing. The fermionic function turns out to be a period of the second kind: a single hypergeometric function, which solves a second-order differential equation and is quasimodular. The bosonic one is not a period but a ratio of periods. At every coupling it is the smaller of the two, so radiation grows along the defect flow from the bosonic to the fermionic line. The key role is played by a new observable, the winding velocity, which turns out to be the 't Hooft coupling shifted by four times the fermionic function. It is at the same time the winding derivative of the wound loop and the curvature of the latitude, and the curve captures it in both incarnations through its logarithmic periods and through its periods with two charges. It is also a datum of the defect conformal field theory on the 1/2BPS line, since it fixes a new integrated four-point function of the tilt operators. All results extend to ABJ theory when the ranks of the gauge groups are not equal.

classification.title_zh: 来自周期的辐射：ABJM 中的轫致辐射函数、缠绕圈、纬度圈与积分约束
classification.abstract_zh: ABJM 理论中 1/2BPS 与 1/6BPS Wilson 线的轫致辐射函数测量其对小变形的响应。我们证明单个几何对象——局域化矩阵模型的谱曲线——能以闭合形式同时刻画二者，并给出任意复缠绕数和 framing 下的平面缠绕 Wilson 圈与纬度 Wilson 圈。费米型函数是第二类周期：一个超几何函数，满足二阶微分方程且为拟模形式；玻色型函数不是周期而是周期之比。在每个耦合下它都是两者中较小者，因此辐射沿缺陷流从玻色线增长到费米线。关键是一个新观测量缠绕速度，它等于 't Hooft 耦合移动四倍费米型函数；它同时是缠绕圈的缠绕导数和纬度圈的曲率，谱曲线通过其对数周期和带两个电荷的周期刻画这两种表现。它也是 1/2BPS 线上缺陷 CFT 的数据，因为它固定了倾斜算符的一个新的积分四点函数。所有结果在规范群秩不等时推广到 ABJ 理论。
classification.one_liner: ABJM 的谱曲线统一给出轫致辐射函数与缠绕/纬度 Wilson 圈，并揭示新的缠绕速度观测量。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 中的 Wilson 线/缺陷 CFT 与局域化矩阵模型形式结果；与用户列出的全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力等具体重点标签不直接对应，但仍是理论全息基础方向。

papers.title: The Relaxation of Quantum Near-Extremal Black Holes. (I) Microcanonical States, Pruning of Quasinormal Modes, and the Aretakis Instability
papers.abstract: The late-time relaxation of a near-extremal black hole is classically governed by an infinite tower of purely damped quasinormal modes. This poses a puzzle: the higher overtones decay at rates much larger than the energy $E$ of the black hole above extremality, so they would need black hole states below the extremal mass. We resolve it by including the quantum fluctuations that become large when $E$ falls below a scale $E_b$. We compute the retarded Green's function of a probe of conformal dimension $\Delta$ in a black hole of fixed energy, and find that each classical mode splits into a pair of poles with real parts set by $E_b$. The perturbed black hole decays as an unstable quantum system, and a pair is a resonance, i.e., a quasinormal mode, only if its energy lies within the accessible black hole spectrum. This prunes the tower to finitely many modes, all damped faster than $\Delta^2E_b$, and below $E=\Delta^2E_b/2$ none is left. For generic $\Delta$, the response of the black hole decays first as $t^{-2\Delta}$ and finally as $t^{-3/2}$, with an exponential stage in between if $E\gg\Delta^2E_b$. The same quantum effects bear on the Aretakis instability of extremal black holes, in which transverse derivatives of a perturbation grow without bound on the horizon. Like the tower of modes, it originates in the scale invariance of the classical throat, which the quantum fluctuations break. The $t^{-2\Delta}$ decay, which is the boundary counterpart of the Aretakis growth, ends by $t\sim1/E_b$, when the throat ceases to be classical, and by then horizon derivatives have grown only to a finite value. Their unbounded growth is an artifact of taking the semiclassical limit before the late-time one, two limits that in quantum mechanics do not commute.

classification.title_zh: 量子近极端黑洞的弛豫。(I) 微正则态、准正规模修剪与 Aretakis 不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞的晚期弛豫在经典上由无限多纯阻尼准正规模支配。这带来一个疑难：更高泛音的衰减率远大于黑洞高于极端性的能量 E，因此它们需要低于极端质量的黑洞态。我们通过纳入当 E 低于某个能标 E_b 时变大的量子涨落来解决它。我们计算固定能量黑洞中共形维度 Δ 探针的推迟格林函数，发现每个经典模分裂为一对极点，其实部由 E_b 设定。受扰黑洞像不稳定量子系统一样衰减；一对极点只有当其能量位于可及黑洞谱内时才是共振，即准正规模。这会将模塔修剪为有限多个模，全都比 Δ^2 E_b 衰减更快，而在 E=Δ^2 E_b/2 以下不再有模。对一般 Δ，黑洞响应先按 t^{-2Δ} 衰减，最终按 t^{-3/2} 衰减；若 E≫Δ^2E_b，中间有指数阶段。同样的量子效应影响极端黑洞的 Aretakis 不稳定性，其中微扰的横向导数在视界上无界增长。像模塔一样，它源于经典喉部的标度不变性，而量子涨落破坏该不变性。作为 Aretakis 增长的边界对应，t^{-2Δ} 衰减在 t~1/E_b 时结束，此时喉部不再经典，而到那时视界导数只增长到有限值。其无界增长是先取半经典极限再取晚期极限的假象，这两个极限在量子力学中不对易。
classification.one_liner: 量子涨落修剪近极端黑洞的经典准正规模塔，并把 Aretakis 不稳定性解释为半经典极限与晚期极限不对易的假象。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及准正规模与晚期弛豫，并讨论 Aretakis 不稳定性，与“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签相关；但不是全息凝聚态、超流超导或多分量序参量等主线。

papers.title: Topological Phase Transition of $ F_{\alpha }{}^{\gamma } F^{\alpha \beta } F_{\beta }{}^{\eta } \ F^{\lambda \mu } R_{\gamma \eta \lambda \mu } $ AdS Black Holes
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic criticality and topological properties of four-dimensional charged anti-de Sitter black holes in the presence of a nonminimal electromagnetic-curvature interaction of the form \(F_{\alpha}{}^{\gamma}F^{\alpha\beta}F_{\beta}{}^{\eta}F^{\lambda\mu}R_{\gamma\eta\lambda\mu}\). Treating the coupling perturbatively to first order, we construct the corrected black hole solutions and derive their thermodynamic quantities in the extended phase space. Conventional critical behavior is examined through the criticality conditions for the Hawking temperature in both canonical and grand canonical ensembles. We then use thermodynamic topology to investigate the global structure of equilibrium configurations and its dependence on the thermodynamic parameters. In the canonical ensemble, two distinct regimes emerge: a noncritical region characterized by a total winding number \(W=+1\), and a critical region with \(W=0\). In the grand canonical ensemble, three distinct regimes are identified according to the electric potential. Interestingly, the low- and intermediate-potential regions share the same topological number, \(W=+1\), although conventional critical points occur only in the intermediate-potential region. The high-potential region, by contrast, is characterized by \(W=0\) and exhibits no conventional critical behavior. Our findings show that thermodynamic topology provides a global characterization of equilibrium configurations that complements conventional temperature-based criticality analysis, and that the global winding number alone does not uniquely determine the existence of conventional critical points.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 含非最小电磁-曲率耦合的 AdS 黑洞拓扑相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在存在形式为 \(F_{\alpha}{}^{\gamma}F^{\alpha\beta}F_{\beta}{}^{\eta}F^{\lambda\mu}R_{\gamma\eta\lambda\mu}\) 的非最小电磁-曲率相互作用时，四维带电反 de Sitter 黑洞的热力学临界性和拓扑性质。将耦合按一阶微扰处理，我们构造了修正黑洞解，并在扩展相空间中导出其热力学量。通过正则系综与巨正则系综中霍金温度的临界条件，考察了常规临界行为。随后，我们利用热力学拓扑研究平衡构型的全局结构及其对热力学参数的依赖。在正则系综中出现两个不同区域：总绕数为 \(W=+1\) 的非临界区，以及 \(W=0\) 的临界区。在巨正则系综中，根据电势可识别出三个不同区域。有趣的是，低电势区与中间电势区具有相同的拓扑数 \(W=+1\)，尽管常规临界点只出现在中间电势区。高电势区则具有 \(W=0\)，且不显示常规临界行为。我们的结果表明，热力学拓扑提供了对平衡构型的全局刻画，补充了基于温度的常规临界性分析，并且仅凭全局绕数不能唯一决定常规临界点是否存在。
classification.one_liner: 研究含非最小电磁-曲率耦合的带电 AdS 黑洞热力学临界性，并用绕数拓扑刻画正则/巨正则系综中的平衡构型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力中的 AdS 黑洞热力学与相变临界性研究，并涉及热力学拓扑；与“相变与气泡成核”“经典引力/广义相对论”标签相关，但不涉及全息字典、量子信息或全息凝聚态。

papers.title: Flat Space Entanglement from Wedge Holography
papers.abstract: We study holographic entanglement entropy in three-dimensional flat space by combining wedge holography with a controlled flat limit of AdS end-of-the-world branes. The limit takes a wedge of AdS$_4$ bounded by two AdS$_3$ branes to a Randall-Sundrum-like configuration of two flat branes, and the entanglement entropy of an interval in the two-dimensional corner CFT becomes that of an interval at null infinity of the branes. The result has the functional form of the entanglement entropy of a two-dimensional Carrollian CFT, the proposed holographic dual of gravity in asymptotically flat three-dimensional spacetimes. However, the inferred central charges yield $c_M=0$ and $c_L\to\infty$ in the flat limit. Adding a gravitational Chern-Simons term produces a $c_M$-like contribution, but we still find $c_L\to\infty$ and $c_M\to0$ in this limit. Moreover, the corresponding extremal surfaces do not approach the swing surfaces proposed by Song and collaborators. Instead, they collapse onto null rays along null infinity. We argue that both features are generic for flat limits of AdS/CFT. They follow from entanglement entropy being a property of the domain of dependence and from the equality of causal and entanglement wedges for intervals in the vacuum.

classification.title_zh: 从楔全息看平直空间纠缠
classification.abstract_zh: 本文结合楔全息与 AdS 端壁膜的受控平直极限，研究三维平直空间中的全息纠缠熵。该极限把 AdS4 中由两个 AdS3 膜界定的楔形区域变为由两个平直膜构成的 Randall-Sundrum 型构型，并使二维角 CFT 中区间的纠缠熵变为膜上零无穷远处区间的纠缠熵。所得结果的函数形式符合二维 Carrollian CFT——即三维渐近平直时空引力的候选全息对偶——的纠缠熵。然而，推断出的中心荷在平直极限下给出 c_M=0 且 c_L→∞。加入引力 Chern-Simons 项会产生类 c_M 的贡献，但在此极限下仍得到 c_L→∞ 与 c_M→0。此外，相应极值面并不趋近 Song 等人提出的 swing surfaces，而是塌缩到沿零无穷远的零射线上。作者论证，这两个特征对于 AdS/CFT 的平直极限是普遍的，它们来自纠缠熵是依赖域的性质，以及真空中区间的因果楔与纠缠楔相等。
classification.one_liner: 楔全息的受控平直极限给出 Carrollian 型纠缠熵函数形式，但中心荷与极值面行为显示该极限的普遍退化特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 与用户重点的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动以及经典引力/广义相对论均无直接关联；仅属于全息纠缠与平直空间全息的基础研究。

papers.title: Refined R\'enyi Entropy from Replica-Geometry Tensor Networks
papers.abstract: Holographic tensor networks are a central route to understanding the mechanism behind the holographic duality, but standard fixed-graph constructions with maximally entangled links face a structural obstacle. Their leading entanglement spectra are flat, so their R\'enyi entropies do not depend on the replica index. This is in sharp contrast with holographic conformal field theories, where a tensionful cosmic brane makes the refined R\'enyi entropy $n$-dependent. Capturing this replica dependence is therefore an important test of tensor-network descriptions of holographic entanglement. We construct an explicit family of replica-dependent geodesic graphs that reproduces this behavior while keeping the links maximally entangled. For each replica index $n$, geodesics are emitted from the replicated boundary with the same local, isotropic intersection measure. They perfectly tessellate the selected replica geometry, so the $n$-dependence of their intersection counts comes from the geometry. Tensor-network models on these graphs reproduce the cosmic-brane prescription for refined R\'enyi entropy by counting crossing threads. Their cross-copy endpoint density also agrees, in CFT$_2$, with a boundary reconstruction within the additive linear combination proposal, providing a check beyond the total entropy. In higher dimensions, we further obtain an analytic large-separation decay law for this density.

classification.title_zh: 从复制几何张量网络得到精细 Rényi 熵
classification.abstract_zh: 全息张量网络是理解全息对偶机制的重要途径，但标准的固定图构造使用最大纠缠连接，其领先纠缠谱是平坦的，因此 Rényi 熵不依赖复制指标。这与全息共形场论中带张力的宇宙膜使精细 Rényi 熵依赖 n 形成鲜明对比。我们构造了一族显式的、依赖复制指标的测地线图，在保持连接最大纠缠的同时重现这种行为。对每个复制指标 n，测地线从复制边界以相同的局部各向同性相交测度发出；它们完美镶嵌所选复制几何，因此其相交计数的 n 依赖性来自几何。在这些图上的张量网络模型通过计数穿越线程重现宇宙膜对精细 Rényi 熵的 prescription。其跨副本端点密度在 CFT2 中也与加性线性组合方案下的边界重构一致，提供了总熵之外的检验。在高维中，我们进一步得到该密度的解析大间隔衰减律。
classification.one_liner: 构造依赖复制指标的测地线张量网络，用几何相交计数重现宇宙膜给出的精细 Rényi 熵的 n 依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息张量网络与精细 Rényi 熵，属于全息纠缠/量子信息基础；未涉及用户重点的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/涡旋、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7 探针膜等支线。

papers.title: The Schwarzschild-Kerr crossover of high overtone quasinormal modes
papers.abstract: A slowly rotating black hole is close to a nonrotating one, but its highly damped quasinormal spectrum is not. The Schwarzschild approximation holds only up to overtone numbers of order $\chi^{-4/3}$, where $\chi$ is the dimensionless spin. We find that the frequency shift at this scale is a universal function, derived from the wave boundary conditions with an error estimate. It is given by the spectrum of a sextic oscillator, via the correspondence between ordinary differential equations and integrable models. It recovers the Schwarzschild $\log 3$ and organizes the singular Kerr coefficients.

classification.title_zh: 高泛音准正规模的黑洞从史瓦西到克尔交叉
classification.abstract_zh: 慢旋转黑洞接近非旋转黑洞，但其高度阻尼的准正规模谱并不接近。史瓦西近似仅在泛音数约为 χ^{-4/3} 时成立，其中 χ 为无量纲自旋。作者发现该尺度上的频率移动是一个普适函数，由波边界条件推导并给出误差估计；通过常微分方程与可积模型的对应，该函数由六次振子谱给出。结果恢复史瓦西的 log 3，并组织奇异的克尔系数。
classification.one_liner: 高泛音准正规模在史瓦西与克尔之间出现由六次振子谱控制的普适交叉尺度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞准正规模的高泛音谱及其史瓦西-克尔交叉，属于经典引力与 QNM 重点方向。

papers.title: Circulating currents around orbifolded defects
papers.abstract: We investigate holographic monodromy defects with five dimensional orbifold singularities which lift to smooth and supersymmetric ten dimensional geometries. Such geometries have been of recent interest in spindle compactifications and have been interpreted as generalized Gukov-Witten defects. They are constructed by taking an orbifold of previously considered holographic monodromy defects on a space with a conical excess angle, and are not adiabatically connected to the empty anti-de Sitter vacuum. The the orbifold action acts nontrivially both on the five dimensional base as well as the five-sphere. We calculate one-point functions and anomaly coefficients as a function of the monodromies and orbifold data. Surprisingly, we discover that defects exhibit nonzero circulating currents even when all monodromies are turned off, unlike defects adiabatically connected to the vacuum, and therefore correspond to 1/8-BPS excited states. Comparing defects with nontrivial bulk topology we find that the A-type anomaly coefficient is always larger than those with trivial topology, while the B-type coefficient can be either larger or smaller.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 绕轨道折叠缺陷的环流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有五维轨道折叠奇点的全息单延拓缺陷，其提升为光滑且超对称的十维几何。此类几何近期在纺锤紧致化中受到关注，并被解释为广义 Gukov-Witten 缺陷。它们通过对先前考虑的存在锥形超额角空间上的全息单延拓缺陷做轨道折叠构造，且不与空 AdS 真空绝热连通。轨道折叠作用在五维底空间和五维球面上均非平凡。我们计算单点函数和异常系数作为单延拓参数与轨道折叠数据的函数。令人惊讶的是，即使所有单延拓参数关闭，缺陷仍表现出非零环流，这与绝热连通真空的缺陷不同，因而对应 1/8-BPS 激发态。比较具有非平凡体拓扑的缺陷，我们发现 A 型异常系数总是大于拓扑平凡情形，而 B 型系数可大可小。
classification.one_liner: 研究轨道折叠全息单延拓缺陷的单点函数与异常系数，发现关闭单延拓时仍存在非零环流并对应 1/8-BPS 激发态。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息缺陷与 AdS/CFT 字典研究，涉及轨道折叠缺陷、单点函数和异常系数，与用户重点标签中的缺陷/非均匀态方向相关；但不直接涉及超流超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM 或探针膜等支线。

papers.title: A Kerr-black-hole worldline action to $\mathcal{O}(G^5)$
papers.abstract: We establish a worldline action which correctly reproduces Kerr-black-hole dynamics up to fifth order in Newton's constant in a physical post-Minkowskian counting. This encompasses operators up to second order in the Riemann curvature tensor and up to fourth order in the spin tensor. Doing so entails performing the full effective-field-theory computation of the amplitude for a gravitational-wave scattering off of a spinning compact object up to four-loop order, and matching the result to the predictions from linear black hole perturbation theory. Quadratic-in-curvature operators which must be added to match successfully include time-reversal anti-symmetric ones at linear and cubic spin orders, capturing absorption across the black hole horizon, and conservative quadratic-in-spin ones. As an immediate application of our action, we compute the leading-order change in spin magnitude, and reproduce the leading change in mass, for a Kerr black hole in a scattering event with a second compact body, considering a generic orientation of the black hole's spin.

classification.title_zh: 至 O(G^5) 的 Kerr 黑洞世界线作用量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个世界线作用量，它在物理后闵可夫斯基计数下正确重现到牛顿常数五阶的 Kerr 黑洞动力学。该作用量包含直到黎曼曲率张量二阶和自旋张量四阶的算符。为此，我们完成了引力波被自旋致密天体散射的振幅的完整有效场论计算，直至四圈阶，并将结果与线性黑洞微扰论的预言相匹配。为成功匹配而必须加入的曲率二次算符包括在自旋线性阶和三次阶的时间反演反对称算符（刻画跨越黑洞视界的吸收），以及保守的自旋二次算符。作为该作用量的直接应用，我们计算了 Kerr 黑洞与第二个致密天体散射事件中自旋大小的领头阶变化，并在考虑黑洞自旋任意取向的情况下重现了质量的领头阶变化。
classification.one_liner: 构建到 O(G^5) 的 Kerr 黑洞世界线作用量，并用四圈 EFT 振幅匹配线性微扰论，应用于散射中的自旋与质量变化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Kerr 黑洞经典时空动力学、后闵可夫斯基展开与世界线有效场论，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，不涉及全息。

papers.title: Conserved Gravitational-wave Stress-Energy Tensor in General Metric Theories
papers.abstract: We construct a gravitational-wave (GW) stress-energy tensor for general metric theories and show that it is conserved after averaging in the wave zone. In metric theories involving a vector field, we find that the conventional GW stress-energy tensor is generally not conserved. Combining the diffeomorphism identity, we identify the vector-field contribution required in addition to the conventional GW stress-energy tensor. On this basis, in a flat vacuum wave zone with constant background fields and after short-wavelength averaging, the perturbed field equation, perturbed action, Landau-Lifshitz, and Noether current methods yield equivalent tensors. In this setting, the completed tensor is generally nonsymmetric and satisfies $\partial_\mu\tau^{\mu\nu}=0$, with energy flux $c\tau^{i0}$. It also does not depend on whether a covariant or contravariant vector is chosen as the fundamental variable. Applying this framework to Einstein-\ae ther theory, we derive the orbital energy losses of an adiabatic quasicircular compact binary, and provide a possible explanation for the discrepancies among previous results in this theory. These results establish a consistent radiation balance that allows additional gravitational degrees of freedom to be connected to the evolution of astrophysical systems and to observational tests of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 一般度规理论中的守恒引力波应力-能量张量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为一般度规理论构造引力波应力-能量张量，并证明其在波区平均后守恒。在含矢量场的度规理论中，传统引力波应力-能量张量一般不守恒；结合微分同胚恒等式，我们确定了除传统项之外所需的矢量场贡献。在此基础上，在具有常数背景场的平直真空波区并作短波平均后，微扰场方程、微扰作用量、Landau-Lifshitz 与 Noether 流方法给出等价张量。该完备张量一般非对称并满足 ∂_μ τ^{μν}=0，能流为 cτ^{i0}，且不依赖于选取协变或逆变矢量作为基本变量。将框架应用于 Einstein-aether 理论，我们推导绝热准圆致密双星的轨道能量损失，并为该理论中已有结果之间的差异提供一种可能解释。这些结果建立一致的辐射平衡，使额外引力自由度可与天体系统演化和引力观测检验相联系。

papers.title: Bondi-Sachs formalism on past light cones and an analogue of the integral mass formula
papers.abstract: Following a proposal that the thermodynamic aspects of general relativity can be found in the evolution of the past light cones of arbitrary worldlines, we generalise the Bondi-Sachs formalism to these surfaces. The observer may accelerate and rotate their tetrad, the spacetime may contain matter and a cosmological constant, and no symmetry is assumed. We impose regularity conditions at the vertex of each light cone and along the polar axis, including general axial conditions that allow for shear. Given a suitable prescription for the stresses of matter, the Einstein field equations can then be integrated hierarchically from data on a single light cone, and the regularity at the vertex fixes all constants of integration. The solution reveals a universal property: to first order in the observer's proper time, the evolution of the metric and of the four-momentum crossing the light cones is independent of the specific behaviour of matter. As an application, we derive, for an observer immersed in matter, an analogue of the integral mass formula of black hole mechanics.

classification.title_zh: 过去光锥上的 Bondi-Sachs 形式与积分质量公式的类比
classification.abstract_zh: 基于一个提议——广义相对论的热力学方面可在任意世界线过去光锥的演化中找到——我们将 Bondi-Sachs 形式推广到这些曲面。观测者的四元标架可加速和转动，时空可含物质与宇宙学常数，且不假设对称性。我们在每个光锥顶点和极轴处施加正则条件，包括允许剪切的广义轴向条件。给定合适的物质应力规定后，Einstein 场方程可由单个光锥上的数据逐层积分，顶点正则性固定所有积分常数。解显示一个普遍性质：在观测者固有时的一阶，度规和穿过光锥的四维动量的演化与物质具体行为无关。作为应用，我们为浸没于物质中的观测者导出了黑洞力学积分质量公式的类比。

papers.title: Analytic motions of spinning particles in Schwarzschild-(anti-)de Sitter spacetime
papers.abstract: The motion of a spinning test particle in a static, spherically symmetric spacetime with a cosmological constant is studied within the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon formalism, working to linear order in the particle's spin. By exploiting the symmetries of the background, the radial and latitudinal dynamics are reduced to first-order equations governed by a spin-deformed quintic polynomial. A complete classification of the real root structure of this quintic is carried out, from which the allowed orbital types for spinning particles in the Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter and Schwarzschild-de Sitter geometries follow directly. The parameter dependence of the root structure and of the stable circular orbit interval is analyzed. In particular, for values of the cosmological constant beyond the Stuchl\'ik limit, where spinless particles admit no bound orbits, spinning particles can still remain bound. The radial motion is expressed piecewise in terms of Lauricella hypergeometric functions, with the simple positive real roots of the quintic acting as branch cuts. The latitudinal motion consists of small oscillations about an equatorial plane, and its phase, governed by the same quintic, admits an analogous analytic representation.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild-(反)德西特时空中自旋粒子的解析运动
classification.abstract_zh: 在Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon形式框架下，研究静态球对称且带宇宙学常数时空中自旋测试粒子的运动，并保留到自旋线性阶。利用背景对称性，将径向与纬度动力学约化为一阶方程，并由自旋形变五次多项式支配。对该五次多项式的实根结构进行完整分类，由此直接得到Schwarzschild-反德西特和Schwarzschild-德西特几何中自旋粒子允许的轨道类型。分析根结构及稳定圆轨道区间对参数的依赖。特别地，当宇宙学常数超过Stuchlík极限（无自旋粒子无束缚轨道）时，自旋粒子仍可保持束缚。径向运动用Lauricella超几何函数分段表示，五次多项式的简单正实根作为分支割线。纬度运动是绕赤道面的小振荡，其相位由同一五次多项式支配，并具有类似的解析表示。

papers.title: Quark Stars in $f(T,\mathcal{T}) $ Gravity: Structure, Stability, and Observational Constraints
papers.abstract: Quark stars-hypothetical compact stars made entirely of deconfined quark matter-offer a clean testing ground for gravity beyond general relativity. We study their structure in $f(T,\mathcal{T})$ gravity, a teleparallel theory in which torsion is coupled directly to the trace of the energy-momentum tensor through a single constant coupling. Using the standard MIT bag description of quark matter, we solve the modified stellar structure equations and follow how the mass, radius, compactness, and surface redshift respond as the coupling is varied across its full admissible range. The maximum mass turns out to depend on the coupling in a non-monotonic way: it rises above the general relativity value, peaks near 2.02 solar masses at a moderate positive coupling, and then falls steeply as the coupling approaches a critical value at which the structure equations become singular. The two-solar-mass pulsar constraint is satisfied within a finite window of positive couplings. All configurations on the candidate stable branch satisfy causality and remain below the standard general-relativistic compactness and surface-redshift benchmarks.

classification.title_zh: f(T,𝒯) 引力中的夸克星：结构、稳定性与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 f(T,𝒯) 远平行引力中研究由退禁闭夸克物质构成的夸克星结构，其中挠率通过单一常数耦合直接与能量动量张量的迹耦合。采用 MIT 袋模型描述夸克物质，求解修改后的恒星结构方程，并考察质量、半径、致密度和表面红移随耦合常数在其允许范围内变化的行为。最大质量非单调依赖耦合：在中等正耦合附近升至约 2.02 倍太阳质量，随后在结构方程变为奇异的临界耦合附近迅速下降；两倍太阳质量脉冲星约束在有限正耦合窗口内得到满足。候选稳定支上的所有位形均满足因果性，并低于广义相对论的致密度和表面红移基准。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(T,𝒯) 远平行引力中，用 MIT 袋模型计算夸克星结构，发现最大质量随耦合非单调变化并给出脉冲星约束窗口。

papers.title: Convergence of the post-Newtonian series in the quasicircular, nonprecessing, and comparable-mass regime
papers.abstract: Post-Newtonian (PN) theory provides the analytic foundation for modeling the early inspiral of binary black holes. However, as an asymptotic series, successive PN orders do not necessarily improve agreement with the full nonlinear dynamics. While this has been explored in the extreme-mass-ratio (EMR) limit, comparable-mass systems most relevant to current observations have not been benchmarked as systematically at high PN order. We study the convergence of the PN series for non-spinning and quasi-circular systems by comparing the PN energy flux at future null infinity to a long, high-accuracy numerical relativity (NR) simulation. To enable a gauge-consistent comparison, we place both descriptions in the same BMS frame and calibrate the intrinsic PN parameters by fitting to the NR waveform in the early inspiral. We find that for orbital velocities $v\lesssim0.45$, higher PN orders continue to reduce the PN--NR flux discrepancy, with EMR terms beyond 4.5PN providing further improvement in the late inspiral. The improvement with PN order is non-monotonic with local extrema around 2.5PN and 4PN. Thus, for the comparable-mass flux comparison considered here, the first local minimum of the finite-order residual does not identify the best PN truncation order among the orders available. As $v$ approaches $\sim 0.5$ near the innermost circular orbit, higher PN orders no longer improve the agreement between NR and PN, indicating a loss of convergence. These results motivate continued high-order PN calculations and clarify the NR accuracy needed to validate them.

classification.title_zh: 准圆、无进动、可比质量区域中后牛顿级数的收敛性
classification.abstract_zh: 后牛顿（PN）理论为双黑洞早期旋进建模提供解析基础。然而作为渐近级数，逐阶 PN 未必改善与完整非线性动力学的符合。此前多在极端质量比极限探讨，当前观测最相关的可比质量系统尚未在高 PN 阶系统基准检验。我们通过将未来零无穷处 PN 能流与长时间高精度数值相对论（NR）模拟比较，研究无自旋准圆系统的 PN 级数收敛性。为规范一致比较，将两者置于同一 BMS frame，并用早期旋进 NR 波形拟合校准内禀 PN 参数。发现轨道速度 v≲0.45 时，更高 PN 阶持续减小 PN-NR 能流差异，超过 4.5PN 的 EMR 项在晚期旋进有额外改善。改善随阶数非单调，在 2.5PN 和 4PN 附近有局部极值。因此对本文可比质量能流比较，有限阶残差的首个局部极小并不对应可用阶数中的最佳 PN 截断。当 v 接近约 0.5（最内圆轨道附近），更高 PN 阶不再改善 NR 与 PN 的一致性，表明收敛性丧失。结果支持继续高阶 PN 计算，并明确验证所需 NR 精度。

papers.title: Memory effect for generalized modes in pp-wave spacetimes
papers.abstract: The memory effect of test particles interacting with pp-wave Gaussian pulses is investigated for { higher-order polynomial pp--wave modes beyond the standard quadrupolar $+$ and $\times$ profiles}. Massive geodesic equations are solved numerically for several values of the { polynomial index $m$}, allowing the analysis of velocity and energy memory effects. In order to eliminate possible coordinate artifacts, the study is formulated in terms of the relative motion between two test particles. The results show that the relative kinetic energy variation exhibits a quartic dependence on the wave amplitude in the regime of low initial velocities. The coefficient of this scaling is found to depend on the { transverse polynomial structure of the wave, reflecting the spatial gradients associated with the different modes}. It is further shown that the energy memory effect is determined by the integrated tidal field, linking the permanent change in the relative kinetic energy to the history of the spacetime curvature carried by the wave.

classification.title_zh: pp波时空中广义模式的记忆效应

papers.title: Statistics of time and frequency-averaged spectra in gravitational-wave background searches
papers.abstract: Time series analysis from gravitational-wave detectors often relies on the assumption that time chunks, or frequency bins, are uncorrelated. We discuss the validity of this approximation in the context of searches for stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds. We examine the impact of averaging over time and frequency, a reduction technique commonly employed to minimize the computational expense of likelihood evaluations. We introduce an analytical tool based on Fisher information to quantify the error in parameter inference arising from ignoring these effects. Finally, we address the issue of locally stationary processes and optimal time chunking. As an application, we study examples based on simulated data of the LISA space mission.

classification.title_zh: 引力波背景搜索中时间与频率平均谱的统计性质
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波探测器的时间序列分析常依赖时间块或频率箱互不相关的假设。我们讨论该近似在随机引力波背景搜索中的有效性，考察时间与频率平均这一常用于降低似然评估计算成本的数据压缩技术的影响。我们引入基于Fisher信息的分析工具，以量化忽略这些效应导致的参数推断误差。最后讨论局部平稳过程与最优时间分块问题，并基于LISA空间任务模拟数据给出应用示例。

papers.title: Prospect on constraining environment-dependent dilaton model from gravitational redshift measurements
papers.abstract: Scalar-tensor gravity represents a natural extension of general relativity. This paper investigates the prospects for constraining the environmentally dependent dilaton through atomic-clock comparisons across media of different densities. Using the scalar Compton wavelength, we assess how the finite size of the surrounding medium and screening by the clock enclosure limit the accessible region. To test the continuous-density approximation for dilute media, we model matter as a periodic lattice of spherical particles and compare an analytic Neumann solution with a three-dimensional finite-element solution on the cubic box. The continuous and discrete models give indistinguishable redshift predictions near the $10^{-20}$ and $10^{-25}$ benchmarks. In the strong-coupling regime, differences become apparent on redshift contours of order $10^{-46}$ or lower. Under the assumed environmental and instrumental conditions, comparisons involving a dense medium identify a window for probing smaller values of $A_2$, offering a gravitational-redshift test complementary to existing fifth-force searches.

classification.title_zh: 利用引力红移测量约束环境依赖膨胀子模型的前景
classification.abstract_zh: 标量-张量引力是广义相对论的自然扩展。本文研究通过在不同密度介质中进行原子钟比较来约束环境依赖膨胀子的前景。利用标量康普顿波长，作者评估了周围介质的有限尺寸和时钟外壳屏蔽如何限制可探测区域。为检验稀薄介质的连续密度近似，本文将物质建模为球形粒子的周期晶格，并将解析 Neumann 解与立方盒上的三维有限元解进行比较。连续模型与离散模型在 10^{-20} 和 10^{-25} 基准附近给出不可区分的红移预言；在强耦合区域，差异出现在约 10^{-46} 或更低的红移等值线上。在所假设的环境与仪器条件下，涉及致密介质的比较确定了一个探测更小 A_2 值的窗口，提供了一种与现有第五力搜寻互补的引力红移检验。

papers.title: Influence of perfect fluid dark matter on shadow observables of Yang-Mills modified charged black holes
papers.abstract: We investigate the influence of perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM) on Yang--Mills--inspired charged black holes, with a particular focus on the resulting modifications to key black hole observables. By embedding a PFDM term into the spacetime geometry, we examine the alterations in shadow morphology, photon geodesics, and the associated energy emission spectra. Our analysis reveals that PFDM induces notable deviations in the shadow size, shape, and circularity, and significantly impacts the stability of circular orbits. Furthermore, the energy emission rate exhibits a strong dependence on both the Yang--Mills charge and the dark matter distribution. These results indicate that environmental effects arising from dark matter can imprint observable signatures on black hole shadows and radiation processes, offering a potential pathway to constrain dark matter models and probe non-Kerr geometries with forthcoming high-precision observations such as those from the Event Horizon Telescope and next-generation interferometers.

classification.title_zh: 完美流体暗物质对杨-米尔斯修正带电黑洞阴影可观测量的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究完美流体暗物质（PFDM）对杨-米尔斯启发式带电黑洞的影响，特别关注由此导致的黑洞关键可观测量的修正。通过将 PFDM 项嵌入时空几何，我们考察阴影形态、光子测地线以及相关能量发射谱的变化。分析表明，PFDM 会引起阴影大小、形状和圆度的显著偏离，并显著影响圆轨道的稳定性。此外，能量发射率强烈依赖于杨-米尔斯荷和暗物质分布。这些结果表明，暗物质产生的环境效应可以在黑洞阴影和辐射过程中留下可观测印记，为利用事件视界望远镜和下一代干涉仪等高精度观测限制暗物质模型并探测非 Kerr 几何提供潜在途径。

papers.title: Area-minimizing surfaces and the rigidity of three-dimensional electrostatic systems
papers.abstract: We study three-dimensional electrostatic systems, the Riemannian data of static solutions of the Einstein--Maxwell equations with cosmological constant $\Lambda$, by means of locally area-minimizing surfaces. Such a surface with non-empty boundary on the horizons is a totally geodesic hemisphere and forces the de Sitter system. A closed one in the interior forces a system of product type, one of eight models if the scalar curvature is somewhere positive on it, among them the Bertotti--Robinson, Nariai and cold and ultracold black hole systems. No compactness, asymptotic or pinching assumption is needed. In particular, closed systems without horizons are flat or compact quotients of the Nariai--Bertotti--Robinson system. For compact systems with connected horizon, the electric field vanishes even when the system is not simply connected, and the area of the horizon is either $12\pi/\Lambda$, for de Sitter, or at most $4\pi/\Lambda$. With several horizons, every horizon whose area does not exceed the sum of the others is stable, minimizes area in its homology class and satisfies an area--charge inequality, with equality only for the charged Nariai systems; its charged Hawking mass and charge therefore lie in the parameter region of the Reissner--Nordstr\"om--de Sitter black holes. Compact systems with horizons are spherical space forms with balls removed. Noncompact systems with strictly mean-convex ends have one end, and their horizons are stable and $\pi_1$-injective and satisfy a strict area--charge inequality.

classification.title_zh: 面积最小曲面与三维静电系统的刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 研究三维静电系统，即带宇宙学常数Λ的Einstein-Maxwell方程静态解的黎曼数据，并利用局部面积最小曲面。边界位于视界上的此类曲面是全测地半球，并迫使系统为de Sitter系统。内部的闭面积最小曲面迫使系统为乘积型；若标量曲率在某处为正，则属于八种模型之一，包括Bertotti-Robinson、Nariai以及冷和超冷黑洞系统。无需紧致性、渐近或挤压假设。特别地，无视界的闭系统为平坦空间或Nariai-Bertotti-Robinson系统的紧商。对于连通视界的紧系统，即使系统非单连通，电场也消失；视界面积要么为de Sitter情形的12π/Λ，要么至多4π/Λ。存在多个视界时，每个面积不超过其余视界面积之和的视界是稳定的，在其同调类中面积最小，并满足面积-电荷不等式，等号仅在带电Nariai系统中成立；其带电Hawking质量和电荷因此位于Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter黑洞的参数区域。带视界的紧系统是挖去球体的球空间形式。具有严格平均凸端的非紧系统只有一个端，其视界稳定且π1-内射，并满足严格的面积-电荷不等式。
classification.one_liner: 用面积最小曲面证明带Λ Einstein-Maxwell静态解（三维静电系统）的刚性分类与视界面积-电荷约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Einstein-Maxwell静态解、视界刚性与面积-电荷不等式；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶。

papers.title: Late-time cosmic acceleration from matter inhomogeneities: constraints from DESI DR2 and SNe Ia
papers.abstract: We present the first observational constraints on the Misner-Sharp (MS) mass of the universe, within a newly proposed exact General Relativity solution providing a non-perturbative description of nonlinear cosmic structure formation. At early times, when statistical homogeneity and isotropy are satisfied, our model reduces to usual FLRW cosmology, accommodating Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) data. At late times, the departure from homogeneity and isotropy on scales $\lesssim 200$ Mpc -- codified in the scale-dependent redshift distribution of the MS mass -- naturally induces cosmic acceleration, through an extensive term generated by the MS mass asymptotic limit on large scales. We derive the MS mass from Baryon Acoustic Oscillation data from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) and Type Ia Supernovae, obtaining a value of the cosmological constant in agreement with $\Lambda$CDM results. We outline broader implications and future observational prospects, highlighting how multi-probe strategies -- particularly CMB lensing and the late Integrated Sachs-Wolfe effect -- can ultimately test this solution to the dark energy puzzle.

classification.title_zh: 物质非均匀性导致的晚期宇宙加速：来自 DESI DR2 和 Ia 型超新星的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一个新近提出的、可非微扰描述非线性宇宙结构形成的精确广义相对论解中，首次给出对宇宙 Misner-Sharp（MS）质量的观测限制。早期满足统计均匀和各向同性时，模型退化为通常 FLRW 宇宙学，并可容纳 CMB 数据。晚期在尺度 ≲200 Mpc 上对均匀性和各向同性的偏离——编码在 MS 质量的尺度依赖红移分布中——通过大尺度上 MS 质量渐近极限产生的一项扩展项，自然诱导宇宙加速。我们由 DESI 的 BAO 数据和 Ia 型超新星数据推导 MS 质量，得到与 ΛCDM 结果一致的宇宙学常数值。我们概述更广泛意义和未来观测前景，强调多探针策略——特别是 CMB 透镜和晚期积分 Sachs-Wolfe 效应——最终可检验这一暗能量难题的解。
classification.one_liner: 该文用精确 GR 解将晚期宇宙加速归因于物质非均匀性，并用 DESI DR2 与 SNe Ia 限制宇宙 Misner-Sharp 质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/宇宙学方向，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线相关；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Geometrothermodynamics characterization of ABG-AdS black hole immersed by string clouds
papers.abstract: Regular black holes, whose singular cores are replaced by smooth geometries sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics, provide a natural setting to study how thermodynamic stability is encoded in spacetime geometry. Conventional stability criteria, however, depend on the choice of thermodynamic potential. Here we develop the quasi-homogeneous geometrothermodynamics of the regular Ay\'on-Beato--Garc\'ia anti-de Sitter (ABG-AdS) black hole surrounded by a cloud of strings, a Legendre-invariant framework in which no potential needs to be preferred. We show that the entropy, electric monopole charge and AdS radius act as extensive variables obeying a generalized quasi-homogeneity condition, and that the equilibrium manifold then carries three families of thermodynamic metrics. We establish an exact correspondence between response-function anomalies and curvature singularities: the first metric's curvature diverges on the zero-temperature extremal boundary, where the heat capacity vanishes, signaling Davies first-order transitions, whereas the second's diverges precisely where the heat capacity does, pinpointing Davies second-order transitions. The Gibbs free energy displays a swallow-tail structure that reveals a first-order small/large black hole transition, whose metastable region is bounded by these divergences of the heat capacity, together with a Hawking--Page-type transition to thermal AdS. The string-cloud density and the electric charge jointly control the horizon structure, the admissible thermal domain and the stability intervals.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 弦云包围的ABG-AdS黑洞的几何热力学刻画
classification.abstract_zh: 规则黑洞用非线性电动力学源取代奇点核心，为研究热力学稳定性如何编码在时空几何中提供了自然框架。然而传统稳定性判据依赖于热力学势的选择。本文发展被弦云包围的规则Ayon-Beato--Garcia反德西特（ABG-AdS）黑洞的准齐次几何热力学，这是一个无需偏好任何势的Legendre不变框架。作者表明熵、电单极电荷和AdS半径作为广延变量满足广义准齐次条件，平衡流形随之携带三类热力学度规。论文建立响应函数异常与曲率奇点之间的精确对应：第一类度规的曲率在零温柔外边界发散，此处热容消失，标志Davies一阶相变；第二类度规恰在热容发散处发散，指认Davies二阶相变。Gibbs自由能呈现燕尾结构，揭示小/大黑洞一阶相变，其亚稳区由热容的这些发散界定，并伴随向热AdS的Hawking--Page型相变。弦云密度与电荷共同控制视界结构、允许的热力学区域和稳定区间。
classification.one_liner: 用准齐次几何热力学刻画弦云包围的ABG-AdS规则黑洞的相变与稳定性。

papers.title: Machine learning enables full Bayesian inference for spinning extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
papers.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), stellar-mass compact objects spiralling into massive black holes, promise to measure the masses and spins of the central black holes, reveal the strong-field environment around them and gauge cosmic distances via millihertz gravitational-wave observations. Yet most forecasts for the parameter inference of these systems assume known source parameters, and broad-prior analyses have addressed only simplified versions of the problem. The joint inversion of all 14 parameters of a spinning source from the complete prior has remained unsolved. Here we solve it for the augmented analytic kludge model: generative networks narrow the complete prior and reveal a ring of degenerate spin directions, and the exact detector likelihood determines the posterior. For a simulated one-year LISA-Taiji observation, within one ring sector we obtain, for the first time, a 14-parameter posterior of a spinning EMRI from the complete prior, the most precise yet obtained for such a source from broad priors. The redshifted mass and spin of the massive black hole are determined to two parts in $10^5$, the mass two orders of magnitude beyond any electromagnetic measurement. The compact object's redshifted mass is measured to one part in $10^4$, and its eccentric, retrograde orbit discriminates between capture channels. The 0.8% distance and sub-square-degree localization are sufficient for dark-siren cosmology. Year-long coherent analysis resolves the inspiral driven by radiation reaction itself.

classification.title_zh: 机器学习实现旋转极端质量比旋近的全贝叶斯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是恒星级致密天体旋入大质量黑洞的系统，可通过毫赫兹引力波观测测量中心黑洞质量与自旋、探测强场环境并测量宇宙距离。本文针对augmented analytic kludge模型，利用生成网络缩小完整先验并揭示自旋方向的简并环，再用精确探测器似然确定后验；对模拟的一年期LISA-Taiji观测，首次从完整先验获得旋转EMRI的14参数后验，并在宽先验下达到目前最高精度。
classification.one_liner: 用生成网络加精确似然，首次从完整先验实现旋转EMRI的14参数全贝叶斯推断。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力波天文学与黑洞参数估计，不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Prospects for Detecting Post-merger Signals from Binary Neutron Stars with Future Gravitational-Wave Detectors
papers.abstract: The post-merger (PM) phase of binary neutron star (BNS) mergers carries information about the merger remnant and the dense-matter equation of state, but its observational prospects remain uncertain. We compare two approaches to accessing this emission: the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) from the BNS population and direct PM-band detections of individually resolved mergers. Using a unified inspiral--merger--post-merger (IPM) waveform prescription and the same astrophysical population model for both calculations, we evaluate representative third-generation detector configurations involving ET, CE, and a dedicated kilohertz detector. For the representative detector networks considered, the baseline IPM model predicts that the all-source, broadband BNS SGWB exceeds the adopted detection threshold across the local merger-rate interval. In contrast, the kilohertz PM-band SGWB remains below this threshold. For individual events, over $R_0=7.6$--$250~{\rm Gpc}^{-3}\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$, the baseline IPM model predicts approximately $5$--$174$ PM-band candidates per year for the dedicated kilohertz detector, whereas the numerical-relativity cases considered here yield approximately $0.07$--$7~{\rm yr}^{-1}$.

classification.title_zh: 利用未来引力波探测器探测双中子星并合后信号的展望
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星并合的后合并阶段携带并合遗迹与致密物质状态方程的信息，但其观测前景仍不确定。我们比较两种获取该辐射的途径：来自双中子星群体的随机引力波背景，以及对单个可分辨并合事件的后合并频段直接探测。使用统一的旋进—并合—后合并波形方案和同一天体物理群体模型进行两种计算，我们评估了涉及 ET、CE 和专用千赫兹探测器的代表性第三代探测器配置。对于所考虑的代表性探测器网络，基线 IPM 模型预测全源宽带双中子星随机引力波背景在本地并合率区间内超过所采用的探测阈值；相比之下，千赫兹后合并频段随机引力波背景仍低于该阈值。对于单个事件，在 R0=7.6–250 Gpc^-3 yr^-1 范围内，基线 IPM 模型预测专用千赫兹探测器每年约 5–174 个后合并频段候选事件，而本文考虑的数值相对论情形给出约每年 0.07–7 个。
classification.one_liner: 比较双中子星并合后信号的随机背景与直接探测前景，并评估未来第三代及千赫兹引力波探测器的探测能力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦双中子星并合的引力波后合并信号与未来探测器探测前景，属于经典引力/引力波与致密星现象，不是全息研究；与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签直接对应。

papers.title: Anisotropic Fluid Inhomogeneous Cosmology
papers.abstract: We propose a new framework for inhomogeneous cosmology based on General Relativity sourced by an anisotropic fluid. The model is parametrized by a single input function, the radial Misner--Sharp mass distribution at different redshifts, and admits exact solutions to Einstein's equations. Going beyond the standard assumption of small metric perturbations, it provides a fully relativistic framework to describe the non-linear regime of cosmic structure formation. The Friedmann-Lema\^itre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) cosmology is recovered both at early times and -- on large scales only -- at late times. Our Anisotropic Fluid Inhomogeneous Cosmology (AFIC) model provides a natural mechanism through which matter inhomogeneities give rise to late-time acceleration. The extensive term driving this effect does not enter the exact metric solution and therefore does not contribute to the local gravitational potential. Rather, it emerges as a genuinely large-scale effect induced by the inhomogeneous distribution of matter at late times. This mechanism may provide a physical interpretation of the results from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI). Finally, we present a simple analytical realization of the model and use it to provide an estimate of the present-day effective dark energy density.

classification.title_zh: 各向异性流体非均匀宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 提出一个基于广义相对论、由各向异性流体作为源的非均匀宇宙学框架。模型以不同红移下的径向 Misner-Sharp 质量分布作为单一输入函数，并给出 Einstein 方程的精确解；它超越小度规扰动假设，可描述宇宙结构形成的非线性区。早期以及晚期大尺度上可恢复 FLRW 宇宙学。该模型提供一种机制，使物质非均匀性导致晚期加速；驱动该效应的大尺度项不进入精确度规解，因此不贡献局域引力势，而是作为晚期物质非均匀分布诱导的纯大尺度效应出现。该机制或可为 DESI 结果提供物理解释。文末给出一个简单解析实现，并据此估计当前有效暗能量密度。
classification.one_liner: 用各向异性流体与 Misner-Sharp 质量函数构造广义相对论精确非均匀宇宙学模型，解释晚期加速。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典广义相对论与宇宙学，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或量子引力。

papers.title: Split Ends: UV Physics branches Black Hole Hair
papers.abstract: Coupling a shift-symmetric scalar field to the Gauss-Bonnet invariant modifies black holes (BHs) via scalar hair. Here we consider this field to be the Goldstone of a complex scalar field with a symmetry-breaking potential. For BHs of a size comparable with the inverse mass gap, the gapped field tries to restore the symmetry close to the horizon, enhancing the departure from standard BHs. Moreover, BHs of the same mass can have up to three different horizon areas and surface gravities. This branching has profound consequences for BH physics, potentially observable in gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: 分叉末端：紫外物理使黑洞毛发分支
classification.abstract_zh: 将平移对称标量场与Gauss-Bonnet不变量耦合，会通过标量毛发修改黑洞。这里我们考虑该场是一个具有对称性破缺势的复标量场的Goldstone玻色子。对于尺寸与逆质量间隙相当的黑洞，有能隙的场试图在视界附近恢复对称性，从而增强对标准黑洞的偏离。此外，相同质量的黑洞最多可以有三个不同的视界面积和表面引力。这种分支对黑洞物理有深远影响，并可能在引力波中观测到。
classification.one_liner: 在标量-Gauss-Bonnet理论中，对称破缺Goldstone毛发可使同质量黑洞出现最多三个视界分支，并可能产生引力波信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究标量-Gauss-Bonnet修改引力中的经典黑洞毛发与多视界分支，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息字典，因此与全息主线关联有限。

papers.title: On the evidence of lensing in GW231123
papers.abstract: Just like light, gravitational waves may be gravitationally lensed by massive objects along their travel path, however, this has not been observed so far. GW231123 is the most massive binary black-hole merger observed to-date, and quasi-circular gravitational wave analyses infer high masses and spin parameters that are particularly sensitive to the waveform model used. Here we investigate whether gravitational lensing can account for these features. We model the signal as a superposition of multiple overlapping images of the same merger and find support for lensing across four waveform models. The lensing interpretation reduces the support for these high spins, bringing both the inferred spins and masses into closer agreement across waveform models. A comparison with a background of unlensed signals gives the lensing interpretation an estimated significance of $3.96^{+0.68}_{-0.30}\sigma$. This makes lensing a compelling interpretation of this event but is insufficient for a definitive claim.

classification.title_zh: 关于 GW231123 中透镜效应的证据
classification.abstract_zh: 像光一样，引力波在传播路径上可能被大质量天体引力透镜化，但迄今尚未观测到。GW231123 是迄今观测到的质量最大的双黑洞并合，准圆轨道引力波分析推断出高质量和自旋参数，而这些对所用波形模型特别敏感。这里我们研究引力透镜能否解释这些特征。我们将信号建模为同一次并合的多个重叠像的叠加，并在四个波形模型中发现支持透镜效应的证据。透镜解释降低了对这些高自旋的支持，使推断的自旋和质量在不同波形模型之间更一致。与未透镜信号背景比较，透镜解释的估计显著性为 3.96^{+0.68}_{-0.30}σ。这使透镜成为对该事件有说服力的解释，但不足以作出确定性断言。
classification.one_liner: 该文检验 GW231123 是否可由强透镜产生的多重像解释，并在四个波形模型下发现约 4σ 的支持，但尚不足以定论。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究引力波事件的经典引力透镜解释与波形参数推断，属于广义相对论/经典引力范畴，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: How to Play a Black Hole: Understanding Quasinormal Mode Excitation
papers.abstract: Understanding the excitation of black hole quasinormal modes is essential for interpreting gravitational-wave signals and inferring black hole properties from them. In this work, we investigate the excitation of the quasinormal modes of Schwarzschild black holes under controlled probes. In the absence of a source, we find that broader initial data suppresses mode excitation, enhancing the relative contribution of the late-time tail, while data localized near the light ring strongly suppresses overtones relative to the fundamental mode. On the other hand, plunging sources give rise to two distinct ringdown stages, associated with scattered radiation generated during the particle's infall and with the particle crossing the light ring. Finally, we investigate how much of the signal is sourced from the strong-field region by switching off the source at some finite radius. The resulting waveform is exponentially close -- in cutoff radius -- to that of a standard infall. These results provide insight into the dependence of QNM excitation on the properties and dynamics of the perturbation, and offer a controlled setting in which to investigate the origin of black hole ringdown.

classification.title_zh: 如何“演奏”黑洞：理解准正规模激发
classification.abstract_zh: 理解黑洞准正规模的激发对于解释引力波信号并从中推断黑洞性质至关重要。本文研究在受控探针下 Schwarzschild 黑洞准正规模的激发。在无源情形下，我们发现较宽的初始数据会抑制模式激发，增强晚期尾波的相对贡献；而局域在光子环附近的数据会相对于基频强烈抑制泛音。另一方面，落入源会产生两个不同的铃宕阶段，分别与粒子下落过程中产生的散射辐射以及粒子穿过光子环相关。最后，我们通过在有限半径处关闭源，研究信号中有多少来自强场区域。所得波形随截断半径指数式地接近标准落入情形。这些结果有助于理解 QNM 激发对微扰性质与动力学的依赖，并提供了一个受控环境来研究黑洞铃宕的起源。
classification.one_liner: 在受控探针下研究 Schwarzschild 黑洞 QNM 激发，分析初始数据、落入源与强场截断对铃宕波形及泛音/尾波的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞准正规模激发与铃宕波形，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并明确匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但未涉及全息方法。

papers.title: Free hyperboloidal evolution in 3D: gauge waves and constraint-violating gravitational waves
papers.abstract: Hyperboloidal evolution allows to reach future null infinity within numerical relativity simulations. This work extends the conformal compactification approach with BSSN/Z4 from spherical symmetry to full 3D simulations. This is the first free numerical hyperboloidal evolution in 3D with a common formulation of general relativity. In this first step, gauge waves and constraint-violating gravitational waves perturbing Minkowski spacetime are evolved nonlinearly and show that the implementation is reliable and signals can be successfully extracted at future null infinity.

classification.title_zh: 三维中的自由双曲层演化：规范波与违反约束的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 双曲层演化允许在数值相对论模拟中到达未来零无穷。本工作将基于 BSSN/Z4 的共形紧致化方法从球对称推广到完整三维模拟。这是首个使用广义相对论常用表述的三维自由数值双曲层演化。作为第一步，演化扰动 Minkowski 时空的规范波和违反约束的引力波，非线性地表明该实现可靠，并能在未来零无穷成功提取信号。
classification.one_liner: 将 BSSN/Z4 共形紧致化双曲层演化推广到三维，并验证规范波与违反约束引力波可在未来零无穷提取。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/数值相对论支线，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签匹配；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Stochastic gravitational waves from narrow-band cosmological magnetic fields
papers.abstract: We calculate the spectrum of gravitational waves generated by a cosmological magnetic field with a narrow-band power spectrum. For a magnetic spectrum narrowly peaked at a comoving wavenumber $k_c$, we find that the gravitational wave signal has a maximum at $2k_c$ and, as expected from momentum conservation, has a sharp cutoff at that scale. We apply this analysis to an ultralight dark matter model of magnetogenesis operating around recombination, in which an axion-photon coupling generates a helical magnetic field by parametric resonance. We determine the conditions for the resulting gravitational waves to enter the frequency range of pulsar timing experiments. Although the required frequency can be reached for sufficiently large coupling, the corresponding amplitude is below the experimental sensitivity for physically allowed energy densities of the magnetic field. We generalize this conclusion to models of magnetogenesis operating at other epochs, estimating as $T \simeq 160$ MeV the temperature of a magnetogenesis process assumed to be the source of the stochastic gravitational wave background suggested by pulsar timing arrays. We place the lower bound $T \gtrsim 1$-10 MeV on such viable models.

classification.title_zh: 窄带宇宙磁场产生的随机引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算由具有窄带功率谱的宇宙磁场产生的引力波谱。对于在共动波数 k_c 处窄峰化的磁谱，我们发现引力波信号在 2k_c 处达到最大，并且正如动量守恒所预期，在该尺度处有尖锐截断。我们将此分析应用于一种在复合时期附近运行的超轻暗物质磁成因模型，其中轴子-光子耦合通过参量共振产生螺旋磁场。我们确定所得引力波进入脉冲星计时实验频率范围的条件。尽管在足够大的耦合下可达到所需频率，但对于物理允许的磁场能量密度，相应振幅低于实验灵敏度。我们将此结论推广到在其他时期运行的磁成因模型，估计 T ≃ 160 MeV 是假定为脉冲星计时阵列所提示随机引力波背景来源的磁成因过程的温度。我们对此类可行模型给出下界 T ≳ 1-10 MeV。
classification.one_liner: 计算窄带宇宙磁场产生的随机引力波谱，并评估轴子-光子磁成因模型能否进入脉冲星计时观测频段。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为宇宙学磁成因与随机引力波，不属于 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或用户列出的全息研究支线；仅与经典引力/引力波有边缘关联。

papers.title: Inaccessibility of the Schwarzschild Singularity to Quantum Probes
papers.abstract: We revisit the Schwarzschild singularity in a semiclassical setting where the background geometry is classical and quantum effects enter through Bohmian (quantal) trajectories associated with a Klein-Gordon wave function. Using the Madelung-Bohm decomposition of the Klein-Gordon wavefunction, we show that the quantum-modified motion is equivalent to geodesic motion in an effective metric conformally related to Schwarzschild, with a conformal factor fixed by the wavefunction amplitude. Solving the wavefunction equation near $r\to 0$ determines this factor and yields finite curvature invariants, in suitable coordinates the interior extends smoothly and the effective spacetime is geodesically complete. Our result suggests that quantum probes on a prescribed classical background can experience an operationally regular effective geometry, even though the underlying Schwarzschild spacetime itself remains classically singular.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild 奇点对量子探针的不可达性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在半经典框架下重新审视 Schwarzschild 奇点：背景几何为经典，量子效应通过伴随 Klein-Gordon 波函数的 Bohmian（量子）轨迹进入。利用 Klein-Gordon 波函数的 Madelung-Bohm 分解，我们表明量子修正的运动等价于一个与 Schwarzschild 共形相关的有效度规中的测地线运动，共形因子由波函数振幅固定。在 r→0 附近求解波函数方程可确定该因子，并给出有限的曲率不变量；在适当坐标下内部平滑延展，且有效时空测地完备。我们的结果提示，在给定经典背景上的量子探针可以经历一个操作上规则的有效几何，尽管底层的 Schwarzschild 时空本身在经典意义上仍是奇异的。
classification.one_liner: 用 Madelung-Bohm 分解将 Schwarzschild 背景上的 Klein-Gordon 量子探针映射为共形有效度规中的测地线，得到有限曲率与测地完备的有效几何，从而论证奇点对量子探针不可达。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；属于经典/半经典黑洞与广义相对论支线，涉及 Schwarzschild 奇点、有效度规与测地完备性，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签。

papers.title: Quantum particle production and radiative properties of a new bumblebee black hole
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the quantum and radiative properties of a recently proposed static bumblebee black hole arising from a general Lorentz-violating vacuum configuration. The analysis begins with the geometric structure of the solution and the thermodynamic temperature obtained from the surface-gravity prescription. The associated thermodynamic topological structure is also examined. Quantum particle production is then analyzed for bosonic and fermionic fields using the tunneling method. Analytic greybody bounds are derived for spin-0, spin-1, spin-2, and spin-1/2 fields. Furthermore, full greybody factors are computed with the sixth-order WKB method, together with the corresponding absorption cross sections and their characteristic spin-dependent peak patterns. These results support the evaluation of the evaporation lifetimes and the emission rates of energy and particle modes associated with each spin contribution, followed by a comparison of the high-frequency regime with other Lorentz-violating geometries, including the metric bumblebee, metric-affine bumblebee, Kalb-Ramond, and non-commutative Kalb-Ramond black holes. In addition, greybody factors are obtained using a quasinormal-mode-based prescription.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 一种新 Bumblebee 黑洞的量子粒子产生与辐射性质
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究最近提出的、由一般 Lorentz 破缺真空构型产生的静态 Bumblebee 黑洞的量子与辐射性质。首先分析解的几何结构和由表面引力 prescription 得到的热力学温度，并考察相关的热力学拓扑结构。随后用隧穿方法分析玻色子和费米子场的量子粒子产生，给出自旋 0、1、2 和 1/2 场的解析灰体界。进一步用六阶 WKB 方法计算完整灰体因子、相应吸收截面及其自旋依赖的峰型。基于这些结果评估蒸发寿命以及各自旋贡献对应的能量和粒子模式发射率，并将高频区域与包括 metric bumblebee、metric-affine bumblebee、Kalb-Ramond 和非对易 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞在内的其他 Lorentz 破缺几何进行比较。此外，还用基于准正规模的规定获得灰体因子。
classification.one_liner: 研究新 Bumblebee 黑洞的热力学、量子隧穿辐射、灰体因子与蒸发寿命，并与多种 Lorentz 破缺黑洞比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/半经典黑洞、热力学与 QNM/灰体辐射研究，和用户重点中的经典引力及 QNM 支线相关；但不涉及全息对偶、全息超流超导、multi-trace 等核心全息方向。

papers.title: Searching for cosmic strings via black hole spin-down
papers.abstract: Cosmic strings that are attached to rapidly spinning black holes can extract significant amounts of rotational energy and angular momentum. Here, we study the effect on primordial black holes, which are expected to form with one or more cosmic strings attached. Although large primordial black holes of mass greater than O$(10 M_\odot)$ are predicted to rapidly spin up due to accretion soon after forming, we argue that cosmic strings will spin them down again. We show that if there are cosmic strings with tension greater than $10^{-20}$, and, provided at least one remains attached, the spins of large primordial black holes should consequently be observed to be near zero. We also investigate the effect on a supermassive black hole of capturing a cosmic string and discuss the possibility of observing the subsequent spin down by its effect on a pulsar orbiting the black hole.

classification.title_zh: 通过黑洞自旋减速搜寻宇宙弦
classification.abstract_zh: 附着在快速自转黑洞上的宇宙弦可以提取大量旋转能量和角动量。我们研究了对原初黑洞的影响，预计原初黑洞形成时会附有一条或多条宇宙弦。虽然质量大于约10个太阳质量的大原初黑洞预计在形成后不久由于吸积而迅速自旋，但我们认为宇宙弦会使它们再次减速。我们表明，如果宇宙弦张力大于10^{-20}，并且至少有一条保持附着，那么大原初黑洞的自旋应被观测到接近零。我们还研究了超大质量黑洞俘获宇宙弦的效应，并讨论了通过其对绕黑洞运行的脉冲星的影响来观测随后自旋减速的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 宇宙弦附着于黑洞可提取转动能，使大质量原初黑洞自旋接近零，并可能通过脉冲星观测超大质量黑洞自旋减速。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究宇宙弦与黑洞自旋等经典引力现象，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论方向，不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Gravitational Bremsstrahlung Waveform at the fourth Post-Minkowskian order and the second Post-Newtonian level
papers.abstract: Using the Multipolar Post-Minkowskian formalism, we compute the frequency-domain waveform generated by the gravitational scattering of two nonspinning bodies at the fourth post-Minkowskian order ($O(G^4)$, or two-loop order), and at the fractional second Post-Newtonian accuracy ($O(v^4/c^4)$). The waveform is decomposed in spin-weighted spherical harmonics and the needed radiative multipoles, $U_{\ell m}(\omega), V_{\ell m}(\omega)$, are explicitly expressed in terms of a small number of master integrals. The basis of master integrals contains both (modified) Bessel functions, and solutions of inhomogeneous Bessel equations with Bessel-function sources. We show how to express the latter in terms of Meijer G functions. The low-frequency expansion of our results is checked againg existing classical soft theorems. We also complete our previous results on the $O(G^2)$ bremsstrahlung waveform by computing the $O(G^3)$ spectral densities of radiated energy and momentum, in the rest frame of one body, at the thirtieth order in velocity.

classification.title_zh: 第四后闵可夫斯基阶与第二后牛顿阶的引力轫致辐射波形
classification.abstract_zh: 使用多极后闵可夫斯基形式，我们计算了两个无自旋天体引力散射在第四后闵可夫斯基阶（O(G^4)，或两圈阶）和分数第二后牛顿精度（O(v^4/c^4)）产生的频域波形。波形按自旋加权球谐函数分解，所需的辐射多极矩 U_{\ell m}(\omega), V_{\ell m}(\omega) 被显式表示为少量主积分。主积分基包含（修正）Bessel 函数以及以 Bessel 函数为源的非齐次 Bessel 方程的解。我们展示如何将后者用 Meijer G 函数表示。我们的结果的低频展开与现有经典软定理进行了核对。我们还通过计算在一天体静止系中、速度的第三十阶辐射能量和动量的 O(G^3) 谱密度，完成了先前关于 O(G^2) 轫致辐射波形结果。
classification.one_liner: 计算无自旋双体引力散射在 4PM/2PN 的频域引力轫致辐射波形，并给出主积分与低频谱密度结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的后闵可夫斯基引力波波形计算，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Cubic Curvature Corrections to Taub-NUT-AdS Black Holes and Their Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate cubic curvature corrections to four-dimensional Taub-NUT-AdS black holes and their thermodynamics. We construct the complete analytic solution to the first order in the higher-derivative couplings, and derive the corrected Hawking temperature and Wald entropy. The NUT potential remains unchanged, while reconstructing the NUT charge and Gibbs free energy through the Maxwell relation leaves just one undetermined function of the NUT parameter. We then independently evaluate the Gibbs free energy using two improved Reall-Santos methods, based on either the field redefinition or the background subtraction. After matching the thermodynamic variables, both methods yield identical results and fix the undetermined function, providing a consistent determination of the mass and NUT charge. Our work therefore establishes that the thermodynamics of Taub-NUT-AdS black hole withstands the higher-derivative corrections.

classification.title_zh: 四维 Taub-NUT-AdS 黑洞的三次曲率修正及其热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究四维 Taub-NUT-AdS 黑洞的三次曲率修正及其热力学。我们构造了直到高阶导数耦合一阶的完整解析解，并导出修正的 Hawking 温度和 Wald 熵。NUT 势保持不变；通过 Maxwell 关系重构 NUT 荷和 Gibbs 自由能后，只留下一个依赖 NUT 参数的未定函数。随后用两种改进的 Reall-Santos 方法独立计算 Gibbs 自由能，分别基于场重定义和背景减除。在匹配热力学变量后，两种方法给出相同结果并确定该未定函数，从而一致地确定质量和 NUT 荷。我们的工作因此表明 Taub-NUT-AdS 黑洞的热力学经得起高阶导数修正。
classification.one_liner: 构造四维 Taub-NUT-AdS 黑洞的三次曲率修正解，并用两种 Reall-Santos 方法检验其修正热力学的自洽性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS 黑洞的经典引力与高阶曲率修正热力学，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点；但摘要未涉及全息对偶、全息凝聚态或用户列出的其他全息研究支线，因此相关性为中等。

papers.title: Resonant electroweak clouds around Schwarzschild black holes
papers.abstract: We construct nonlinear electroweak clouds around Schwarzschild black holes in the bosonic Weinberg-Salam theory. These configurations are supported by harmonically time-dependent charged gauge fields, while their energy-momentum tensor remains static. Regularity at the horizon imposes a resonance condition relating the field frequency to the horizon electrostatic potential. Unlike linear clouds, these solutions exhibit a finite mass and electric charge gap, and exist only up to a maximal horizon size. We obtain both magnetic and electric clouds, including spherically symmetric and dipolar configurations, which reduce to electroweak balls in the vanishing-horizon limit. We also report a new family of dipolar electroweak balls, which can be energetically favoured over their spherical and magnetic counterparts at fixed electric charge. Our results, obtained in the probe limit for electroweak couplings away from their measured values, establish a new realization of nonlinear resonant vector hair in a non-Abelian gauge-Higgs theory.

classification.title_zh: 史瓦西黑洞周围的共振电弱云
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在玻色 Weinberg-Salam 理论中构建了围绕史瓦西黑洞的非线性电弱云。这些构型由随时间简谐振荡的带电规范场支持，而其能量-动量张量保持静态。视界处的正则性给出将场频率与视界静电势联系起来的共振条件。与线性云不同，这些解具有有限的质量和电荷隙，并且只存在到最大视界尺寸。我们得到磁性和电性云，包括球对称和偶极构型，它们在视界消失极限下退化为电弱球。我们还报告了一类新的偶极电弱球，在固定电荷下可能比球对称和磁性对应物在能量上更有利。我们在电弱耦合偏离测量值的探针极限下得到的结果，在非阿贝尔规范-希格斯理论中建立了一种非线性共振矢量毛发的新实现。
classification.one_liner: 在史瓦西黑洞背景的非阿贝尔规范-希格斯理论中构造出具有质量/电荷隙的非线性共振电弱云和偶极电弱球。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题不是 AdS/CFT/全息，但涉及黑洞经典背景、非阿贝尔矢量毛发和非均匀孤子/云，与经典引力及孤子/非均匀重点支线相关。

papers.title: Cohomological Aspects of Entanglement Entropy: From Information Theory to Noncommutative Geometry
papers.abstract: We develop a cohomological framework for entanglement entropy that unifies information theory, operator algebras, and noncommutative geometry. Entropy is a 1-cocycle in information cohomology; we generalize this to the quantum setting via Hochschild and cyclic cohomology. For an inclusion of von Neumann algebras N contained in M with a faithful normal state w admitting a cyclic and separating vector, and a conditional expectation E: M -> N (whose existence is equivalent to modular invariance of N by Takesaki's theorem), we construct the entanglement complex as the image of the transgression map tau_w on the relative cyclic complex, where A is a dense *-subalgebra of M and B = A intersect N. Our main result identifies entanglement cohomology with the kernel of the restriction map HC*(A) -> HC*(B), up to the connecting homomorphism d of the long exact sequence of the pair (A,B); when d = 0, the identification is exact. The relative modular cocycle u_t = (Dw : D(w|_N) o E)_t generates explicit entanglement classes when E is not w-invariant, with the Araki relative entropy as its infinitesimal generator. The framework accommodates Type III von Neumann algebras, where no local density matrix exists, and leads to a holographic proposal: a subspace of H^1_ent is conjecturally dual to linearized modular Hamiltonian perturbations of the bulk entanglement wedge. We verify the construction in finite-dimensional, type II_1, and type III_1 examples.

classification.title_zh: 纠缠熵的上同调方面：从信息论到非交换几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为纠缠熵发展了一个上同调框架，统一信息论、算子代数与非交换几何。熵是信息上同调中的 1-余循环；我们通过 Hochschild 与循环上同调将其推广到量子情形。对于 von Neumann 代数包含 N⊂M，配有忠实正规态 w 且存在循环分离向量，以及条件期望 E:M→N（其存在性由 Takesaki 定理等价于 N 的模不变性），我们在相对循环复形上以转射映射 τ_w 的像构造纠缠复形，其中 A 是 M 的稠密 *-子代数，B=A∩N。主要结果将纠缠上同调等同于限制映射 HC*(A)→HC*(B) 的核，精确到配对 (A,B) 长正合序列的连接同态 d；当 d=0 时该等同是精确的。当 E 不是 w-不变时，相对模余循环 u_t=(D w:D(w|_N)∘E)_t 生成显式的纠缠类，其无穷小生成元为 Araki 相对熵。该框架适用于不存在局域密度矩阵的 Type III von Neumann 代数，并给出一个全息提议：H^1_ent 的一个子空间被猜想对偶于体纠缠楔的线性化模 Hamiltonian 微扰。我们在有限维、type II_1 与 type III_1 例子中验证了该构造。
classification.one_liner: 用 Hochschild/循环上同调刻画算子代数包含的纠缠熵，并提出与体纠缠楔模 Hamiltonian 微扰对偶的猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究算子代数与非交换几何中的纠缠熵上同调，虽包含全息对偶猜想，但与用户关注的全息超流、p波序参量、畴壁/涡旋、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet驱动及经典引力支线均无直接对应。

papers.title: Flat Space Physics from AdS Actions
papers.abstract: Flat spacetimes are foliated by hyperbolic slices that are geometrically three-dimensional de Sitter or anti-de Sitter spaces. As such, it is possible to construct flat space holographic dualities by applying the AdS/CFT bulk-to-boundary dictionary slice by slice. In this work, we reduce 4D actions for massless scalars in both Minkowski space and Klein space and massive scalars in Minkowski space to actions on these 3D dS and AdS slices. In both Minkowski and Klein space, the reduced theories have a continuous spectrum of fields originating from the reduction over the noncompact $x^2$ direction. These actions are linked by boundary terms arising from field configurations discontinuous across the lightcone. In the massless case, different asymptotic limits of the reduced field near the boundary of the unit hyperbolic slice replicate either lightcone or null infinity limits of the field; in the massive case, only one boundary mode of the reduced field has a simple geometric interpretation.

classification.title_zh: 从 AdS 作用量看平直时空物理
classification.abstract_zh: 平直时空可由几何上为三维 de Sitter 或反 de Sitter 空间的双曲切片叶状化。因此，可以逐片应用 AdS/CFT 的体-边界字典来构造平直时空全息对偶。本文把四维 Minkowski 空间与 Klein 空间中无质量标量场的作用量，以及 Minkowski 空间中有质量标量场的作用量，约化到这些三维 dS 与 AdS 切片上的作用量。在 Minkowski 与 Klein 空间中，约化理论都因沿非紧 x^2 方向约化而具有连续场谱。这些作用量由跨越光锥不连续场构型产生的边界项相联系。无质量情形下，约化场在单位双曲切片边界附近的不同渐近极限分别重现场的类光无穷远或零无穷远极限；有质量情形下，只有一个约化场边界模式具有简单的几何解释。
classification.one_liner: 将平直时空按双曲切片约化，并逐片套用 AdS/CFT 字典，为平直时空全息对偶构造标量场作用量基础。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论平直时空全息与 AdS/CFT 字典的逐片应用，属于全息理论；但未涉及用户列出的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、相变等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Multi-Centered Black Hole Index from a Superconformal Quiver Index
papers.abstract: We formulate a $D(2,1;0)$ superconformal index for scaling quiver quantum mechanics in its gauged sigma model description which preserves the hyperK\"ahler with torsion geometry. These quivers describe the Coulomb-branch dynamics of multi-centered D-brane configurations in the $AdS_2$ scaling limit of type II Calabi--Yau compactifications. Using supersymmetric localization, we derive a fixed-point formula for this superconformal quiver index and identify the geometric origin of its saddle equations and fixed-point contributions. We compare the result with the configurational index of multi-centered BPS black holes, finding the same universal denominator and angular momentum weights but different saddle equations. We then examine the additional scaling contributions to the microscopic quiver index and show that, for the symmetric three-center cyclic family, the unequal-sign scaling term is exactly reproduced by the superconformal index.

classification.title_zh: 来自超共形quiver指标的多中心黑洞指标
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为保持扭转超Kähler几何的标度quiver量子力学规范sigma模型表述构造了一个D(2,1;0)超共形指标。这些quiver描述II型Calabi-Yau紧化AdS2标度极限中多中心D膜构型的Coulomb支动力学。利用超对称局域化，我们推导出该超共形quiver指标的固定点公式，并识别其鞍点方程与固定点贡献的几何起源。我们将结果与多中心BPS黑洞的构型指标比较，发现相同的普适分母和角动量权重，但鞍点方程不同。随后我们考察对微观quiver指标的额外标度贡献，并证明对于对称三中心循环族，不等号标度项被超共形指标精确重现。
classification.one_liner: 构造D(2,1;0)超共形quiver指标并用局域化计算，与多中心BPS黑洞构型指标比较，证明三中心循环族标度贡献精确重现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦AdS2标度极限下的超共形quiver指标与多中心BPS黑洞指标，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜等支线。

papers.title: Algebraic traversable wormholes
papers.abstract: We discuss a large $N$ limit for the thermofield double state which at the extreme ($N=\infty$) limit is dual in the bulk to a back-reacted traversable wormhole, by making use of an operator in the algebra at infinity, an algebra familiar in the literature from the study of quasi-local algebras. We also compute, from a purely algebraic perspective, the effects registered by a left universe observer due to a unitary fluctuation on the right universe of the traversable wormhole, and reproduce a result from an earlier computation by Maldacena, Stanford and Yang \cite{Maldacena:2017axo}.

classification.title_zh: 代数可穿越虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论热场双态的一个大 N 极限；在 N=∞ 极限下，其在体引力中对应于一个考虑背反作用的可穿越虫洞，方法是利用无穷远代数中的一个算符，该代数在准局域代数研究中已为人熟知。我们还从纯代数视角计算可穿越虫洞右宇宙上的幺正涨落对左宇宙观测者所记录的影响，并重现 Maldacena、Stanford 和 Yang 早先计算的一个结果。
classification.one_liner: 用无穷远代数与 TFD 大 N 极限描述背反作用可穿越虫洞，并代数重现 MSY 的左右宇宙扰动效应。

papers.title: Charge at regular centers in curvature-coupled electrodynamics
papers.abstract: An electric or magnetic flux through shrinking symmetry spheres ordinarily produces an $r^{-4}$ Maxwell stress and a singular center. We examine how this obstruction changes when the Maxwell invariant is multiplied by an arbitrary scalar-curvature response $h(R)$. For real, static, spherically symmetric solutions, the difference between the radial and temporal gravitational equations gives a linear equation for a composite response variable. Combined with the trace equation, it bounds the response-weighted Maxwell source whenever the Kretschmann scalar is bounded, without assuming a limit or derivative bounds for the Ricci scalar. Magnetic and electric displacement charges cannot coexist, and neither charge is possible if $h$ remains bounded and bounded away from zero. On either surviving charged branch, the Ricci scalar converges and the weighted source tends to zero. Magnetic charge requires $h=o(r^4)$, whereas electric displacement requires $r^4|h|\to\infty$. Exact solutions show that these thresholds are sharp and realize the $r^6$ magnetic and $r^{-6}$ electric rates for a smooth geometric center. We also classify the zero-response sector, where an electric field may survive even though its displacement charge vanishes.

classification.title_zh: 曲率耦合电动力学中规则中心的电荷
classification.abstract_zh: 穿过收缩对称球面的电通量或磁通量通常产生 r^{-4} Maxwell 应力和奇异中心。我们考察当 Maxwell 不变量乘以任意标量曲率响应 h(R) 时这一障碍如何改变。对于实的、静态、球对称解，径向与时间引力方程之差给出复合响应变量的线性方程。结合迹方程，在 Kretschmann 标量有界时，它给出响应加权 Maxwell 源的界，而不假设 Ricci 标量的极限或导数界。磁位移电荷与电位移电荷不能共存；若 h 有界且远离零，则两种电荷都不可能。在任一幸存的带电分支上，Ricci 标量收敛且加权源趋于零。磁荷要求 h=o(r^4)，而电位移要求 r^4|h|→∞。精确解表明这些阈值是尖锐的，并对光滑几何中心实现 r^6 磁性和 r^{-6} 电性速率。我们还分类零响应扇区，其中电场可以存活即使其位移电荷消失。
classification.one_liner: 研究曲率耦合电动力学中规则中心对电荷的限制及精确解阈值。

papers.title: Boundary preparation and anomalous relaxation near a black hole exceptional point
papers.abstract: We study the relaxation of a Robin scalar field near a stable exceptional point of a planar Schwarzschild AdS black hole, where finite boundary driving controls the recovery time without changing the leading decay rate at linear order. At the exceptional point, two weighted moments of the source determine the time dependence of the leading response. When the zeroth moment vanishes while the first remains nonzero, the linear time factor is eliminated, leaving an ordinary exponential decay. With suitable boundary preparation, a perturbation that retains more energy at release can nevertheless reach a common recovery threshold sooner. At the exceptional point, its recovery time advantage over a fixed reference that retains the linear factor grows as $\gamma_*^{-1}\log\log(1/\theta)$ as the common amplitude threshold $\theta$ approaches zero, where $\gamma_*$ is the common decay rate. The source moments also determine the constant term in this asymptotic time difference. Full scalar field evolution on a fixed background near the exceptional point illustrates the reversal for pulses matched in duration, boundary task, source cost, and injected work, within the time window where the small spectral splitting remains unresolved. The injected work also modifies the final spectrum through gravitational heating. When weak driving begins with a black hole at the exceptional point, the temperature rise is quadratic in the source amplitude, whereas the final pole splitting is linear in its magnitude. This splitting limits the time window over which the exceptional point recovery law can be observed.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞例外点附近的边界制备与反常弛豫
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究平面 Schwarzschild AdS 黑洞稳定例外点附近的 Robin 标量场弛豫。有限边界驱动控制恢复时间，但在线性阶不改变主导衰减率。在例外点，源的两个加权矩决定主导响应的时间依赖；当零阶矩消失而一阶矩非零时，线性时间因子被消除，只剩普通指数衰减。通过适当的边界制备，释放时保留更多能量的扰动反而可能更早达到共同恢复阈值。在例外点，相对于保留线性因子的固定参考，其恢复时间优势随共同振幅阈值 θ→0 按 γ_*^{-1} log log(1/θ) 增长，其中 γ_* 是共同衰减率；源矩也决定该渐近时间差的常数项。固定背景上完整标量场演化展示了在持续时间、边界任务、源成本和注入功匹配的脉冲之间的反转，且处于小谱分裂尚未分辨的时间窗口内。注入功还通过引力加热改变最终谱。当弱驱动从处于例外点的黑洞开始时，温升与源振幅的平方成正比，而最终极点分裂与其幅度成线性关系；该分裂限制了可观测例外点恢复律的时间窗口。
classification.one_liner: 研究 AdS 黑洞例外点附近由边界源矩控制的标量场反常恢复时间及其受极点分裂和引力加热限制的观测窗口。

papers.title: Black hole binary mergers in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity with regularisation
papers.abstract: We study the non-linear dynamics of Chern-Simons gravity with numerical relativity for the first time. We use the regularisation prescription to obtain a well-posed initial-value formulation in the gauges commonly used in numerical relativity, and we simulate head-on collisions and binary black hole mergers in the regime of validity of effective field theory, extracting the corresponding scalar and gravitational waves. This opens up the possibility to test general effective field theories of gravity, including those with higher-than-second-order equations of motion, with gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: 带正则化的动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中的黑洞双星并合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次使用数值相对论研究 Chern-Simons 引力的非线性动力学。我们采用正则化方案，在数值相对论常用规范下得到适定的初值表述，并在有效场论适用范围内模拟正面碰撞和双黑洞并合，提取相应的标量与引力波。这为利用引力波检验广义有效场论引力理论（包括运动方程为高于二阶的理论）开辟了可能。
classification.one_liner: 首次用数值相对论模拟动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中的黑洞碰撞与并合，并提取标量波和引力波。
