papers.title: Gauge and scale dependence of the quadratic backreaction source during inflation: Uniform-expansion gauge
papers.abstract: Cosmological backreaction is most directly expressed through the local expansion of the spacetime foliation, so uniform-expansion (UE) slicing provides a natural geometrical setting in which to examine the quadratic effective energy-momentum tensor (2EMT) of scalar perturbations during slow-roll inflation. We impose the complete scalar gauge conditions $\kappa=0$ and $E=0$. The uniform-expansion condition gives a \textit{differential} constraint for the shift $Q$ in configuration space and satisfies $Q_{\mathrm{UE}}(k)=-3(\Psi'+\mathcal H\Psi)/(k^2+3\epsilon\mathcal H^2)$ for each Fourier mode. In the strict infrared, the UE source vanishes at zero gradient, while its first nonzero terms are $\widehat\tau_{00}^{\mathrm{UE}}/\mathcal F_{\mathrm{LW}} \simeq8\sigma_1^2/\epsilon$ and $\widehat\tau_{ii}^{\mathrm{UE}}/\mathcal F_{\mathrm{LW}} \simeq-8\sigma_1^2/(3\epsilon)$ at leading slow-roll order. Thus $w_{\rm raw}^{\mathrm{UE}}\simeq-1/3$, but the first finite-gradient coefficients differ from the comoving and uniform-density gauges. Sufficiently deep in the gradient-dominated intermediate infrared, the leading UE behavior approaches the spatially-flat result, whereas the crossover region between the strict and intermediate infrared regimes requires the full expressions for the 2EMT. In the ultraviolet, we have $\widehat\tau_{00}^{\mathrm{UE}}\simeq2\mathcal F_{\mathrm{SW}}$ and $\widehat\tau_{ii}^{\mathrm{UE}}\simeq(2/3)\mathcal F_{\mathrm{SW}}$, yielding $w_{\mathrm{raw}}\simeq1/3$. Separately, we demonstrate the gauge dependence of the 2EMT under general scalar gauge transformations and discuss the complete fixing of the UE gauge.

classification.title_zh: 暴胀期间二次反作用源的规范与尺度依赖：均匀膨胀规范
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学反作用最直接地体现在时空叶片的局域膨胀中，因此均匀膨胀（UE）切片为研究慢滚暴胀期间标量扰动的二次有效能量动量张量（2EMT）提供了自然的几何框架。我们施加完整的标量规范条件 κ=0 与 E=0。均匀膨胀条件在组态空间中对 shift Q 给出微分约束，并对每个傅里叶模式满足 Q_UE(k)=-3(Ψ'+HΨ)/(k^2+3εH^2)。在严格红外极限下，UE 源在零梯度处消失，而其首个非零项在领头慢滚阶为 τ̂_00^UE/F_LW ≃ 8σ_1^2/ε 与 τ̂_ii^UE/F_LW ≃ -8σ_1^2/(3ε)。因此 w_raw^UE ≃ -1/3，但首个有限梯度系数不同于共动规范与均匀密度规范。在梯度主导的中间红外足够深处，领头 UE 行为趋近空间平坦结果，而严格红外与中间红外之间的交叉区域需要完整的 2EMT 表达式。在紫外，τ̂_00^UE ≃ 2F_SW 与 τ̂_ii^UE ≃ (2/3)F_SW，给出 w_raw ≃ 1/3。此外，我们展示了 2EMT 在一般标量规范变换下的规范性依赖，并讨论了 UE 规范的完全固定。

papers.title: Comment on "Exact, nonsingular black holes from a phantom DBI field as primordial dark matter"
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the metric and scalar configuration proposed in Ref.~[1] do not satisfy the complete set of field equations of the Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) field theory minimally coupled to general relativity on a radial domain containing the event horizon. The physical DBI branch for this gravitational setup terminates outside the event horizon. Thus, the proposed configuration does not describe a black hole solution of that theory.

classification.title_zh: 对“来自 phantom DBI 场作为原初暗物质的精确非奇异黑洞”的评论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，Ref.[1] 提出的度规和标量场构型在包含事件视界的径向区域上不满足最小耦合到广义相对论的 Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) 场论的完整场方程。该引力设置下的物理 DBI 分支在事件视界外终止。因此，该构型不描述该理论的黑洞解。

papers.title: Dynamics of a spinning body with scalar multipoles
papers.abstract: We construct an effective worldline action for a spinning compact object in theories of gravity with massless, non-minimally coupled scalar fields. To this end, we generalize the standard skeletonized approach used in General Relativity to model the stress-energy tensor of a small body in a background spacetime, dressing its multipolar structure with the scalar field. Within a pole-dipole approximation, we derive a modified set of Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations of motion for the spinning body, together with the field equations for the scalar field and the metric. We consider both parity-even and parity-odd scalars. We tailor this formalism to model the evolution of asymmetric binaries, such as Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals (EMRIs), by systematically expanding the relevant equations in powers of the binary mass ratio and deriving the dynamics up to first post-adiabatic (1PA) order, along with the self-force equations needed to determine the particle's acceleration. For a parity-even scalar, the 1PA dynamics depends only on the mass, spin, and scalar charge of the secondary, plus a single self-coupling constant. For a pseudoscalar, we find that the binary dynamics coincides with General Relativity through 1PA.

classification.title_zh: 带标量多极矩的旋转天体动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在含无质量非最小耦合标量场的引力理论中，为旋转致密天体构建有效世界线作用。作者将广义相对论中用于描述背景时空中小天体应力张量的骨架化方法推广至标量场情形，使多极结构携带标量贡献；在极点-偶极近似下导出修正的 Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon 运动方程，以及标量场和度规的场方程。文中考虑宇称偶和宇称奇标量，并将形式体系用于非对称双星（如 EMRI）演化：按双星质量比展开，推导至一阶后绝热（1PA）阶的动力学及确定粒子加速度所需的自力方程。对于宇称偶标量，1PA 动力学仅依赖次级天体的质量、自旋、标量荷以及一个自耦合常数；对于赝标量，双星动力学在 1PA 阶与广义相对论一致。
classification.one_liner: 构建含标量多极矩的旋转致密天体世界线作用，导出修正 MPD 方程并应用于 EMRI 的 1PA 动力学。

papers.title: Rotating black hole thermodynamics at NNLO in higher-curvature gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate higher-curvature corrections to black-hole thermodynamics in quasitopological gravity using perturbative Euclidean-action methods. Static, spherically symmetric black holes provide a benchmark for the action expansion, while our main application concerns five-dimensional, asymptotically flat, rotating black holes with equal angular momenta. For Einstein gravity supplemented by Gauss--Bonnet and cubic quasitopological interactions, we compute the Gibbs free energy through next-to-next-to-leading order, retaining both quadratic and cubic corrections. The result retains the full dependence on the background spin parameter, without a slow-rotation expansion, and extends to arbitrary couplings of quadratic and cubic curvature invariants. We derive the corrected mass, entropy and angular momenta, and show how rotation affects the size and sign of the corrections.

classification.title_zh: 高阶曲率引力中NNLO的旋转黑洞热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文使用微扰欧几里得作用量方法研究准拓扑引力中黑洞热力学的高阶曲率修正。静态球对称黑洞被用作作用量展开的基准，主要应用是五维、渐近平直、具有等角动量的旋转黑洞。对于由Gauss-Bonnet与三次准拓扑相互作用补充的Einstein引力，作者计算了至次次领头阶（NNLO）的吉布斯自由能，保留二次与三次曲率修正。结果保留对背景自旋参数的完整依赖，不做慢转展开，并推广到二次与三次曲率不变量的任意耦合。文中导出了修正后的质量、熵与角动量，并展示了旋转如何影响修正的大小与符号。
classification.one_liner: 在准拓扑高阶曲率引力中，以欧几里得作用量微扰计算五维渐近平直等角动量旋转黑洞热力学的NNLO修正。

papers.title: Holography at finite resolution: zero-point length in AdS/CFT
papers.abstract: We explore the zero-point length $l_0$ of T-duality-inspired effective field theory in holography, distinguishing two readings. As a boundary resolution scale, $l_0$ filters the source of a bulk scalar in anti-de Sitter space and yields an exactly solvable boundary response that is ultraviolet finite without a hard cutoff and inherits the power-law tails of the zero-point-length kernel. We show that this filter is the source-normalized bulk-to-boundary transfer function of a $\nu=1$ scalar evaluated at radial depth $z=l_0$. Anchoring Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces on the same radial surface gives finite entanglement entropies that retain the perimeter law and the universal sphere free energy. For two intervals in AdS$_3$, the prescription yields the mutual-information connectivity transition in closed form for arbitrary interval lengths; equal intervals maximize the connectivity window at fixed total length, and in the subresolution regime the critical separation exhibits a universal scaling law with a rescaled mutual information collapsing onto a piecewise-linear profile. As an AdS-invariant bulk proper length, $l_0$ renders the one-loop tadpole finite while preserving the conformal form of boundary two-point functions. Its exact K\"all\'en-Lehmann decomposition, however, has negative continuum weight beginning at threshold, obstructing a unitary interpretation of this propagator. The ratio $L/l_0$ identifies a crossover scale of the form factor rather than a derived spectrum of a unitary completion.

classification.title_zh: 有限分辨率下的全息：AdS/CFT 中的零点长度
classification.abstract_zh: 本文探讨受 T-对偶启发的有效场论中的零点长度 l0 在全息中的两种解读。作为边界分辨率尺度，l0 过滤 AdS 中体标量场的源，给出无需硬截断即紫外有限、并可精确求解的边界响应，该响应继承零点长度核的幂律尾部；作者证明该过滤器等价于在径向深度 z=l0 处取值的 ν=1 标量场的源归一化体到边界传递函数。将 Ryu-Takayanagi 面锚定在同一径向面上可得到有限纠缠熵，并保留周长律和普适球面自由能。在 AdS3 的双区间情形，该方案给出任意区间长度下互信息连通性转变的闭式结果；在固定总长度下等长区间最大化连通窗口，而在亚分辨率区域，临界间距呈现普适标度律，重标度后的互信息坍缩到分段线性轮廓。若将 l0 视为 AdS 不变的体固有长度，则单圈蝌蚪图变为有限，同时保持边界两点函数的共形形式；但其精确 Källén-Lehmann 分解从阈值开始具有负的连续谱权重，妨碍对该传播子作幺正解释。比值 L/l0 标识的是形状因子的交叉尺度，而不是某个幺正完备理论推导出的谱。
classification.one_liner: 论文研究 T-对偶启发有效场论中零点长度在 AdS/CFT 内的两种全息解读，分析边界过滤、RT 纠缠熵与互信息转变，以及体固有长度解读下的单圈有限性与非幺正 Källén-Lehmann 权重。

papers.title: Deep learning spacetime from entanglement dynamics
papers.abstract: In the eternal AdS black hole, the entanglement of the thermofield double state is geometrically realised by the Einstein--Rosen bridge, in line with the ER=EPR conjecture. Hartman--Maldacena surfaces threading this bridge pass behind the event horizon, so the time-dependent entanglement entropy $S(t)$ of a pair of half-lines, one on each boundary, probes the black hole interior. We turn this relation around and ask how much of the bulk spacetime can be reconstructed from $S(t)$, using a neural ordinary differential equation that learns the metric directly from the entanglement data. We show that $S(t)$ depends on the geometry only through a single function, the local surface gravity expressed in terms of the timelike Killing norm. This is enough to fix a metric with one unknown function: for charged BTZ black holes, the network reconstructs it throughout the region probed by the surfaces, including part of the interior, and the learned metric also yields the Hawking temperature and the location of the critical surface that bounds the accessible interior. With two unknown functions, however, it is not: physically distinct geometries whose two-dimensional $(t,z)$ sectors are related by diffeomorphisms produce the same $S(t)$. Finally, although the null energy condition is not imposed, the network reproduces data obeying the causal bound $v_E\le 1$ on the entanglement velocity, but not data that violate it. Our results thus offer a data-driven perspective on how spacetime, including the black hole interior, emerges from quantum entanglement, and delineate which features of the geometry entanglement alone can determine.

classification.title_zh: 从纠缠动力学中深度学习时空
classification.abstract_zh: 在永恒AdS黑洞中，热场双态纠缠由爱因斯坦-罗森桥几何实现，符合ER=EPR。穿过桥的Hartman-Maldacena面位于视界之后，因此两侧边界半直线对的含时纠缠熵S(t)可探测黑洞内部。本文反向利用该关系，用神经常微分方程直接从S(t)学习度规，考察能从纠缠数据重构多少体时空。结果表明S(t)仅通过一个函数依赖几何：以类时Killing矢模表示的局域表面引力；这足以固定含一个未知函数的度规。对于带电BTZ黑洞，网络重构了曲面探测区域（包括部分内部）的度规，并给出Hawking温度及可及内部临界面的位置。但含两个未知函数时并不唯一：二维(t,z)扇区经微分同胚联系的不同几何可给出相同S(t)。最后，尽管未施加零能量条件，网络能再现满足纠缠速度因果界v_E≤1的数据，而不能拟合违反该界的数据。结果给出时空（含黑洞内部）如何由量子纠缠涌现的数据驱动视角，并界定仅凭纠缠能确定哪些几何特征。
classification.one_liner: 用神经常微分方程从边界含时纠缠熵重构AdS黑洞体度规，并界定纠缠可确定与不可确定的几何信息。

papers.title: Only the disk: topological obstructions for warped AdS$_6\times S^2$ in Type IIB
papers.abstract: Supersymmetric AdS$_6\times S^2$ solutions of Type IIB supergravity are warped products over a Riemann surface $\Sigma$. They are determined by two holomorphic differentials on $\Sigma$, with five-branes at poles on its boundary. We derive restrictions on the genus and the number of boundary components of $\Sigma$. Without seven-branes or orientifolds, the differentials are taken to be single-valued on $\Sigma$. Regularity implies that the number of interior zeros of one differential equals the total rotation of the phase of the ratio of the two differentials along the boundary. It also bounds this rotation on each boundary component by the number of poles on that component. Combined with the known count of zeros on the double of $\Sigma$, these two statements force $\Sigma$ to be a disk. With mutually local seven-branes and orientifolds as interior punctures, the same conclusion follows under additional assumptions on the global structure of the differentials and on their behavior at the punctures. The disk then admits at most one orientifold puncture. On a disk without punctures, the bound applied between successive poles also recovers the known cyclic ordering of the five-brane charges along the boundary.

classification.title_zh: 只有圆盘：Type IIB 中 warped AdS$_6\times S^2$ 的拓扑障碍
classification.abstract_zh: Type IIB 超引力中的超对称 AdS$_6\times S^2$ 解是 Riemann 面 $\Sigma$ 上的 warped product。它们由 $\Sigma$ 上两个全纯微分决定，五膜位于其边界上的极点。我们推导了对 $\Sigma$ 的亏格和边界分支数的限制。在没有七膜或 orientifold 时，微分取为在 $\Sigma$ 上单值。正则性意味着一个微分的内部零点数等于两个微分之比的相位沿边界的总旋转。它还以每个边界分支上的极点数给出了该分支上旋转的界。结合 $\Sigma$ 的双倍面上零点数的已知计数，这两个陈述迫使 $\Sigma$ 为圆盘。当存在相互局域的七膜和 orientifold 作为内部穿刺点时，在关于微分整体结构及其在穿刺点行为的一些额外假设下，可得到相同结论。该圆盘随后至多允许一个 orientifold 穿刺点。在无穿刺点的圆盘上，将这一界应用于相邻极点之间，还可恢复已知的五膜电荷沿边界的循环序。
classification.one_liner: 证明在设定条件下，IIB 超引力中一类超对称 warped AdS$_6\times S^2$ 解所对应的 Riemann 面只能是圆盘，并给出边界与穿刺点限制。

papers.title: Folded out-of-time-order correlators in double-scaled SYK
papers.abstract: Harlow and Zhao arXiv:2607.14215 have identified ``anti-scrambling'' as a characteristic signature of cosmological horizons in de Sitter space, and proposed that it can be realized in a quantum system with bounded energy by Euclidean time ``folding" of out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs). We implement this prescription in the DSSYK model. We use arXiv:2303.03474 to define an infinite-temperature ($\beta=0$) DSSYK OTOC that in the semiclassical limit of small values of the double-scaling parameter $\lambda$ reproduces the usual AdS eikonal shockwave behavior with its characteristic time delay, and then apply the Harlow-Zhao fold with the ``fake'' DSSYK inverse temperature $\beta_f$ playing the role of $\beta$. We demonstrate both numerically and analytically that the resulting folded OTOC displays anti-scrambling. The exact DSSYK evaluation tracks the semiclassical de Sitter eikonal formula in the scrambling regime, including a time advance instead of a time delay.The direction of the fold selects the side from which the continued eikonal amplitude approaches its branch cut. We show how our results are consistent with recent ``no-go" constraints. We compare the folded correlator with the two-shell analysis of arXiv:2607.14215: the growing term of the two-shell dilaton invariant appears in DSSYK with the same exponent, but as an imaginary part, while its real part, which would signal the backreaction that ends in a crunch, only moves by $O(\lambda)$ for thermal-scale probes. We also generalize to finite $\beta$; we find reasonable agreement with the de Sitter eikonal form for sufficiently high temperatures, but at lower temperatures the folded correlator is dominated by a pair of complex conjugate saddles, an anti-Stokes crossover that prevents retrieval of the eikonal behavior from the folded OTOC.

classification.title_zh: 双标度SYK中的折叠非时序关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: Harlow和Zhao将“反扰乱”识别为de Sitter宇宙视界的特征信号，并提议通过对非时序关联函数(OTOC)作欧氏时间折叠，在有限能谱量子系统中实现。我们在DSSYK中实现该方案：采用已有工作定义无穷温度DSSYK OTOC，在小λ半经典极限下重现AdS eikonal激波行为及时间延迟，再以虚拟逆温β_f作Harlow-Zhao折叠。数值与解析表明折叠OTOC显示反扰乱，精确DSSYK结果在扰乱区跟踪半经典dS eikonal公式，并给出时间超前而非延迟。折叠方向决定延拓eikonal振幅从哪一侧趋近分支割。结果与近期no-go约束一致；与双壳分析比较，双壳dilaton不变量的增长项以相同指数出现但为虚部，其实部（结束于crunch的反作用信号）对热尺度探针仅移动O(λ)。推广到有限β时，足够高温下与dS eikonal形式合理一致，但低温下折叠关联函数由一对复共轭鞍点主导，反Stokes交叉阻止从折叠OTOC恢复eikonal行为。
classification.one_liner: 在DSSYK中实现Harlow-Zhao折叠OTOC，解析和数值展示dS型反扰乱与时间超前。

papers.title: ER=EPR and IMP wormholes in quantum gravity
papers.abstract: We analyze and refine the ER=EPR conjecture by studying IMP (Isenberg, Mazzeo and Pollack \cite{Isenberg:2001qe}) wormholes in QFT and quantum gravity, in the AdS/CFT context. IMP wormholes are solutions to the Einstein equations constructed from another general solution of Einstein's equations by gluing a handle on a Cauchy slice with a constant mean curvature, so that the initial data on the slice does not change in the regions away from the handle. This is made possible by using what is called the conformal method. This same method also enables one to recover a well defined perturbation theory in quantum gravity, and particularly for asymptotically AdS spacetimes \cite{Witten:2022xxp}. Thus we construct the perturbation theory on these backgrounds in addition to exploring ER=EPR when $G_{N}=0$, in the limit it is perturbatively small and beyond perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 量子引力中的 ER=EPR 与 IMP 虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 AdS/CFT 语境下，通过研究量子场论与量子引力中的 IMP 虫洞，分析并细化 ER=EPR 猜想。IMP 虫洞是由爱因斯坦方程的另一通解通过共形方法在常平均曲率 Cauchy 切片上粘接手柄构造而成，使远离手柄区域的初始数据保持不变。该方法也可用于在量子引力中、尤其是渐近 AdS 时空中恢复良定义的微扰论。因此，我们在这些背景上构造微扰论，并在 G_N=0、微扰小以及超出微扰论的范围内探讨 ER=EPR。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/CFT 框架下用 IMP 虫洞和共形方法细化 ER=EPR，并构造相应量子引力微扰论。

papers.title: Scalar/axion Wormholes and Boundary Conditions in Gravitational Path Integrals
papers.abstract: Recent work noted that whether or not a given class of spacetime wormholes contributes to the gravitational path integral can depend strongly on the choice of boundary conditions. In particular, for asymptotically-AdS scalar/axion wormholes with spherical boundaries it was suggested that there are regimes where the same wormhole contributes to a Euclidean low-energy effective field theory computation of the partition function $Z_N$ defined by imposing Neumann boundary conditions on the scalar/axion field, while it fails to contribute to a corresponding partition function $Z_D$ defined by imposing Dirichlet boundary conditions on this field. Here we investigate toy models of related wormholes associated with JT gravity coupled to a scalar field, asymptotically-AdS gravity coupled to an axion/scalar with toroidal boundary conditions, and asymptotically flat gravity coupled to an axion/scalar. In all cases we compare $Z_D$ and $Z_N$ as computed in a truncated low-energy effective theory by an appropriate integral over constrained wormholes. In each case we find that, even though $Z_D$ and $Z_N$ are related by an integral transform, the two generally receive contributions from differing sets of saddles. Along the way, we uncover a variety of additional interesting subtleties associated with semiclassical contributions to our $Z_D$ and $Z_N$.

classification.title_zh: 标量/轴子虫洞与引力路径积分中的边界条件
classification.abstract_zh: 近期工作指出，给定类型时空虫洞是否对引力路径积分有贡献，可能强烈依赖边界条件的选择。特别地，对于具有球面边界的渐近AdS标量/轴子虫洞，有人提出在某些区域，同一虫洞会贡献于对标量/轴子场施加Neumann边界条件所定义的配分函数 Z_N 的欧氏低能有效场论计算，而不贡献于施加Dirichlet边界条件所定义的 Z_D。本文研究相关虫洞的玩具模型：JT引力耦合标量场、具有环面边界条件的渐近AdS引力耦合轴子/标量，以及渐近平直引力耦合轴子/标量。所有情形下，我们在截断低能有效理论中通过对受约束虫洞的适当积分计算并比较 Z_D 与 Z_N。每种情形都发现，尽管 Z_D 与 Z_N 由积分变换相联系，两者一般从不同的鞍点集合获得贡献。期间还揭示出与 Z_D 和 Z_N 的半经典贡献相关的多种额外有趣微妙之处。
classification.one_liner: 比较Dirichlet与Neumann边界条件下标量/轴子虫洞对引力路径积分配分函数的鞍点贡献，并在JT、AdS环面及渐近平直玩具模型中揭示两者由不同鞍点主导。

papers.title: Melvin-type Electromagnetized Kerr Black Hole in Kaluza-Klein and Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton-axion Theories
papers.abstract: A naive application of solution-generating techniques to construct Melvin-type rotating black holes in the Kaluza-Klein (KK) theory in the presence of both electric and magnetic external fields generically introduces an undesirable Taub-swirling twist term. We investigate its origin and modify the electromagnetization procedure, thereby constructing an exact solution of the Melvin-type electromagnetized Kerr black hole in the KK theory without the swirling term. We also obtain the analogous solution in the Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton-axion (EMDA) theory. The modified solution-generating techniques allow one to introduce both the dyonic charges and external electromagnetic fields independently into Ricci-flat seed metrics in both theories, without generating either Taub-NUT or Taub-swirling twists.

classification.title_zh: Kaluza-Klein与Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton-axion理论中的Melvin型电磁化Kerr黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 对在Kaluza-Klein（KK）理论中同时存在外部电场和磁场时，用解生成技术构造Melvin型旋转黑洞的朴素做法通常会引入不希望的Taub-swirling扭曲项。我们研究其起源并修改电磁化过程，从而在KK理论中构造出不含该扭曲项的Melvin型电磁化Kerr黑洞精确解。我们也在Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton-axion（EMDA）理论中得到类似解。修改后的解生成技术允许在两理论中独立地将双荷电荷和外部电磁场引入Ricci-flat种子度规，而不会产生Taub-NUT或Taub-swirling扭曲。
classification.one_liner: 通过修改电磁化解生成技术，在KK与EMDA理论中构造不含Taub-swirling扭曲的Melvin型电磁化Kerr黑洞精确解。

papers.title: Horizon kinematics and the fine structure induced by finite-energy Hawking radiation
papers.abstract: Hawking radiation can modify the horizon structure of a black hole through the loss of mass and global charges. Investigating this process through quantum tunneling, we develop a systematic strategy to reconstruct horizon displacements under finite-energy emission, even when their radii are not explicitly known. Inversion of the horizon condition allows to follow roots's displacements along sequences of static geometries. As a concrete realization, we consider a nonlinearly charged extension of the Ba\~nados--Teitelboim--Zanelli (BTZ) family, whose horizon structure offers an ideal setup to explore this process. Of particular interest is an initial configuration with a double inner horizon coexisting with a simple event horizon. We show that neutral emission necessarily splits the inner root into two simple ones, revealing a horizon fine structure. For charged emission, the dependence of extracted charge on emitted energy determines the separation law and allows that preservation or later restore the degeneracy. We construct such channels connecting the same initial and final states through distinct internal histories sharing the same leading semiclassical factor. As emission continues, the larger of the newly separated inner horizons can coalesce with the event horizon, driving the sequence towards extremality with a vanishing temperature but finite tunneling probability. We find that zero temperature cannot be attained in finite boundary time while uniform adiabaticity bounds hold. We also establish a regime where the geometric expansion and the canonical thermal approximation remain controlled near this endpoint. Finally, applying this analysis to the sector reproducing a quantum-backreacted BTZ geometry reveals how the leading semiclassical corrections raise the temperature and enhance the neutral-probe horizon emission factor relative to classical BTZ.

classification.title_zh: 视界运动学与有限能量Hawking辐射诱导的精细结构
classification.abstract_zh: Hawking辐射可通过质量和全局荷的损失改变黑洞视界结构。本文通过量子隧穿研究有限能量发射下视界位移的重构，即使视界半径未知也可追踪静态几何序列中视界根的运动。具体考虑非线性带电BTZ扩展，其初始构型具有双内视界与单事件视界。中性发射会使内根分裂为两个单根，形成视界精细结构；带电发射中提取电荷与发射能量的依赖决定分离规律，并可保持或恢复简并。作者构造连接相同初末态、但内部历史不同且具有相同领头半经典因子的通道。继续发射时，新分离的较大内视界可与事件视界合并，使序列趋向温度为零但隧穿概率有限的极端状态；零温不能在有限边界时间达到，且均匀绝热界成立。文章还建立了几何展开与正则热近似受控的区域，并在量子反作用BTZ几何中说明领头半经典修正会提高温度并增强中性探针的视界发射因子。
classification.one_liner: 在非线性带电BTZ黑洞中追踪有限能量Hawking发射导致的视界根位移、内视界分裂及趋向极端性的半经典图像。

papers.title: Localizing the M-Theory Path Integral: Membrane Instantons
papers.abstract: We propose a formula for M2-instanton contributions to the M-theory path integral, incorporating quantum corrections to all orders in the Planck length. The M2-brane action is determined by relative equivariant localization, while an equivariant Dolbeault character computes the one-loop determinant. Continuous families of M2-branes are treated by equivariant localization on their moduli spaces. For M-theory backgrounds dual to ABJM theory, we compute single instanton contributions from linear holomorphic fillings to the sphere partition function and the topologically twisted index associated with supersymmetric $AdS_4$ black holes. Our results reproduce known field theory instanton coefficients and give new analytic predictions for mass and squashing deformations at all Chern-Simons levels. For the $V^{5,2}$ theory, we compute new instanton contributions and establish an exact relation between its partition function at special squashing and that of ABJM theory on the round three-sphere.

classification.title_zh: M理论路径积分的局域化：膜瞬子
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出M2瞬子对M理论路径积分贡献的公式，包含普朗克长度所有阶量子修正。M2膜作用量由相对等变局域化确定，等变Dolbeault特征标计算单圈行列式；连续M2膜族通过其模空间上的等变局域化处理。对于对偶于ABJM理论的M理论背景，计算线性全纯填充对球面配分函数和与超对称AdS4黑洞相关的拓扑扭曲指标的贡献。结果复现已知场论瞬子系数，并给出所有Chern-Simons层次下质量与压扁形变的新解析预言；对V^{5,2}理论计算新瞬子贡献，并建立特殊压扁下配分函数与ABJM圆三球面配分函数之间的精确关系。
classification.one_liner: 用等变局域化计算M2膜瞬子对M理论路径积分的全阶量子修正，并在ABJM/V^{5,2}全息对偶中给出配分函数与拓扑扭曲指标的新预言。

papers.title: Foliations by constant spacetime mean curvature surfaces for asymptotically hyperboloidal initial data sets
papers.abstract: We construct an exhaustive family of constant spacetime mean curvature (STCMC) surfaces for initial data sets close to the anti-de Sitter-Schwarzschild hyperboloid. In particular, we obtain such a foliation as the long time limit of the volume preserving spacetime mean curvature flow starting from the constant mean curvature foliation constructed by Neves-Tian (Geom. Funct. Anal., 2009). As an application, inspired by the definition of STCMC center of mass for initial data sets proposed in the asymptotically Euclidean setting by Cederbaum-Sakovich (Calc. Var. PDE, 2021), we study the center of mass of an asymptotically hyperboloidal initial data set.

classification.title_zh: 渐近双曲型初始数据的常时空平均曲率曲面叶状结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为接近反德西特-史瓦西双曲面的初始数据集构造了一族完备的常时空平均曲率（STCMC）曲面。特别地，我们从 Neves-Tian 构造的常平均曲率叶状结构出发，以保体积时空平均曲率流的长时极限得到该叶状结构。作为应用，受 Cederbaum-Sakovich 在渐近欧氏情形提出的 STCMC 质心定义启发，我们研究渐近双曲型初始数据集的质心。
classification.one_liner: 构造渐近双曲型初始数据集的 STCMC 叶状结构并研究其质心。

papers.title: Seeing through the fog: astrophysical priors and the evidence for new physics in pulsar timing arrays
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have found evidence for a gravitational wave background at nHz frequencies. Inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) likely contribute to at least part of the signal, but there may be additional cosmological sources from new physics in the early universe. Disentangling the two is complicated by the prohibitively slow modelling of SMBHB spectra based on realistic population models. Here we introduce binaryfog, a surrogate of up-to-date population models also used by the NANOGrav collaboration, that returns the statistical distribution of bent spectra $\mathcal{O}(10^6)$ faster than direct computation. We use binaryfog to profile over the six astrophysical parameters in fits of four extensively discussed new-physics models: a dark sector phase transition, cosmic superstrings, inflationary gravitational waves, and domain walls. Compared to the widely adopted power-law description of the SMBHB background, the preference for a phase transition drops from $2.8\sigma$ to $1.5\sigma$. The other three models follow a similar pattern. We also recommend updated astrophysical priors based on galaxy surveys published since 2014, which for current PTA data still only give a marginal preference of $1.7\sigma$ for a phase transition. An interpretation of the signal in terms of SMBHBs alone favours binaries that merge within about $2\,$Gyr after their host galaxies have merged, requiring an efficient mechanism to overcome the final parsec of separation. If binaries need longer than about $6.5\,$Gyr to merge, the preference for a phase transition exceeds $3\sigma$ under our recommended updated prior set. binaryfog can help resolve these questions, as it allows users to study the impact of updated astrophysical priors and a realistic SMBHB population model on new-physics searches with PTAs.

classification.title_zh: 穿透迷雾：天体物理先验与脉冲星计时阵列中新物理的证据
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）已在 nHz 频率上发现引力波背景的证据。旋近的超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）很可能至少贡献了信号的一部分，但早期宇宙的新物理也可能提供额外的宇宙学源。基于现实族群模型对 SMBHB 谱的建模极其缓慢，使两者难以区分。本文提出 binaryfog，这是一个与 NANOGrav 合作所用最新族群模型一致的代理模型，能比直接计算快 \mathcal{O}(10^6) 倍地返回弯折谱的统计分布。我们使用 binaryfog 在四个广泛讨论的新物理模型（暗扇区相变、宇宙超弦、暴胀引力波和畴壁）拟合中，对六个天体物理参数做剖面分析。与广泛采用的 SMBHB 背景幂律描述相比，对相变的偏好从 2.8σ 降至 1.5σ。其他三个模型呈现类似趋势。我们还建议基于 2014 年以来发表的星系巡天更新天体物理先验；对当前 PTA 数据，这仍然只给出对相变的 1.7σ 边际偏好。若仅用 SMBHB 解释信号，则偏好在其宿主星系并合后约 2 Gyr 内并合的双星，这需要有效机制克服最后秒差距的分离。如果双星需要超过约 6.5 Gyr 才能并合，在我们推荐的更新先验集下，对相变的偏好超过 3σ。binaryfog 可帮助解决这些问题，因为它允许用户研究更新天体物理先验和现实 SMBHB 族群模型对 PTA 新物理搜索的影响。
classification.one_liner: 用 binaryfog 代理模型和更新的星系巡天先验，重新评估 PTA 引力波背景中暗扇区相变、宇宙弦、暴胀引力波与畴壁相对于 SMBHB 的统计偏好。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景与早期宇宙新物理，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力；仅在引力波/经典引力观测层面与‘经典引力/广义相对论’支线有边缘关联。

papers.title: Low-$T/|W|$ instabilities in differentially rotating neutron stars resembling merger remnants
papers.abstract: We construct constant rest-mass sequences of equilibrium models of differentially rotating neutron stars which resemble binary neutron star post-merger remnants. For a more realistic description of the post-merger remnant, we impose that each model carries approximately $95\%$ of the angular momentum that a binary system with the same total rest-mass has at the moment of merging, based on an empirical relation informed from neutron star merger simulations. We account for equation of state effects by employing two distinct microphysical descriptions for high density matter. We dynamically evolve the equilibrium models with a three-dimensional general relativistic hydrodynamics code that employs the conformal flatness approximation. We investigate the connection between the occurrence of the instability and the existence of corotation radii within the stellar configurations and determine the instability window for both equation of state sequences. The occurrence of low-$T/|W|$ instabilities leads to pronounced gravitational wave emission in the range $0.13 \lessapprox\beta \lessapprox 0.2$, while models outside this range exhibit less pronounced features in the gravitational wave spectrum. The prominence of gravitational wave emission is primarily determined by $\beta$, while the equation of state seems to have a more minor effect. We present correlations between the strength of the gravitational wave emission associated with the instability and properties of the equilibrium models. Stellar configurations modelled by different equations of state display differences in the timescales over which the various dynamical features develop, as well as whether they exhibit a pronounced $m=1$ deformation. Potential relations between the instability growth timescales and properties of the stellar models are studied.

classification.title_zh: 类似并合遗迹的差转中子星中的低 T/|W| 不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构建了类似双中子星并合后遗迹的差转中子星平衡模型恒定静止质量序列。为更真实描述并合遗迹，作者依据中子星并合模拟得到的经验关系，要求每个模型携带相同总静止质量双星系统在并合时刻约 95% 的角动量。作者采用两种高密度物质微观物态方程描述以考虑物态方程效应，并用采用共形平坦近似的三维广义相对论流体力学代码对平衡模型进行动力学演化。文章研究不稳定性出现与星体构型内共转半径存在之间的联系，并确定两种物态方程序列的不稳定窗口。低 T/|W| 不稳定性的出现会在 0.13 ≲ β ≲ 0.2 范围内导致显著引力波辐射，而该范围之外的模型在引力波谱中表现出较不显著的特征。引力波辐射的显著程度主要由 β 决定，物态方程的影响似乎较小。作者给出与不稳定性相关的引力波辐射强度同平衡模型性质之间的关联。不同物态方程建模的星体构型在各类动力学特征发展的时间尺度上存在差异，并且是否表现出显著的 m=1 形变也不同。文章还研究了不稳定性增长时间尺度与星体模型性质之间的可能关系。
classification.one_liner: 用三维广义相对论流体力学演化类似双中子星并合遗迹的差转中子星模型，研究低 T/|W| 不稳定性的发生条件、引力波特征及其与物态方程和共转半径的关系。

papers.title: Where can Gauss--Bonnet scalarization begin in neutron and quark stars, and when do stars carry scalar charge?
papers.abstract: In scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity, with a coupling $\zeta(\phi)\mathcal G$, the Gauss-Bonnet invariant $\mathcal G$ sources the scalar when $\zeta'(0)\neq0$ and sets the sign of the effective mass squared of its perturbations when $\zeta$ is quadratic, so the surface on which $\mathcal G$ changes sign inside a star organises both the scalar flux and the regions in which spontaneous scalarization can begin. A regular static star with continuous density contains a surface $\Sigma$ on which $\mathcal G$ vanishes whenever its surface density is below half its mean density, and $\Sigma$ is unique when the density profile steepens outward and $p/\rho$ decreases. Neutron-star models without density discontinuities therefore have one, but self-bound stars need not: in the MIT bag model $\mathcal G<0$ inside every stable quark star, for any bag constant. For a quadratic coupling the tachyonic region is then, in a quark star, either the whole interior or the whole exterior, according to the sign of $\zeta''(0)$, whereas in a neutron star it includes part of the interior for either sign. In the Newtonian limit $\Sigma$ lies where $\rho=\bar\rho/2$ in every dimension. Over a whole slice the lapse-weighted integral of $\mathcal G$ equals the lapse-weighted Gauss-Bonnet curvature of space, which vanishes identically in three dimensions, so regular stars carry no scalar charge when $D=4$. Above four dimensions every star, isotropic or anisotropic, carries a scalar monopole given by an interior integral weighted by $\rho+p_r$. Under the radial null energy condition its sign is that of $\zeta'(0)$ for any equation of state, opposite to that of a Schwarzschild-Tangherlini black hole at the same order, and its size relative to the exterior contribution is of first post-Newtonian order.

classification.title_zh: 中子星与夸克星中Gauss–Bonnet标量化可在何处起始，以及恒星何时携带标量荷？
classification.abstract_zh: 在标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中，耦合为 ζ(φ)G；当 ζ'(0)≠0 时，Gauss-Bonnet不变量 G 作为标量场的源，而当 ζ 为二次时，它决定扰动有效质量平方的符号，因此星体内部 G 变号的曲面同时组织标量通量与自发标量化可起始的区域。一个密度连续的正则静态星，若其表面密度低于平均密度的一半，则包含 G 消失的曲面 Σ；当密度剖面向外变陡且 p/ρ 递减时，Σ 唯一。因此，无密度间断的中子星模型有一个 Σ，而自束缚星未必：在 MIT 袋模型中，对任意袋常数，每个稳定夸克星内部都有 G<0。对于二次耦合，夸克星中的快子区域要么是整个内部，要么是整个外部，取决于 ζ''(0) 的符号；而中子星无论该符号正负，都包含部分内部区域。在牛顿极限下，任意维数中 Σ 位于 ρ=\barρ/2 处。对整个切片，G 的 lapse 加权积分等于空间 Gauss-Bonnet 曲率的 lapse 加权积分；后者在三维恒为零，所以 D=4 时正则星不带标量荷。高于四维时，每颗各向同性或各向异性星都携带一个标量单极，由以 ρ+p_r 加权的内部积分给出。在径向零能量条件下，对任意状态方程，其符号均为 ζ'(0) 的符号，与同阶 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 黑洞相反；其相对外部贡献的大小为第一后牛顿阶。
classification.one_liner: 该文分析标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中中子星与夸克星内部 G 变号曲面对自发标量化的组织作用，并给出四维无标量荷、高于四维普遍存在标量单极的条件与符号。

papers.title: From the Early Slope to Curvature: Future Prospects and challenges for Astrophysical Parameter Estimation Using the Core-Collapse Supernova High-Frequency Feature
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) signals from core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe) contain both stochastic and deterministic components. Among these, the High-Frequency Feature (HFF), associated with Proto-Neutron Star (PNS) oscillations, has emerged as an observable for probing dense-matter physics. Previous studies of the HFF have primarily focused on its early-time slope as a diagnostic of PNS contraction and its dependence on the nuclear equation of state (EOS). In this work, we investigate recovering higher-order features of the HFF evolution, such as its curvature, from core-collapse supernova numerical simulations. By analyzing 2D and 3D waveforms injected into real interferometric noise, we apply the coherent WaveBurst algorithm in its cWB-XP implementation to reconstruct the HFF of recovered events. Comparing reconstructions at different signal strengths allows us to examine the extent to which the HFF remains accessible beyond its early linear evolution

classification.title_zh: 从早期斜率到曲率：利用核心坍缩超新星高频特征进行天体物理参数估计的未来前景与挑战
classification.abstract_zh: 核心坍缩超新星（CCSNe）的引力波信号包含随机和确定性成分。其中，与原中子星（PNS）振荡相关的高频特征（HFF）已成为探测致密物质物理的可观测量。此前对HFF的研究主要关注其早期斜率，将其作为PNS收缩的诊断量，并研究其对核状态方程（EOS）的依赖。本文研究从核心坍缩超新星数值模拟中恢复HFF演化的高阶特征（如曲率）。通过分析注入真实干涉仪噪声的2D和3D波形，我们采用cWB-XP实现中的coherent WaveBurst算法重建被恢复事件的HFF。比较不同信号强度下的重建结果，使我们能够考察HFF在其早期线性演化之外仍可被访问的程度。
classification.one_liner: 利用cWB-XP在真实噪声中重建核心坍缩超新星高频特征的曲率等高阶演化，评估其参数估计可观测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为核心坍缩超新星引力波高频特征的参数估计与经典引力波数据分析，不属于全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力研究；仅与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Out-of-Equilibrium Effects in Non-Radial Relativistic Stellar Perturbations: A Model-Agnostic Formulation and Mode Analysis
papers.abstract: We present a systematic, model-agnostic analysis of out-of-equilibrium effects, including viscosity and thermal conductivity, in non-radial oscillations of relativistic stars. Extending the Lindblom-Detweiler formalism, we construct, to our knowledge, the first general framework for linear, non-radial relativistic stellar perturbations that incorporates generic nonequilibrium corrections to the perfect-fluid sector in both the even- and odd-parity channels. Our framework is formulated in terms of the tensorial structure and thermodynamic decomposition of generic corrections without relying on any specific constitutive relations, thereby allowing us to elucidate, at a structural level, how these effects enter the perturbation equations and contribute to geometric deformations and fluid fluctuations. As an application, we consider the Bemfica-Disconzi-Noronha-Kovtun fluid and perturbatively investigate shifts in the frequencies and damping times of modes connected to their perfect-fluid counterparts in the limit of vanishing transport coefficients. We also identify structural features of the closed eigenvalue problem that suggest the possibility of additional mode families. Our formalism provides a unified framework for analyzing how different relativistic fluid theories modify the structure of non-radial stellar perturbations.

classification.title_zh: 非径向相对论恒星扰动中的非平衡效应：模型无关表述与模式分析
classification.abstract_zh: 本文系统且模型无关地分析相对论恒星非径向振荡中的非平衡效应（黏性与热导率）。作者扩展 Lindblom-Detweiler 形式，构建了据称首个同时包含奇宇称和偶宇称通道、对完美流体部分引入一般非平衡修正的线性非径向相对论恒星扰动框架。该框架基于一般修正的张量结构和热力学分解，不依赖具体本构关系，从而在结构层面说明这些效应如何进入扰动方程并影响几何形变与流体涨落。作为应用，考虑 Bemfica-Disconzi-Noronha-Kovtun 流体，并在输运系数趋于零的极限下微扰研究与其完美流体对应模式相关的频率和阻尼时间偏移。还指出闭合本征值问题的结构特征，暗示可能存在额外模式族。该形式为分析不同相对论流体理论如何改变非径向恒星扰动结构提供了统一框架。
classification.one_liner: 建立模型无关的相对论恒星非径向扰动框架，纳入黏性/热导率等非平衡效应并分析模式频率与阻尼偏移。

papers.title: Improving the resolution of double white dwarf systems with spaceborne gravitational wave observatories using a robust astrophysical prior
papers.abstract: Resolving the crowded population of double white dwarf (DWD) binaries in data from spaceborne gravitational wave (GW) observatories (e.g., LISA, Taiji) remains a major analysis challenge. Comparable performance on addressing this problem has been achieved with two main approaches: global fit, in which resolvable sources are estimated simultaneously from the data, and iterative, where sources are estimated one at a time and subtracted out from the data. While the latter is computationally efficient, methods developed under this approach have traditionally followed a frequentist framework that ignores astrophysical priors. This work incorporates a strong astrophysical prior, derived from the mass limits of detached white dwarfs and linking the GW signal frequency $f$ with its time derivative $\dot{f}$, into the iterative \fitalgoname{} pipeline. Applied to simulated LISA and LISA-Taiji network data, the method increases the number of confidently resolved sources by ${\approx}7.3\%$ (LISA-only) and ${\approx}14.6\%$ (network) at matched detection rate, respectively, and improves parameter estimation accuracy.

classification.title_zh: 利用稳健天体物理先验提高空间引力波天文台对双白矮星系统的分辨率
classification.abstract_zh: 在LISA、太极等空间引力波天文台数据中分辨密集的双白矮星双星群体仍是主要分析挑战。全局拟合与迭代方法已取得相近性能；迭代方法计算高效，但传统上采用忽略天体物理先验的频率学派框架。本工作将源自分离白矮星质量上限、并联系引力波信号频率 f 与其时间导数 \dot{f} 的强天体物理先验，纳入迭代 algoname 流程。应用于模拟 LISA 与 LISA-Taiji 网络数据时，在匹配探测率下，该方法分别将置信分辨源数提高约7.3%（仅LISA）和约14.6%（网络），并改善参数估计精度。
classification.one_liner: 将白矮星质量上限给出的 f-\dot{f} 先验加入迭代LISA/LISA-Taiji双白矮星分辨流程，提高可分辨源数和参数精度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题是空间引力波观测中的双白矮星数据分析和参数估计，不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论；仅与经典引力/引力波观测有边缘关联。

papers.title: Eikonal quasinormal modes, greybody factors and shadow of charged accelerating black holes
papers.abstract: We show that the quasinormal modes, in the eikonal limit, for accelerating (non-rotating) black holes, are related to the angular velocity of the circular null geodesics and to the corresponding Lyapunov exponent, in a similar, but generalized way as the ones for spherically symmetric black holes are. We compute those quasinormal modes and greybody factors for neutral and charged accelerating black holes by considering massless test scalar fields. Later we show that the obtained results are universal for perturbations of any spin. We also determine the radius of the shadow cast by these black holes. Our results for charged accelerating black holes simplify to the ones of the Reissner-Nordstrom black hole simply by setting acceleration to zero.

classification.title_zh: 带电加速黑洞的程函准正模、灰体因子与阴影
classification.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在程函极限下，非旋转加速黑洞的准正模与圆轨道零测地线的角速度及相应Lyapunov指数相关，形式类似球对称黑洞但有所推广。作者通过无质量试探标量场计算了中性和带电加速黑洞的准正模与灰体因子，并说明所得结果对任意自旋扰动具有普适性。文中还确定了这些黑洞阴影的半径；当加速度趋于零时，带电加速黑洞的结果退化为Reissner-Nordström黑洞的结果。
classification.one_liner: 在程函极限下将加速黑洞准正模与圆轨道零测地线角速度及Lyapunov指数联系，并计算灰体因子和阴影半径。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究经典黑洞时空中的准正模、灰体因子和阴影，属于用户明确列出的经典引力/广义相对论与QNM相关研究支线；但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Rapid Equation of State Inference from Multiprobe Datasets
papers.abstract: Fully constraining the neutron star equation of state (EoS) requires combining observations from various channels that probe different density regimes. We perform a joint multimessenger inference of the equation of state using gravitational-wave observations from binary neutron star mergers, NICER mass-radius measurements of X-ray pulsars, and radio timing measurements of massive pulsars. We constrain the parametrized equation of state and perform Bayesian model selection among a set of candidate equations of state. The joint analysis produces a radius of $R_{1.4} = 11.93^{+1.02}_{-0.83} \, \rm km$ for a canonical $1.4 \, M_\odot$ neutron star, and a maximum non-rotating neutron star mass of $M_{\rm max} = 2.31^{+0.23}_{-0.23} \, M_\odot$ with $90\%$ credible intervals. Gravitational-wave and NICER observations constrain the equation of state at low to intermediate densities, while massive pulsar observations constrain it at high densities by requiring the equation of state to support the neutron star masses. We find no simple correlation between the stiffness of an EoS and Bayesian evidence because the observations probe the pressure at different density regimes. By combining constraints on the equation of state with Bayesian model selection using multimessenger data, our analysis connects macroscopic neutron star measurements to microscopic properties of candidate nuclear matter models.

classification.title_zh: 多探针数据集的快速状态方程推断
classification.abstract_zh: 完全约束中子星状态方程需要结合探测不同密度区的多通道观测。我们利用双中子星并合引力波观测、NICER对X射线脉冲星的质量-半径测量以及大质量脉冲星射电计时测量，对状态方程进行联合多信使推断。我们约束参数化状态方程，并在候选状态方程中进行贝叶斯模型选择。联合分析给出1.4 M⊙典型中子星半径 R1.4=11.93^{+1.02}_{-0.83} km，最大非旋转中子星质量 Mmax=2.31^{+0.23}_{-0.23} M⊙（90%可信区间）。引力波与NICER观测约束低至中等密度状态方程，大质量脉冲星观测通过要求状态方程支撑中子星质量来约束高密度区。我们发现状态方程刚度与贝叶斯证据之间没有简单关联，因为观测探测不同密度区的压强。通过将状态方程约束与多信使数据贝叶斯模型选择结合，分析把宏观中子星测量与候选核物质模型的微观性质联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 利用引力波、NICER与大质量脉冲星射电计时的联合贝叶斯推断约束中子星状态方程并比较候选模型。

papers.title: Cosmological First-Order Phase Transitions with Full Nonlinear Gravity
papers.abstract: Cosmological first-order phase transitions can contribute to the stochastic gravitational wave background. For decades, these first-order phase transitions have been studied using a Friedmann--Lema\^itre--Robertson--Walker background where the gravitational waves are treated as linear perturbations. Here, we present simulations of a first-order phase transition in the presence of fully nonlinear general relativity, using the BSSN formalism. We simulate a universe that contains a scalar field alongside a relativistic radiation fluid. We focus on GUT-scale transitions in which bubbles nucleate near the horizon size. We describe a method to construct initial data that satisfies the Hamiltonian and momentum constraints, starting from a Coleman--de~Luccia-like bubble profile and adjusting the bubble radius. We compute the gravitational wave spectrum directly from the trace-free extrinsic curvature and find a present-day peak amplitude of $\Omega_{\rm GW,0}h^2 \sim 5\times 10^{-11}$, consistent with earlier results that do not include nonlinear gravity. The peak frequency depends on the symmetry-breaking scale and could fall anywhere from the LISA band to GHz frequencies. At late times, the field fragments into long-lived oscillons, which push its effective equation of state toward that of matter.

classification.title_zh: 全非线性引力下的宇宙学一阶相变
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学一阶相变可以贡献随机引力波背景。几十年来，这类相变通常在FLRW背景中研究，并把引力波当作线性扰动处理。本文使用BSSN形式，在完全非线性广义相对论下模拟一阶相变。模拟的宇宙包含一个标量场和一个相对论性辐射流体。作者聚焦于GUT能标、气泡在视界尺度附近成核的相变，并描述了一种构造初始数据的方法：从类似Coleman-de Luccia的气泡轮廓出发，通过调整气泡半径使其满足哈密顿约束和动量约束。他们直接从无迹外曲率计算引力波谱，得到当今峰值振幅 Ω_GW,0 h^2 ∼ 5×10^{-11}，与未包含非线性引力的早期结果一致。峰值频率依赖对称破缺能标，可能落在LISA波段到GHz频率之间。晚期标量场碎裂成长寿命的振荡子，使其有效物态方程趋向物质。

papers.title: Reconstructing the mass-redshift distribution of supermassive black holes using multiband gravitational-wave observations
papers.abstract: The formation and evolution of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) remain major open questions in astrophysics. Astrophysical models of SMBHs invoke black-hole (BH) seeds formed at high redshift, which subsequently grow through gas accretion and mergers. Although observations of high-redshift quasars and active galactic nuclei constrain these scenarios, the mechanisms governing SMBH formation and growth remain uncertain. Future gravitational-wave (GW) observations across the millihertz, decihertz, and audio-frequency bands will provide a complementary and direct probe of SMBH assembly by tracing their merger history. We investigate the extent to which multiband GW observations can reconstruct the mass-redshift distribution of these mergers. We simulate populations of BH mergers predicted by different astrophysical models and identify those observable by the millihertz detector LISA, the decihertz detector LGWA, and next-generation ground-based detectors operating in the audio-frequency band. We reconstruct the mass-redshift distribution of these mergers using the nonparametric inference code FIGARO. We find that combining observations across frequency bands substantially improves the reconstruction for the light-seed models considered here, whose merger populations span broad ranges of mass and redshift. In contrast, for the heavy-seed models considered here, LISA alone recovers most of the accessible mass-redshift distribution, with little additional improvement from the multiband network.

classification.title_zh: 利用多波段引力波观测重建超大质量黑洞的质量-红移分布
classification.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的形成与演化仍是天体物理中的重大未解问题。SMBH的天体物理模型通常假设高红移处形成的黑洞种子，随后通过气体吸积和并合增长。尽管高红移类星体和活动星系核的观测对这些情景给出限制，但主导SMBH形成与增长的机制仍不确定。未来在毫赫兹、分赫兹和音频频段的引力波（GW）观测将通过追踪其并合历史，为SMBH组装提供互补且直接的探针。我们研究多波段GW观测能在多大程度上重建这些并合的质量-红移分布。我们模拟不同天体物理模型预言的BH并合种群，并识别可由毫赫兹探测器LISA、分赫兹探测器LGWA以及音频频段下一代地面探测器观测到的并合。我们使用非参数推断代码FIGARO重建这些并合的质量-红移分布。我们发现，对本文考虑的轻种子模型（其并合种群覆盖较宽的质量和红移范围），跨频段联合观测显著改善重建。相反，对本文考虑的重种子模型，仅LISA就能恢复大部分可及的质量-红移分布，多波段网络带来的额外改进很小。
classification.one_liner: 多波段引力波观测能重建超大质量黑洞并合的质量-红移分布；轻种子模型需多波段联合，重种子模型LISA单独已接近充分。

papers.title: The Geometric Imprint of a Tilted Accretion Disk in Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Gravitational wave astronomy has opened a new window onto black holes and the dynamics of strong-field gravity, while accretion flows offer a complementary and natural laboratory for probing strong-field physics. In this work, we show that the gravitational wave emission from an initially tilted accretion disk carries a distinct imprint of its orientation. We perform three dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulations and evaluate the gravitational waves through Teukolsky equation. For an aligned disk, the emission is concentrated in low-$|m|$ modes, where $m$ is the azimuthal quantum number. For the initially tilted disk, higher-$|m|$ modes make a larger relative contribution. As the tilted flow subsequently aligns with the black hole spin, the contribution of $|m|\ge2$ modes decreases, showing strong correlation with the tilt angle. This indicates that the gravitational waves generated by the black hole environment carries geometric information about the surrounding matter. Our results establish a route towards using multimode gravitational radiation to probe the geometry and dynamical evolution of accretion flows in the strong-field region.

classification.title_zh: 倾斜吸积盘在引力波中的几何印记
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波天文学为黑洞和强场引力动力学打开了新窗口，而吸积流提供了探测强场物理的互补且自然的实验室。本文表明，初始倾斜吸积盘的引力波辐射带有其取向的独特印记。我们进行三维广义相对论磁流体力学模拟，并通过 Teukolsky 方程计算引力波。对于对齐盘，辐射集中在低 |m| 模式，其中 m 为方位量子数。对于初始倾斜盘，较高 |m| 模式相对贡献更大。随着倾斜流随后与黑洞自旋对齐，|m|≥2 模式的贡献减小，并与倾角强烈相关。这表明黑洞环境产生的引力波携带周围物质的几何信息。我们的结果建立了一条利用多模引力辐射探测强场区域吸积流几何和动力学演化的途径。
classification.one_liner: 三维 GRMHD 模拟显示倾斜吸积盘的引力波多模结构随倾角变化，可作为探测强场吸积流几何的探针。

papers.title: Fuzzy Dark Matter as a diffractive barrier: Wave-optics Signatures of Ultralight Fields on Lensed Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) propagate through the universe from sources at high redshift, experiencing the gravitational fields of the intervening matter distribution. Halos composed of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) contain strong density fluctuations, reflecting the interference pattern in the field distribution of the ultralight bosons. In the wave-optics regime, ULDM fluctuations act as a diffractive grating, imprinting frequency-dependent modulations of GWs, in addition to magnification and other gravitational lensing effects. Since lensing depends on the projected surface density, we derive its approximate probability distribution and show how it departs from a Gaussian distribution depending on the halo profile and coherence length. We then quantify how the GW diffraction signatures produced by the granules depend on macroimage magnification and parity. The ULDM interference network imprints stochastic diffraction fluctuations at the $O(1)\%$ level on GWs moderately lensed by the host when the Fresnel scale is comparable to the granule coherence length $r_F(f)\sim\ell_c$. These fluctuations can be enhanced to $\gtrsim10\%$ when the host macroimage forms near the critical curve or for Type II macroimages. For massive black hole binaries observed by LISA, the diffraction signature can be detectable around the ULDM particle mass $m_\phi\sim10^{-21}$ eV, providing either a smoking-gun signature of ULDM or new constraints on $m_\phi$.

classification.title_zh: 模糊暗物质作为衍射屏障：超轻场对透镜化引力波的波光学特征
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波从高红移源传播时会经历 intervening 物质分布的引力场。由超轻暗物质组成的晕包含强密度涨落，反映超轻玻色子场分布的干涉图样。在波光学区，ULDM 涨落像衍射光栅，在放大和其他引力透镜效应之外给引力波留下频率依赖调制。由于透镜效应依赖投影面密度，我们推导其近似概率分布，并展示其如何依赖晕轮廓和相干长度而偏离高斯分布。随后量化颗粒产生的引力波衍射特征如何依赖宏观像放大率和宇称。当菲涅尔尺度与颗粒相干长度可比 r_F(f)~ℓ_c 时，ULDM 干涉网络在宿主中等透镜的引力波上留下 O(1)% 量级的随机衍射涨落；当宿主宏观像接近临界曲线或为 Type II 宏观像时，这些涨落可增强到 ≳10%。对于 LISA 观测的大质量黑洞双星，在 ULDM 粒子质量 m_phi~10^-21 eV 附近可探测该衍射特征，提供 ULDM 的 smoking-gun 信号或对 m_phi 的新限制。
classification.one_liner: 超轻暗物质密度涨落在波光学区作为衍射光栅，在透镜化引力波上产生频率依赖的 O(1)%–≳10% 随机调制，可用于 LISA 探测 m_φ~10^-21 eV。

papers.title: Probing horizonless compact objects through observable signatures and images of accretion disk
papers.abstract: The observed images of M87$^*$ and Sgr A$^*$ by Event Horizon Telescope motivate us to study the spacetime geometry and accretion flow dynamics around compact objects beyond the Kerr/Schwarzschild scenario. In this work, we investigate the properties of a steady, inviscid, axisymmetric, advective accretion flow around the Zipoy-Voorhees ($\gamma$-metric) spacetime by solving the relativistic hydrodynamic equations. The $\gamma$-metric is a static, axisymmetric generalization of the Schwarzschild geometry and is characterized by a mass ($M_\bullet$) and a deformation parameter ($\gamma$). We examine how the deformation parameter $\gamma$ influences the effective potential, the location and nature of the critical points, and the resulting accretion flow topologies. Then, using relativistic thermal bremsstrahlung emissivity, we compute the spectral energy distribution and bolometric luminosity of the flow. We find that $\gamma$ affects the luminosity in opposite ways for the flow having outer critical point (O-type) and that having inner critical point (I-type). Finally, combining the flow properties with general relativistic ray tracing, we construct synthetic images of the accretion disk for different values of $\gamma$ and observer inclination angles. The resulting observed flux distribution independently confirms the trends obtained from the luminosity and spectral analyses. Although the shadow of the $\gamma$-metric has been shown to be consistent with the observed shadow radii of M87$^*$ and Sgr A$^*$, its accretion flow topology, the resulting radiative properties and image differ from the Schwarzschild case, thereby giving a complementary way to probe the deviations from the Schwarzschild paradigm.

classification.title_zh: 通过可观测特征和吸积盘图像探测无视界致密天体
classification.abstract_zh: 受事件视界望远镜对M87*和Sgr A*成像的推动，本文在Zipoy-Voorhees（γ度规）时空中研究稳态、无粘、轴对称的平流吸积流。γ度规是Schwarzschild几何的静态轴对称推广，由质量M_·和形变参数γ刻画。作者求解相对论流体动力学方程，考察γ对有效势、临界点位置与性质以及吸积流拓扑的影响；采用相对论热轫致辐射发射率计算谱能量分布和热光度，发现γ对具有外临界点（O型）和内临界点（I型）的吸积流光度有相反影响。最后结合广义相对论光线追踪，构造不同γ和观测倾角下的吸积盘合成图像；观测通量分布独立证实了光度和光谱分析的趋势。尽管γ度规的阴影与M87*和Sgr A*观测阴影半径一致，其吸积流拓扑、辐射性质和图像与Schwarzschild情形不同，从而提供了探测偏离Schwarzschild范式的互补途径。
classification.one_liner: 该文用γ度规吸积流动力学、辐射谱和光线追踪图像，研究无视界致密天体偏离Schwarzschild的可观测特征。

papers.title: Efficient search for microlensed gravitational-wave signals with matched filtering and a two-image statistic
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves from compact binary coalescences can be microlensed by compact objects along the line of sight, producing frequency-dependent waveform distortions. As standard matched-filter searches rely on unlensed templates without accounting for lensing effects, microlensed signals can lose signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) through template mismatch and suffer further losses from signal-consistency tests. We quantify both effects for the $\texttt{PyCBC}$ search using microlensed injections in simulated data. The two losses occupy different regions of lens parameter space in the geometric optics representation: template mismatch is governed by the relative magnification of the two images, while the consistency-test penalty is governed by their time delay. We show that a microlensed signal lies in the two-dimensional subspace spanned by a template and its time-shifted copy, allowing the relative magnification and Morse phase to be maximized over analytically, leaving only the time delay to search. The resulting statistic requires no extension of the template bank and reduces the median loss in re-weighted SNR from $10\%$ to $1.6\%$, and the $90^\mathrm{th}$ percentile from $41\%$ to $9\%$. At a false-alarm rate of one per day, the relative detection volume improves by about $6\%$ across all injections, and by a factor of $1.9$ for the $10\%$ of injections most affected by lensing. In addition to increased detection capacities, we also show how the detection statistic can be used to establish the lensed nature of the trigger. Therefore, the work proposed here lays the foundation for an effective search and identification of microlensed signals in gravitational-wave data.

classification.title_zh: 利用匹配滤波和双像统计量高效搜索微引力透镜化引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 致密双星并合产生的引力波可被视线方向上的致密天体微引力透镜化，导致波形出现频率依赖的畸变。标准匹配滤波搜索使用未透镜化模板，不包含透镜效应，因此微透镜化信号会因模板失配损失信噪比，并进一步受到信号一致性检验的惩罚。本文利用模拟数据中的微透镜化注入，量化 PyCBC 搜索中的这两种损失。在几何光学近似下，两种损失占据不同的透镜参数区域：模板失配由双像相对放大率决定，一致性检验惩罚由双像时间延迟决定。作者表明，微透镜化信号位于一个模板及其时间平移副本张成的二维子空间中，因此可解析地最大化相对放大率和 Morse 相位，只需搜索时间延迟。所得统计量无需扩展模板库，将重加权信噪比的中位损失从 10% 降至 1.6%，第 90 百分位损失从 41% 降至 9%。在每天一次虚警率下，所有注入的相对探测体积提高约 6%，而对受透镜影响最大的 10% 注入提高约 1.9 倍。作者还展示了该探测统计量可用于判定触发事件的透镜化性质，为在引力波数据中有效搜索和识别微透镜化信号奠定基础。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种无需扩展模板库的匹配滤波双像统计量，用解析最大化相对放大率与 Morse 相位、仅搜索时间延迟的方式，显著降低微透镜化引力波信号的搜索损失并提升探测体积。

papers.title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of gravitational-wave astronomy and high-precision numerical relativity has created an acute computational bottleneck: direct numerical integration of the Einstein field equations and high-dimensional Bayesian parameter estimation require millions of waveform evaluations that cannot be sustained by traditional solvers alone. Reduced-order modeling (ROM) and surrogate techniques have emerged as foundational tools to bridge this gap, compressing high-fidelity solution manifolds into compact, rapidly evaluable representations without sacrificing physical accuracy. This perspective reviews the mathematical pillars of projection-based reduced-order modeling---including Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method---and traces their operational impact in gravitational-wave data analysis through surrogate waveform families and Reduced-Order Quadratures. We then examine the fundamental approximation barriers posed by slow Kolmogorov n-width decay in non-stationary, transient, and strongly nonlinear regimes, showing how adaptive hp-greedy domain partitioning and multi-scale spectral compression overcome these limits. Finally, we discuss how combining certified reduced-order structures with modern scientific machine learning and sensitivity-aware quantization provides a rigorous blueprint for next-generation detectors such as LISA, Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer.

classification.title_zh: 引力波物理与数值相对论中的代理建模与降阶方法：从谱表示到自适应压缩
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波天文学与高精度数值相对论的快速发展带来了严重计算瓶颈：直接数值积分爱因斯坦场方程和高维贝叶斯参数估计需要海量波形评估，传统求解器难以承受。降阶建模与代理技术通过将高保真解流形压缩为紧凑、可快速评估的表示来弥合这一差距，同时尽量不牺牲物理精度。本文综述基于投影的降阶建模数学基础，包括本征正交分解、贪心基选择和经验插值法，并梳理代理波形族与降阶求积在引力波数据分析中的实际作用。文章进一步讨论非定常、瞬态和强非线性区域中Kolmogorov n宽度衰减缓慢带来的近似障碍，说明自适应hp-greedy区域划分和多尺度谱压缩如何克服这些限制。最后讨论将可认证降阶结构与现代科学机器学习及敏感性感知量化结合，为LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探险者等下一代探测器提供严格蓝图。
classification.one_liner: 综述投影降阶、代理波形与自适应谱压缩在引力波数值相对论和数据分析中的应用、瓶颈与下一代探测器路线。

papers.title: Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. III. Reissner-Nordstrom spectra from zero to extremal charge
papers.abstract: Earlier calculations left open how gravitational quasinormal modes (QNMs) of charged black holes recover the Schwarzschild spectrum and how the modes near algebraically special frequencies relate to the exact special solutions. We extend our Kerr analysis to Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes by analytically continuing the ingoing horizon solution and locating the zeros of the incoming amplitude at infinity. For each of $\ell=2$ and $3$, we trace the first 42 overtone families from the Schwarzschild limit to extremality. The charge trajectories distinguish crossings of the negative imaginary axis from turns near it and separate the unconventional Schwarzschild modes from neighboring branches. At zero charge the polar algebraically special mode is a QNM. At extremal charge the exact axial special modes are total-transmission modes. Of the 84 families, 75 approach distinct extremal frequencies with finite damping, and nine approach zero frequency with vanishing excitation. At exact extremality we also compute, for the first time, gravitational QNMs on the unconventional Riemann sheet reached across the negative imaginary axis. At intermediate charge, the clearest resonant enhancement of both excitation factors occurs for the $\ell=3$ overtone pairs $(22,23)$ and $(23,24)$.

classification.title_zh: Type-D 黑洞的完整准正规模 III：从零电荷到极端电荷的 Reissner-Nordström 谱
classification.abstract_zh: 此前计算未明确带电黑洞引力准正规模如何恢复 Schwarzschild 谱，以及近代数特殊频率的模与精确特殊解的关系。我们将 Kerr 分析推广到 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞：解析延拓入射视界解，并定位无穷远处入射振幅的零点。对 ℓ=2 和 3，追踪前 42 个 overtone 族从 Schwarzschild 极限到极端电荷。电荷轨迹区分负虚轴交叉与在其附近转向，并将非传统 Schwarzschild 模与相邻分支分开。零电荷时极向代数特殊模是 QNM；极端电荷时精确轴向特殊模是全透射模。84 个族中 75 个趋近具有有限阻尼的不同极端频率，9 个以零激发趋近零频率。在严格极端性下，还首次计算了跨负虚轴到达的非传统 Riemann 叶上的引力 QNM。在中间电荷，ℓ=3 overtone 对 (22,23) 和 (23,24) 出现最明显的两个激发因子共振增强。
classification.one_liner: 系统追踪 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞引力准正规模从零电荷到极端电荷的完整谱，并揭示特殊模与极端极限行为。

papers.title: A twist in the tail: GWLENS, a fast and accurate tool for wave-optics lensing of gravitational waves
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave lensing in the wave-optics regime requires evaluating the Fresnel--Kirchhoff diffraction integral, whose integrand is highly oscillatory and must be evaluated numerically, as closed-form solutions exist only for a few lens models. We present a novel, efficient algorithm that splits the integration domain at a point beyond the region containing the lensed images. The bounded head region is integrated along the real axis with Gauss--Legendre quadrature, while the semi-infinite tail is rotated into the complex plane, where the integrand decays exponentially, and is evaluated with Gauss--Laguerre quadrature. Since the image region is never deformed, the method avoids the treatment of poles and branch cuts required by existing contour-deformation approaches. Our results agree with the exact point-mass solution to $10^{-13}$ and show good agreement with other methods. We present several examples for non-trivial lens models, showing potential for parameter estimation of realistic lenses. The method is particularly efficient when the amplification factor is needed for many source positions. In addition to transient broadband compact binary coalescence GW signals, we apply it to long-duration (continuous), quasi-monochromatic GW signals, for which the relative motion of source and lens makes the amplification factor time-dependent over the observation. The implementation is publicly available in the Python package GWLENS.

classification.title_zh: 尾部的转折：GWLENS——快速精确的引力波波动光学透镜工具
classification.abstract_zh: 波动光学 regime 下的引力波透镜需要计算 Fresnel–Kirchhoff 衍射积分，其被积函数高度振荡，通常只能数值求解，因为仅少数透镜模型有闭式解。我们提出一种高效算法，将积分域在包含透镜像的区域之外某点分开：有界的头部区域沿实轴用 Gauss–Legendre 求积，半无限尾部旋转到复平面，使被积函数指数衰减，并用 Gauss–Laguerre 求积计算。由于像区域从不形变，该方法避免了现有围道变形方法所需的极点和分支割线处理。结果与精确点质量解在 10^{-13} 精度一致，并与其他方法吻合。我们给出非平凡透镜模型的例子，展示对真实透镜参数估计的潜力。当需要计算许多源位置的放大因子时，该方法尤其高效。除瞬变宽带致密双星并合引力波信号外，我们还将其应用于长持续时间准单色连续引力波信号，其中源与透镜的相对运动使放大因子在观测期间随时间变化。该实现已在 Python 包 GWLENS 中公开。
classification.one_liner: 提出 GWLENS 算法，通过分域复平面求积快速精确计算引力波波动光学透镜放大因子。

papers.title: Electro-Penrose Process in Charged BTZ Black Holes: From Probe Limit to Thermodynamic Backreaction
papers.abstract: We investigate the electro-Penrose process (EPP) in $(2+1)$-dimensional charged Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) spacetime, from probe-limit particle dynamics to quasistatic thermodynamic backreaction. In the probe background, neutral particles have no exterior circular orbits, and charged circular motion requires a minimum repulsive coupling. We derive the maximum single-event energy at fixed decay data, including fragment masses and charge allocation, and check capture and collection at a finite receiver in anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime. Repetitive radial extraction on successive exact stationary backgrounds uses an adaptive incident specific charge. The continuum mass-charge path identifies the switch between incident turning-point and negative-energy stopping, supported by numerical checks. The prescribed sequences terminate at nonzero residual charge before exhausting the energy reservoir, providing a protocol-dependent third-law analogy. The consumed reservoir is divided between extracted energy and irreversible growth of irreducible mass, with proportions depending on the protocol.

classification.title_zh: 带电BTZ黑洞中的电-Penrose过程：从探针极限到热力学反作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究(2+1)维带电Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli（BTZ）时空中的电-Penrose过程（EPP），范围从探针极限下的粒子动力学到准静态热力学反作用。在探针背景中，中性粒子没有外部圆轨道，带电圆运动需要最小排斥耦合。我们推导固定衰变数据（包括碎片质量和电荷分配）下的最大单次事件能量，并检查反德西特（AdS）时空中有限接收器处的捕获与收集。在连续精确稳态背景上的重复径向提取使用自适应入射比荷。连续质量-电荷路径识别入射转折点与负能量停止之间的切换，并得到数值检验支持。预设序列在耗尽能量库之前终止于非零残余电荷，提供了一种依赖协议的第三定律类比。消耗的能量库分为提取能量和不可约质量的不可逆增长，其比例取决于协议。
classification.one_liner: 研究带电BTZ时空中电Penrose过程的探针极限与准静态热力学反作用，分析能量提取、电荷约束及第三定律类比。

papers.title: Orbit-averaged spinning and eccentric binary black holes: Hamiltonian and integrability
papers.abstract: For over two decades, the orbit-averaged precession equations of spinning binary black holes at second post-Newtonian order have been a standard model for their spin dynamics. One of their constants of motion, the projected effective spin, underlies the stability analysis of aligned-spin configurations and the construction of analytical solutions. The system is known to be Hamiltonian and integrable, its Hamiltonian being the orbit average of the full post-Newtonian Hamiltonian. Independently, we derive this Hamiltonian from the equations of motion alone, show why the orbit average gives the correct equations, and relate its constants of motion to those of the full system. We then construct the action-angle variables and frequencies with the recently introduced method of fictitious variables, and propose a criterion for the breakdown of the integrability conditions. This criterion recovers the separatrices of simple classical systems and the up-down instability, whose thresholds we give explicitly for eccentric orbits. We also show that, when all binaries of an ensemble share the same parameters and radiation reaction does not depend on the spins, the Hamiltonian structure preserves an isotropic distribution of spin directions. We confirm numerically that isotropy can be lost when the parameters are correlated with the spin directions. Finally, we use the orbit-averaged Hamiltonian to generalize the projected effective spin to binary neutron stars, for which it is not conserved, and obtain a closed form valid for eccentric orbits.

classification.title_zh: 轨道平均的自旋与偏心双黑洞：哈密顿量与可积性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究二阶后牛顿阶自旋双黑洞的轨道平均进动方程。作者仅从运动方程出发重新导出该哈密顿量，说明轨道平均为何给出正确方程，并将其守恒量同完整系统的守恒量相联系；随后用虚构变量方法构造作用量-角变量与频率，提出可积性条件破缺的判据，该判据可恢复简单经典系统的分界线以及偏心轨道下上下不稳定性的阈值。文章还证明，当系综中所有双星参数相同且辐射反作用不依赖自旋时，哈密顿结构保持自旋方向的各向同性分布，并用数值确认参数与自旋方向相关时各向同性可能丧失；最后将轨道平均哈密顿量用于推广投影有效自旋至双中子星，得到偏心轨道下适用的闭式。
classification.one_liner: 从运动方程重新导出2PN轨道平均自旋哈密顿量，构造作用量-角变量并讨论可积性破缺判据及双中子星推广。

papers.title: Geodesic-informed neural networks for testing spacetimes with S2
papers.abstract: Stellar orbits around Sagittarius A*, in particular that of S2, test the spacetime of the Galactic Center. Such analyses usually integrate the equations of motion for every likelihood evaluation and sample the posterior. We develop a differentiable orbit model for static, spherically symmetric spacetimes that obtains the parameters, their uncertainties and the Bayesian evidence by optimization rather than sampling. In the Geodesic-Informed Neural Network (GINN), the conserved quantities, the shape of the orbit and the redshift are computed exactly from the metric, and a neural network constrained by the geodesic equation represents the time evolution of the radial phase. The physical parameters and the network weights minimize a single loss with Adam and Gauss-Newton steps, and the curvature at the minimum gives the uncertainties and the evidence. We test this Gaussian approximation against a second-order expansion and an exact geodesic solver, and apply GINN to the S2 data in the Schwarzschild, Reissner-Nordstr\"om, hairy Horndeski, Bardeen, Janis-Newman-Winicour and Yukawa spacetimes. GINN reproduces the estimates and uncertainties of the exact solver. For Schwarzschild we find $M=(4.32\pm0.22)\times10^6\,M_\odot$ and $D=8.33\pm0.21$ kpc. No spacetime deviates significantly from Schwarzschild; a Yukawa correction, for example, is limited to $|\delta|<0.011$ (95%) at a range of about 180 AU. No additional parameter improves the fit enough to pay its Occam penalty, so the Bayes factors range from inconclusive to moderate in favor of Schwarzschild. The Gaussian approximation is accurate when the hair enters the metric linearly and conservative when it enters only through its square. When the posterior is close to Gaussian, GINN gives the estimates, their uncertainties and the evidence from a single optimization, and the same derivatives quantify departures from it.

classification.title_zh: 用于利用 S2 检验时空的测地线信息神经网络
classification.abstract_zh: 围绕人马座 A* 的恒星轨道，尤其是 S2，可用于检验银河系中心时空。此类分析通常对每次似然评估积分运动方程并采样后验。我们为静态球对称时空开发了一个可微轨道模型，通过优化而非采样获得参数、不确定度和贝叶斯证据。在 GINN 中，守恒量、轨道形状和红移由度规精确计算，一个受测地线方程约束的神经网络表示径向相位的时间演化。物理参数与网络权重通过 Adam 和 Gauss-Newton 步最小化单一损失，极小值处的曲率给出不确定度和证据。我们用二阶展开和精确测地线求解器检验该高斯近似，并将 GINN 应用于 Schwarzschild、Reissner-Nordström、hairy Horndeski、Bardeen、Janis-Newman-Winicour 和 Yukawa 时空中的 S2 数据。GINN 复现精确求解器的估计和不确定度。对 Schwarzschild 得到 M=(4.32±0.22)×10^6 M⊙ 和 D=8.33±0.21 kpc。没有时空显著偏离 Schwarzschild；例如 Yukawa 修正在约 180 AU 尺度上被限制为 |δ|<0.011 (95%)。没有额外参数能改善拟合到足以抵消其 Occam 惩罚，因此 Bayes 因子从不确定到中等支持 Schwarzschild。当 hair 线性进入度规时高斯近似准确，当其仅通过平方进入时则保守。当后验接近高斯时，GINN 通过单次优化给出估计、不确定度和证据，且同一组导数可量化偏离程度。
classification.one_liner: 提出测地线信息神经网络 GINN，用单次可微优化从 S2 轨道数据检验多种静态球对称时空并计算贝叶斯证据。

papers.title: A relativistic gravitisation of quantum theory?
papers.abstract: We develop a model, that we call local semiclassical gravity, based on the distributional semiclassical Einstein field equations (EFEs) sourced by the local quantum state, i.e. the reduced density matrix of the local system updated by collapses (only) in its past light cone. We propose this as the basis of a relativistically causal generally covariant gravitisation of relativistic quantum theory in $1+3$ spacetime dimensions. We derive the weak-field limit which exhibits the explicitly causal dynamical structure of the theory, and recover the Schr\"odinger-Newton (SN) system in the nonrelativistic limit. This proposal can thus be understood as a causal completion of the SN equation, a nonlinear extension to quantum theory. We analyze relativistic quantum measurements in this nonlinear setup, showing that these do not lead to superluminal signalling if quantum states update (only) in the future light-cone of the measurement region. We give explicit examples of quantum measurements on a spatial superposition and on entangled subsystems showing how, in the weak field limit, discontinuities in the expectation value of the stress-energy tensor can be consistent with distributional solutions to the (linearised) semiclassical EFEs. We also highlight that the theory allows non-standard measurements via its nonlinearities. These effective ``readout devices'' can approximately determine a quantum state without affecting it through the state's influence on the classical gravitational field and hence can implement approximate quantum state cloning. Nonetheless, the theory does not allow superluminal signalling, although it does violate the quantum no-signalling principle. We further show that the classical gravitational field is generally not locally causal in the sense of Bell. We present several paths to test the model against low-energy quantum gravity in tabletop experiments.

classification.title_zh: 相对论性量子理论的引力化？
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种称为“局域半经典引力”的模型，其基础是由局域量子态（即局域系统的约化密度矩阵，并且仅在其过去光锥内发生坍缩时更新）作为源的分布型半经典 Einstein 场方程。作者将其作为 1+3 维相对论量子理论的一种相对论因果、广义协变的“引力化”基础。文中推导了弱场极限，显示理论的显式因果动力学结构，并在非相对论极限下恢复 Schrödinger-Newton 系统；因此该方案可视为 SN 方程的因果完备化，也是对量子理论的非线性扩展。作者分析了该非线性框架下的相对论量子测量，表明若量子态仅在测量区域的未来光锥内更新，则不会导致超光速信号。文中给出空间叠加态和纠缠子系统测量的显式例子，说明在弱场极限下应力-能量张量期望值的不连续性与（线性化）半经典 Einstein 场方程的分布解相容。文章还指出非线性允许非标准测量：这些有效“读出装置”可通过量子态对经典引力场的影响近似确定量子态而不改变它，从而实现近似量子态克隆；尽管理论违反量子无信号原理，但不允许超光速信号。作者进一步表明经典引力场一般不满足 Bell 意义上的局域因果性，并提出若干桌面实验检验该模型与低能量子引力的路径。
classification.one_liner: 提出局域半经典引力模型，用局域量子态源化分布型半经典 Einstein 场方程，给出因果弱场极限、Schrödinger-Newton 非相对论极限及量子测量/无超光速信号分析。

papers.title: Long lived QNM for multiple black holes
papers.abstract: We provide a rigorous definition of quasinormal modes (QNM) for the Majumdar--Papapetrou spacetimes with multiple extremal black holes. For certain configurations, the trapped set of the null geodesic flow contains stable (elliptic) orbits. We analyze this phenomenon in the case of two black holes of equal mass and show that it produces QNM converging exponentially fast to the real axis. QNM for black holes have been extensively studied for $\textit{single}$ black holes and this appears to be the first $\textit{mathematical}$ result for the case of multiple black holes.

classification.title_zh: 多黑洞的长寿命准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文对含多个极端黑洞的 Majumdar-Papapetrou 时空给出了准正规模（QNM）的严格定义。对于某些构型，零测地流的不变捕获集包含稳定（椭圆）轨道。作者分析两个等质量黑洞的情形，并表明这会产生以指数速度趋近实轴的 QNM。黑洞 QNM 此前主要针对单个黑洞被广泛研究，而本文似乎是多黑洞情形的首个数学结果。
classification.one_liner: 为多极端黑洞 Majumdar-Papapetrou 时空严格定义 QNM，并证明等质量双黑洞构型中稳定零测地轨道导致 QNM 指数趋近实轴。

papers.title: Projected Sensitivity of a Differential Torsion Sensor for Tests of the Weak Equivalence Principle
papers.abstract: Tests of the weak equivalence principle (WEP) are among the most sensitive probes of new long-range, composition-dependent interactions beyond general relativity and the Standard Model. We evaluate the potential of a differential torsion sensor, which combines long mechanical coherence times with optical-cavity readout and common-mode rejection, for laboratory WEP tests and fifth-force searches. For a representative configuration based on an existing prototype, with Be-Ti test masses and 180 days of coherent integration, the projected noise-limited sensitivity to the E\"otv\"os parameter is $\eta\simeq7.5\times10^{-16}$ and $2.4\times10^{-16}$ for signal modulation at 2 and 20 mHz, respectively, below current ground-based torsion-balance limits. For a baryon-coupled Yukawa interaction sourced by the Earth, the corresponding projected sensitivity to the coupling strength is $\alpha\simeq3.1\times10^{-13}$ and $9.8\times10^{-14}$ for ranges $\lambda\gtrsim10^{7}$ m. We identify the modulation scheme, the material contrast, and the source geometry as the main factors that set the projected reach, and the control of systematic couplings as the main experimental requirement for attaining it. These results indicate that differential torsion sensors are a promising platform for future laboratory WEP tests.

classification.title_zh: 用于弱等效原理检验的差分扭秤传感器投影灵敏度
classification.abstract_zh: 弱等效原理（WEP）检验是探测超越广义相对论和标准模型的新长程、组分相关相互作用的最灵敏探针之一。我们评估一种差分扭秤传感器的潜力，它结合长机械相干时间、光腔读出和共模抑制，用于实验室 WEP 检验和第五力搜寻。对于基于现有原型的代表性配置，使用 Be-Ti 检验质量并相干积分 180 天，在 2 和 20 mHz 信号调制下，对 Eötvös 参数的噪声限制投影灵敏度分别为 η≃7.5×10^{-16} 和 2.4×10^{-16}，低于当前地面扭秤平衡极限。对于由地球作为源的重子耦合 Yukawa 相互作用，在范围 λ≳10^7 m 下，对耦合强度的相应投影灵敏度为 α≃3.1×10^{-13} 和 9.8×10^{-14}。我们指出调制方案、材料对比度和源几何是决定投影可达范围的主要因素，而系统耦合的控制是达到该灵敏度所需的主要实验要求。这些结果表明差分扭秤传感器是未来实验室 WEP 检验的有前景平台。
classification.one_liner: 评估差分扭秤传感器在弱等效原理检验和第五力搜寻中的投影灵敏度。

papers.title: Helicity-squared scaling of post-eikonal phases for electromagnetic and gravitational waves in Ricci-flat spacetimes
papers.abstract: Spin-optical descriptions of electromagnetic and gravitational waves isolate finite-frequency corrections that are odd in the helicity. We study the complementary, helicity-even part of the first post-eikonal correction for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational waves on Ricci-flat backgrounds. In a parallel-propagated null tetrad, the direct Weyl coupling of the gravitational field projects onto the circular transverse-traceless states as the multiple $2C_{\bar m m\bar m m}$ of the identity. The Ricci identity for the spin coefficient $\mu$ then rewrites this projection as a total derivative plus optical terms. The helicity-even phase of a spin-$s$ wave, measured relative to the scalar wave, then obeys a helicity-squared law, $\Delta_2=4\Delta_1$, up to endpoint terms. The Weyl coupling is what completes the $h^2$ scaling in the gravitational case. For weak-deflection scattering by a Schwarzschild black hole we evaluate the relevant integrals along the ray and obtain $\Delta_s=-3\pi s^2/(8M\omega\rho^3)$, with $\rho=b/M$. The same coefficient follows independently, and without reference to any frame or gauge, from the Regge--Wheeler phase shifts combined with the asymptotics of the rotation functions $d^l_{ss}$. Direct numerical integration of the radial equations confirms it. At first order in $M$ the helicity-even phase difference vanishes, as required by the Born amplitudes. The helicity-odd spin-optical sector and the helicity-even post-eikonal sector are therefore organized by the first and second powers of the helicity, respectively.

classification.title_zh: 电磁波与引力波在Ricci平坦时空中后程函相位的螺旋度平方标度
classification.abstract_zh: 电磁波和引力波的自旋光学描述分离出对螺旋度呈奇数的有限频率修正。我们研究标量波、电磁波和线性化引力波在Ricci平坦背景上第一阶后程函修正中互补的、螺旋度偶的部分。在平行传播的零标架中，引力场的直接Weyl耦合投影到圆横向无痕态上，表现为恒等式的倍数 2C_{\bar m m\bar m m}。自旋系数 μ 的Ricci恒等式随后将此投影改写为全导数加光学项。相对于标量波测得自旋s波的螺旋度偶相位，服从螺旋度平方律 Δ2=4Δ1，直到端点项。Weyl耦合正是完成引力情形中 h^2 标度的因素。对于Schwarzschild黑洞的弱偏转散射，我们沿射线计算相关积分并得到 Δ_s=-3π s^2/(8Mωρ^3)，其中 ρ=b/M。同一系数也可独立地、不参考任何标架或规范，由Regge-Wheeler相移结合旋转函数 d^l_{ss} 的渐近行为得到。径向方程的直接数值积分证实了这一点。在M的一阶，螺旋度偶相位差消失，正如Born振幅所要求。因此，螺旋度奇的自旋光学部分和螺旋度偶的后程函部分分别由螺旋度的一次方和二次方组织。
classification.one_liner: 在Ricci平坦背景上，标量、电磁与线性化引力波的第一后程函螺旋度偶相位满足螺旋度平方标度，并在Schwarzschild弱偏转散射中给出显式系数。
