papers.title: Filling the interior of the light cone
papers.abstract: The retarded Green's function of gravitational waves in a spatially flat Friedmann--Lema\^itre--Robertson--Walker universe contains, besides the light-cone term, a tail supported inside the light cone. We formulate the tail, for homogeneous and isotropic backgrounds, as the solution of a ``\textit{Goursat problem},'' {\emph{i.e.}}, a hyperbolic partial differential equation with boundary conditions given on two intersecting characteristic curves. In this sense, we fill the interior of the light cone. We solve this problem directly in position space for any expansion history, and compare exact solutions in $\Lambda$CDM independently with a convergent double series about the coincidence point, and with an approximate analytic interaction model. We discuss the interpretation of the tail as the sum of the waves scattered off the background curvature, as suggested by its expansion in powers of the curvature potential. Our novel solutions allow us to follow the tail throughout the entire expansion history, from the electroweak epoch to today. We find that the tail of an early source records the trace of the cosmic fluid along the light cone, ordered in retarded time: single scattering accounts for its features in the radiation era, while multiple scattering is needed in the matter era. This work establishes the accuracy of our calculation of the tail and lays the groundwork for its applications. From the position-space data we obtain the large-$k$ expansion of the propagator. Its first correction, the effect of the tail, depends on the curvature potential integrated along the light cone. The applications of the tail, the power spectrum of a background of bursts, and the memory waveform of a single burst, both of which require convolving the Green's function with its source, are presented in follow-up papers.

classification.title_zh: 填充光锥内部
classification.abstract_zh: 在空间平直的FLRW宇宙中，引力波的推迟格林函数除了光锥项外，还包含支撑在光锥内部的尾迹。本文将均匀且各向同性背景下的该尾迹表述为一个Goursat问题，即具有两条相交特征线上边界条件的双曲偏微分方程，并直接在位置空间中对任意膨胀历史求解。对于LambdaCDM，作者将精确解分别与围绕重合点的收敛双级数以及近似解析相互作用模型进行比较。文中讨论了将尾迹解释为被背景曲率散射的波之和，这一解释由其按曲率势幂次的展开所提示。新解允许追踪尾迹贯穿整个膨胀历史，从电弱时期到今天。作者发现，早期源的尾迹记录了沿光锥按推迟时间排序的宇宙流体痕迹：单次散射解释了辐射时期特征，而物质时期需要多次散射。该工作确立了尾迹计算的精度，并为其应用奠定基础。由位置空间数据还可得到传播子的大k展开，其第一项修正即尾迹效应依赖于沿光锥积分的曲率势；尾迹在爆发背景功率谱和单爆发记忆波形中的应用将在后续论文中给出。
classification.one_liner: 在FLRW宇宙中把引力波推迟格林函数的光锥内尾迹表述并求解为Goursat问题，用于追踪从早期到今天的曲率散射尾迹。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/宇宙学中的引力波传播与格林函数问题，匹配‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子信息。

papers.title: Separable equations of motion for spinning test bodies in spacetimes with Killing--Yano symmetry
papers.abstract: At linear order in spin, the motion of a spinning compact body in curved spacetime is known to have two remarkable properties: (i) in Kerr spacetime, a suitable shift of the worldline maps the motion onto fiducial geodesics, yielding separable equations of motion; and (ii) in four-dimensional spacetimes admitting a non-degenerate Killing--Yano tensor, the dynamics are integrable. In this work, we generalize the worldline-shift method of (i) to the whole class of spacetimes in (ii), using a covariant construction built on the Killing--Yano symmetry. We show that spin then plays the role of charge: after the shift, the motion is described by a fictitious spinless particle, with charge set by the spin component along the orbital angular momentum, obeying a Lorentz-force equation. The effective field strength is built from the Ricci tensor and the dual of the Killing--Yano tensor. It vanishes in Ricci-flat spacetimes, recovering the geodesic description known in Kerr. In the general off-shell metric admitting a Killing--Yano tensor, we derive explicitly separated equations of motion, which reduce to quadratures and provide a constructive realization of the known integrability. Since no field equations are assumed, our results apply to any such spacetime, including those sourced by matter or arising in modified theories of gravity, and we illustrate them in Kerr--de Sitter spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 具有Killing-Yano对称性的时空中自旋测试体的可分离运动方程
classification.abstract_zh: 在自旋线性阶，弯曲时空中自旋致密体的运动已知有两个显著性质：(i) 在Kerr时空中，通过适当的世界线平移可将运动映射到参考测地线，从而得到可分离的运动方程；(ii) 在允许非退化Killing-Yano张量的四维时空中，动力学是可积的。本文利用基于Killing-Yano对称性的协变构造，将(i)中的世界线平移方法推广到(ii)中的整类时空。我们表明自旋随后扮演电荷的角色：平移后，运动由无自旋的虚构粒子描述，其电荷由自旋沿轨道角动量的分量设定，并服从洛伦兹力方程。有效场强由Ricci张量和Killing-Yano张量的对偶构造；它在Ricci平坦时空中消失，从而恢复Kerr中已知的测地线描述。在允许Killing-Yano张量的一般离壳度规中，我们显式导出了可分离运动方程，它们化为求积，并给出了已知可积性的构造性实现。由于未假设场方程，我们的结果适用于任何此类时空，包括由物质源产生的时空或修改引力中出现的时空，并在Kerr-de Sitter时空中作了示例说明。
classification.one_liner: 把Kerr中自旋测试粒子的世界线平移推广到Killing-Yano时空，导出可分离运动方程并揭示自旋作为有效电荷。

papers.title: Holographic spin alignment of vector mesons in a spinning black-hole background
papers.abstract: Holographic predictions for vector-meson spin alignment may depend on the background geometry and on the meson model. We examine the opposite polarization preferences observed for charmonium and light vector mesons by placing \(J/\psi\) and \(\phi\) in one soft-wall model on the planar limit of a five-dimensional equal-spin Myers--Perry AdS black hole. Spectral functions and spin alignment are computed within the same current-correlator framework; the nonrotating results of Sheng et al. [Phys. Rev. D 110, 056047 (2024)] are recovered at \(a=0\). At \(T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}\), \(J/\psi\) retains a clear resonance peak, whereas \(\phi\) shows no narrow peak and instead behaves as a broad distribution consistent with unstable \(s\bar{s}\) pairs. For \(J/\psi\) along \(z\), rotation enhances the positive deviation of \(\rho_{00}^{h}\) from \(1/3\) at low and intermediate momenta but suppresses it at high momenta; along \(x\), the effect is small. For \(\phi\), rotation enhances the negative deviation, more along \(z\) than along \(x\). The opposite helicity-frame signs and the opposing azimuthal and rapidity trends of the global alignment provide a reference for interpreting data: trends inconsistent with these would challenge the simplest single homogeneous rotating-medium interpretation. We distinguish model-dependent numerical details from qualitative features stable within this model class.

classification.title_zh: 旋转黑洞背景中矢量介子自旋排列的全息研究
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在五维等自旋 Myers–Perry AdS 黑洞的平面极限下，用同一软墙模型放置 J/ψ 与 φ，并在同一流关联函数框架中计算谱函数和自旋排列，以考察粲偶素与轻矢量介子相反极化偏好。非旋转结果在 a=0 时回到已有工作。T=0.15 GeV 时 J/ψ 保留明显共振峰，φ 无窄峰而呈宽分布；旋转对沿 z 与 x 方向的 ρ00 偏离 1/3 的影响不同，并对 J/ψ 与 φ 呈现相反符号及不同方位角和快度趋势。作者将这些定性特征与模型依赖的数值细节区分开，作为解释数据的参考。
classification.one_liner: 在旋转 AdS 黑洞背景下用软墙全息模型计算 J/ψ 与 φ 的谱函数和自旋排列，比较旋转对相反极化偏好的影响。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave Modeling of White-Dwarf--Compact-Object Binaries and Observational Outlook
papers.abstract: Binaries consisting of a white dwarf and a compact object (neutron stars, black holes, or sub-solar-mass compact objects) display unique orbital evolution and gravitational wave signals. We investigate the end stages of these systems by developing a novel integrator implementing mass transfer and 2.5-order Post-Newtonian kinematics. White-dwarf--compact-object binaries are subject to two phases: a slow inspiral during which binary evolution is dominated by weak-gravity radiation reaction and a quicker "outspiral" dominated by mass transfer. These systems have unique gravitational waveforms with several characteristic features including an accumulation of signal near the maximum cutoff frequency set by the transition between in- and outspiral. We investigate trends in gravitational wave parameters based on component masses. In particular, maximum cutoff frequency depends strongly on white dwarf mass and compactness. It is unlikely that extragalactic binaries will be measured by LISA or current or future terrestrial detectors. However, white-dwarf--compact-object binary end stages will be an important source for future decihertz detectors such as DECIGO and LGWA: The final inspiral of tens of white-dwarf--neutron-star binaries will be detected annually by LGWA, and millions of inspirals along with thousands of outspirals will be detected by DECIGO. The ultimate fates of these binaries are diverse and dependent upon the intricacies of angular momentum loss. In particular, we show that white dwarfs with partners of sufficiently low/high mass can end their lives in mergers, while white dwarfs do not enter contact with partners of intermediate mass. The highest frequencies produced by white-dwarf--compact-object binaries in our tests are 10--20 Hz--incapable of mimicking sub-solar-mass compact object signals in terrestrial detectors or explaining S251112cm-like signals.

classification.title_zh: 白矮星—致密天体双星的引力波建模与观测展望
classification.abstract_zh: 白矮星与致密天体（中子星、黑洞或亚太阳质量致密天体）组成的双星具有独特的轨道演化和引力波信号。本文通过开发一个实现质量转移和2.5阶后牛顿运动学的新积分器，研究这类系统的末段演化。白矮星—致密天体双星经历两个阶段：由弱引力辐射反作用主导的缓慢旋近，以及由质量转移主导的更快“外旋”。这些系统产生具有若干特征的特殊引力波形，包括在由旋近到外旋转变所设定的最大截断频率附近信号累积。我们基于组分质量研究引力波参数趋势，发现最大截断频率强烈依赖白矮星质量和致密度。河外双星不太可能被LISA或当前/未来地面探测器测量；然而，白矮星—致密天体双星末段将成为DECIGO和LGWA等未来分赫兹探测器的重要源：LGWA每年可探测数十个白矮星—中子星双星的最终旋近，DECIGO可探测数百万个旋近以及数千个外旋。这些双星的最终命运多样，并依赖角动量损失的细节；特别地，白矮星与质量足够低/高的伴星可最终并合，而与中等质量伴星则不会进入接触。测试中产生的最高频率为10–20 Hz，无法模仿地面探测器中的亚太阳质量致密天体信号或解释类似S251112cm的信号。
classification.one_liner: 用含质量转移与2.5PN动力学的积分器建模白矮星—致密天体双星末段引力波，并评估DECIGO/LGWA等分赫兹探测器的观测前景。

papers.title: The deci-Hz gravitational wave signal from the collapse of rotating very massive stars
papers.abstract: We calculate the gravitational wave signal from the collapse of a rotating 300 $M_\odot$ star just above the upper end of the pair-instability supernova regime. The large-scale asymmetries that develop during the collapse produce a strong signal in the deci-Hz range that has a characteristic shape that is likely amenable to a template-based search. Although tempered by the low incidence of nearby astrophysical candidates, the most ambitious designs for deci-Hz detectors could detect such signals out to distances of ~250 Mpc, possibly at a rate of 0.3 per year. Additional numerical modeling is required to refine these rate estimates, however. We also demonstrate that proposed deci-Hz GW observation missions, even without confident single-source detections, could be used to provide information about the population of astrophysical candidates and, in particular, constrain the initial mass function of very massive stars.

classification.title_zh: 旋转极大质量恒星坍缩产生的分赫兹引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了一颗旋转的 300 M⊙ 恒星在刚好高于对不稳定性超新星区间上端时坍缩所产生的引力波信号。坍缩过程中形成的大尺度非对称性在分赫兹频段产生强信号，其具有可能适合模板搜索的特征形状。尽管受附近天体物理候选源发生率低的限制，最具雄心的分赫兹探测器设计仍可能探测到约 250 Mpc 范围内的此类信号，探测率可能为每年 0.3 次。不过，仍需更多数值模拟来改进这些率估计。我们还表明，拟议的分赫兹引力波观测任务即使没有可靠的单源探测，也可用于提供关于天体物理候选源族群的信息，特别是限制极大质量恒星的初始质量函数。
classification.one_liner: 计算旋转 300 M⊙ 恒星坍缩产生的分赫兹引力波信号，并讨论探测器可及距离、探测率及其对极大质量恒星初始质量函数的约束潜力。

papers.title: Optimal robust detection statistics for pulsar timing arrays
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) seek to detect a nano-Hz stochastic gravitational-wave background (GWB) by searching for the characteristic Hellings and Downs angular pattern of timing residual correlations. So far, the evidence remains below the conventional $5\sigma$ threshold, as assessed using the literature-standard "optimal cross-correlation detection statistic". While this quadratic combination of cross-correlated data maximizes the deflection (signal-to-noise ratio), it does not maximize the detection probability at fixed false-alarm probability (FAP), and therefore is not Neyman-Pearson (NP) optimal for the assumed noise and signal models. The NP-optimal detection statistic is a different quadratic form, but is not used because it also incorporates autocorrelations, making it more susceptible to uncertainties in the modeling of pulsar timing noise. Here, we derive the best compromise: a quadratic detection statistic which is as close as possible to the NP-optimal detection statistic (minimizing the variance of its difference with the NP statistic) subject to the constraint that it only uses cross-correlations, so that it is less affected by pulsar noise modeling errors. We study the performance of this new NPMV statistic for a simulated PTA whose noise and (putative) signal match those of the NANOGrav 15-year data release: GWB amplitude $A_{\rm gw} = 2.1 \times 10^{-15}$ and spectral index $\gamma = 13/3$. Compared to the literature-standard "optimal" cross-correlation detection statistic, the NPMV statistic increases the detection probability by 47% when operating at a $5\sigma$ false-alarm probability of $\alpha = 2.9 \times 10^{-7}$.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列的最优鲁棒检测统计量
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）通过寻找计时残差相关中特征的Hellings and Downs角模式来探测纳赫兹随机引力波背景（GWB）。迄今为止，用文献标准的“最优互相关检测统计量”评估的证据仍低于常规5σ阈值。虽然这种互相关数据的二次组合最大化了偏转（信噪比），但在固定虚警概率（FAP）下并未最大化检测概率，因此对于假定噪声和信号模型并非Neyman-Pearson（NP）最优。NP最优检测统计量是另一种二次型，但因还包含自相关而更易受脉冲星计时噪声建模不确定性的影响，故未被使用。本文推导最佳折中：一种二次检测统计量，在仅使用互相关（从而较少受脉冲星噪声建模误差影响）的约束下，尽可能接近NP最优检测统计量（最小化其与NP统计量之差的方差）。我们针对模拟PTA研究该新NPMV统计量的性能，其噪声和（假定）信号与NANOGrav 15年数据释放一致：GWB振幅A_gw=2.1×10^-15，谱指数γ=13/3。与文献标准“最优”互相关检测统计量相比，在5σ虚警概率α=2.9×10^-7下，NPMV统计量将检测概率提高47%。
classification.one_liner: 提出仅用互相关的NPMV二次检测统计量，在保持对脉冲星噪声建模误差鲁棒的同时提升PTA引力波背景检测概率。

papers.title: Transient resonances of chaotic orbits in magnetized black hole spacetimes: an event-based frequency-ratio diagnostic
papers.abstract: The geodesic equations of the Kerr spacetime are separable, and this separability is what makes orbital dynamics around black holes tractable. An external electromagnetic field removes it, the motion turns chaotic, and the orbit wanders between resonances for irregular and unequal intervals; a long-time Poincar\'e section returns a single static blur, so that it records where an orbit has been but not when. We introduce the sliding-window frequency ratio, an event-based diagnostic that counts polar turning events within a window of fixed radial-cycle number and returns the local ratio of the two frequencies without any spectral decomposition; for regular motion with bounded count deviations, the error falls off as the window widens. We first establish that a single globally chaotic orbit in a magnetized black hole spacetime pays temporally ordered visits to distinct resonances, and that the corresponding section structure appears only in those intervals that the event counts select. A charged orbit in magnetized Kerr spacetime dwells near 3/5 and later near 4/7, opening fivefold and sevenfold structures, while a photon in Schwarzschild--Melvin spacetime holds 4/5 across a fivefold pattern. Because we keep every event time, we can replot each selected interval as its own section, and integer counts then agree with phase-space geometry. These visits control the phase accumulated along an orbit, and they therefore bear on any orbit-based probe of strong-field black hole geometry.

classification.title_zh: 磁化黑洞时空中混沌轨道的瞬态共振：一种基于事件的频率比诊断
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr 时空的测地线方程可分离，这是黑洞轨道动力学可处理的原因；外加电磁场破坏可分离性，使运动混沌，轨道在共振之间以不规则且不等的间隔游走，长时间 Poincaré 截面只返回一个静态模糊，记录轨道去过哪里却不记录何时。作者引入滑动窗口频率比，这是一种基于事件的诊断：在固定径向周期数的窗口内计数极向转向事件，无需谱分解即可返回两个频率的局部比值；对具有有界计数偏差的规则运动，误差随窗口加宽而下降。作者首先确认磁化黑洞时空中单条全局混沌轨道会按时间顺序访问不同共振，而相应的截面结构只出现在事件计数选出的那些区间。磁化 Kerr 时空中的带电轨道先靠近 3/5、后靠近 4/7，打开五重与七重结构；Schwarzschild--Melvin 时空中的光子则在五重图案中保持 4/5。由于保留每个事件时间，可将每个选中区间重绘为各自的截面，整数计数随后与相空间几何一致。这些访问控制沿轨道累积的相位，因此关系到任何基于轨道的强场黑洞几何探针。
classification.one_liner: 提出滑动窗口频率比诊断，用于追踪磁化黑洞时空中混沌轨道按时间顺序访问的瞬态共振。

papers.title: The macroscopic precession model of quasi-periodic oscillations for rotating compact objects
papers.abstract: The relativistic precession model (RPM) interprets the twin kilohertz quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) as geodesic frequencies of test particles orbiting in the spacetime of X-ray binaries hosting either a neutron star (NS) or a black hole. In several NS X-ray binaries, QPOs are well reproduced by effective geometries nearly degenerate with a Schwarzschild-de Sitter (SdS) spacetime, hindering independent determinations of the mass, the angular momentum and other observables. We propose how to solve this physical limitation by incorporating the effects of orbiting matter spin, culminating in introducing the macroscopic precession model (MPM). We treat the disk inhomogeneities as spinning test bodies governed by the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon (MPD) equations and obtain non-minimal spin curvature corrections to the azimuthal and the radial epicyclic frequencies. We perform Monte Carlo Markov chain (MCMC) fits, based on the Metropolis algorithm, and model eight NS X-ray binary sources. Our statistical analyzes show that the data select the internal structure of the accreting matter, without requiring corrections to Kerr and Schwarzschild spacetimes through the introduction of any correcting de Sitter phase. Physically, the MPM paradigm explains why an effective SdS-like structure could be statistically favored if spin is not employed, through non-minimal spin-curvature coupling, leaving unaltered the test particle hypothesis.

classification.title_zh: 旋转致密天体准周期振荡的宏观进动模型
classification.abstract_zh: 相对论进动模型（RPM）将双千赫兹准周期振荡（QPOs）解释为X射线双星中绕中子星或黑洞运动试验粒子的测地线频率。在一些中子星X射线双星中，QPOs可由几乎与Schwarzschild-de Sitter（SdS）时空简并的有效几何很好地再现，这妨碍了质量、角动量等可观测量的独立确定。本文提出通过纳入绕行物质自旋效应来解决这一物理限制，并引入宏观进动模型（MPM）。作者将吸积盘非均匀性视为由Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon（MPD）方程支配的自旋试验体，得到对方位角和径向本轮频率的非最小自旋-曲率修正。基于Metropolis算法进行MCMC拟合，并对八个中子星X射线双星源建模。统计分析表明，数据选择吸积物质的内部结构，而不需要通过引入任何修正de Sitter相来修正Kerr和Schwarzschild时空。物理上，MPM范式通过非最小自旋-曲率耦合解释了为何在不采用自旋时SdS类有效结构可能在统计上被偏好，同时保持试验粒子假设不变。
classification.one_liner: 提出宏观进动模型，用自旋试验体的MPD方程与非最小自旋-曲率耦合解释致密天体QPO，并说明SdS类有效几何的统计偏好可由自旋效应替代。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves as Thermodynamic Shear Excitations in Scalar-Tensor Gravity
papers.abstract: Can a propagating spin-2 mode participate in a local thermodynamic process without assigning an autonomous entropy or a unique local energy to the wave itself? We show that this occurs as a local thermodynamic work process in Jordan-frame scalar-tensor gravity, where a timelike scalar gradient defines an internal gravitational thermodynamic medium. Building on the first-order TT deformation-response relation, we identify the local shear power $\mathcal W_\phi=\pi_{ab}^{(\phi)}\sigma^{ab}$ from scalar-frame traction mechanics and show that its leading pure-TT contribution is second order, gauge invariant, and enters the exact scalar-sector energy balance. We further show that the same effective anisotropic stress controls the scalar-tensor modification of the tensor-friction term, so the local shear-work process is directly encoded in gravitational-wave propagation. In geometric optics the corresponding ratio of shear work to GR-normalized tensor energy is controlled by the running effective Planck mass, providing a local thermodynamic interpretation of the standard modified gravitational-wave luminosity-distance law. Finally, we extend this shear-excitation mechanism to nonminimally coupled scalars, metric $f(R)$ gravity, and viable luminal Horndeski theories, and identify the condition required for the same interpretation in more general tensor sectors.

classification.title_zh: 标量-张量引力中作为热力学剪切激发的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 本文探讨传播的自旋-2模式能否在不赋予波自身独立熵或唯一局域能量的情况下参与局域热力学过程。作者在Jordan框架标量-张量引力中表明，这一过程可作为局域热力学做功过程出现，其中类时标量梯度定义了内部引力热力学介质。基于一阶TT形变-响应关系，作者从标量框架牵引力学中识别出局域剪切功率，并证明其主导的纯TT贡献是二阶、规范不变的，且进入精确的标量扇区能量平衡。进一步表明，同一有效各向异性应力控制张量摩擦项的标量-张量修正，因此局域剪切做功过程直接编码于引力波传播中。在几何光学中，剪切功与GR归一化张量能量之比由跑动的有效Planck质量控制，从而为标准修改引力波光度距离规律提供局域热力学解释。最后，作者将该剪切激发机制推广到非最小耦合标量、度规f(R)引力和可行的光速Horndeski理论，并指出在更一般张量扇区中获得相同解释所需的条件。
classification.one_liner: 在标量-张量引力中，引力波传播可被解释为局域热力学剪切做功过程，并由有效Planck质量控制修改的光度距离规律。

papers.title: Combining Pulsar Timing data with $\texttt{MetaPulsar}$. The linearized timing model
papers.abstract: Combining the data of multiple pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations increases the sensitivity to nanohertz gravitational waves (GWs) and other signals correlated between pulsars. The International PTA (IPTA) has combined such data, but historically these projects have taken many years. We introduce $\texttt{MetaPulsar}$, a software package that ingests the $\texttt{.par}$ and $\texttt{.tim}$ files of individual data releases, and turns them into single consistent deterministic models for the combined datasets, compatible with both timing packages $\texttt{PINT}$ and $\texttt{Tempo2}$. We validate the method in four ways. First, we show for two pulsars that the linearized timing solution of a combined dataset does not depend on the parameter values in the $\texttt{.par}$. A mild exception is formed by the Shapiro-delay parameters. No combination considered requires a manual refit. Second, for PSR J0613$-$0200 we show that the residuals are explained by the timing model if we take intrinsic red-noise and dispersion-measure processes into account, and that the single-PTA timing posteriors agree with one another and with the combination, except for the parallax. Third, we quantify the consistency of the timing parameters measured by different PTAs with a two-sample tension statistic, for every pulsar that is observed by multiple PTAs. Finally, we carry out a gravitational-wave background search on the direct combination of the NANOGrav 9-yr, EPTA DR1 (v2.2), and PPTA DR2 data releases, the constituents of IPTA Data Release 2 (DR2). The combined dataset is assembled in under two hours, and the recovered amplitude and spectral index of the common process are consistent with the published IPTA DR2 result. With $\texttt{MetaPulsar}$, a joint PTA analysis can be prototyped as soon as the individual collaborations publish their data, instead of after a years-long reprocessing effort.

classification.title_zh: 结合脉冲星计时数据与 MetaPulsar：线性化计时模型
classification.abstract_zh: 结合多个脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作的数据可提高对纳赫兹引力波（GW）及其他脉冲星间相关信号的灵敏度。国际 PTA（IPTA）已进行过此类数据组合，但历史上这些项目耗时多年。我们介绍 MetaPulsar，一个软件包，可读入各数据发布中的 .par 和 .tim 文件，并将其转化为组合数据集的单一一致确定性模型，兼容 PINT 和 Tempo2 两个计时软件包。我们以四种方式验证该方法。第一，对两颗脉冲星展示组合数据集的线性化计时解不依赖于 .par 中的参数值；Shapiro 延迟参数构成一个轻微例外。所考虑的组合均无需人工重拟合。第二，对 PSR J0613−0200 展示，在考虑内禀红噪声和色散量过程后，计时模型可解释残差；除视差外，单 PTA 的计时后验彼此一致并与组合结果一致。第三，对每颗被多个 PTA 观测的脉冲星，用两样本张力统计量量化不同 PTA 测得计时参数的一致性。最后，对 NANOGrav 9 年、EPTA DR1（v2.2）和 PPTA DR2 数据发布的直接组合（即 IPTA Data Release 2 的组成部分）进行引力波背景搜索。组合数据集在两小时内组装完成，恢复的公共过程振幅和谱指数与已发表的 IPTA DR2 结果一致。借助 MetaPulsar，联合 PTA 分析可在各合作发布数据后立即进行原型化，而无需等待多年的再处理工作。
classification.one_liner: MetaPulsar 将多个 PTA 的 .par/.tim 数据快速组合为统一计时模型，并复现 IPTA DR2 的引力波背景结果。

papers.title: Using the 0i Einstein equation to break dark-sector degeneracies
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, cosmological observations have started to challenge the $\Lambda$CDM model. If these tensions persist, they immediately raise one fundamental question: what new physics could be responsible for them? More specifically, do these deviations arise from a modification of gravity, from an evolving or clustering dark energy component, or from dark matter properties beyond the cold dark matter paradigm? In this paper we show that, with current methods, any observed deviation can always be attributed to more than one sector, preventing us from determining if the tension is due to gravity, dark energy or dark matter. The main reason is that current tests rely on unobservable quantities. These quantities are then either related to observables by assuming the validity of specific equations, or compared with theoretical predictions computed within a given class of theories. Both approaches inevitably break the model independence of the tests, leading to degeneracies between gravity, dark energy, and dark matter. To overcome this limitation, we construct a set of three tests that rely only on observable quantities and that, when combined, can distinguish between the three sectors. We show that the $0i$ Einstein equation -- which is never tested in standard analyses -- adds crucial information to that provided by the gravitational slip equation and the Euler equation.

classification.title_zh: 利用0i爱因斯坦方程打破暗扇区简并
classification.abstract_zh: 过去十年，宇宙学观测开始挑战ΛCDM模型。若这些张力持续存在，就会提出一个根本问题：哪些新物理应对此负责？更具体地说，这些偏离来自引力修改、演化或成团的暗能量，还是超越冷暗物质范式的暗物质性质？本文表明，用当前方法，任何观测到的偏离总能被归因于不止一个扇区，从而无法确定张力源于引力、暗能量还是暗物质。主要原因是当前检验依赖不可观测量；这些量要么通过假设特定方程成立而与可观测量联系，要么与给定理论类中的理论预言比较。两种做法都不可避免地破坏检验的模型独立性，导致引力、暗能量和暗物质之间的简并。为克服这一限制，我们构造三个只依赖可观测量的检验，组合后可区分三个扇区。我们表明，标准分析中从未检验的0i爱因斯坦方程，为引力滑移方程和欧拉方程提供的信息增加了关键补充。
classification.one_liner: 提出仅用可观测量的三个宇宙学检验，并强调0i爱因斯坦方程可打破引力、暗能量与暗物质之间的简并。

papers.title: Raytracing Black Holes with AI Accelerators
papers.abstract: We show how software infrastructure that was mainly built to power AI applications also can be used to great benefit for other purposes -- by demonstrating a fully self-contained JAX-based black hole raytracer in under 180+200 lines of Python code plus documentation. Major motivations for showcasing such a construction are (a) to show to professional physicists how Machine Learning (ML) accelerators can greatly simplify building numerical applications for GPU accelerator hardware with very modest coding effort and programming expertise -- even if the problems at hand do not involve ML per se, (b) to make a meaningful part of General Relativity (GR) accessible to computer science professionals who might not have realized that mathematical background they developed on Deep Learning problems may have brought this theory within easy reach for them, and (c) to inspire students and educators to explore the potential of an approach that represents physical law, i.e. relations between local differential quantities, not in terms of differentiable symbolic expressions, but in terms of differentiable algorithms.

classification.title_zh: 用人工智能加速器进行黑洞光线追踪
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示，主要为人工智能应用构建的软件基础设施也可用于其他目的：通过一个完全自包含的、基于 JAX 的黑洞光线追踪器，其核心代码不足 180+200 行 Python 并附带文档。展示这种构造的主要动机是：(a) 向专业物理学家表明，即使问题本身不涉及机器学习，机器学习加速器也能以非常少的编码工作和编程专业知识，极大简化面向 GPU 加速硬件的数值应用构建；(b) 让计算机科学专业人员能够接触广义相对论中有意义的一部分，他们可能没有意识到自己在深度学习问题中发展的数学背景已使该理论触手可及；(c) 启发学生和教育工作者探索一种表示物理定律的方法，即局部微分量之间的关系，不是用可微符号表达式，而是用可微算法来表示。
classification.one_liner: 介绍一个基于 JAX 的轻量黑洞光线追踪器，说明 AI 加速器与可微算法可简化广义相对论数值计算并降低学习门槛。

papers.title: \texttt{StochAXtic}: a JAX-Accelerated, End-to-End Differentiable Framework for Gravitational-Wave Backgrounds from Compact Binary Populations
papers.abstract: We present \texttt{StochAXtic}, a package for computing the dimensionless energy density spectrum $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ of the stochastic gravitational-wave background generated by compact binary coalescences. Rather than sampling binary populations via Monte Carlo, \texttt{StochAXtic} exploits the \emph{scale invariance} of the waveforms: at fixed mass ratio, spins and tidal deformabilities, the waveform depends on the total mass only through the dimensionless combination $Mf$. This allows all computationally expensive waveform evaluations using \texttt{LALSuite} to be performed once and stored in a population-independent lookup table. The subsequent integrals over mass and redshift can then be recast as convolutions and evaluated efficiently using fast Fourier transforms. We further employ truncated singular value decomposition to compress the lookup table, reducing both computational cost and memory requirements. Once the table has been computed and cached, \texttt{StochAXtic} evaluates $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ in a few milliseconds, achieving a relative numerical error below $10^{-3}$ at frequencies up to $1$ kHz. Its results agree with those of \texttt{popstock} within the latter's statistical uncertainties. Implemented entirely in \texttt{JAX}, \texttt{StochAXtic} also provides gradients of $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ with respect to population hyperparameters, enabling its direct integration with gradient-based inference methods including Hamiltonian Monte Carlo.

classification.title_zh: StochAXtic：一个 JAX 加速、端到端可微的紧致双星族群随机引力波背景框架
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出 StochAXtic，一个用于计算紧致双星并合产生的随机引力波背景无量纲能量密度谱 Ω_GW(f) 的程序包。StochAXtic 不采用蒙特卡洛方法对双星族群采样，而是利用波形的标度不变性：在质量比、自旋和潮汐形变固定时，波形仅通过无量纲组合 Mf 依赖于总质量。这使得所有使用 LALSuite 的高计算成本波形评估只需进行一次，并存入与族群无关的查找表。随后，对质量和红移的积分可重写为卷积，并用快速傅里叶变换高效计算。我们进一步使用截断奇异值分解压缩查找表，降低计算成本和内存需求。查找表计算并缓存后，StochAXtic 可在几毫秒内评估 Ω_GW(f)，在频率至 1 kHz 时相对数值误差低于 10^{-3}。其结果在 popstock 的统计不确定度范围内与 popstock 一致。StochAXtic 完全用 JAX 实现，还提供 Ω_GW(f) 对族群超参数的梯度，使其可直接与包括哈密顿蒙特卡洛在内的基于梯度的推断方法集成。
classification.one_liner: 提出 JAX 加速且可微的 StochAXtic 框架，利用波形标度不变性和 FFT 卷积快速计算紧致双星族群产生的随机引力波背景能谱，并支持梯度推断。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves Population Study for Testing Kerr Hypothesis: Are Non-Kerr Deformations Universal or Source-Dependent?
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations of binary black hole mergers can test the Kerr black hole hypothesis in the strong-field and dynamical regime. In our previous works, we constrained the deformation parameters $\alpha_{13}$ and $\epsilon_3$ of the Johannsen metric using individual inspiral-dominated events from GWTC-3 and GWTC-4 and found no evidence of deviations from the Kerr solution. Here we combine 17 of these events to test whether black holes are Kerr, share a common non-zero deformation, or have deformations that vary from source to source. We first estimate the Savage--Dickey Bayes factor of each event, and we test how it depends on the prior range and on the removal of single events. We then combine the event likelihoods assuming a universal deformation, yielding a tighter joint constraint. Next, we perform a simple hierarchical analysis by assuming that the event-level deformation parameters are drawn from a population with mean $\mu$ and intrinsic scatter $\sigma$. A universal deformation is constrained to $\alpha_{13}=-0.01^{+0.14}_{-0.12}$ and $\epsilon_3=0.06^{+0.59}_{-0.54}$. The means from the population are consistent with zero for both parameters, and the scatter is not resolved by the current data. Our results are consistent with the Kerr hypothesis, but they cannot yet distinguish a shared deformation from a source-dependent one.

classification.title_zh: 引力波族群研究检验Kerr假设：非Kerr形变是普适的还是依赖源？
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合的引力波观测可在强场和动力学区域检验Kerr黑洞假设。作者此前利用GWTC-3和GWTC-4中单个旋进主导事件约束了Johannsen度规的形变参数α13和ε3，未发现偏离Kerr解的证据。本文将其中17个事件联合起来，检验黑洞是否为Kerr、是否共享一个共同的非零形变，或形变是否随源变化。作者先估计每个事件的Savage-Dickey Bayes因子，并检验其对先验范围和剔除单个事件的依赖；随后在普适形变假设下联合事件似然，得到更紧的联合约束；接着假设事件级形变参数来自均值为μ、内禀弥散为σ的族群，进行简单层级分析。普适形变被约束为α13=-0.01^{+0.14}_{-0.12}、ε3=0.06^{+0.59}_{-0.54}。族群均值对两个参数均与零一致，当前数据未能分辨弥散。结果与Kerr假设一致，但尚不能区分共享形变与源依赖形变。
classification.one_liner: 联合17个引力波事件检验Kerr假设，结果与Kerr一致但尚不能区分普适形变与源依赖形变。

papers.title: Geometric optics for gravitational waves in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity: amplitude birefringence and tensor-scalar mixing on general backgrounds
papers.abstract: We study the propagation of high-frequency gravitational waves in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity within the geometric optics approximation. In contrast to previous work, we allow for a general background with a nonvanishing scalar field, which enables a covariant treatment of amplitude birefringence. The background scalar gradient introduces third-derivative terms into the linearized field equations. These must be treated as subleading for the linearized system to be free of ghosts, which yields a covariant upper bound on the frequency. Tensor-scalar mixing is induced by the Weyl curvature through the Newman-Penrose scalar $\Psi_0$ along the ray. When the mixing is efficient, the propagation eigenmodes consist of one luminal, one subluminal, and one superluminal mode, and a violation of the ghost-free condition leads to a classical instability. From the transport equations at next-to-leading order, we show that, when the mixing is negligible, the relative amplitude of the two helicities depends only on the scalar-field gradients along the ray at the emission and observation events, independently of the path in between.

classification.title_zh: 动态 Chern-Simons 引力中引力波的几何光学：一般背景上的振幅双折射与张量-标量混合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在几何光学近似下研究动态 Chern-Simons 引力中高频引力波的传播。与先前工作不同，我们允许标量场非零的一般背景，从而可以对振幅双折射作协变处理。背景标量梯度会在线性化场方程中引入三阶导数项。为了使线性化系统无鬼，这些项必须被视作次领头阶，这给出了频率的协变上界。张量-标量混合由沿射线的 Weyl 曲率通过 Newman-Penrose 标量 Ψ0 诱导。当混合有效时，传播本征模由一个类光模、一个亚光速模和一个超光速模组成，而违反无鬼条件会导致经典不稳定性。由次领头阶的输运方程，我们证明：当混合可忽略时，两个螺旋度的相对振幅只依赖于发射和观测事件处沿射线的标量场梯度，而与两者之间的路径无关。
classification.one_liner: 在动态 Chern-Simons 引力中建立高频引力波几何光学，给出一般标量背景下的振幅双折射、张量-标量混合及无鬼频率上界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究修改引力中的经典引力波传播与几何光学，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，因此全息相关性低。

papers.title: What makes the gravito-thermodynamic arrow of time coincide with that of proper time?
papers.abstract: In the pursuit of a geometrical resolution to this important question for the evolution of spherically symmetric perfect fluids in general relativity, we excavated a novel result: the presence of volume distortions and inhomogeneities are, though necessary, but not sufficient for the total gravitational entropy to monotonically increase with proper time. We need a further refinement of the space of distortions and only those that favour shell crossing caustics, causing local flocculations and structure formations, can ensure the alignment. This result will have far reaching consequences for the study of thermodynamical viability of various gravitational collapse and cosmological solutions of Einstein field equations.

classification.title_zh: 是什么使引力-热力学时间箭头与固有时时间箭头重合？
classification.abstract_zh: 为了从几何上解决这一重要问题，我们研究广义相对论中球对称完美流体的演化，并得到一个新结果：体积畸变和非均匀性的存在虽然是必要条件，但不足以保证总引力熵随固有时单调增加。我们需要进一步细化畸变空间，只有那些有利于壳层穿越焦散、导致局部絮凝和结构形成的畸变，才能确保这种一致性。该结果将对研究爱因斯坦场方程各类引力坍缩和宇宙学解的热力学可行性产生深远影响。
classification.one_liner: 在球对称完美流体的广义相对论中，引力熵随固有时单调增加不仅需要体积畸变和非均匀性，还需要有利于壳层穿越焦散的特定畸变。

papers.title: Binary black-hole mergers with ultralight vector bosons
papers.abstract: We simulate the inspiral, merger, and ringdown of equal-mass, nonspinning binary black holes coupled to a massive vector (Proca) field. Starting from constraint-consistent electric-field initial data, we find that the Proca field rapidly concentrates around the black holes. However, it continues to exhibit nontrivial dynamics. Orbital evolution depends on vector mass, while the dominant gravitational waveforms remain close to vacuum after time, phase, and amplitude alignment. This contrast highlights the limited imprint of the field on aligned merger-ringdown morphology at these resolutions.

classification.title_zh: 与超轻矢量玻色子耦合的双黑洞并合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们模拟了等质量、无自旋双黑洞与有质量矢量（Proca）场耦合的旋近、并合和铃宕过程。从满足约束的电场初始数据出发，我们发现Proca场会迅速聚集在黑洞周围，但仍表现出非平庸动力学。轨道演化依赖于矢量质量，而在时间、相位和振幅对齐后，主导引力波形仍接近真空情形。这一对比表明，在这些分辨率下，该场对对齐后的并合-铃宕形态印记有限。
classification.one_liner: 数值模拟显示，与有质量Proca场耦合的等质量双黑洞在旋近、并合和铃宕中，场虽在黑洞附近聚集并影响轨道演化，但对对齐后的主导引力波波形印记有限。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/数值相对论支线，涉及双黑洞并合与Proca场；与全息/AdS-CFT无直接关联，但匹配用户重点标签中的经典引力方向。

papers.title: Gravitational Mode Instabilities in Kerr-like Black Holes
papers.abstract: We identify exponentially growing modes of a homogeneous gravitational Teukolsky-like operator on highly spinning Kerr-like black holes subject to quasinormal mode boundary conditions. Specifically, we compute electromagnetic and gravitational quasinormal modes of a spacetime proposed by Konoplya, Rezzolla, and Zhidenko that parametrizes deformations from the Kerr geometry, including configurations with black hole spin parameter $a/M > 1$ that retain an event horizon. Using the continued fraction method, we find that the spin-weight $s=-2$ operator develops exponentially growing modes when the black hole spin and deformation parameters are sufficiently large, while the electromagnetic modes remain damped throughout the parameter space. We further compare the quasinormal mode predictions with an agnostic analysis of the GW250114 ringdown, identifying regions of the parameter space that are compatible with the spectrum inferred from the data.

classification.title_zh: 类Kerr黑洞中的引力模式不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在高度旋转的类Kerr黑洞上，识别出满足准正规模边界条件的齐次引力Teukolsky型算符的指数增长模式。具体而言，我们计算了Konoplya、Rezzolla和Zhidenko提出的时空中的电磁与引力准正规模；该时空参数化了对Kerr几何的偏离，并包含在黑洞自旋参数 a/M>1 时仍保留事件视界的构型。使用连分数方法，我们发现当黑洞自旋与形变参数足够大时，自旋权重 s=-2 的算符会出现指数增长模式，而电磁模式在整个参数空间中保持阻尼。我们进一步将准正规模预言与对GW250114铃宕的无假设分析进行比较，识别出与数据推断谱相容的参数空间区域。
classification.one_liner: 在参数化偏离Kerr的旋转黑洞中，引力Teukolsky型算符在高自旋与强形变下可出现指数增长模式，并与GW250114铃宕数据约束进行比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞准正规模、Teukolsky型扰动与引力波铃宕，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；不涉及全息。

papers.title: New traversable wormholes without invoking exotic matter in $f(Q)$ from the freedom of different connections
papers.abstract: Wormhole solutions in General Relativity can only exist in the presence of exotic matter that violates the null energy condition. In this paper, we investigate the possibility of constructing wormhole solutions in $f(Q)$ gravity in which the extra connection degrees of freedom contribute such that no exotic matter is needed. Considering the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole as an example, we find that the system admits two families of connections consistent with the spacetime symmetries and the requirements of symmetric teleparallel gravity. For both families, we show that constant non-metricity scalar $Q$ is not merely a simplifying assumption but arises naturally from the field equations when $f_{QQ}$ is regular, and that the resulting exact analytic solutions can satisfy the null energy condition throughout the entire spacetime. For the second family, which possesses richer connection degrees of freedom, we further demonstrate that solutions with a spatially varying $Q$ exist when $f_{QQ}$ is allowed to diverge at a finite value of $Q$, and that these too can satisfy the null energy condition everywhere. Our results show that the nontrivial connection degrees of freedom in $f(Q)$ gravity can naturally be responsible for supporting wormhole geometries, without resorting to any exotic matter.

classification.title_zh: f(Q)引力中利用不同联络自由度构造无需奇异物质的新型可穿越虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，虫洞解只能存在于违反零能量条件的奇异物质存在时。本文研究在f(Q)引力中构造虫洞解的可能性，其中额外的联络自由度贡献使得无需奇异物质。以Ellis-Bronnikov虫洞为例，我们发现系统允许两族与时空对称性及对称远平行引力要求一致的联络。对于这两族联络，我们证明当f_{QQ}正则时，常数非度规标量Q并非仅是一种简化假设，而是自然地从场方程中出现，并且所得精确解析解可在整个时空中满足零能量条件。对于具有更丰富联络自由度的第二族，我们进一步证明当允许f_{QQ}在有限Q值处发散时，存在Q空间变化的解，且这些解同样可在各处满足零能量条件。我们的结果表明，f(Q)引力中的非平凡联络自由度可以自然地支撑虫洞几何，而无需借助任何奇异物质。
classification.one_liner: 在f(Q)对称远平行引力中，利用联络自由度构造满足零能量条件的可穿越虫洞解，无需奇异物质。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究f(Q)修改引力中的经典虫洞解与能量条件，属于经典引力/广义相对论范畴，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: An Orbital Curvature for ISCOs
papers.abstract: Building on the fact that circular orbits are the fixed points of the phase portraits arising from the geodesic equations on a black hole spacetime, we develop a general orbital geometry, which captures the stability structure of orbits. The construction uses the orbital energy, angular momentum and angular velocity as state space variables, with response functions encoding how the circular orbits react to changes in the black hole background and in their angular motion. The associated scalar curvature provides a geometric diagnostic of certain distinguished points of the circular orbit family, such as the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), where it becomes singular. Across the ISCO, the relevant orbital response functions change sign as the system passes from the stable to the unstable circular orbit branch, and are found to vanish at marginal stability. We illustrate the framework for Schwarzschild black holes in asymptotically flat four dimensions, and five dimensional Schwarzschild AdS spacetimes. In the four dimensional case, the ISCO is associated with a degeneration of the energy response sector, while in the five dimensional AdS case it is detected through the angular response. The AdS example also exhibits a separate curvature singularity at a point which coincides with the minimum temperature of the black hole background. These results show that the orbital geometry provides a promising unified framework for characterizing the stability of circular orbits and criticality of ISCOs.

classification.title_zh: ISCO 的轨道曲率
classification.abstract_zh: 基于圆轨道是黑洞时空测地线方程相图的固定点这一事实，我们发展了一种一般性的轨道几何，用以刻画轨道的稳定性结构。该构造以轨道能量、角动量和角速度为状态空间变量，并用响应函数描述圆轨道如何响应黑洞背景和角运动的变化。相关的标量曲率给出圆轨道族中某些特殊点的几何诊断，例如最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），在该处曲率变为奇异。跨越 ISCO 时，相关轨道响应函数从稳定圆轨道支到不稳定支改变符号，并在临界稳定处消失。我们用渐近平直四维 Schwarzschild 黑洞和五维 Schwarzschild AdS 时空说明该框架。在四维情形，ISCO 与能量响应部分的退化相关；在五维 AdS 情形，则通过角响应探测到。AdS 例子还在与黑洞背景最低温度重合的点显示出另一个曲率奇异。这些结果表明，轨道几何为刻画圆轨道稳定性和 ISCO 临界性提供了一个有希望的统一框架。
classification.one_liner: 提出用轨道响应函数和标量曲率诊断圆轨道稳定性及 ISCO 临界性的经典引力框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞时空中的圆轨道与 ISCO 稳定性，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Gravitational waves flooding the Universe after wall domination
papers.abstract: We discuss a possible early Universe scenario, where radiation era is interrupted by the epoch of domination of domain walls eventually annihilating into particles. During this period the Universe undergoes accelerated expansion, while the comoving correlation length of the domain wall network remains constant. The network serves as a source of tensor modes, which get frozen upon exiting the horizon similarly to the case of inflationary fluctuations. The modes re-enter the horizon during the subsequent stage of radiation domination and since then contribute to the gravitational wave background. The period of wall domination is manifested in the spectral shape of gravitational waves via a distinctive plateau replacing a peak, which is characteristic for the scenario with sub-dominant walls. The gravitational waves are strong enough to be observed with present-day and future facilities in a broad range of frequencies. In particular, their energy density is sufficient to produce a significant impact on the effective number of neutrino species, unless the duration of wall domination is suitably constrained.

classification.title_zh: 畴壁主导之后充斥宇宙的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论一种可能的早期宇宙场景：辐射时代被畴壁主导时期打断，畴壁最终湮灭为粒子。在此期间宇宙加速膨胀，而畴壁网络的共动关联长度保持不变。该网络作为张量模的源，这些模在退出视界时冻结，类似暴胀扰动。随后在辐射主导阶段重新进入视界，并从此贡献引力波背景。畴壁主导时期通过引力波谱形中一个独特平台体现，取代了亚主导畴壁场景中特征性的峰。这些引力波足够强，可在广泛频率范围内被当前和未来设施观测。特别地，其能量密度足以对有效中微子物种数产生显著影响，除非畴壁主导持续时间受到适当限制。
classification.one_liner: 畴壁主导的早期宇宙阶段会在引力波谱中留下平台而非峰，并可影响有效中微子物种数。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及畴壁网络与引力波背景，与畴壁/非均匀及经典引力标签相关，但不是全息研究。

papers.title: Quadratic effective energy--momentum tensor on uniform-density hypersurfaces during slow-roll inflation
papers.abstract: We investigate the quadratic-order effective energy-momentum tensor (2EMT) of scalar cosmological perturbations on uniform-density hypersurfaces during slow-roll inflation. The 2EMT is a gauge-fixed effective source rather than a gauge-invariant observable. We impose the complete scalar gauge conditions $\delta\rho=0$ and $E=0$, express all perturbations in terms of the Bardeen potential $\Psi$, and distinguish the strict infrared and ultraviolet limits from the intermediate regimes. The uniform-density time shift differs from the comoving one by an explicitly gradient-suppressed term, $Q_{\mathrm{UD}}-Q_{\mathrm{C}}=-\Delta\Psi/[3{\mathcal H}({\mathcal H}'-{\mathcal H}^2)]$. The two sources vanish at zero gradient, while their first nonzero infrared coefficients differ and give $w_{\rm raw}\simeq-1/3$ at leading slow-roll order. In the intermediate infrared, all four gauges have this leading ratio, with gauge-dependent amplitudes. In the ultraviolet, the longitudinal, spatially-flat, and comoving gauges give $w_{\rm raw}\simeq1/3$, whereas the uniform-density gauge gives $w_{\rm raw}\simeq1$. The common $1/\epsilon$ enhancement of the matter-clock gauges reflects the slow evolution of their clocks; the additional uniform-density $1/\sigma_2^2$ enhancement originates from the Laplacian contribution to the density constraint. Neither enhancement is interpreted as a gauge-independent physical instability, and the gauge reconstruction must remain perturbatively small.

classification.title_zh: 慢滚暴胀期间均匀密度超曲面上的二次有效能动张量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究慢滚暴胀期间均匀密度超曲面上标量宇宙学扰动的二阶有效能动张量（2EMT）。2EMT 是规范固定的有效源，而不是规范不变的观测量。我们施加完整标量规范条件 δρ=0 和 E=0，用 Bardeen 势 Ψ 表示所有扰动，并区分严格红外、紫外极限与中间区域。均匀密度时间移动与共动时间移动相差一个显式梯度压低项。两个源在零梯度处消失，但其首个非零红外系数不同，并在慢滚领头阶给出 w_raw≈-1/3。在中间红外，四种规范都有此领头比值，振幅依赖规范。在紫外，纵向、空间平坦和共动规范给出 w_raw≈1/3，而均匀密度规范给出 w_raw≈1。物质钟规范的共同 1/ε 增强反映其钟的缓慢演化；均匀密度额外的 1/σ2^2 增强来自密度约束中的 Laplacian 贡献。两种增强都不解释为规范无关的物理不稳定性，且规范重构必须保持微扰小。
classification.one_liner: 研究慢滚暴胀中均匀密度规范下标量扰动的二次有效能动张量及其规范依赖的红外/紫外行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；属于宇宙学扰动与广义相对论规范问题，匹配经典引力支线但非全息核心。

papers.title: A friendly phantom: Late-time AdS-to-dS transition and cosmological tensions
papers.abstract: We present Ph-$\Lambda_{\rm s}$CDM, a phantom-scalar realization within general relativity of the sign-switching cosmological-constant idea, $\Lambda_{\rm s}$CDM, in which a phantom scalar evolving on a bounded hyperbolic-tangent potential induces a smooth mirror AdS-to-dS transition in the late-time dark-energy density. The wrong-sign kinetic term, usually viewed as pathological, becomes the mechanism lifting the field from a negative- to a positive-energy vacuum-like regime. The construction also shows that the field can become repulsive while its energy density is still negative. The cosmology nevertheless remains controlled: total energy stays positive, the late-time attractor is de Sitter rather than a Big Rip, and the dynamics remain safely infrared. Ph-$\Lambda_{\rm s}$CDM thus offers a concrete late-time mechanism with the potential to address multiple cosmological tensions.

classification.title_zh: 一个友好的幽灵：晚期 AdS 到 dS 转变与宇宙学张力
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Ph-Λ_sCDM，这是在广义相对论内对符号切换宇宙学常数思想 Λ_sCDM 的一种幽灵标量实现；其中，一个在有界双曲正切势上演化的幽灵标量，在晚期暗能量密度中诱导出平滑的镜像 AdS 到 dS 转变。通常被视为病态的符号错误动能项，成为将场从负能量类真空区域提升到正能量类真空区域的机制。该构造还表明，场可以在其能量密度仍为负时变为排斥。该宇宙学仍然受控：总能量保持为正，晚期吸引子是 de Sitter 而非 Big Rip，动力学保持安全地处于红外。因此，Ph-Λ_sCDM 提供了一种具体的晚期机制，有潜力应对多种宇宙学张力。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论内用幽灵标量实现晚期 AdS→dS 符号切换暗能量，并提出可能缓解宇宙学张力的机制。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是广义相对论框架下的晚期宇宙学/暗能量模型，涉及 AdS 到 dS 转变但并非 AdS/CFT 全息研究，也不涉及用户重点的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM 或量子信息等支线。

papers.title: Equivariant Localization with Electric Monodromy in M-theory
papers.abstract: We extend equivariant localization for supersymmetric AdS$_3$ backgrounds of M-theory to solutions with nonzero electric flux periods. The associated local electric potential acquires additive monodromy, contributing to the warped volume alongside R-symmetry fixed points and outer boundaries. Using Killing-spinor identities, we relate the electric periods to magnetic flux and, for a class of compact backgrounds, the warped volume to the electric Maxwell charge. We also derive a relation between the gravitational anomaly and the electric flux. We apply these results to AdS$_3$ $\times S^3 \times S^3 \times T^2$ and AdS$_3$ $\times S^3 \times K3 \times S^1$, recovering their central charges and deriving the R-current levels of the former directly from eleven-dimensional supergravity. Finally, we study a noncompact half-BPS AdS$_3$ $\times S^3\times S^3$ geometry fibered over a periodic half-cylinder, where fixed-point, monodromy and outer-boundary contributions coexist.

classification.title_zh: M理论中带电磁单值性的等变局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将M理论超对称AdS3背景的等变局域化推广到具有非零电通量周期的解。相关的局部电势获得加性单值性，并与R对称固定点和外边界一起贡献warped体积。利用Killing旋量恒等式，我们将电周期与磁通量联系起来，并对一类紧致背景将warped体积与电Maxwell电荷联系起来。我们还推导了引力反常与电通量之间的关系。我们将这些结果应用于AdS3×S3×S3×T2和AdS3×S3×K3×S1，恢复其中心荷，并直接由十一维超引力推导前者的R流水平。最后，我们研究一个非紧半BPS AdS3×S3×S3几何，它纤维化在周期半圆柱上，其中固定点、单值性和外边界贡献共存。
classification.one_liner: 将等变局域化推广至M理论AdS3非零电通量周期，并用单值性计算warped体积、中心荷及反常关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于AdS3超引力等变局域化与全息中心荷/反常计算，未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7/Floquet驱动等支线。

papers.title: Landau Theory of Black Brane Phase Transitions from Kasner Singularities
papers.abstract: We develop a Landau theory of a continuous black-brane phase transition using the geometry of the black-hole interior. The normal phase has a Reissner--Nordstr\"om Cauchy horizon, whereas the scalarized phase ends at a Kasner singularity. A conserved radial charge determines the grand potential from either endpoint and permits a direct phase comparison. At the critical point, we show analytically that the quadratic correction to the conserved radial charge vanishes. Using the inverse Kasner scalar velocity as an interior order parameter, we then construct a Landau potential whose coefficients are determined entirely from the terminal singularity. The Iyer--Wald first law relates this potential to the conventional boundary Landau theory and fixes its quartic coefficient. For two models with different scalar self-interactions, the resulting theory predicts the critical scaling of the Kasner order parameter and the grand-potential difference between the phases, in agreement with fully backreacted numerical solutions.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 从Kasner奇点看黑膜相变的朗道理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用黑洞内部几何发展黑膜连续相变的朗道理论。正常相具有Reissner-Nordström Cauchy视界，而标量化相终止于Kasner奇点。守恒径向荷可由任一端点确定巨势，并允许直接相比较。在临界点，我们解析证明守恒径向荷的二次修正消失。以Kasner标量速度的倒数作为内部序参量，我们构造朗道势，其系数完全由终端奇点决定。Iyer-Wald第一定律将该势与常规边界朗道理论联系起来，并固定其四次项系数。对于两个具有不同标量自相互作用的模型，所得理论预言Kasner序参量的临界标度和两相巨势差，与完全背反应数值解一致。
classification.one_liner: 利用黑洞内部Kasner奇点构造黑膜连续相变的朗道势，并用Iyer-Wald第一定律联系边界朗道理论。

papers.title: Landau-Ginzburg Theory of a Holographic Superconductor: A Horizon Perspective on the Zero-Temperature Ground State
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of a quartic scalar self-interaction, $\lambda|\phi|^4$, on a holographic superconductor in which non-linear electrodynamic couplings generate a superconducting dome containing an extended Lifshitz regime. The quartic interaction leaves the linearized scalar dynamics around the normal phase unchanged while modifying the non-linear solutions where the scalar field is large. As $\lambda$ increases, the solutions within the dome pass through three stages. The Lifshitz region shrinks until its scaling solution disappears at $\lambda^*$, leaving a no-AdS region, beyond whose edge the flows end before reaching any asymptotic region, and above $\lambda_c$ the dome consists entirely of asymptotically AdS hairy black holes. At the bottom of the dome we identify the point where the horizon value of the scalar field is largest, which we refer to as the critical point. There this value lies at the deepest symmetry-breaking minimum that the horizon effective potential, of Landau-Ginzburg form, can have. Unlike a conventional Landau-Ginzburg description, this interpretation rests on the scalar field at the horizon rather than on the boundary order parameter. Below $\lambda^*$, the constant scalar of the Lifshitz fixed point sits instead at the minimum of the effective potential of its asymptotic scaling region.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 全息超导体的朗道-金兹堡理论：零温基态的视界视角
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究四次标量自相互作用 λ|φ|^4 对全息超导体的影响；该模型中非线性电动力学耦合产生一个包含扩展 Lifshitz 区域的超导穹顶。四次相互作用不改变正常相附近标量场的线性动力学，但会修改标量场较大时的非线性解。随着 λ 增大，穹顶内的解经历三个阶段：Lifshitz 区域收缩，直到其标度解在 λ* 处消失，留下一个无 AdS 区域，其边缘之外的流在到达任何渐近区域之前终止；当 λ 高于 λ_c 时，穹顶完全由渐近 AdS 的带毛黑洞组成。在穹顶底部，作者识别出视界处标量场取值最大的点，称为临界点；该值位于视界有效势（具有 Landau-Ginzburg 形式）所能具有的最深对称破缺极小值处。与常规 Landau-Ginzburg 描述不同，这一解释基于视界处的标量场，而不是边界序参量。当 λ 低于 λ* 时，Lifshitz 不动点的常标量场则位于其渐近标度区域有效势的极小值处。
classification.one_liner: 研究四次标量自相互作用如何改变含 Lifshitz 区的全息超导穹顶，并从视界有效势的 Landau-Ginzburg 形式刻画零温基态。

papers.title: Spectral function, OPE, and QNMs detect different singular points of black branes with unequal R-charges
papers.abstract: We consider black brane solutions in the STU model, with three R-charges labeled by the parameters $q_1,q_2,q_3$. For equal R-charges $q_1=q_2=q_3$, the solution becomes the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black brane. For unequal R-charges $q_1>q_2>q_3\geq0$, there are three curvature singular points at $R\equiv r^2=-q_i$. Only $R=-q_3$ is the physical singularity, and the other two lie beyond it. Their optical times $T_i$, the complex times of null rays from the boundary to these singular points and back, form a right triangle in the complex $T$-plane. We probe these singular points using three observables, all built from the retarded correlator of $T_{xy}$ at zero spatial momentum: spectral function, OPE coefficients, and QNMs. The exponentially small correction to the spectral function at large real frequency is dominated by $T_1$ and $T_2$, which have the smallest ${\rm Im}\,T_i$. The OPE convergence radius is determined by $T_1$, which has the smallest $|T_i|$. A line of QNMs lies along the direction of $1/T_2$, since $T_2$ has the smallest phase $\arg T_i$. Furthermore, there is a second line of QNMs along the negative imaginary axis, which carries information about $T_3$ corresponding to the physical singularity. We derive these results from a WKB analysis and check them numerically. The three observables are therefore sensitive to different singular points of the geometry.

classification.title_zh: 谱函数、OPE 与 QNM 探测具有不等 R 电荷黑膜的不同奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 考虑 STU 模型中带三个 R 电荷 q1,q2,q3 的黑膜解。当 R 电荷相等时，该解退化为 Reissner-Nordström 黑膜。对于不等 R 电荷 q1>q2>q3≥0，存在三个曲率奇异点 R≡r^2=-q_i。只有 R=-q3 是物理奇点，另外两个位于其外。它们的光学时间 T_i（从边界到这些奇异点再返回的零测地线复时间）在复 T 平面中构成直角三角形。我们使用三个观测量探测这些奇异点，三者均由零空间动量下 T_xy 的推迟关联函数构造：谱函数、OPE 系数和 QNM。大实频率下谱函数的指数小修正由 Im T_i 最小的 T1 和 T2 主导。OPE 收敛半径由 |T_i| 最小的 T1 决定。一条 QNM 线沿 1/T2 方向，因为 T2 具有最小的相位 arg T_i。此外，还有一条沿负虚轴的 QNM 线，携带对应物理奇点的 T3 信息。我们通过 WKB 分析推导这些结果并进行数值检验。因此，这三个观测量对几何的不同奇异点敏感。
classification.one_liner: STU 黑膜中谱函数、OPE 与 QNM 分别对三个曲率奇点敏感，反映复光学时间的几何结构。

papers.title: Near-horizon BF bounds for the $t^+$ KK tower on extremal AdS$_5$ black holes
papers.abstract: We study the charged Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound for all horizon harmonics of the type IIB $t^+$ Kaluza--Klein tower on extremal charged AdS$_5$ black holes with equal rotations. The scalar equation follows from maximal five-dimensional gauged supergravity at level zero and the linearized exceptional-field-theory equations at higher levels. For aligned charge and rotation, a quadratic form in charge and spin changes signature on the curve of supersymmetric (BPS) black holes, where every mode satisfies the bound. Above the curve, where $\Omega_H>1$, every black hole has a violating mode, although no finite truncation in level or spin detects violation at every such black hole. Below the curve, where $\Phi_H>1$, the BF-passing set is confined to a thin strip and controlled by charge and spin discreteness. At large radius and fixed rotation, a level-four mode with spin proportional to the radius violates the bound even where all U(2) singlets satisfy it. These results concern the near-horizon BF bound of one tower in two-derivative supergravity; full radial stability remains open.

classification.title_zh: 极端AdS5黑洞上t^+ Kaluza-Klein塔的近视界BF界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在具有相等旋转参数的极端带电AdS5黑洞上，IIB型t^+ Kaluza-Klein塔所有视界谐波的带电Breitenlohner-Freedman (BF)界。标量方程在零级来自五维最大规范超引力，在更高级别来自线性化的例外场论方程。对于电荷与旋转对齐的情形，电荷和自旋的二次型在超对称(BPS)黑洞曲线上改变符号，此时每个模式都满足该界。在曲线上方，当Ω_H>1时，每个黑洞都有违反该界的模式，尽管任何有限级别或自旋截断都不能在每个此类黑洞上检测到违反。在曲线下方，当Φ_H>1时，通过BF界的集合被限制在一条薄带内，并由电荷和自旋的离散性控制。在大半径和固定旋转下，一个自旋与半径成比例的四级模式违反该界，即使所有U(2)单态都满足它。这些结果涉及两导数超引力中一个塔的近视界BF界；完整的径向稳定性仍未解决。
classification.one_liner: 研究极端AdS5黑洞上t^+ KK塔各视界谐波的近视界BF界，刻画BPS曲线上下及大半径下违反模式的结构。

papers.title: Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains
papers.abstract: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$. We also comment on the generalization to wormhole mimickers of non-extremal black holes and on the implications of these results for unitarity in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

classification.title_zh: 极端黑洞模仿者：几何、稳定性与长延迟信号序列
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个作为极端黑洞无地平线模仿者的时空。与非极端黑洞模仿者（虫洞型、由长喉连接两个渐近平直区）不同，极端黑洞模仿者一端为单个渐近平直区，另一端为无限长喉。在喉区，时空趋近于直积几何 M_{1,1}×S^2。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运：喉区的局部分析会出现 Aretakis 型模式，但它们不会导致该模仿者的物理不稳定性。初始局域于喉区的标量扰动在晚期会产生一系列信号，其特征间隔为 t_delay∼1/λ，其中 λ≪1 是形变参数；这一时标在参数上大于非极端黑洞模仿者所特有的回声时标 t_echo∼ln(1/λ)，我们称之为长延迟信号序列。几何上，长延迟信号的周期性与 S^2 上的周期测地线相关。随后我们将该构造推广到极端 Kerr 情形；此时喉区趋近于涉及 M_{1,1} 与二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何，相应信号预期形成准周期信号序列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。最后，我们评论了对非极端黑洞虫洞型模仿者的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下对幺正性的启示。
classification.one_liner: 构造极端黑洞的无地平线模仿者，并揭示其喉区标量扰动产生由 S^2 周期测地线决定的长延迟信号序列。

papers.title: Stokes Phenomena between AdS/CFT and dS/CFT
papers.abstract: As parameters are varied, the set of saddle points contributing to a (path) integral may change discontinuously, leading to a corresponding change in the asymptotic expansion of the integral. This behavior is known as the Stokes phenomenon. We explore this phenomenon in the context of the analytic continuation problem relating the AdS/CFT and dS/CFT correspondences. In this paper, we study these correspondences for three-dimensional pure gravity and two-dimensional Liouville theory, using independent calculations in bulk minisuperspace and in the boundary Liouville zero-mode. In the bulk, the dS contour selects a single saddle and yields the tunneling wave function. Upon continuation to AdS, the contour instead selects an infinite family of saddles. The boundary calculation independently reproduces the same Stokes structure at leading semiclassical order, providing a nontrivial holographic consistency check. Our construction also offers a contour prescription for the conformal factor problem in Euclidean AdS$_3$ quantum gravity within minisuperspace.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 与 dS/CFT 之间的 Stokes 现象
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 AdS/CFT 与 dS/CFT 对应关系之间解析延拓问题中的 Stokes 现象。作者针对三维纯引力和二维 Liouville 理论，分别在体空间 minisuperspace 和边界 Liouville 零模中进行独立计算。在体空间中，dS 围道选择单个鞍点并给出隧穿波函数；延拓到 AdS 后，围道改为选择无穷多个鞍点。边界计算在半经典领头阶独立复现相同的 Stokes 结构，提供了非平凡的全息一致性检验。该构造还为 minisuperspace 中欧氏 AdS3 量子引力的共形因子问题给出一种围道方案。
classification.one_liner: 用三维纯引力与二维 Liouville 的 minisuperspace/边界计算，揭示 AdS/CFT 与 dS/CFT 解析延拓中的 Stokes 结构并作全息一致性检验。

papers.title: Gravitational Memory Beyond Null Infinity through Finite-Distance Carrollian Screens
papers.abstract: We investigate gravitational memory beyond null infinity by studying finite-distance null hypersurfaces endowed with Carrollian geometry. We show that the intrinsic degenerate geometry, optical data, and null Brown--York tensor of a finite null screen define a quasilocal Carrollian dissipative system, providing a natural framework to characterize the residual geometric response after the passage of radiation. To make this construction explicit and compare it with the standard asymptotic description, we use Robinson--Trautman spacetimes as an exactly solvable radiative setting. For asymptotically flat Robinson--Trautman geometries, we transform the solution to Bondi gauge and extract the asymptotic data directly in terms of the Robinson--Trautman field. In the linearized sector, the Bondi shear is purely electric and produces the standard displacement-memory effect associated with the relaxation toward the final Schwarzschild geometry. We show that the leading large-radius tracefree component of the finite-screen memory reduces to the Bondi displacement memory, while finite-distance corrections retain additional focusing, embedding dependence, angular drift, Coulombic data, and near-zone information. Thus, Bondi memory emerges as the universal asymptotic projection of a broader quasilocal Carrollian response. Late-time screens approaching the final Schwarzschild horizon exhibit exponentially decaying non-isotropic Carrollian data, leaving only the isotropic null Brown--York stress. As a by-product, we construct the Robinson--Trautman solution with nonzero cosmological constant to second order in the radiative amplitude and use the holographic dictionary to study the associated energy fluxes and find that the resulting charge does not obey a universal monotonicity property.

classification.title_zh: 通过有限距离Carrollian屏超越零无穷的引力记忆
classification.abstract_zh: 研究有限距离类光超曲面上的Carrollian几何，以刻画辐射通过后的残余几何响应。作者论证有限零屏的内禀退化几何、光学数据和零Brown-York张量构成准局域Carrollian耗散系统，并以Robinson-Trautman时空作为精确可解的辐射背景，将其变换到Bondi规范以提取渐近数据。在线性化情形下，Bondi剪切为纯电型，产生标准位移记忆。有限屏记忆的大半径无迹领头分量约化为Bondi位移记忆，而有限距离修正保留聚焦、嵌入依赖、角向漂移、Coulomb数据和近区信息。晚期趋近最终Schwarzschild视界的屏具有指数衰减的非各向同性Carrollian数据，仅留下各向同性零Brown-York应力。作为副产品，构造了非零宇宙学常数的Robinson-Trautman解至辐射振幅二阶，并用全息字典研究能流，发现所得荷不满足普适单调性。
classification.one_liner: 将引力记忆推广为有限距离Carrollian屏的准局域耗散响应，并表明Bondi位移记忆是其大半径渐近投影。

papers.title: A Novel Matrix Model for the M5-brane?
papers.abstract: We provide a new formal extension of the BFSS matrix model by an additional 5-bracket. Maximal supersymmetry leads us to promote the BFSS 2-bracket structure constants to a dynamical field $H_{abc}$ governed by a Chern-Simons-like kinetic term. We first show that the full generic pseudo-action is invariant under maximal supersymmetry and that the associated supersymmetry algebra closes upon invoking a number of BPS-like quadratic constraints. We then present a special case based on the 5-Lie algebra $A_6$ that evades these additional constraints and allows for a Lagrangian description. These results hinge on a conspiracy of properties of the $SO(9)$ gamma matrices and the 2- and 5-brackets. Compellingly, the resulting model seems to realize some features expected of a theory containing M5-branes and opens up the possibility of further including higher brackets for the M6- and M9-branes.

classification.title_zh: 一种关于 M5-膜的新矩阵模型？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过对 BFSS 矩阵模型额外引入一个 5-括号，给出了其新的形式扩展。最大超对称要求将 BFSS 的 2-括号结构常数提升为由类 Chern-Simons 动能项支配的动力学场 H_{abc}。我们首先证明，一般的完整赝作用量在最大超对称下不变，并且相关的超对称代数在引入若干类 BPS 二次约束后闭合。随后，我们给出基于 5-李代数 A_6 的一个特殊情形，它规避这些额外约束并允许拉格朗日描述。这些结果依赖于 SO(9) gamma 矩阵以及 2-括号和 5-括号性质的共同作用。引人注意的是，所得模型似乎实现了包含 M5-膜的理论所预期的一些特征，并为进一步纳入 M6-膜和 M9-膜的高阶括号提供了可能。
classification.one_liner: 通过引入 5-括号和动力学结构常数扩展 BFSS 矩阵模型，构造具有最大超对称的 M5-膜候选矩阵模型。
