papers.title: $\mathcal{N}=1$ spectra, cubic couplings and the rigid fate of DGKT
papers.abstract: We show that in the DGKT scenario on a generic Calabi-Yau three-fold, a recently proposed holographic constraint on cubic couplings is satisfied if and only if the Calabi-Yau is rigid, i.e. when $h^{2,1}=0$. More generally, we illustrate how in 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravity, extremal cubic couplings are determined by the third derivatives of the real, K\"ahler-invariant superpotential, while the eigenvalues of its Hessian compute the conformal dimensions of the dual scalar operators. These results extend more broadly beyond 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravity. Applying them to supersymmetric DGKT vacua, we prove that extremal cubic couplings always vanish in the K\"ahler + universal CS/dilaton sector, whereas non-vanishing (super-)extremal couplings are always present in the complex structure sector. It follows that the holographic constraint is satisfied in DGKT if and only if the Calabi-Yau three-fold is rigid with $h^{2,1}=0$.

classification.title_zh: N=1 谱、三次耦合与 DGKT 的刚性命运
classification.abstract_zh: 在一般 Calabi-Yau 三复形上的 DGKT 情景中，最近提出的对三次耦合的全息约束当且仅当 Calabi-Yau 为刚性（h^{2,1}=0）时满足。更一般地，说明在 4d N=1 超引力中，极值三次耦合由实、Kähler 不变超势的三阶导数决定，而其 Hessian 的本征值给出对偶标量算符的共形维数；这些结果可推广到 4d N=1 超引力之外。应用于超对称 DGKT 真空，证明在 Kähler + universal CS/dilaton 扇区中极值三次耦合总是为零，而在复结构扇区中总存在非零（超）极值耦合。由此，DGKT 中全息约束当且仅当 Calabi-Yau 三复形刚性且 h^{2,1}=0 时满足。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明 DGKT 中三次耦合的全息约束当且仅当 Calabi-Yau 三复形刚性时成立，并给出 4d N=1 超引力中极值三次耦合与对偶算符维数的关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 字典与 N=1 超引力谱/耦合研究，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、QNM、探针膜等支线。

papers.title: QFT as a set of ODEs: higher dimensions
papers.abstract: Correlation functions of local operators in Quantum Field Theory (QFT) in Anti-de Sitter space (AdS) are completely fixed by the QFT data: the set of scaling dimensions $\Delta_i$ and OPE coefficients $C_{ijk}$ of the boundary operators, and the bulk-boundary (BOE) coefficients $b^{\hat\Phi}_i$ encoding how bulk fields decompose into boundary operators. In this work, we generalize the ordinary differential equations (ODEs) that govern the variation of the QFT data under a bulk relevant deformation, originally derived for AdS$_2$ \cite{Loparco:2026fki}, to the cases of AdS$_3$ and AdS$_4$. We demonstrate that these flow equations natively capture the mechanism of merger-annihilation when a boundary operator hits marginality, as well as level repulsion when different $\Delta_i$'s approach each other. Furthermore, we address the practical implementation of the framework: we propose substituting the ODE for the OPE coefficients with the crossing equation for greater efficiency, and we observe that Pad\'e approximants dramatically improve the convergence of the sums over boundary operators, at least in free theories. Altogether, these advances lay the groundwork for the future application of the flow equations to the study of strongly coupled QFTs in AdS and their flat space limits.

classification.title_zh: QFT 作为一组 ODE：更高维情形
classification.abstract_zh: 在反德西特空间中，局域算符的关联函数完全由 QFT 数据决定：边界算符的标度维数 Δ_i、OPE 系数 C_ijk，以及描述体场如何分解为边界算符的体-边界系数 b_i^Φ。本文把最初为 AdS2 推导的、描述 QFT 数据在体相关形变下变化的常微分方程推广到 AdS3 和 AdS4。我们表明，这些流方程自然捕捉边界算符到达边际时的合并-湮灭机制，以及不同 Δ_i 相互接近时的能级排斥。此外，我们讨论该框架的实际实现：建议用交叉方程替代 OPE 系数的 ODE 以提高效率，并观察到 Padé 近似能显著改善边界算符求和的收敛性（至少在自由理论中）。这些进展为将来把流方程用于强耦合 AdS QFT 及其平直空间极限奠定基础。
classification.one_liner: 将 AdS2 中描述体相关形变下 QFT 数据演化的常微分方程推广到 AdS3 和 AdS4，并讨论算子混合、边际合并及数值实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 AdS/CFT 字典中 QFT 数据在体相关形变下的流方程及其高维推广，属于全息基础与字典方向。

papers.title: Weyl conformal geometry vs Riemannian geometry of Weyl gauge invariant (dressed) metric
papers.abstract: Weyl conformal geometry is the natural underlying geometry of gauge theories of Weyl group (of dilatations and Poincar\'e symmetry), such as Weyl quadratic gravity and its generalisation, Weyl-Dirac-Born-Infeld action (WDBI). These are local, Weyl-anomaly free (quantum) gauge theories of gravity. We describe Weyl gauge symmetry from a more familiar Riemannian view of Weyl gauge invariant dressed fields by the Wilson line of dilatations. Weyl geometry can then be seen as Riemannian geometry of non-local dressed metric ($g_{\mu\nu}^*$), at the "cost" of (gauge-induced) non-commutativity in the UV, due to Wilson line. Then Weyl quadratic gravity and WDBI actions of Weyl geometry, which are Weyl gauge invariant in $d$ dimensions, have the same expression in Riemannian geometry defined by $g^*_{\mu\nu}$. This is a non-local map and dual description of the two geometries and actions in the symmetric phase. Unlike for the metric, the equation of motion of Weyl gauge field ($\omega_\mu$) does not commute with the dressing of the metric. Quantum non-locality, in particular entanglement, and non-commutativity are (gauge-invariant) physical artefacts of "translating" (local) Weyl geometry and Weyl gauge covariance into our real-world Riemannian geometry of Weyl gauge invariant observables, and they are evidence of Weyl gauge symmetry. At lower energies, $\omega_\mu$ becomes massive, can decouple and Einstein-Hilbert action and commutativity are recovered. The case of a light $\omega_\mu$ is also discussed.

classification.title_zh: Weyl共形几何与Weyl规范不变（缀饰）度规的黎曼几何
classification.abstract_zh: Weyl共形几何是Weyl群（伸缩与Poincaré对称性）规范理论的自然底层几何，例如Weyl二次引力及其推广Weyl-Dirac-Born-Infeld作用量（WDBI）。这些是局域、无Weyl反常的（量子）引力规范理论。本文用伸缩Wilson线缀饰场，从更熟悉的黎曼视角描述Weyl规范对称性；Weyl几何可视为非局域缀饰度规g*_{\mu\nu}的黎曼几何，代价是Wilson线导致的（规范诱导的）UV非对易性。于是，在d维Weyl规范不变的Weyl二次引力和WDBI作用量，在用g*_{\mu\nu}定义的黎曼几何中具有相同表达式；这是对称相中两种几何与作用量的非局域映射和对偶描述。与度规不同，Weyl规范场ω_\mu的运动方程不与度规缀饰对易。量子非局域性（尤其纠缠）和非对易性，是将（局域）Weyl几何与Weyl规范协变性“翻译”到现实世界Weyl规范不变可观测量的黎曼几何时产生的规范不变物理产物，也是Weyl规范对称性的证据。在低能下，ω_\mu获得质量并可解耦，从而恢复Einstein-Hilbert作用量和交换性；文中也讨论了轻ω_\mu情形。
classification.one_liner: 用伸缩Wilson线缀饰度规，将Weyl共形几何及其Weyl规范不变引力作用量映射为非局域黎曼几何描述，并讨论低能解耦恢复Einstein-Hilbert极限。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力规范理论与共形几何，不是全息研究；但与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，且不涉及全息超流、QNM、探针膜等重点标签。

papers.title: Exact solution of two-dimensional Palatini Gauss-Bonnet theory on a strip
papers.abstract: We analyze the two-dimensional Palatini Gauss-Bonnet theory on an infinite strip (product of a finite interval with the infinite line, corresponding to ``time"). The theory has only boundary degrees of freedom. Its phase space is the cotangent bundle to the group manifold of $SL(2,\mathbf{R})$, subject to a (first-class) constraint quadratic in the momenta. With the simplest choice of boundary Hamiltonian, namely $H = 0$, the theory is shown to describe geodesics on the group manifold of $SL(2,\mathbf{R})$, with a ``mass" determined by the Palatini Gauss-Bonnet coupling constant. Other choices of boundary Hamiltonians compatible with gauge invariance are also possible. The symmetry group contains (left and right) group translations on $SL(2,\mathbf{R})$. These are ``boundary symmetries" from the bulk point of view, one copy acting on one end of the interval, the other copy acting on the other end. Comments on the quantum theory are also given.

classification.title_zh: 二维Palatini Gauss-Bonnet理论在长条上的精确解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析无限长条上的二维Palatini Gauss-Bonnet理论（有限区间与无限直线的乘积，后者对应“时间”）。该理论只有边界自由度。其相空间是SL(2,R)群流形的余切丛，并受一个动量的二次第一类约束。取最简单的边界哈密顿量H=0时，理论描述SL(2,R)群流形上的测地线，“质量”由Palatini Gauss-Bonnet耦合常数决定。其他与规范不变性相容的边界哈密顿量也可选择。对称群包含SL(2,R)上的左右群平移；从体时空看这些是边界对称性，一份作用于区间一端，另一份作用于另一端。文中还给出了关于量子理论的评论。
classification.one_liner: 研究二维Palatini Gauss-Bonnet理论在无限长条上的精确解，表明其只有边界自由度，且H=0时对应SL(2,R)群流形上的测地线。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典二维引力模型的精确解与约束分析，摘要未涉及AdS/CFT全息字典或量子引力；与全息主线关联较弱，但与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Mixed-helicity bracket of celestial symmetries
papers.abstract: Celestial symmetries of gravity and gauge theory can be enhanced to a $w_{1+\infty}$ algebra and an $S$-algebra respectively, when restricting to a single graviton/gluon helicity sector. Difficulties in combining both sectors in the full theory have been pointed out in the previous literature. In this work, we face this problem from the covariant phase space perspective and analyze in detail the structure of the mixed-helicity bracket of the higher-spin charges for both gravity and Yang--Mills theory. We show that, when restricting one of the two helicities to the wedge sector, a closed algebra can be obtained for all spins in terms of a notion of shadow charge we introduce. Furthermore, when focusing on the lower spin subalgebra sectors, in the case of gravity, we show that a dual mass extension of the BMS algebra can be consistently constructed; in the case of Maxwell theory, inclusion of magnetic charges allows us to recover a non-vanishing expression for the electromagnetic central charge previously obtained through different methods.

classification.title_zh: 天球对称性的混合螺旋度括号
classification.abstract_zh: 引力与规范理论的天球对称性在限制到单一引力子/胶子螺旋度扇区时，可分别增强为 w_{1+∞} 代数和 S-代数。此前文献已指出在完整理论中结合两个扇区的困难。本工作从协变相空间视角面对该问题，并详细分析引力和 Yang-Mills 理论中高自旋荷的混合螺旋度括号结构。我们证明，当把两种螺旋度之一限制到楔形扇区时，借助我们引入的 shadow charge 概念，可以对所有自旋得到闭合代数。此外，聚焦低自旋子代数扇区时，在引力情形下，我们证明可以一致地构造 BMS 代数的对偶质量扩展；在 Maxwell 理论情形下，引入磁荷可让我们恢复此前通过不同方法得到的非零电磁中心荷表达式。
classification.one_liner: 从协变相空间分析引力与Yang-Mills中混合螺旋度高自旋天球荷的括号，并构造BMS对偶质量扩展与Maxwell电磁中心荷。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要聚焦天球对称性代数、混合螺旋度括号与BMS/Maxwell中心荷，不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、探针膜、相变与气泡成核、QNM或经典引力现象。

papers.title: Modular Witten Diagrams and Quantum Extremality
papers.abstract: We study entanglement entropy for ball-shaped regions in excited states of holographic conformal field theories. The excited states are prepared by the Euclidean path integral in the CFT with a source turned on for some double-trace operator, with a small, $O(1)$ amplitude $\lambda$. On the gravity side, the double-trace operator deforms the bulk geometry as well as the entanglement structure of the state of bulk matter fields. By the quantum extremal surface formula, this leads to a deformation of the shape of the entanglement wedge, an effect which becomes manifest in the entanglement entropy at $O(\lambda^2 G_N)$. On the CFT side, we explicitly calculate the entanglement entropy perturbatively in the source amplitude to $O(\lambda^2)$, in terms of modular-flowed correlation functions of double-trace operators. We then evaluate these modular-flowed correlation functions using Witten diagrams. This calculation involves a Schwinger-Keldysh contour ordering prescription in the bulk, which we motivate using analytic continuation from Euclidean replica correlators. Focusing on a particular graviton-exchange diagram, we rewrite it in a form where it manifestly reproduces the canonical energy term present in the quantum Ryu-Takayanagi formula, including the shape deformation of the entanglement wedge due to backreaction and quantum effects.

classification.title_zh: 模 Witten 图与量子极值性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究全息共形场论中激发态下球状区域的纠缠熵。这些激发态由 CFT 欧几里得路径积分制备，其中某个双迹算符的源被打开，振幅 λ 为小量且为 O(1)。在引力侧，双迹算符会形变体几何以及体物质场态的纠缠结构。根据量子极值面公式，这会导致纠缠楔形状的形变，该效应在 O(λ^2 G_N) 阶的纠缠熵中显现。在 CFT 侧，我们以源振幅的微扰展开显式计算到 O(λ^2) 的纠缠熵，用双迹算符的模流关联函数表示。随后我们用 Witten 图计算这些模流关联函数。该计算涉及体中的 Schwinger-Keldysh 围道排序规定，我们通过从欧几里得副本关联函数的解析延拓来给出其动机。聚焦于一个特定的引力子交换图，我们将其改写为一种形式，使其显式重现量子 Ryu-Takayanagi 公式中出现的正则能量项，包括由反作用与量子效应导致的纠缠楔形状形变。
classification.one_liner: 用模流关联函数与 Witten 图微扰计算双迹激发态球状区域纠缠熵，并验证量子 RT 公式中的能量项与纠缠楔形变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息 CFT 中双迹/多迹激发态的纠缠熵、量子极值面与 Witten 图计算，与 multi-trace 及全息纠缠方向高度相关。

papers.title: BPS Solutions of 4d Euclidean N=2 Supergravity with Higher Derivative Interactions
papers.abstract: We study fully BPS and a broad class of half-BPS stationary configurations of four-dimensional Euclidean N=2 supergravity with higher-derivative interactions. Working within the off-shell conformal supergravity framework of de Wit and Reys (arXiv:1706.04973), we analyse the complete set of Killing spinor equations and obtain the corresponding algebraic and differential constraints. We further derive the Euclidean attractor equations and evaluate the Wald entropy for the fully BPS AdS_2 x S^2 background. For half-BPS stationary configurations, we obtain the generalized stabilization equations expressing all fields in terms of harmonic functions on three-dimensional flat base space, extending the Lorentzian analysis of Cardoso et al (arXiv:hep-th/0009234) to the Euclidean signature. Our results provide a framework for studying supersymmetric saddles and computing the gravitational indices entirely within Euclidean higher-derivative supergravity, without recourse to analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: 含高阶导数相互作用的四维欧几里得 N=2 超引力的 BPS 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究含高阶导数相互作用的四维欧几里得 N=2 超引力的全 BPS 解以及一大类 half-BPS 稳态位形。我们在 de Wit 与 Reys 的离壳共形超引力框架（arXiv:1706.04973）中工作，分析完整的 Killing spinor 方程并得到相应的代数与微分约束。我们进一步导出欧几里得 attractor 方程，并计算全 BPS AdS_2 × S^2 背景的 Wald 熵。对于 half-BPS 稳态位形，我们得到广义稳定化方程，将全部场用三维平坦底空间上的调和函数表示，从而把 Cardoso 等人（arXiv:hep-th/0009234）的洛伦兹签名分析推广到欧几里得签名。我们的结果为完全在欧几里得高阶导数超引力中研究超对称鞍点并计算引力指标提供了框架，而无需借助解析延拓。
classification.one_liner: 在四维欧几里得 N=2 高阶导数超引力中推导 BPS Killing spinor 约束、Euclidean attractor/Wald 熵及 half-BPS 稳定化方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于高阶导数超引力的 BPS 解与黑洞熵/AdS2 背景研究，与用户重点中的经典引力/黑洞熵支线有部分关联；但未涉及全息字典及全息超流、凝聚态、QNM、D3-D7 探针膜等主要方向。

papers.title: Small-$b$ expansion of the DOZZ formula for light operators
papers.abstract: We present a systematic asymptotic small-$b$ expansion of the Liouville DOZZ three-point structure constant in the light-operator regime $\alpha_i=b\sigma_i$ in the limit $b\to0$. In this limit, the DOZZ structure constant admits the asymptotic representation \[ C(b\sigma_1,b\sigma_2,b\sigma_3) \sim {\cal P}(b;\sigma_i) \left[ 1+\sum_{n\ge1}b^{2n}\Omega_n(\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\sigma_3) \right], \qquad b\to0 , \] where ${\cal P}(b;\sigma_i)$ is an explicitly determined prefactor. Using Thorn's asymptotic expansion of the $\Upsilon_b$-function, we derive explicit closed-form expressions for the first coefficients $\Omega_n(\sigma_i)$ and show that they form a symmetric polynomial structure in the variables $\sigma_i$. The resulting asymptotic expansion provides explicit finite-$b$ corrections to the leading light-limit Liouville three-point data and furnishes a practical framework for applications in celestial holography. In particular, it provides Liouville data relevant for a perturbative program aimed at studying finite-$b$ corrections to celestial Yang-Mills amplitudes. Finally, we formulate such a perturbative Liouville framework and discuss several directions for its future development.

classification.title_zh: 轻算符情形下 DOZZ 公式的小 $b$ 展开
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出 Liouville DOZZ 三点结构常数在轻算符区域 $\alpha_i=b\sigma_i$、$b\to0$ 极限下的系统渐近小 $b$ 展开。在此极限下，DOZZ 结构常数具有渐近表示 $C(b\sigma_1,b\sigma_2,b\sigma_3)\sim {\cal P}(b;\sigma_i)[1+\sum_{n\ge1}b^{2n}\Omega_n(\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\sigma_3)]$，其中 ${\cal P}(b;\sigma_i)$ 为显式确定的前因子。利用 Thorn 对 $\Upsilon_b$ 函数的渐近展开，我们导出前若干系数 $\Omega_n(\sigma_i)$ 的显式闭式表达式，并表明它们在变量 $\sigma_i$ 中形成对称多项式结构。所得渐近展开给出领先轻极限 Liouville 三点数据的显式有限 $b$ 修正，并为天球全息中的应用提供实用框架。特别地，它为研究天球 Yang-Mills 振幅有限 $b$ 修正的微扰方案提供相关 Liouville 数据。最后，我们建立这样的微扰 Liouville 框架并讨论其未来发展的若干方向。
classification.one_liner: 系统推导 Liouville DOZZ 三点结构常数在轻算符小 $b$ 极限下的渐近展开及前几阶显式系数，面向天球全息应用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为 Liouville CFT/DOZZ 公式的渐近展开及天球全息应用，与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论等具体支线无直接重合。

papers.title: Analytic approaches to anisotropic holographic superfluids in asymptotically hyperscaling violation geometry
papers.abstract: We explore anisotropic holographic superfluidity and find analytic solutions near critical point where superfluid/normalfluid phase transition appears in a holographic dual fluid system. In arXiv:hep-th/1109.4592, the authors obtained such an analytic solution in 5-dimensional Einstein-SU(2)Yang-Mills system, and it is asymptotically AdS$_5$. What is more in this note is that we get analytic solutions near the critical point in 3- and 4- dimensional Einstein-Scalar-U(1)$\times$SU(2)Yang-Mills systems, which become asymptotically hyperscaling violation geometry. We also get leading order back reactions to the background geometry, which clearly shows spatial anisotropy of the bulk geometry. To explore the properties of the spacetime, we compute holographic entanglement entropy and confirm that the superfluid/normalfluid phase transition must occur at the critical point.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 渐近超尺度破坏几何中各项异性全息超流体的解析方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究各向异性全息超流，并在全息对偶流体系统中超流/正常流体相变出现的临界点附近寻找解析解。此前 arXiv:hep-th/1109.4592 在5维 Einstein-SU(2) Yang-Mills 系统中得到了渐近 AdS5 的此类解析解；本文进一步在3维和4维 Einstein-Scalar-U(1)×SU(2) Yang-Mills 系统中得到临界点附近的解析解，其渐近几何为超尺度破坏几何。我们还得到对背景几何的首阶背反应，清楚显示体时空的空间各向异性。为探究时空性质，我们计算了全息纠缠熵，并确认超流/正常流体相变必须在临界点发生。
classification.one_liner: 在渐近超尺度破坏几何中给出各向异性全息超流临界点附近的解析解与首阶背反应，并用全息纠缠熵确认相变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息超流/超导相变，包含各向异性、SU(2) Yang-Mills 序参量、临界点解析解与全息纠缠熵，与用户的全息超流超导及p波/多分量序参量重点支线高度匹配。

papers.title: Holographic covering and the fortuity of black holes
papers.abstract: We propose a classification of BPS states in holographic CFTs into monotone and fortuitous, based on their behaviors in the large $N$ limit. Intuitively, monotone BPS states form infinite sequences with increasing rank $N$, while fortuitous ones exist within finite ranges of consecutive ranks. A precise definition is formulated using supercharge cohomology. We conjecture that under the AdS/CFT correspondence, monotone BPS states are dual to smooth horizonless geometries, and fortuitous ones are responsible for typical black hole microstates and give dominant contributions to the entropy. We present supporting evidence for our conjectures in the ${\cal N}=4$ SYM and symmetric product orbifolds.

classification.title_zh: 全息覆盖与黑洞的偶然性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种将全息CFT中的BPS态分为单调和偶然的分类，依据其在大N极限下的行为。直观上，单调BPS态形成随秩N增加的无限序列，而偶然BPS态只存在于有限范围的连续秩内。利用超荷上同调给出精确定义。我们猜想在AdS/CFT对偶下，单调BPS态对偶于光滑的无视界几何，而偶然BPS态负责典型黑洞微观态并对熵给出主导贡献。我们在N=4 SYM和对称乘积orbifold中给出支持证据。
classification.one_liner: 提出全息CFT中BPS态的单调/偶然分类，并猜想偶然态对应典型黑洞微观态与熵。

papers.title: Convergence of the quasinormal-mode expansion of the Kerr Green function
papers.abstract: Black-hole ringdown is usually modeled as a linear superposition of quasinormal modes, and fits to gravitational-wave observations increasingly include high overtones. However, the overtone sum does not necessarily converge: overtones are more strongly damped and thus decay faster in time, but their amplitudes in the Green function (the signal at an observer produced by an impulse at a source point) grow, so the mode description may break down before a finite time. We show that for a rotating (Kerr) black hole this time has a clear geometric meaning. For highly damped modes, the amplitudes grow exponentially with the optical distance from the source and the observer to a characteristic "bounce" radius close to the black hole, defined as the location where the mode amplitude is smallest. For one family of modes, the amplitudes are also suppressed the farther the source and observer sit from the equatorial plane. Rotation therefore makes the onset of convergence depend on direction as well as distance, extending the geometric picture from bounce radii to bounce surfaces. Combining these effects gives a sufficient condition for absolute convergence. For spin $a/M = 0.7$, we map how this time varies with source and observer position, and amplitudes computed numerically reproduce the predicted spatial dependence to better than one percent. These results set geometric limits on when the quasinormal-mode sums converge.

classification.title_zh: Kerr Green 函数准正规模展开的收敛性
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞铃宕通常被建模为准正规模的线性叠加，且引力波观测拟合越来越多地包含高阶泛音。然而泛音求和不一定收敛：泛音阻尼更强、随时间衰减更快，但它们在 Green 函数中的振幅会增长，因此模式描述可能在有限时间之前失效。我们证明，对旋转 Kerr 黑洞，这一时间具有清晰的几何意义。对于高度阻尼模式，振幅随源和观测者到靠近黑洞的特征“反弹”半径的光学距离指数增长，该半径定义为模式振幅最小处。对其中一族模式，源和观测者离赤道面越远，振幅也越受抑制。旋转因此使收敛起始依赖方向和距离，将反弹半径的几何图像推广到反弹曲面。结合这些效应可给出绝对收敛的充分条件。对自旋 a/M=0.7，我们映射该时间随源和观测者位置的变化，数值计算的振幅以优于百分之一的精度重现预测的空间依赖。这些结果为 QNM 求和何时收敛设定了几何限制。
classification.one_liner: Kerr 黑洞 Green 函数中准正规模展开的收敛时间由源和观测者到反弹半径或反弹曲面的几何距离控制。

papers.title: The additive ambiguity of gravitational entropy fixed by the topology of the horizon
papers.abstract: In quantum gravity the algebra of observables of a subregion is of type III$_1$ at leading order in the semiclassical expansion, and it becomes of type II once the gravitational constraint is imposed. Hence generalized entropy acquires a trace, however it is defined only up to an additive constant. In this work we argue that in four-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity this constant is the Gauss--Bonnet contribution to the Wald entropy, and that it is carried by the normalization of the trace and not by the state. In particular, the conical expansion of the Gauss--Bonnet density is exactly linear in the deficit angle, and on smooth squashed cones it reduces to the intrinsic curvature of the cut, so that the term is a constant on every smooth cross-section and carries no boost energy. Its Noether charge is invariant under all deformations within a topological sector and central in any algebra that preserves the sector, and thus a state-independent constant on such an algebra can only rescale the trace. Additionally, when the boundary of the subregion is completed as the Euler action requires, the Gauss--Bonnet term does not contribute to the presymplectic form, the crossed product is inherited from Einstein gravity, and the constant is the Euler number of the excised Euclidean tip. We state the hypotheses, we weaken factoriality to a central decomposition, and we illustrate the mechanism in Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity and in topological black holes in anti-de Sitter space, where the topological weight displaces the Hawking--Page temperature and a black-hole merger shifts the coarse-grained boundary entropy by a state-independent amount.

classification.title_zh: 由视界拓扑固定的引力熵加性模糊
classification.abstract_zh: 在量子引力中，半经典展开领头阶子区域的可观测量代数为 III1 型，施加引力约束后变为 II 型。因此广义熵获得迹，但仅定义到加性常数。本文论证在四维 Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中，该常数是 Wald 熵的 Gauss–Bonnet 贡献，且由迹的归一化而非态承载。特别地，Gauss–Bonnet 密度的锥展开在 deficit angle 中严格线性，在光滑 squashed cones 上约化为切片的內禀曲率，因此该项在每个光滑截面上为常数且不携带 boost energy。其 Noether 荷在拓扑扇区内所有变形下不变，并在任何保持该扇区的代数中中心，因此此类代数上态无关常数只能重标度迹。此外，当子区域边界按 Euler 作用要求补全时，Gauss–Bonnet 项不贡献预辛形式，crossed product 继承自 Einstein 引力，该常数为挖去欧几里得尖端的 Euler 数。我们陈述假设，将 factoriality 弱化为中心分解，并在 Jackiw–Teitelboim 引力和反 de Sitter 空间拓扑黑洞中展示机制，其中拓扑权重移动 Hawking–Page 温度，黑洞并合使粗粒化边界熵移动一个态无关量。
classification.one_liner: 论证四维 Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中广义熵的加性常数由视界拓扑/Euler 数固定，并表现为迹归一化而非态依赖项。

papers.title: Beyond the point lens: radial structure and the horizon in wave-optics gravitational lensing
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave lensing in the wave-optics regime is sensitive to the structure of the lens beyond its total mass: to its exterior radial profile and, as we show, to the boundary condition at its centre. We develop an analytic framework to compute these effects for a scalar wave, as corrections to the wave lensed by a Newtonian point mass. The corrections are organized in inverse powers of the distance from the lens and computed with dressed radial kernels, which include the Newtonian interaction to all orders and resum the long-range phase that invalidates the Born expansion around the free wave. Retaining wavefront curvature, we find that the scattered wave is not the whole response: an inverse-square deformation changes the direct wave by an equal amount, even when the scattered wave is faint. Steeper terms of the exterior potential lead to short-distance divergences, which signal that the exterior geometry alone does not determine the lensed wave: the missing information is a set of local terms fixed by the inner boundary condition. For a Schwarzschild black hole we determine them by matching to the ingoing solution at the horizon. The horizon enters the amplification factor as an absorptive contact term, which reproduces the horizon-area cross section; it is absent for a non-absorbing lens of the same mass, and cannot be described by the thin-lens diffraction integral. It completes the correction quadratic in the mass, where it appears at the same order as finite-distance optical corrections, and largely cancels against them for an aligned source. Together, these results connect Newtonian dressing, diffraction and inner boundary conditions, in a systematic description of corrections to point-mass gravitational-wave lensing.

classification.title_zh: 超越点透镜：波光学引力透镜中的径向结构与视界
classification.abstract_zh: 波光学区间的引力波透镜对透镜的总质量之外的结构敏感：对透镜外部径向轮廓敏感，并且如本文所示，也对透镜中心边界条件敏感。作者建立了解析框架，以标量波计算这些效应对牛顿点质量透镜波的修正；修正按距透镜距离的逆幂组织，并用穿衣径向核计算，这些核包含全阶牛顿相互作用并重求和使自由波附近的Born展开失效的长程相位。保留波前曲率时，散射波并非全部响应：平方反比形变会以相同量改变直接波，即使散射波很弱。外部势的更陡项导致短距离发散，表明外部几何本身不能决定透镜波，缺失信息由内部边界条件固定的局域项给出。对Schwarzschild黑洞，作者通过匹配视界处的入射解确定这些项；视界作为吸收性接触项进入放大因子，并重现视界面积截面；同质量非吸收透镜没有该项，且薄透镜衍射积分无法描述它。该接触项补全质量平方阶修正，在其中与有限距离光学修正同阶出现，并在对齐源时与后者大幅抵消。
classification.one_liner: 本文系统计算波光学引力透镜中点质量近似之外的径向轮廓与Schwarzschild视界边界条件修正，并指出视界表现为薄透镜衍射积分无法描述的吸收性接触项。

papers.title: Cyclic Boson Stars with Quantum Vortex Molecules
papers.abstract: We find a new type of stationary boson star with cyclic rotational symmetry in the minimal model of complex scalar field coupled to gravity. Unlike conventional axisymmetric spinning boson stars, these configurations can carry noninteger angular momentum per particle in units of the reduced Planck constant, revealing a new way for boson stars to carry angular momentum. We identify the vortex assemblies within these stars as self-gravitating quantum vortex molecules, in which gravity supports a stationary vortex arrangement despite internal circulation. These structures provide a relativistic realization of quantum vortex molecules studied in condensates and motivate possible laboratory analogues.

classification.title_zh: 具有循环旋转对称性与量子涡旋分子的玻色子星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在复标量场与引力耦合的最小模型中，发现了一类具有循环旋转对称性的新型稳态玻色子星。与传统的轴对称旋转玻色子星不同，这些位形可以携带以约化普朗克常数为单位的非整数单粒子角动量，揭示了玻色子星携带角动量的一种新方式。我们将这些星体内部的涡旋组装识别为自引力量子涡旋分子；在其中，尽管存在内部环流，引力仍支撑着一种稳态涡旋排列。这些结构为凝聚体中研究的量子涡旋分子提供了相对论性实现，并激发了可能的实验室类比。

papers.title: Black holes as black boxes: a query lower bound on python's lunch decoding
papers.abstract: The python's lunch conjecture relates the complexity of bulk reconstruction in holographic tensor networks to an exponential cost associated with post-selection. We establish a tight query lower bound for this decoding problem in a Haar random oracle model, with a python's lunch circuit that applies Haar random unitary $U$ to a logical input and fixed ancillas, followed by post-selection on $m$ output qubits. Given one copy of the normalized encoded state and coherent oracle access to $U$ and $U^\dagger$, including controlled queries, we prove that recovering even a single logical bit with constant average advantage requires $\Omega(2^{m/2})$ queries. Together with the state-independent amplitude amplification upper bound for approximately isometric encodings, this establishes query complexity $\Theta(2^{m/2})$ at constant decoding accuracy. We also comment on the decoding cost for other "admissible'" ensembles of unitaries $U$ which give rise to families of approximately isometric holographic maps.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞作为黑箱：python's lunch 解码的查询下界
classification.abstract_zh: Python's lunch 猜想将全息张量网络中体时空重构的复杂度与后选择相关的指数代价联系起来。我们在 Haar 随机 oracle 模型中为该解码问题建立紧的查询下界：一个 python's lunch 电路将 Haar 随机酉 U 作用于逻辑输入和固定辅助比特，然后对 m 个输出量子比特做后选择。给定一份归一化编码态，以及对 U 和 U† 的相干 oracle 访问（包括受控查询），我们证明即使以常数平均优势恢复单个逻辑比特也需要 Ω(2^{m/2}) 次查询。结合近似等距编码的与态无关的振幅放大上界，这在常数解码精度下给出查询复杂度 Θ(2^{m/2})。我们还评论了其他可允许酉系综的解码代价，这些系综产生近似等距全息映射族。
classification.one_liner: 在 Haar 随机 oracle 模型下证明 python's lunch 解码需要 Θ(2^{m/2}) 次查询，给出紧的查询复杂度下界。

papers.title: Hidden wormholes from an action principle in $D=4$
papers.abstract: We present new black hole solutions for the class of gravitational effective field theories in four spacetime dimensions that extend General Relativity while retaining the graviton as the only degree of freedom of gravitational origin. We consider terms up to cubic order in curvature, solve the resulting field equations, and find one-way hidden wormholes as numerical solutions: these are regular black holes with an interior wormhole throat that is crossable in one direction and leads to a cosmological spacetime in its interior. They are regular and have no inner horizon, thus evading the mass inflation instability that afflicts conventional regular black hole geometries.

classification.title_zh: 四维中来自作用量原理的隐藏虫洞

papers.title: Astrophysical Constraints for Bosonic Dark Matter in and Around Quark Stars
papers.abstract: We investigate the structure, stability, and mass-radius relations of compact stars composed of quark matter within the non-ideal MIT Bag Model mixed with self-interacting bosonic dark matter with a $\phi^n$ self-interaction potential. By solving the coupled two-fluid Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations for boson masses between 200 MeV and 1 GeV and self-interaction strengths with $n=4$ and $n=40$, we show that strong self-interactions and higher boson masses enhance the stability of compact star configurations at high central pressures, though they reduce maximum overall masses. Ultra-compact solutions with $C \ge 1/3$ capable of mimicking black holes are significantly restricted compared to hadronic models, emerging only for strong self-interactions and dark matter fractions exceeding 90\%. Depending on the parameters, the compact stars form either extended dark matter halos or compact cores: stronger self-interactions and higher boson masses suppress the radial extension to favor compact cores of dark matter. Matching our models against observational constraints highlights PSR J1614$-$2230 and XTE J1814$-$338 as potential window of opportunity for dark matter detection. Notably, XTE J1814$-$338 could confirm a dark sector, given its requirement for light boson masses ($m_b \approx 200\text{--}300\text{ MeV}$) and strongly DM-dominated configurations.

classification.title_zh: 夸克星内及周围玻色暗物质的天体物理约束
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究由非理想 MIT 袋模型夸克物质与具有 phi^n 自相互作用势的自相互作用玻色暗物质混合组成的致密星的结构、稳定性与质量-半径关系。通过求解耦合的双流体 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，作者在玻色子质量 200 MeV 到 1 GeV、自相互作用强度 n=4 与 n=40 的参数范围内表明：强自相互作用和较高玻色子质量会增强高中心压强下致密星构型的稳定性，但降低最大总质量。能够模拟黑洞的超致密解（C ≥ 1/3）相比强子模型受到显著限制，仅在强自相互作用且暗物质占比超过 90% 时出现。根据参数不同，致密星可形成延展的暗物质晕或致密暗物质核心；更强的自相互作用和更高玻色子质量会抑制径向延展，倾向于形成致密核心。与观测约束匹配显示，PSR J1614-2230 和 XTE J1814-338 是潜在的暗物质探测窗口；特别是 XTE J1814-338 在要求较轻玻色子质量（约 200-300 MeV）且暗物质主导的构型时，可能确认暗扇区的存在。

papers.title: The Pfaffian sector of $\mathrm{SO}(2N)$ BPS cohomology: brane excitations, triality and fortuity
papers.abstract: We study the classical $\frac{1}{16}$-BPS cohomology of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory with gauge group $\mathrm{SO}(2N)$ in the BMN sector, including the operators built with one $\epsilon$-tensor. These operators are odd under the reflection in $\mathrm{O}(2N)$, carry the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ charge of a D3-brane wrapped on $\mathbb{RP}^3\subset\mathbb{RP}^5$, and form the Pfaffian sector. For $\mathrm{SO}(8)$ we determine this sector through level $j=18$, where the level is twice the total charge of an operator. All but one of its $106$ $\mathrm{SU}(3)_R$ multiplets are products of trace gravitons and excited Pfaffians. The exception is a singlet, represented by the singlet projection of the rank-four member of a four-term family of $\epsilon$-tensor operators. We construct a covering space for the Pfaffian sector in which this family is closed at every rank, and the family defines a non-graviton class for every $N\ge 4$. Triality pairs the singlet with a reflection-even class that is fortuitous with respect to the trace covering. The two classes restrict, along the spinor and the vector embedding of $\mathfrak{so}(7)$ respectively, to the known non-graviton singlet of $\mathrm{SO}(7)$, which is lifted at first order. We show that the two $\mathrm{SO}(8)$ classes, and the family for every $N\ge 4$, are protected to all orders of perturbation theory. Their protection is compatible with the lifting in $\mathrm{SO}(7)$ because restriction to a subalgebra does not commute with the quantum corrections to the supercharge.

classification.title_zh: SO(2N) BPS 上同调的 Pfaffian 扇区：膜激发、三重性与偶然性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究规范群为 SO(2N) 的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论在 BMN 扇区中的经典 1/16-BPS 上同调，包含由一个 ε 张量构造的算符。这些算符在 O(2N) 反射下为奇，携带包裹于 RP^3⊂RP^5 的 D3 膜的 Z2 荷，并构成 Pfaffian 扇区。对于 SO(8)，我们确定该扇区至 level j=18，其中 level 是算符总荷的两倍。其 106 个 SU(3)_R 多重态中，除一个外均为 trace graviton 与激发 Pfaffian 的乘积。例外是一个单态，由四算符 ε 张量家族中 rank-4 成员的单态投影表示。我们构造 Pfaffian 扇区的一个覆盖空间，使该家族在每个 rank 处闭合，并且该家族对每个 N≥4 定义一个非引力子类。三重性将该单态与一个相对于 trace covering 而言是偶然的反射偶类配对。这两类分别沿 so(7) 的旋量和矢量嵌入限制到 SO(7) 的已知非引力子单态，后者在一阶被 lifted。我们证明两个 SO(8) 类以及 N≥4 的该家族在所有微扰阶均受保护。它们的保护与 SO(7) 中的 lifting 相容，因为限制到子代数不与超荷的量子修正对易。
classification.one_liner: 系统刻画 SO(2N) N=4 SYM BMN 扇区的 Pfaffian BPS 上同调，并发现受全阶微扰保护的非引力子类及其三重性配对。

papers.title: Strange-Metal Magnetotransport without a Strange-Metal Ground State
papers.abstract: Strange metals display a linear-in-temperature resistivity, $\rho_{xx}\sim T$, and a quadratic inverse Hall angle, $\cot\Theta_H\sim T^2$. These seemingly universal laws are often attributed to quantum criticality, yet no controlled theory realizes both at an asymptotic zero-temperature fixed point, and experimentally they persist only over finite temperature windows. Here, we show that these properties can arise from an intermediate critical regime that does not govern the ground state. Using a minimal class of holographic models, we construct a fully backreacted realization of both scalings, which appear within a finite temperature window controlled by an emergent intermediate scaling geometry. The window is bounded by relevant deformations of the corresponding fixed point: momentum relaxation sets the upper edge, while the magnetic field $B$ closes it from below at $T_{\min}\sim B^{2/3}$, up to logarithmic corrections. At $T_{\min}$, strange-metal transport, the scaling geometry, and critical thermodynamics break down together. Our results point to intermediate criticality as a distinct route to strange-metal transport, and suggest that it can be identified by the simultaneous breakdown of transport and thermodynamic scaling under a magnetic field.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 无奇异金属基态的奇异金属磁输运
classification.abstract_zh: 奇异金属表现出电阻率随温度线性变化，$\rho_{xx}\sim T$，以及霍尔角的平方反比随温度平方变化，$\cot\Theta_H\sim T^2$。这些看似普适的规律常被归因于量子临界性，但尚无受控理论能在渐近零温不动点同时实现二者，且实验上它们仅在有限温度窗口内持续存在。本文表明，这些性质可以来自一个不支配基态的中间临界区域。利用一类最小全息模型，我们构建了这两种标度行为的完全背反应实现，它们出现在由涌现的中间标度几何所控制的有限温度窗口内。该窗口受相应不动点的相关形变限制：动量弛豫设定上边界，而磁场 $B$ 在 $T_{\min}\sim B^{2/3}$ 处从下方关闭窗口，并带有对数修正。在 $T_{\min}$ 处，奇异金属输运、标度几何与临界热力学同时失效。我们的结果指出，中间临界性是实现奇异金属输运的一条独特途径，并表明可通过磁场下输运与热力学标度同时失效来识别它。
classification.one_liner: 全息模型展示奇异金属输运可由不支配基态的有限温中间临界区产生，并给出磁场关闭该窗口的标度。

papers.title: Fluid/Gravity Correspondence in 3d Flat Gravity with Non-Compact Boundaries
papers.abstract: We study 3d flat gravity on a restricted phase space with a non-compact spatial boundary. The charge algebra splits into two commuting chiral current algebras, which a fluid/gravity dictionary maps to the stress tensor of a two-dimensional conformal fluid, with energy bounded below by the momentum. On the line, finiteness of the charges selects integrable, square-integrable currents, and the global data are carried by the scattering variables of a Schr\"odinger operator rather than by a monodromy. We analyze Heisenberg-like and Dirichlet-like boundary conditions; the latter give independently propagating chiral kinks associated with the reflectionless P\"oschl-Teller operator. Both admit first-law relations. We outline the quantization as a Weyl $C^*$-algebra with quasi-free states. Retaining the radial dependence, the quasi-local stress tensor obeys an exact, non-perturbative flow of square-root $T\bar T$ type, which integrates to a finite boost in the radial position.

classification.title_zh: 非紧致边界三维平直引力中的流体/引力对应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在具有非紧致空间边界的受限相空间上研究三维平直引力。电荷代数分裂为两个对易的手征流代数，流体/引力字典将其映射为二维共形流体的应力张量，且能量被动量从下方界定。在直线上，电荷的有限性选出可积且平方可积的流，整体数据由 Schrödinger 算子的散射变量而非单值性承载。我们分析类 Heisenberg 与类 Dirichlet 边界条件；后者给出与无反射 Pöschl-Teller 算子相关的独立传播手征 kink。两者均满足第一定律。我们概述将其量子化为具有准自由态的 Weyl C*-代数。保留径向依赖后，准局域应力张量满足精确的非微扰平方根 T Tbar 型流，并积分为径向位置的有限 boost。
classification.one_liner: 研究非紧致边界三维平直引力的电荷代数与二维共形流体对应，并给出平方根 T Tbar 型准局域应力张量流。

papers.title: Higher Spin Lagrangians for Black Holes in Arbitrary Dimension
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the classical gravitational multipolar structure of rotating objects studying higher-spin Lagrangians coupled to gravity in arbitrary dimensions $D=d+1$. We first consider fields described by totally symmetric tensors with $s$ indices. At finite spin, the minimal coupling depends on both the spin and spacetime dimension. We show that, in the high-spin limit $s\gg 1$, the minimal multipolar expansion becomes dimension independent and it corresponds to the one which reproduces the Kerr solution in four dimensions. Furthermore, we identify a dimension independent relation among the non-minimal coupling coefficients that allows us to reproduce the Myers-Perry multipolar structure in arbitrary dimensions. We then extend our analysis to Lagrangians involving fields with different Young representations, which are allowed in higher dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 任意维度黑洞的高自旋拉格朗日量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究旋转物体的经典引力多极结构，考察任意维度 D=d+1 中与引力耦合的高自旋拉格朗日量。我们首先考虑由具有 s 个指标的全对称张量描述的场。在有限自旋下，最小耦合依赖于自旋和时空维数。我们证明，在高自旋极限 s≫1 下，最小多极展开变得与维数无关，并且对应于在四维中重现 Kerr 解的那一展开。此外，我们找出非最小耦合系数之间一个与维数无关的关系，使我们能够在任意维度重现 Myers-Perry 多极结构。随后我们将分析推广到涉及不同 Young 表示场的拉格朗日量，这些场在高维中是允许的。
classification.one_liner: 研究任意维旋转黑洞多极结构的高自旋拉格朗日量，并给出重现 Kerr/Myers-Perry 多极的耦合关系。

papers.title: Non-integrability of open strings via Pohlmeyer reduction
papers.abstract: We study integrable and non-integrable boundary conditions for classical strings from the point of view of Pohlmeyer reduction. We first consider the integrable case of strings ending on Y=0 non-maximal giant gravitons. Pohlmeyer reduction of such strings leads to a sine-Gordon model, for which a criterion for boundary integrability was provided by Ghoshal and Zamolodchikov. We confirm that the Pohlmeyer field satisfies this condition. We then turn to the main focus of our work, which is open strings on AdS3. By evaluating the Ghoshal-Zamolodchikov criterion for the corresponding Pohlmeyer-reduced models, we are able to distinguish between integrable and non-integrable cases, in line with expectations from recent analytic and numerical studies. We conclude that Pohlmeyer reduction can provide a useful perspective on open-string non-integrability.

classification.title_zh: 通过Pohlmeyer约化研究开弦的非可积性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从Pohlmeyer约化角度研究经典弦的可积与非可积边界条件。首先考虑终止于Y=0非极大巨引力子的可积情形，其Pohlmeyer约化给出sine-Gordon模型，并验证Pohlmeyer场满足Ghoshal-Zamolodchikov边界可积判据。随后重点研究AdS3上的开弦，通过对相应Pohlmeyer约化模型应用Ghoshal-Zamolodchikov判据，区分可积与非可积情形，与近期解析和数值研究预期一致。结论认为Pohlmeyer约化可为开弦非可积性提供有用视角。
classification.one_liner: 用Pohlmeyer约化与Ghoshal-Zamolodchikov判据区分AdS3开弦的边界可积性。

papers.title: Regular/Singular Black Hole Thermodynamics from Renormalised Volume/Area
papers.abstract: We study the finite mismatch between the holographically and topologically renormalised Euclidean actions of the four-dimensional AdS C-metric. Starting from the relation between Renormalised Volume and the Einstein sector of Conformal Gravity, we separate the regular curvature contribution from the contributions supported on the two conical axes. After introducing the usual Euler normalisation for smooth manifolds, the residual difference between the regular action evaluations is determined by the tension-weighted Euler terms of the renormalised worldsheet area. We identify this difference with the Gauss--Bonnet entropy contribution at the polar conical points of the horizon. The ordinary Euler characteristic remains fixed, while the deficits determine how its curvature representation is divided between regular and singular contributions. At fixed total string tension, the difference of the renormalised worldsheet areas per unit Euclidean time determines the relative tension work, giving a geometric interpretation of the relative thermodynamic length.

classification.title_zh: 从重整化体积/面积看规则/奇异黑洞热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究四维 AdS C-度规的全息重整化与拓扑重整化欧几里得作用量之间的有限差异。作者从重整化体积与共形引力的爱因斯坦部分之间的关系出发，将规则曲率贡献与两个锥轴上的贡献分离。在采用光滑流形通常的 Euler 归一化后，规则作用量评估之间的剩余差异由重整化世界面面积的张力加权 Euler 项决定。作者将该差异识别为视界极锥点处的 Gauss--Bonnet 熵贡献。普通 Euler 示性数保持不变，而锥亏损决定其曲率表示如何在规则与奇异贡献之间分配。在总弦张力固定时，每单位欧几里得时间重整化世界面面积之差决定相对张力做功，从而给出相对热力学长度的几何解释。
classification.one_liner: 该文用 AdS C-度规的重整化体积与面积分解，将黑洞热力学中的规则/奇异贡献与 Gauss--Bonnet 熵及相对张力做功联系起来。

papers.title: Structure Constants of Planar N=4 SYM at Any Coupling
papers.abstract: We recast a recent conjecture for structure constants in planar N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory in a separation-of-variables-inspired form suitable for non-perturbative analysis. All state-dependent information enters through the quantum spectral curve. As a showcase, we compute at finite coupling the three-point functions of two half-BPS operators and the spin-two member of the Konishi multiplet. Our results span weak to strong coupling, reproduce the known perturbative and string-theory limits, and are consistent with conformal-bootstrap bounds. We also obtain new six- and seven-loop perturbative coefficients and extract new strong-coupling data from high-precision numerical fits.

classification.title_zh: 任意耦合下平面 N=4 SYM 的结构常数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将最近关于平面 N=4 超对称 Yang-Mills 理论结构常数的猜想，重新表述为一种受分离变量启发、适合非微扰分析的形式。所有依赖于态的信息都通过量子谱曲线进入。作为示例，我们在有限耦合下计算了两个半 BPS 算符与 Konishi 多重态中自旋二成员的三点函数。我们的结果覆盖从弱耦合到强耦合，重现已知的微扰和弦论极限，并与共形 bootstrap 界一致。我们还获得了新的六圈和七圈微扰系数，并通过高精度数值拟合提取了新的强耦合数据。
classification.one_liner: 利用分离变量形式和量子谱曲线在任意耦合下研究平面 N=4 SYM 的结构常数，计算了 Konishi 相关三点函数及六/七圈系数。

papers.title: Giant gravitons without giant gravitons
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the partition function of a free bosonic $U(N)$ multi-matrix model admits a giant graviton expansion. For $d$ matrices, there are $d$ distinct giant gravitons, and the expansion can be characterized by a $d$-node quiver with bifundamentals connecting the nodes. This suggests the intriguing possibility of a more generalized holography where models without any obvious gravitational dual can nevertheless be given a dual brane interpretation. The giant graviton expansion of this multi-matrix model is somewhat unconventional though, as the giant graviton partition functions will necessarily have intrinsic $N$-dependence.

classification.title_zh: 没有巨引力子的巨引力子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，自由玻色 U(N) 多矩阵模型的配分函数允许巨引力子展开。对于 d 个矩阵，存在 d 个不同的巨引力子，展开可由一个 d 节点箭图刻画，节点之间由双基本表示连接。这暗示一种更广义全息的可能性：没有明显引力对偶的模型仍可被赋予对偶膜解释。不过，该多矩阵模型的巨引力子展开有些不寻常，因为巨引力子配分函数必然具有内禀的 N 依赖。
classification.one_liner: 论文证明自由玻色 U(N) 多矩阵模型的配分函数具有巨引力子展开，并由此讨论无显式引力对偶模型仍可具有膜对偶解释的广义全息可能性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文关注多矩阵模型中的巨引力子展开与广义全息/膜对偶，不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动；也不是经典引力/广义相对论研究。

papers.title: Gravity/Thermodynamics Correspondence for Generic Dynamical Spacetimes
papers.abstract: Working within covariant phase space formalism, we establish \textit{gravity-thermodynamics correspondence} for generic dynamical spacetimes. We derive local first and second laws of thermodynamics on general null boundaries, for generic non-stationary solutions to Einstein gravity {with minimally coupled matter} for physical observers that we carefully specify. Entropy variation, which receives contribution only from the gravitational sector, is the surface charge variation associated with a vector field generating the null boundary, and temperature is its non-affinity parameter (divided by $2\pi$). The statement of the second law in our setting is that the entropy variation evaluated along the null vector field is strictly non-negative for the admissible positive-non-affinity clock and matter satisfying the null energy condition. Our dynamical entropy variation, which is non-integrable for generic non-stationary solutions, becomes integrable in near-stationary configurations, reproducing the Hollands--Wald--Zhang dynamical entropy formula. Strikingly, this local second law holds even when the boundary area is decreasing, disentangling thermodynamic irreversibility and the second law from standard area theorems. Our first-principles construction demonstrates that gravitational thermodynamics requires neither a stationary background, teleological event horizons, nor an exact entropy state function on individual codimension-1 spacelike slices of the null boundary (codimension two in spacetime).

classification.title_zh: 一般动力学时空的引力/热力学对应
classification.abstract_zh: 在协变相空间形式下，我们为一般动力学时空建立引力-热力学对应。针对爱因斯坦引力（含最小耦合物质）的一般非稳态解，在一般零边界上为明确指定的物理观测者导出局域第一和第二热力学定律。熵变只来自引力部分，是与生成零边界的向量场相关的表面荷变分；温度是该向量场的非仿射参数除以2π。第二定律表述为：沿零向量场计算的熵变，在允许的正非仿射时钟和满足零能量条件的物质下严格非负。我们的动力学熵变对一般非稳态解不可积，在近稳态情形下可积并重现Hollands-Wald-Zhang动力学熵公式。值得注意的是，即使边界面积减小，该局域第二定律仍成立，从而将热力学不可逆性与第二定律同标准面积定理解耦。我们的第一性原理构造表明，引力热力学既不需要稳态背景，也不需要目的论式事件视界，也不需要在零边界的单个余维1类空切片（时空中余维2）上存在精确的熵态函数。
classification.one_liner: 在协变相空间框架下为一般非稳态时空导出零边界局域热力学定律，并表明第二定律可独立于面积定理成立。

papers.title: Supersymmetric warped AdS$_3$ solutions in eleven-dimensional supergravity
papers.abstract: We construct new families of supersymmetric solutions of eleven-dimensional supergravity by deforming the half-BPS $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3_+\times \mathrm{S}^3_-\times\mathbb R^2$ background. We consider lightlike, spacelike and timelike warpings of the anti-de Sitter factor, accompanied by deformations of the two three-spheres, and determine the supporting four-form fluxes and the constraints imposed by the equations of motion. In particular, the deformation parameters of the two spheres are necessarily equal, although their radii need not coincide. We compute the conserved charges and determine the preserved supersymmetries and Killing superalgebras. Generic lightlike solutions preserve four real supercharges, whereas spacelike and timelike solutions preserve eight, with a Killing superalgebra containing a single exceptional $\mathfrak d(2,1;\alpha)$ factor.

classification.title_zh: 十一维超引力中的超对称 warped AdS3 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过变形半BPS的 AdS3×S3_+×S3_-×R^2 背景，构造了十一维超引力中新的超对称解族。我们考虑反德西特因子的类光、类空和类时 warping，并伴随两个三维球面的变形，确定了支撑的四形式通量以及运动方程施加的约束。特别地，两个球面的变形参数必须相等，尽管其半径不必相同。我们计算守恒荷，并确定保持的超对称及Killing超代数。一般的类光解保持四个实超荷，而类空和类时解保持八个，其Killing超代数包含单个例外 d(2,1;α) 因子。
classification.one_liner: 构造11维超引力中warped AdS3超对称解族，给出通量约束、守恒荷与Killing超代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为11维超引力中warped AdS3超对称解构造，未涉及所列全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜或经典GR重点。

papers.title: Not All Holographic Entropy Inequalities Are Free of Area Law Ultraviolet Divergences
papers.abstract: In the AdS/CFT correspondence, linear constraints on subsystem entropies, which are necessary conditions for the validity of the Ryu-Takayanagi proposal, define the holographic entropy cone. We disprove a prior claim that all holographic constraints of this type are free of area law divergences (superbalanced). We analyze one explicit counterexample and explain how to easily find more; we report signatures of $\mathcal{O}(10^5)$ counterexamples. Our findings invalidate multiple prior claims and conjectures.

classification.title_zh: 并非所有全息熵不等式都免于面积律紫外发散
classification.abstract_zh: 在 AdS/CFT 对应中，对子系统熵的线性约束是 Ryu-Takayanagi 提案成立的必要条件，并定义了全息熵锥。本文否证了此前“所有此类全息约束均免于面积律发散（超平衡）”的主张，分析了一个明确反例并说明如何容易找到更多反例，报告了约 10^5 个反例的迹象；这些发现使多项先前主张和猜想失效。
classification.one_liner: 否证“所有全息熵不等式均为超平衡、无面积律紫外发散”的先前主张，并给出反例及大量反例迹象。

papers.title: Cosmic Censorship in the Landscape of SUSY-Broken AdS Vacua
papers.abstract: We investigate signatures of weak cosmic censorship in non-supersymmetric vacua of both IIA and IIB string theory. In particular, we examine the Penrose Inequality, which can be proven holographically using Ryu-Takayanagi, and can be independently proven in SUSY AdS vacua for spherically symmetric initial data. We prove that any EFT of scalars coupled to gravity in AdS, including in particular those of string compactifications, satisfies both the Penrose Inequality and a positive mass theorem if a function that we call a "weak fake superpotential" exists. We demonstrate that this condition is satisfied globally for the DGKT skew-whiffed vacua in IIA. Since there is no known nonperturbative instability in this DGKT vacuum, this provides evidence that the IIA SUSY-broken AdS vacua may be absolutely stable. We also find the weak fake superpotential exists locally in field space in some SUSY-broken AdS vacua in a KKLT construction in IIB. Thus, within the framework considered here, some false SUSY-broken KKLT AdS vacua are stable against vacuum decay. Conversely, we find that some KKLT vacua do not have a weak fake superpotential, and correspondingly violate the Penrose Inequality and fail to have a positive mass theorem; the DGKT vacua only violate the Penrose Inequality in the presence of designer gravity boundary conditions. In all cases studied, this is due to false vacuum decay. We discuss the implications of these violations for holography and black hole thermodynamics in these SUSY-broken AdS vacua.

classification.title_zh: 超对称破缺 AdS 真空景观中的宇宙监督
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 IIA 和 IIB 弦论非超对称真空中的弱宇宙监督迹象。特别检验 Penrose 不等式：它可用 Ryu-Takayanagi 全息证明，并在超对称 AdS 真空中对球对称初始数据独立证明。我们证明，若存在所谓“弱 fake 超势”，则任何 AdS 中标量耦合引力的 EFT（包括弦紧化）都满足 Penrose 不等式和正质量定理。我们证明 IIA 的 DGKT skew-whiffed 真空全局满足该条件。由于该 DGKT 真空没有已知非微扰不稳定性，这为 IIA 超对称破缺 AdS 真空可能绝对稳定提供证据。我们还在 IIB 的 KKLT 构造中某些超对称破缺 AdS 真空的场空间局部发现弱 fake 超势存在。因此，在所考虑框架内，一些假超对称破缺 KKLT AdS 真空对真空衰变稳定。相反，一些 KKLT 真空没有弱 fake 超势，相应违反 Penrose 不等式且不满足正质量定理；DGKT 真空仅在 designer gravity 边界条件下违反 Penrose 不等式。所有研究情形中，这都源于假真空衰变。我们讨论这些违反对这些超对称破缺 AdS 真空中全息术和黑洞热力学的含义。
classification.one_liner: 通过弱 fake 超势判据研究超对称破缺 AdS 真空中的 Penrose 不等式与宇宙监督，并将其与 DGKT/KKLT 真空稳定性和全息黑洞热力学联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及用户重点中的相变与气泡成核（假真空衰变）以及经典引力/宇宙监督，但不直接研究全息超流超导、p 波与多分量序参量、QNM 与非线性演化、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或 Floquet 驱动等主线；对全息黑洞热力学有间接关联。

papers.title: An infrared-safe $S$-matrix for $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills
papers.abstract: Scattering amplitudes of massless gauge theories are not observables: they are infrared divergent, and the standard regulators are tied either to perturbation theory or the planar limit. We study $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory on rigid AdS$_4$ with Dirichlet boundary conditions, where the role of the amplitude is played by correlation functions of boundary operators. These are finite, and they are defined at any coupling and for any gauge group. Among them, the four-point function of the flavor-current supermultiplet is the counterpart of the $2\to2$ amplitude of the elementary supergluon states, and arguably the simplest non-trivial observable of the theory. In this paper, we compute it at weak coupling to one loop. The tree-level correlator follows directly from the microscopic theory, and the one-loop correlator, which we obtain from AdS unitarity, takes a remarkably simple form in Mellin space. In the flat-space limit, it reproduces the one-loop scattering amplitude, with the infrared divergences re-emerging as logarithms.

classification.title_zh: N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论的红外安全 S 矩阵
classification.abstract_zh: 无质量规范理论的散射振幅不是可观测量：它们存在红外发散，而标准正规化方案要么依赖于微扰论，要么依赖于平面极限。我们研究在刚性 AdS4 上带 Dirichlet 边界条件的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论，其中振幅的角色由边界算符的关联函数承担。这些关联函数是有限的，并且对任意耦合和任意规范群都有定义。其中，味流超多重态的四点函数是基本超胶子态 2→2 振幅的对应物，也可谓该理论中最简单的非平凡可观测量。本文在弱耦合下将其计算到一圈。树-level 关联函数可直接由微观理论得到，而我们通过 AdS 幺正性得到的一圈关联函数在 Mellin 空间中形式非常简单。在平直空间极限下，它复现一圈散射振幅，红外发散以对数形式重新出现。
classification.one_liner: 该文用刚性 AdS4 上 N=4 超杨-米尔斯边界关联函数构造红外安全的振幅对应物，并计算味流超多重态四点函数至一圈。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与振幅/边界关联函数方向，与用户重点列出的全息凝聚态、相变、探针膜、QNM 或经典引力支线没有直接对应。

papers.title: Holographic Approaches to Hadron Structure
papers.abstract: We give an introduction to and an overview of holographic approaches to QCD and hadron structure. After an introduction to the string-theoretic foundations of holographic QCD, we review the predictions of top-down and bottom-up models for the phenomenology of mesons, baryons, and glueballs. We focus on the top-down model following from probe flavor branes in the Witten model of low-energy Yang-Mills theory and, in the more phenomenological approach of bottom-up models, mostly on minimal models based on five-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, which also implement global symmetries and their anomalies consistently, but allow the high-energy behavior to better match real QCD.

classification.title_zh: 强子结构的全息方法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文介绍并综述全息QCD与强子结构的方法。在介绍全息QCD的弦论基础后，我们回顾自上而下和自下而上模型对介子、重子和胶球现象的预言。重点讨论Witten低能Yang-Mills模型中探针味膜给出的自上而下模型，以及在现象学自下而上方法中主要基于五维反de Sitter空间的最小模型；这些模型一致地实现整体对称性及其反常，同时允许高能行为更好地匹配真实QCD。
classification.one_liner: 综述全息QCD中自上而下与自下而上模型对介子、重子和胶球强子结构的预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为全息QCD与强子结构综述，与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子及经典引力等具体支线不直接重合；仅同属全息方法。

papers.title: Challenging the hoop conjecture with spinning pancakes and baguettes
papers.abstract: Understanding when gravitational collapse produces a black hole remains a central challenge in general relativity. Black-hole uniqueness results characterize the stationary endpoint under suitable assumptions, while singularity theorems establish geodesic incompleteness in the presence of trapped surfaces and appropriate energy and global conditions. Neither, however, provides a general criterion for horizon formation. The hoop conjecture offers such a criterion by relating the enclosed mass to the compactness of a matter distribution in every direction. We construct axisymmetric families of initial data describing rotating dust and test a formulation of the conjecture adapted to this setting. We explore highly prolate and oblate configurations with both constant and differential rescaled angular-velocity profiles, including configurations near the threshold for apparent-horizon formation. We find that the conjecture holds for rotating configurations, with a coefficient within 14% of unity as in the nonrotating case, provided the quasilocal mass includes the rotational energy. If the irreducible mass of the apparent horizon is used instead, the deviations grow with spin, as they do for Kerr black holes. For horizonless configurations, the conjecture likewise holds when the mass is restricted to the energy enclosed by the matter surface, whereas using the ADM mass, which also includes rotational field energy outside the matter, leads to apparent violations of up to $\approx$25%. We also discuss the possible evolution of compact configurations without apparent horizons, their relation to weak cosmic censorship, and their implications for horizonless compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 用旋转薄饼和法棍挑战环箍猜想
classification.abstract_zh: 构建描述旋转尘埃的轴对称初始数据族，并检验适应此设置的环箍猜想表述。探索高度扁长和扁圆构型，采用恒定与微分重标角速度剖面，包括接近表观视界形成阈值的构型。发现若准局域质量包含转动能，猜想在系数偏离1不超过14%的范围内成立；若改用表观视界的不可约质量，偏差随自旋增长。对于无视界构型，当质量限制为物质面所包围的能量时猜想同样成立，而使用还包含物质外部转动场能的ADM质量会出现约25%的表观违反。还讨论了无表观视界致密构型的可能演化、其与弱宇宙监督的关系及对无视界致密天体的启示。
classification.one_liner: 在轴对称旋转尘埃初始数据中检验环箍猜想，表明质量定义（含转动能、不可约质量或ADM质量）决定偏差大小。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论中的引力坍缩、视界形成与环箍猜想，属于用户重点关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black holes from background subtraction
papers.abstract: The non-asymptotic flatness of the charged rotating black holes immersed in the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field causes the ambiguity in the gauge choice for the time generator and the electric potential. By using the newly established form of the integrability condition together with the gauge choice for the asymptotically flat charged rotating black holes as the initial condition, we have found that the gauge can be uniquely fixed. With this fixed gauge, we further obtain the mass and angular momentum by the background subtraction method with the Minkowski spacetime as the reference spacetime. As a result, not only is the first law of black hole thermodynamics as well as the quantum statistical relation automatically satisfied, but also both the Christodoulou-Ruffini relation and the Smarr formula are obeyed.

classification.title_zh: 背景减除法下 Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson 黑洞的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 浸没在 Bertotti-Robinson 磁场中的带电旋转黑洞不具有渐近平直性，这导致时间生成元与电势的规范选择存在歧义。利用新建立的积分条件形式，并以渐近平直带电旋转黑洞的规范选择作为初始条件，可以唯一固定规范。在此规范下，采用以 Minkowski 时空为参考时空的背景减除法，得到黑洞的质量和角动量。结果表明，黑洞热力学第一定律和量子统计关系自动满足，同时 Christodoulou-Ruffini 关系和 Smarr 公式也成立。
classification.one_liner: 用背景减除法固定 Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson 黑洞热力学中的规范，并验证第一定律、Smarr 公式与 Christodoulou-Ruffini 关系。

papers.title: Direct product geometries in $n$-dimensional linear and quadratic gravity
papers.abstract: Direct-product spacetimes offer a tractable route to exact solutions in gravity theories beyond general relativity. We study $n$-dimensional direct-product spacetimes of $(m_1+m_2)$, $(2+m)$, and $(2+\ldots+2)$ type in linear gravity and general pure quadratic-curvature gravity, allowing the two-dimensional subspaces to have nonconstant curvature. We classify the resulting solution spaces and determine how the allowed geometries depend on the gravitational theory, the dimension, and the curvature couplings. Metrics containing two-dimensional part(s) of nonconstant curvature are governed either by algebraic conditions on a curvature profile, or, in one special class of quadratic gravity, by a differential equation. Relations governing metrics with only constant-curvature $m$ dimensional subspaces are purely algebraic. We compare the two considered theories and study relations between their solution sets. We further examine conformal relations, generalized Petrov types, and compatibility with electromagnetic sources. Four- and six-dimensional cases are analyzed in detail, and so is the Weyl squared action (that reduces to Weyl conformal gravity in $n=4$), as a particular example of quadratic gravity couplings. Explicit analytic solutions illustrating the resulting structure are presented whenever possible.

classification.title_zh: n维线性引力与二次引力中的直积几何
classification.abstract_zh: 直积时空为研究广义相对论之外的引力理论中的精确解提供了一条可行途径。本文研究线性引力与一般纯二次曲率引力中 (m1+m2)、(2+m) 和 (2+…+2) 型 n 维直积时空，并允许二维子空间具有非常数曲率。我们分类所得的解空间，并确定允许的几何如何依赖于引力理论、维数和曲率耦合。包含非常数曲率二维部分的度规由曲率剖面的代数条件控制，或在二次引力的一个特殊类中由微分方程控制。仅含常数曲率 m 维子空间的度规之间的关系完全是代数的。我们比较所考虑的两种理论并研究其解集之间的关系。进一步考察共形关系、广义 Petrov 类型以及与电磁源的相容性。详细分析四维和六维情形，也分析作为二次引力耦合具体例子的 Weyl 平方作用量（在 n=4 时约化为 Weyl 共形引力）。在可能时给出说明所得结构的显式解析解。
classification.one_liner: 分类n维线性引力和纯二次曲率引力中直积时空的精确解及其对理论、维数与曲率耦合的依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/修改引力中的精确解研究，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Towards ultrarelativistic scattering near the light ring: asymptotic divergence of gravitational-wave fluxes
papers.abstract: Near the threshold between scattering and capture by a Schwarzschild black hole, a particle spends a long time close to an unstable circular orbit, which in the ultrarelativistic limit approaches the light ring. Here we study the behavior of the gravitational wave fluxes emitted by such an ultrarelativistic particle at first order in the mass ratio. The fluxes radiated to infinity and absorbed by the horizon diverge as the inverse distance from the light ring multiplied by its logarithm. Using the Wentzel, Kramers, and Brillouin (WKB) approximation to solve the Regge-Wheeler equation and treating the infinite harmonic sum analytically, we derive an exact expression for the coefficient of this logarithmic enhancement and show that it is identical for both fluxes. We then estimate the coefficients of the subleading pole contributions by combining numerical calculations at low multipoles with the exact asymptotics at large multipoles. We further conjecture an extension to equatorial circular orbits in Kerr. Interestingly, our results also inform the analytical structure of the energy and angular momentum losses of ultrarelativistic scattering orbits near the light ring. More broadly, our work illustrates how WKB methods can provide the asymptotic behavior of self-force observables in regimes where numerical mode sums become increasingly challenging.

classification.title_zh: 迈向光环附近的超相对论散射：引力波通量的渐近发散
classification.abstract_zh: 在史瓦西黑洞散射与捕获阈值附近，粒子会长时间停留在不稳定圆轨道附近，而超相对论极限下该轨道趋近光环。本文在一阶质量比下研究此类超相对论粒子发射的引力波通量，发现辐射至无穷远和被视界吸收的通量均按距光环距离的倒数乘以其对数发散。作者用 WKB 近似求解 Regge-Wheeler 方程并解析处理无限谐波求和，得到对数增强系数的精确表达式，并证明两种通量系数相同；随后结合低多极数值计算与大多的精确渐近估计次主导极点贡献，并猜测可推广到 Kerr 赤道圆轨道。结果还揭示光环附近超相对论散射轨道能量和角动量损失的解析结构，说明 WKB 方法可用于数值模式求和困难的区域中的自力观测量渐近行为。
classification.one_liner: 用 WKB 解析史瓦西光环附近超相对论散射的引力波通量对数发散及自力渐近。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞扰动、引力波和自力计算，契合经典引力支线；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Analytic parity-violating greybody factors of a dynamical Chern-Simons black hole
papers.abstract: We study the low-frequency scattering of gravitational and pseudoscalar waves off a non-rotating black hole in dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity, where the axial (odd-parity) gravitational sector is irreducibly coupled to the dynamical pseudoscalar while the polar sector remains general relativistic. Working to first order in the dimensionless coupling zeta = (l_CS/M)^4 and using matched asymptotic expansions, we obtain, for the quadrupole (l=2) channel, an exact closed form for the graviton-to-pseudoscalar conversion probability and a high-precision analytic reconstruction of the absorption (greybody) asymmetry. Both reduce to combinations of pi^4, pi^2, and rational numbers, with no ln2 or odd-zeta terms in the reconstructed basis; the transmission-phase sector, by contrast, is governed by an analytically derived static integral involving Apery's constant zeta(3), with its matching prefactor identified numerically. The parity-violating reflection-phase asymmetry is strongly suppressed at low frequency -- well below the parity-even general-relativistic reflection phase -- so that any polarization rotation imprinted on the reflected wave is negligible, while a subleading O(omega*zeta) asymmetry remains in the transmitted phase. These effects are intrinsically strong-field and low-frequency: the normalized flux asymmetries are consistent with a 1/(M*omega)^2 falloff in the geometric-optics limit, where the leading remaining flux effect is conversion loss. The matched-asymptotic results are checked against direct two-channel integration, and the integral determining the absorption asymmetry is evaluated to high precision within an analytically controlled transcendental basis. The coefficients provide analytic targets linking dCS parity violation in absorption and mode conversion to the axial/polar quasinormal-mode splitting.

classification.title_zh: 动态 Chern-Simons 黑洞的解析宇称破坏灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究非旋转动态 Chern-Simons（dCS）黑洞对引力波与赝标量波的低频散射。在该理论中，轴矢（奇宇称）引力扇区与动态赝标量不可约耦合，而极向扇区仍为广义相对论。作者在无量纲耦合 zeta=(l_CS/M)^4 的一阶近似下，使用匹配渐近展开，对四极（l=2）通道给出引力子到赝标量转换概率的精确闭式，以及对吸收（灰体）不对称性的高精度解析重构；这些结果化为 pi^4、pi^2 与有理数的组合，重构基底中无 ln2 或奇 zeta 项。透射相位扇区则由一个包含 Apéry 常数 zeta(3) 的解析静态积分控制，其匹配前因子由数值确定。低频下宇称破坏的反射相位不对称性受到强烈压低，远低于宇称偶的广义相对论反射相位，因此反射波上印记的偏振旋转可忽略；透射相位中仍保留 O(omega*zeta) 的次领头不对称性。这些效应本质上是强场低频效应：归一化通量不对称性在几何光学极限下与 1/(M*omega)^2 衰减一致，此时剩余领头通量效应是转换损失。匹配渐近结果与直接双通道积分核对，并且决定吸收不对称性的积分在解析可控的超越数基底内被高精度计算。所得系数为将 dCS 吸收与模式转换中的宇称破坏联系到轴矢/极向准正规模分裂提供了解析目标。
classification.one_liner: 在动态 Chern-Simons 引力中解析计算低频引力波与赝标量散射的宇称破坏灰体因子、模式转换及与准正规模分裂的联系。

papers.title: Black Holes and Scalar Propagation in Three-Dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet Gravity
papers.abstract: We derive an analytic black-hole family in three-dimensional scalar--tensor Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling. A single implicit equation determines the static circular metric and a scalar linear in time. We show that these solutions exhaust regular nonextremal exteriors with the stated AdS boundary conditions and a fixed nonzero coefficient of time in the scalar. The coupled metric and scalar perturbations have one propagating degree of freedom. On one branch, its kinetic coefficient is positive, its equation is hyperbolic throughout the exterior, and its bulk spatial energy is positive for perturbations of compact support. Scalar signals can cross the metric horizon outward, so exterior evolution needs information from the interior. For linear perturbations with the original metric and scalar boundary values fixed, nonzero compact initial master displacements with zero velocity can evolve only until their first contact with the AdS boundary. We derive this restriction from the original metric and scalar equations.

classification.title_zh: 三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的黑洞与标量传播
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了正耦合下三维标量--张量 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的一个解析黑洞族。单个隐式方程决定静态圆对称度规，标量随时间线性变化。我们证明，在给定 AdS 边界条件和固定的非零标量时间系数下，这些解穷尽了正则非极端外部解。耦合的度规与标量扰动具有一个传播自由度。在其中一支上，其动能系数为正，方程在整个外部区域为双曲型，且紧支撑扰动的体空间能量为正。标量信号可以向外穿过度规视界，因此外部演化需要来自内部的信息。对于原始度规和标量边界值固定的线性扰动，非零紧支撑初始主位移且速度为零时，只能演化到首次接触 AdS 边界为止。我们从原始度规和标量方程导出这一限制。
classification.one_liner: 在三维标量--张量 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中构造解析黑洞族，并分析耦合度规--标量线性扰动的双曲性、能量正定性及 AdS 边界下的初值限制。

papers.title: Charged Klein--Gordon modes on an Ellis wormhole: magnetic confinement and conditional Heun-polynomial solvability
papers.abstract: We study a charged Klein--Gordon field on the complete $(2+1)$-dimensional Ellis wormhole, coupled to the pullback of a uniform ambient magnetic field. The induced gauge potential is regular, whereas the intrinsic magnetic pseudoscalar reverses sign across the throat. For $\alpha_B>0$, the radial operator is unitarily equivalent to a self-adjoint one-dimensional Schr\"odinger operator with a smooth confining potential and discrete spectrum. The radial equation is reduced to confluent-Heun form, and polynomial solvability is shown to require two independent termination conditions. These conditions yield degree-zero Gaussian modes, degree-one states of both global parities, and representative degree-two even states. Exact Ellis-measure normalization is obtained for the degree-zero and degree-one modes. An independent fourth-order full-line finite-difference calculation validates the analytic benchmarks and determines the first eight eigenvalues and their parities. In the double-well regime, the forbidden-region action determines the leading semiclassical exponential of the even--odd level splitting.

classification.title_zh: Ellis 虫洞上的带电 Klein–Gordon 模：磁约束与条件性 Heun 多项式可解性
classification.abstract_zh: 研究完整 (2+1) 维 Ellis 虫洞上的带电 Klein–Gordon 场，并与均匀环境磁场的拉回耦合。诱导规范势保持正则，而内禀磁赝标量在喉部两侧反号。对 α_B>0，径向算符幺正等价于一维自伴 Schrödinger 算符，具有光滑约束势和离散谱。径向方程化为合流 Heun 形式，并证明多项式可解性需要两个独立终止条件。这些条件给出零阶高斯模、一阶的两种全局宇称态以及代表性的二阶偶宇称态。对零阶和一阶模得到精确的 Ellis 测度归一化。独立的四阶全线有限差分计算验证了解析基准，并确定了前八个本征值及其宇称。在双阱区域，禁闭区作用量决定偶—奇能级劈裂的主导半经典指数。
classification.one_liner: 在 (2+1) 维 Ellis 虫洞上分析带电 Klein–Gordon 场的磁约束谱、合流 Heun 多项式可解条件，并用有限差分给出低能本征值与宇称劈裂。

papers.title: Stationary Rotating Geometries Associated with Nonsingular Pulsating Collapse
papers.abstract: Since the first exact solutions of General Relativity (GR) were obtained, it became clear that the theory predicts a new class of compact objects: black holes. The Hawking--Penrose singularity theorems show that, under appropriate assumptions, gravitational collapse in GR leads to singular behavior. Motivated by the expectation that such regimes require physics beyond classical GR, effective approaches inspired by Loop Quantum Cosmology (LQC) and braneworld scenarios introduce high-density corrections. In this work we consider the static exterior geometry introduced by Gao, Lu, Shen, and Faraoni, associated with a comoving interior model in which the singularity is avoided through a sequence of collapse and bounce phases. Using the Newman--Janis algorithm in the Azreg-A\"inou formulation, we construct a stationary rotating exterior extension of this geometry. The resulting line element describes a stationary axisymmetric rotating spacetime whose horizon geometry, angular velocity, surface gravity, and Hawking temperature recover the Kerr and Schwarzschild limits when the quantum/braneworld correction becomes negligible ($l\to 0$). We further analyze the thermal response at fixed rotational state-space parameter, identify Davies-type singular points, and formulate an extended thermodynamic state-space relation.

classification.title_zh: 与无奇点脉动坍缩相关的稳态旋转几何
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论最初精确解表明黑洞是一类致密天体，而 Hawking–Penrose 奇点定理表明在适当假设下引力坍缩会导致奇点。受此类区域需要超越经典广义相对论物理的预期驱动，Loop Quantum Cosmology 和 braneworld 场景启发的有效方法引入高密度修正。本文考虑 Gao、Lu、Shen 和 Faraoni 提出的静态外部几何，该几何联系一个共动内部模型，其中奇点通过一系列坍缩和反弹阶段被避免。利用 Azreg-Aïnou 表述下的 Newman–Janis 算法，我们构造该几何的稳态旋转外部延拓。所得线元描述一个稳态轴对称旋转时空，其视界几何、角速度、表面引力和 Hawking 温度在量子/braneworld 修正可忽略（l→0）时回到 Kerr 和 Schwarzschild 极限。我们进一步分析固定旋转状态空间参数下的热响应，识别 Davies 型奇点，并建立扩展的热力学状态空间关系。
classification.one_liner: 用 Newman–Janis 算法为无奇点脉动坍缩的静态外部几何构造稳态旋转延拓，并分析其视界、热力学与 Davies 型奇点。

papers.title: Fragility of stealth solutions in mimetic gravity
papers.abstract: We study a broad class of constrained mimetic-type extensions of general relativity with action $S=\int{\rm d}^4x\sqrt{-g}\,\bigl(R/2+\lambda\,C[g,\Psi]+{\cal L}_{\rm m}\bigr)$, where $R$ is the Ricci scalar, $\lambda$ is a Lagrange multiplier, $C[g,\Psi]$ is a scalar functional of the metric and generic field content $\Psi$ (possibly involving $\Psi$ and its covariant derivatives) and ${\cal L}_{\rm m}$ is the matter Lagrangian. On the branch $\bar{\lambda}=0$, with the bar denoting a background value, the constrained sector drops out of the background dynamics, so, on domains where a background profile $\bar\Psi$ satisfying $\bar C=0$ exists, the theory admits the corresponding general relativity geometries as stealth solutions. As an explicit illustration, we consider the scalar field case, where $C=g^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\phi\partial_\nu\phi\pm1=0$ becomes a Hamilton-Jacobi equation selecting geodesic congruences. In this setting, we discuss spherically symmetric and rotating stealth profiles using Carter separability. We then analyze perturbations at the general level. The quadratic terms weighted by $\bar\lambda$ vanish on the stealth branch, while the nonlinear constraint still holds order by order and nonlinear interactions need not vanish. Consequently, reproducing GR at the background level does not ensure a uniform $\bar\lambda\to0$ limit for perturbations, and strong coupling may arise.

classification.title_zh: mimetic 引力中 stealth 解的脆弱性
classification.abstract_zh: 研究一类受约束的 mimetic 型广义相对论扩展，其作用量为 S=∫d^4x√-g(R/2+λ C[g,Ψ]+L_m)，其中 λ 为拉格朗日乘子，C[g,Ψ] 是度规与一般场内容 Ψ（可能含 Ψ 及其协变导数）的标量泛函。在背景值 λ̄=0 的分支上，约束部分从背景动力学中消失；因此在存在满足 C̄=0 的背景 profile Ψ̄ 的区域，该理论允许相应的广义相对论几何作为 stealth 解。作为显式例子，考虑标量场情形，C=g^{μν}∂_μϕ∂_νϕ±1=0 成为选择测地线汇的 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程。在此设置下，利用 Carter 可分离性讨论球对称与旋转 stealth profile。随后在一般层面分析扰动：以 λ̄ 加权的二次项在 stealth 分支上消失，而非线性约束仍逐阶成立，非线性相互作用不一定消失。因此，在背景层面重现 GR 并不保证扰动具有均匀的 λ̄→0 极限，可能出现强耦合。
classification.one_liner: 受约束 mimetic 引力的 stealth 分支可在背景层面重现 GR，但扰动极限可能不均匀并导致强耦合。

papers.title: Constraints on regular black holes with nonminimally coupled electromagnetic fields
papers.abstract: Construction of physically realistic theories admitting regular black hole solutions remains an important open problem in gravitational physics. While theories with electromagnetic fields minimally coupled to gravity have been extensively studied over the past two decades, theories with nonminimal couplings remain comparatively unexplored. We investigate theories containing the interaction terms $R F_{ab}F^{ab}$, $R_{ab} F^a_{\ \, c} \, F^{bc}$ and $R_{abcd} F^{ab} F^{cd}$, which generically arise in low-energy effective Lagrangians. We prove that magnetically charged regular black holes are excluded, except possibly for a special choice of coupling constants, and argue that a similar conclusion applies to electrically charged regular black holes. We further show that similar conclusions hold for Lagrangian terms of the form $f(R,F_{ab}{\star F}^{ab})$.

classification.title_zh: 非最小耦合电磁场正则黑洞的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 构造物理上可实现且允许正则黑洞解的理论仍是引力物理中的重要开放问题。过去二十年，电磁场与引力最小耦合的理论已被广泛研究，而非最小耦合理论相对较少探索。我们研究包含相互作用项 $R F_{ab}F^{ab}$、$R_{ab} F^a_{\ \, c} F^{bc}$ 和 $R_{abcd} F^{ab} F^{cd}$ 的理论，这些项通常出现在低能有效拉格朗日量中。我们证明磁荷正则黑洞被排除，除非耦合常数取特殊选择；并论证类似结论适用于电荷正则黑洞。进一步表明，对形如 $f(R,F_{ab}{\star F}^{ab})$ 的拉格朗日项也有类似结论。
classification.one_liner: 证明非最小耦合电磁场项通常排除磁荷（并可能排除电荷）正则黑洞解，除非耦合常数特殊。

papers.title: The symplectic geometry of the black hole photon shell
papers.abstract: The unstably bound, critical null geodesics of the Kerr spacetime form a distinguished class of orbits whose properties govern observables such as the photon ring and the high-frequency component of black-hole ringdown. This set of orbits defines a codimension-two submanifold of the null-geodesic phase space known as the photon shell. In this work we investigate the photon shell's intrinsic symplectic geometry. Using the induced symplectic form, we construct the canonical volume form on the shell and compute the differential phase-space volume it encloses as a function of radius -- equivalently, the radial density of states. In the near-extremal limit the photon shell bifurcates into near-horizon and far-region components; we find that approximately $3\%$ of the shell's phase-space volume resides in the near-horizon component. We also analyze a thickening of the photon shell that includes near-critical orbits, and compute its differential phase-space volume. Beyond their intrinsic theoretical interest, these results may inform the interpretation of high-resolution observations of spinning black holes.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞光子壳的辛几何
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr时空中不稳定束缚的临界零测地线构成一类特殊轨道，其性质决定光子环以及黑洞铃宕的高频成分。这些轨道定义了零测地线相空间中的余维二子流形，即光子壳。本文研究光子壳的内禀辛几何，利用诱导辛形式构造壳上的典范体积形式，并计算其作为半径函数所围的微分相空间体积，等价于径向态密度。在近极端极限下，光子壳分叉为近视界和远区两部分；我们发现约3%的壳相空间体积位于近视界部分。我们还分析了包含近临界轨道的加厚光子壳并计算其微分相空间体积。除内在理论兴趣外，这些结果可能有助于解释旋转黑洞的高分辨率观测。
classification.one_liner: 研究Kerr黑洞光子壳的诱导辛形式、相空间体积与近极端分叉，并讨论其对光子环/铃宕观测的潜在意义。

papers.title: Bound States of Two D0-Branes and the Three-Graviton Coupling
papers.abstract: We numerically solve for the ground state of the $SU(2)$ BFSS matrix model for M-theory. This state corresponds to the zero-energy bound state of two D0-branes or, by the BFSS conjecture, to the eleven-dimensional graviton with two units of momentum along the M-theory circle. The wavefunction exhibits a strongly coupled core, as well as an asymptotic power-law tail where the D0-branes are well separated. The coefficient of this power-law decay is the three-graviton coupling, previously computed by Herderschee and Maldacena, which our numerical solution reproduces with high accuracy. We also show that this coupling is protected by supersymmetry in the matrix model, and derive its value from the non-renormalized one-loop interaction of the two D0-branes. Lastly, we provide a simple representation-theoretic argument regarding the recently proposed excited bound states of the model.

classification.title_zh: 两个 D0-膜的结合态与三引力子耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们数值求解了 M 理论 SU(2) BFSS 矩阵模型的基态。该态对应两个 D0-膜的零能束缚态，或依 BFSS 猜想对应沿 M 理论圆具有两单位动量的十一维引力子。波函数具有强耦合核心以及 D0-膜彼此远离时的渐近幂律尾。该幂律衰减系数即三引力子耦合，此前由 Herderschee 和 Maldacena 计算，我们的数值解高精度重现了它。我们还表明该耦合在矩阵模型中受超对称保护，并从两个 D0-膜的非重整化单圈相互作用导出其数值。最后，我们对模型近期提出的激发束缚态给出一个简单的表示论论证。
classification.one_liner: 数值求解 SU(2) BFSS 矩阵模型基态并高精度重现三引力子耦合，论证其受超对称保护。

papers.title: Holographic dual of the 2d Ising model
papers.abstract: We propose a holographic dual of the 2d Ising model on a torus as the Turaev-Viro TQFT on a solid torus. The bulk spacetime is divided into the ``core'' region and the ``sandwich'' region. The core region prepares a defect state $|\mathcal{D}\rangle$ on the topological boundary $\mathbb{D}$. The sandwich region computes the Turaev-Viro state sum $\langle\mathcal{D}|\Pi|\mathcal{F}\rangle$ between the state $|\mathcal{D}\rangle$ on $\mathbb{D}$ and the state $|\mathcal{F}\rangle$ on the physical boundary $\mathbb{B}$. The fusion diagram (or string-net) $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathbb{B}$ is given by the Aasen-Fendley-Mong construction. There is also a ``bedding surface'' $\mathbb{S}$ between $\mathbb{D}$ and $\mathbb{B}$, and the height variables (or Ising spins inside/outside of the domain wall) are naturally living on $\mathbb{S}$. The bulk spacetime is discretized by the 2-skeleton $P$ which interpolates $\mathcal{D}$ and $\mathcal{F}$. When the defect $\mathcal{D}$ is absent, the 2-skeleton $P$ ends on the bedding surface $\mathbb{S}$ and $P$ is interpreted as the bulk worldsheet of the string-net $\mathcal{F}$.

classification.title_zh: 二维 Ising 模型的全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出将环面上的二维 Ising 模型全息对偶为实心环面上的 Turaev-Viro 拓扑量子场论。体时空被分为“核心”区域和“三明治”区域。核心区域在拓扑边界 D 上制备一个缺陷态 |D>。三明治区域计算拓扑边界 D 上的态 |D> 与物理边界 B 上的态 |F> 之间的 Turaev-Viro 态求和 <D|Π|F>。物理边界 B 上的融合图（或 string-net）F 由 Aasen-Fendley-Mong 构造给出。D 与 B 之间还有一个“铺陈面”S，高度变量（即畴壁内/外的 Ising 自旋）自然生活在 S 上。体时空由插值 D 与 F 的 2-骨架 P 离散化。当缺陷 D 不存在时，2-骨架 P 终止于铺陈面 S，并且 P 可解释为 string-net F 的体世界面。

papers.title: Holographic two-point functions across a PT symmetry-breaking transition
papers.abstract: In parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian systems, an exceptional point, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, typically separates a real spectrum from complex-conjugate eigenvalues. In logarithmic conformal field theories (LCFTs), such an exceptional point appears in the spectrum of scaling dimensions. Holographic models of LCFTs, such as the dipole model, are built exactly at this point. Here, we deform the holographic dipole model so that its two coalescing scaling dimensions split into either two real ones or a complex-conjugate pair. We obtain the renormalized two-point functions in closed form. They change continuously from a linear combination of two power laws, through the logarithmic form of the LCFT at the exceptional point, to log-periodic oscillations. For any pair of scalar primary operators with real mixing under dilatations, the conformal Ward identities fix this form up to two normalization constants, which the holographic dictionary determines. In PT-symmetric theories with such a dilatation operator, real and complex-conjugate scaling dimensions correspond to the PT-unbroken and PT-broken phases. In the BTZ black hole at finite temperature, the difference between the quasinormal frequencies associated with the two scaling dimensions changes from purely imaginary to purely real across the real-to-complex spectral transition. Correspondingly, the linear response changes from overdamped to underdamped, with critical damping at the exceptional point. Direct experimental observation of the two-point functions across the exceptional point could be achieved in two hyperbolic electric circuits with a non-reciprocal coupling, through the voltage response between their edge nodes.

classification.title_zh: 穿过 PT 对称破缺相变的全息两点函数
classification.abstract_zh: 在宇称-时间（PT）对称的非厄米系统中，异常点（本征值和本征矢合并）通常将实谱与复共轭本征值分开。在对数共形场论（LCFT）中，这种异常点出现在标度维谱中。LCFT 的全息模型（如偶极模型）正建立在此点。这里，我们变形全息偶极模型，使其两个合并的标度维分裂为两个实标度维或一对复共轭标度维。我们以闭合形式得到重整化两点函数。它们从两个幂律的线性组合，经过异常点处 LCFT 的对数形式，连续变为对数周期振荡。对于任意一对在膨胀下具有实混合的标量主算子，共形 Ward 恒等式将此形式固定到两个归一化常数，而全息字典确定这两个常数。在此类具有这种膨胀算子的 PT 对称理论中，实标度维和复共轭标度维分别对应 PT 未破缺相和 PT 破缺相。在有限温度 BTZ 黑洞中，与两个标度维相关的准正频率之差在实到复谱跃迁中从纯虚变为纯实。相应地，线性响应从过阻尼变为欠阻尼，在异常点处为临界阻尼。通过在两个具有非互易耦合的双曲电路中测量边缘节点之间的电压响应，可以直接实验观测穿过异常点的两点函数。
classification.one_liner: 通过形变全息偶极模型，展示 PT/LCFT 异常点两侧两点函数的连续演化，以及 BTZ 准正频率和线性响应从过阻尼到欠阻尼的转变。
