papers.title: From Critical Zero Modes to Interior Dynamics in Holographic Superconductors
papers.abstract: We study how the critical behavior of holographic superconductors controls the interior geometry of charged black holes. Although the exterior condensate vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode develops logarithmic oscillations near the Reissner--Nordstr\"om Cauchy horizon, rendering the interior critical limit nonuniform. We show that the transmitted critical-mode amplitude, together with local Cauchy-horizon quantities, fixes both the leading Einstein--Rosen collapse $\Delta z_{\rm ER}$ width and the phase $\Theta_J$ in the subsequent Josephson regime. If the condensate obeys $t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\epsilon^{2r}$, then $\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ and $\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$. This Josephson phase is transferred to the first Kasner epoch, producing oscillatory Kasner exponents and an accumulation law $t_n\sim n^{-r}$ for successive zeros of the scalar velocity. The critical zero mode fixes the leading collapse and phase coefficients, which are quantitatively confirmed by fully nonlinear solutions in both the ordinary and tricritical cases. At low temperature, the interior instead depends on the infrared completion of the zero-temperature geometry. Thus near-critical scaling is governed by critical-mode transmission, whereas the low-temperature behavior is controlled by the infrared endpoint.

classification.title_zh: 全息超导体中从临界零模到内部动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究全息超导体的临界行为如何控制带电黑洞的内部几何。尽管在临界点外部凝聚消失，临界零模在 Reissner–Nordström 柯西视界附近产生对数振荡，使内部临界极限非一致。我们表明，透射的临界模振幅与局部柯西视界量共同确定主导的 Einstein–Rosen 坍缩宽度 Δz_ER 以及后续 Josephson 区中的相位 Θ_J。若凝聚满足 t≡1−T/T_c∝ε^{2r}，则 Δz_ER∝t^{1/r} 且 Θ_J∝t^{-1/r}。该 Josephson 相位传递到第一个 Kasner 历元，产生振荡的 Kasner 指数，并给出标量速度相继零点的累积规律 t_n∼n^{-r}。临界零模确定主导坍缩与相位系数，这些系数由普通和三临界情形下的完全非线性解定量证实。在低温下，内部反而依赖于零温几何的红外完成。因此，近临界标度由临界模透射支配，而低温行为由红外端点控制。
classification.one_liner: 全息超导临界零模的透射决定带电黑洞内部 Einstein–Rosen 坍缩与 Kasner/Josephson 振荡，低温则由红外几何控制。

papers.title: Reduction technique for expanding the Feynman diagrams in AdS$_2$
papers.abstract: We formulate the reduction technique for expanding the $n$-point AdS Feynman diagrams in two dimensions into the Wilson line networks. The technique applies to any $n$-point tree diagram, expressing it as several series of the matrix elements of Wilson line network operators, and employs the Wilson network expansions of the $(n-1)$-point AdS$_2$ Feynman diagrams, which can in turn be obtained using the same technique. Consequently, the complexity of this technique does not increase with $n$, provided that the expansions of the $(n-1)$-point diagrams are known. To demonstrate the reduction technique, we apply it to all topologically distinct five-point AdS$_2$ Feynman tree diagrams. The resulting expansions near the conformal boundary reproduce the known decompositions of the corresponding five-point Witten diagrams into conformal blocks.

classification.title_zh: 用于展开 AdS2 中费曼图的约化技术
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种约化技术，用于将二维 AdS 中的 n 点费曼图展开为 Wilson 线网络。该技术适用于任意 n 点树图，将其表示为若干 Wilson 线网络算符矩阵元素的级数，并利用 (n-1) 点 AdS2 费曼图的 Wilson 网络展开；这些展开又可由同一技术递归得到。因此，在已知 (n-1) 点图展开的情况下，该技术的复杂度不随 n 增加。为展示该技术，我们将其应用于所有拓扑不同的五点 AdS2 费曼树图。所得在共形边界附近的展开重现了相应五点 Witten 图到共形块的已知分解。
classification.one_liner: 提出递归约化方法，将 AdS2 树级费曼图展开为 Wilson 线网络并复现五点 Witten 图的共形块分解。

papers.title: Stress Tensor Deformations in dS/CFT: Mixed Boundary Conditions, Spectrum Flow and Pseudo Entropy
papers.abstract: We formulate a local semiclassical source--response prescription for derivative-free stress-tensor deformations in dS/CFT. The metric flow determines the deformed boundary metric and stress tensor, encoding the deformation through mixed boundary conditions at future infinity. In Kerr-dS$_3$/CFT$_2$, the holographic charges reproduce the field-theory spectral flow, providing an internal consistency check. For general deformations in this class, we derive a holographic pseudo-entropy formula in terms of the flowed boundary data, nonperturbative in the deformation parameters within a specified complex-geodesic prescription. We evaluate this formula explicitly for the $T\bar{T}$ and root-$T\bar{T}$ deformations. On the non-rotating principal branch, an analytically continued replica calculation reproduces the interval-dependent corrections at first order in the couplings and leading semiclassical order. Agreement of the interval-independent terms additionally requires a source-frame regulator identification.

classification.title_zh: dS/CFT中的应力张量形变：混合边界条件、谱流与赝熵
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为dS/CFT中无导数应力张量形变建立局域半经典源-响应方案。度规流决定形变后的边界度规与应力张量，并通过未来无穷远处的混合边界条件编码形变。在Kerr-dS3/CFT2中，全息荷复现场论谱流，作为内部一致性检验。对于此类一般形变，作者在指定复测地线方案下给出用流化边界数据表示的全息赝熵公式，该公式在形变参数上非微扰。作者对T\bar{T}与root-T\bar{T}形变显式求值该公式；在非旋转主支上，解析延拓的replica计算在一阶耦合与领头半经典阶复现区间依赖修正，而区间无关项还需源框架调节器识别。
classification.one_liner: 在dS/CFT中建立应力张量形变的源-响应框架，并用Kerr-dS3/CFT2谱流与T\bar{T}形变赝熵计算检验。

papers.title: Filtering out Erratic Observables: Wormholes from Gauging Nonlocal Symmetries
papers.abstract: The wormhole contribution to the gravitational path integral may be interpreted as smooth remnant of correlations among the erratic large-$N$ behaviors of dual CFTs. In this work, we investigate this idea in (2+1)-dimensional gravity. We show that one-sided boundary gravitons are intrinsically incomplete in the sense that the associated observable algebra has a nontrivial center regardless of choices of boundary conditions. Based on asymptotic symmetries, we bootstrap a general Poisson bracket to construct completions of the boundary gravitons. In the simplest completion, the commutant of the boundary graviton observable algebra is given by an observable algebra of monodromy data which we interpret as an effective description of one-sided black holes. We show that, to describe Lorentzian multi-boundary wormholes, only the monodromy data with a positivity restriction is needed. The positivity restriction results in emergent erratic large-$N$ behaviors for some observables. We filter out the erratic observables by restricting to a subspace on which they act trivially. The monodromy observables generate nonlocal symmetries lack of corresponding local currents. We show that gauging the nonlocal symmetries is equivalent to filtering out the erratic observables. For one CFT, gauging the nonlocal symmetries at the quantum level removes all black hole states. Filtering the partition function of CFTs leads to an apparent ensemble averaging. For two CFTs, a Hilbert subspace describing wormholes survives after gauging global part of the nonlocal symmetries. The filtered partition function of the two CFTs is an ensemble average over quantum gates entangling the monodromy degrees of freedom of the two CFTs. The correlation between the erratic observables of the two CFTs is preserved, which contributes to the filtered partition function as a wormhole term.

classification.title_zh: 滤除不规则可观测量：通过规范化非局域对称性得到虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 引力路径积分中的虫洞贡献可被解释为对偶 CFT 中不规则大 N 行为之间关联的平滑残存。本文在 (2+1) 维引力中研究这一想法。我们证明单侧边界引力子本质上不完备：无论边界条件如何选择，相关可观测量代数都有非平凡中心。基于渐近对称性，我们 bootstrap 一个一般泊松括号来构造边界引力子的完备化。在最简单的完备化中，边界引力子可观测量代数的中心化子由单值性数据可观测量代数给出，我们将其解释为单侧黑洞的有效描述。我们证明，要描述洛伦兹多边界虫洞，只需要带正性限制的单值性数据。正性限制导致某些可观测量出现涌现的不规则大 N 行为。我们通过限制到这些可观测量平凡作用的子空间来滤除不规则可观测量。单值性可观测量生成缺乏对应局域流的非局域对称性。我们证明规范化这些非局域对称性等价于滤除不规则可观测量。对一个 CFT，在量子层面规范化非局域对称性会移除所有黑洞态。过滤 CFT 配分函数导致表观系综平均。对两个 CFT，在规范化非局域对称性的整体部分后，一个描述虫洞的 Hilbert 子空间存活。两个 CFT 的过滤配分函数是对纠缠两个 CFT 单值性自由度的量子门的系综平均。两个 CFT 的不规则可观测量之间的关联被保留，并作为虫洞项贡献到过滤配分函数。
classification.one_liner: 在 (2+1) 维引力中，规范化边界引力子完备化所生成的非局域单值性对称性等价于滤除不规则大 N 可观测量，并决定虫洞贡献是否保留。

papers.title: A gravity interpretation for the complex saddles of the ABJM and spindle indices
papers.abstract: The superconformal index is a grand-canonical partition function that counts the 1/16-BPS states in the theory, and its Legendre transform with respect to reduced chemical potentials accounts for the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of electrically charged rotating black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime. However, the superconformal index of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory appears to allow shifts in chemical potentials, and the contributions of the shifted terms diverge exponentially. We resolved this puzzle by showing the instability of wrapped D3-branes corresponding to shifts in the gravitational on-shell action. Analogously, we study the M5-brane instability criterion of the ABJM index and the spindle index.

papers.title: Entanglement inequalities for timelike intervals within dynamical holography
papers.abstract: This paper extends our previous work (arXiv:2504.14313) of a single timelike subregion to two, in the framework of AdS$_3$-Vaidya holography. We confirm the positivity of timelike mutual information and the statement of weak monotonicity when the subregions are non-overlapping. We also study entanglement inequalities such as Araki-Lieb inequality and strong subadditivity when the intervals start to overlap. In line with the recent findings in the literature, we provide explicit working examples showing that the timelike version of the strong subadditivity is generally violated in these setups, even though the statements of subadditivity and Araki-Lieb inequality hold true.

classification.title_zh: 动力学全息中类时间隔的纠缠不等式
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 AdS3-Vaidya 全息框架下，将作者此前关于单个类时子区的工作推广到两个类时子区。对于不重叠子区，确认了类时互信息的正性以及弱单调性；对于开始重叠的区间，研究了 Araki-Lieb 不等式和强次可加性等纠缠不等式。与近期文献结果一致，作者给出明确例子表明，在这些设置中类时版本的强次可加性通常被违反，而次可加性和 Araki-Lieb 不等式仍然成立。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3-Vaidya 全息中研究两个类时子区的纠缠不等式，发现类时强次可加性通常被违反，而次可加性与 Araki-Lieb 不等式成立。

papers.title: Effective Field Theory for Superconducting Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Employing the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we formulate an effective field theory for s-wave superconducting phase transition, where the dynamical variables consist of electromagnetic gauge field and complex scalar order parameter. Symmetry-constrained effective action allows systematic handling of dissipations and fluctuations. In particular, we explore the physical implications of higher-order terms, including those involving additional dynamical fields as well as higher time derivatives, on the real-time dynamics near the superconducting critical point. When appropriately truncated, the effective field theory reproduces the phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau equations. Upon crossing the critical temperature into the low-temperature phase, the electromagnetic gauge symmetry undergoes spontaneous breaking induced by the condensate of the order parameter. Collective excitation analysis reveals that the Higgs mode behaves as an overdamped diffusive mode near the critical point, while the phase fluctuation is absorbed into the gauge field via the Higgs mechanism. For complex kinetic coefficients, we derive the coupled linearized equations for amplitude, phase, and longitudinal gauge fluctuations, and distinguish propagation from damping through their complex poles. The holographic Schwinger-Keldysh construction provides an explicit realization and a nontrivial consistency check of the effective action, and determines its Wilsonian coefficients within a specific strongly coupled model. Holographic results reveal a complex relaxation parameter that indicates oscillatory dynamics characteristic of strongly coupled systems.

classification.title_zh: 超导相变的有效场论
classification.abstract_zh: 利用Schwinger-Keldysh形式，我们构建了s波超导相变的有效场论，其动力学变量由电磁规范场和复标量序参量组成。受对称性约束的有效作用量允许系统处理耗散和涨落。特别地，我们探讨了高阶项（包括涉及额外动力学场以及更高时间导数的项）对超导临界点附近实时动力学的影响。适当截断后，该有效场论可重现唯象的Ginzburg-Landau方程。当跨过临界温度进入低温相时，序参量凝聚诱导电磁规范对称性自发破缺。集体激发分析表明，Higgs模在临界点附近表现为过阻尼扩散模，而相位涨落通过Higgs机制被规范场吸收。对于复动力学系数，我们导出了振幅、相位和纵向规范涨落的耦合线性化方程，并通过复极点区分传播与阻尼。全息Schwinger-Keldysh构造提供了有效作用量的显式实现和非平凡一致性检验，并在特定强耦合模型中确定其Wilson系数。全息结果表明存在一个复弛豫参数，指示强耦合系统特有的振荡动力学。
classification.one_liner: 用Schwinger-Keldysh有效场论描述s波超导相变，并以全息构造确定强耦合模型中的Wilson系数。

papers.title: Conformal Vacua in Boundary-Glued AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: We argue that the purely topological gluing of AdS$_3$ spacetimes, which are otherwise independent due to Dirichlet boundary conditions, can still produce non-trivial spaces after a quotient. In this direction, we extend the study of a recently discovered non-orientable AdS$_3$, which is a $\mathbb Z_2$ quotient of two AdS$_3$ spaces glued along their conformal boundaries. We find that this space is compact and boundaryless and that the quotient sends the gluing surface to a torus comprised of a null lattice with halved periods. However, the bulk wraps around both its sides, which means that as an embedded space this gluing surface forms a one-sided torus. We discover that it supports a permutation-twisted sector of two CFT$_2$s with shared Dirichlet boundary conditions and conjecture that conformal maps can be extended across this gluing surface. Using this extension, we show that the vacuum of pairs of Rindler wedges, which share a boundary in this non-orientable AdS$_3\times$S$^2$ space, are conformal to static patch vacua, which are supported on two dS$_4\times \mathbb R$ glued together at their conformal boundaries.

classification.title_zh: 边界粘合 AdS$_3$ 中的共形真空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们论证，AdS$_3$ 时空的纯拓扑粘合——这些时空因 Dirichlet 边界条件而原本相互独立——在取商后仍可产生非平凡空间。沿此方向，我们扩展了对最近发现的一个不可定向 AdS$_3$ 的研究；该空间是两个 AdS$_3$ 空间沿其共形边界粘合后的 $\mathbb Z_2$ 商。我们发现该空间紧致且无边界，并且该商把粘合面变成一个由周期减半的零格点构成的环面。然而，体空间会绕其两侧，这意味着作为嵌入空间，该粘合面形成一个单侧环面。我们发现它支持两个共享 Dirichlet 边界条件的 CFT$_2$ 的置换扭曲扇区，并猜想共形映射可以延拓穿过该粘合面。利用这一延拓，我们证明：在这个不可定向 AdS$_3\times$S$^2$ 空间中共享边界的成对 Rindler 楔的真空，共形于静态补丁真空；后者支撑在两个于其共形边界处粘合在一起的 dS$_4\times \mathbb R$ 上。
classification.one_liner: 研究边界粘合 AdS$_3$ 的 $\mathbb Z_2$ 商及其 CFT$_2$ 扭曲扇区，并联系 Rindler 楔真空与 dS$_4$ 静态补丁真空。

papers.title: A geometrical invitation to BMS group theory
papers.abstract: In these lecture notes, a group-theoretical introduction to BMS symmetries is provided in a self-contained manner. More precisely, all definitions and structures are purely based on geometrical and group-theoretical notions defined at null infinity and valid in any dimension (four or higher), in a way that circumvents its traditional bulk realisation as asymptotic symmetries. The topics which are reviewed are: the definition of BMS transformations as conformal Carrollian isometries of null infinity, the semidirect structure of the BMS group, the holographic reconstruction of Minkowski spacetime in terms of good cuts, the one-to-one correspondence between good cut subspaces and Poincar\'{e} subgroups (aka vacua), as well as a basic introduction to the unitary representations of the BMS group.

classification.title_zh: BMS 群论的几何导引
classification.abstract_zh: 这些讲义以自洽的方式给出 BMS 对称性的群论导引。更准确地说，所有定义与结构都纯粹基于零无穷处定义的几何与群论概念，并适用于任意维度（四维或更高），从而绕开其传统的体空间实现，即作为渐近对称性。综述的主题包括：将 BMS 变换定义为零无穷处的共形 Carrollian 等距，BMS 群的半直积结构，借助 good cuts 对 Minkowski 时空进行全息重构，good cut 子空间与 Poincaré 子群（即真空）之间的一一对应，以及 BMS 群幺正表示的基本介绍。

papers.title: Higher genus twistor spaces and the celestial torus
papers.abstract: This paper studies novel four-dimensional integrable field theories that are deformations of self-dual Yang-Mills. They are engineered by considering holomorphic Chern-Simons and BF type theories on covers of twistor space obtained by pulling back the vector bundle $\mathcal{O}(1)^2\to\mathbb{CP}^1$ to hyperelliptic or elliptic curves. Compactifying to 4d yields an integrable theory, which in the examples I study, are determined to leading order. The form of the higher-order corrections are bootstrapped, and I argue that the index structure and coefficients of these terms are fixed by integrability. The celestial chiral algebras of these theories are shown to live on hyper-elliptic and elliptic curves, respectively. Symmetry reducing these integrable deformations to 2d yields an example of a hyperelliptic and elliptic integrable model governing a deformation of Hitchin's equations.

classification.title_zh: 高亏格扭量空间与天球环面
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究新型四维可积场论，它们是自对偶 Yang-Mills 的形变。构造方式是在扭量空间的多重覆盖上考虑全纯 Chern-Simons 与 BF 型理论；这些覆盖由将向量丛 O(1)^2→CP^1 拉回到超椭圆或椭圆曲线得到。紧化到四维给出可积理论，在所研究例子中确定到领头阶。高阶修正的形式通过 bootstrap 得到，作者论证这些项的指标结构与系数由可积性固定。这些理论的天球手征代数分别位于超椭圆曲线和椭圆曲线上。将这些可积形变对称约化到二维，得到超椭圆与椭圆可积模型的例子，它们支配 Hitchin 方程的一种形变。
classification.one_liner: 通过高亏格扭量覆盖构造自对偶 Yang-Mills 的可积形变，并研究其天球手征代数与二维约化。

papers.title: Black Hole Chemistry Knows Extra Dimensions
papers.abstract: We study black hole chemistry in the eight-dimensional Einstein-Yang-Mills-Maxwell theory, where the stabilized size of the compact internal space dynamically determines the four-dimensional thermodynamic pressure. Analyzing AdS black holes, we show that larger extra dimensions lower phase-transition temperatures and broaden the range of thermodynamically excluded black hole sizes. Additionally, we investigate a geometric representation of the thermodynamic volume by defining a volume-constrained minimal surface using a lapse-weighted volume functional. This codimension-two surface minimizes its area under the constraint that its enclosed volume exactly matches the thermodynamic volume. This surface prescription naturally reproduces the event horizon for dyonic and Schwarzschild-AdS black holes. We also apply this to the Kerr--AdS black hole and find an off-horizon surface numerically and analytically for finite and small angular momenta. In addition, we interpret the thermodynamic volume in terms of an effective number of disentanglers in a MERA system.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 黑洞化学认识额外维度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究八维 Einstein-Yang-Mills-Maxwell 理论中的黑洞化学；其中紧致内空间的稳定尺寸动力学地决定四维热力学压强。通过分析 AdS 黑洞，我们表明更大的额外维度会降低相变温度，并拓宽热力学上被排除的黑洞尺寸范围。此外，我们通过定义体积约束的极小曲面来研究热力学体积的几何表示，该曲面使用带 lapse 权重的体积泛函。这个余二维曲面在其包围体积恰好等于热力学体积的约束下最小化面积。该曲面规定自然再现了双荷和 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑洞的事件视界。我们还将其应用于 Kerr-AdS 黑洞，并在有限和较小角动量下数值和解析地找到视界外曲面。另外，我们用 MERA 系统中有效解纠缠器数目来解释热力学体积。
classification.one_liner: 研究八维 Einstein-Yang-Mills-Maxwell 理论中 AdS 黑洞化学，并用体积约束极小曲面与 MERA 解纠缠器解释热力学体积。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及 AdS 黑洞热力学相变与经典引力，靠近“相变/引力热力学”和“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但重点是高维黑洞化学与热力学体积的几何表示，不涉及全息超流、p波、探针膜、QNM 或 Floquet 驱动。

papers.title: Boundary to bound dictionary for generic Kerr orbits
papers.abstract: We establish a new relation between classical observables for scattering and bound orbits of a massive probe particle in a Kerr background. We find an exact representation of the Hamilton-Jacobi action in terms of the conserved charges which admits an analytic continuation, both for the radial and polar contribution, for a general class of geodesics beyond the equatorial case. Remarkably, this allows to extend the boundary to bound dictionary and it provides an efficient method to compute the deflection angles and the time delay for scattering orbits, as well as frequency ratios for bound orbits, in the probe limit but at all orders in the perturbative expansion.

classification.title_zh: 一般 Kerr 轨道的边界到束缚态字典
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了 Kerr 背景中大质量探针粒子的散射轨道与束缚轨道经典可观测量之间的一种新关系。我们发现，Hamilton-Jacobi 作用量可以用守恒荷精确表示，并且对于赤道面情形之外的一大类测地线，其径向和极角贡献都允许解析延拓。值得注意的是，这使我们能够扩展边界到束缚态字典，并提供一种高效方法，在探针极限下但微扰展开的所有阶上计算散射轨道的偏折角和时间延迟，以及束缚轨道的频率比。
classification.one_liner: 该文利用 Kerr 测地线 Hamilton-Jacobi 作用量的解析延拓，将散射轨道与束缚轨道的经典可观测量联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Kerr 黑洞背景中经典测地线及散射/束缚轨道可观测量，属于经典引力与广义相对论；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: A separation criterion for chiral systems and its application to Pleba\'nski--Demia\'nski perturbations
papers.abstract: We give a constructive criterion for local separation of first-order chiral systems coupling two complex doublets. It combines a Gram decomposition of the coupling sources with separate coordinate dependence and a differential transport test. For recoverable, nondegenerate source families, the criterion is necessary and sufficient within the specified class of mode-independent complex matrix transformations with unit determinant. For a fixed differential operator and admissible Gram decomposition, we identify conditions under which the sources uniquely determine the Hermitian coefficient matrix required for separation. As an application, we construct an explicit algebraic transformation and derive separated radial and angular equations for coupled radiative Einstein--Maxwell perturbations of rotating, charged Pleba\'nski--Demia\'nski backgrounds with acceleration, NUT charge, and a cosmological constant, on specified local patches. Its Gram decomposition is unique under additional generic assumptions. We also derive angular endpoint indices for Bonnor and Misner identifications with conical deficits or excesses. Under the stated regularity assumptions, each specified self-adjoint angular realization at fixed real mode parameters has a discrete spectrum and a complete orthonormal eigenbasis.

classification.title_zh: 手征系统的分离判据及其在Plebański–Demański微扰中的应用
classification.abstract_zh: 本文给出一个构造性判据，用于局部区分耦合两个复二重态的一阶手征系统。该判据将耦合源的Gram分解与分离的坐标依赖及微分输运检验结合起来。对于可恢复的非退化源族，在指定的、与模式无关且行列式为1的复矩阵变换类中，该判据是必要且充分的。对于固定微分算子和容许的Gram分解，作者识别出源唯一决定分离所需Hermitian系数矩阵的条件。作为应用，文章在指定局部 patches 上为旋转、带电、带加速度、NUT荷和宇宙学常数的Plebański–Demański背景中耦合辐射Einstein–Maxwell微扰构造显式代数变换，并导出分离的径向和角向方程。其Gram分解在额外泛型假设下唯一。文章还推导了带锥形亏欠或过剩的Bonnor与Misner identification的角向端点指标；在所述正则性假设下，固定实模式参数的每个指定自伴角向实现具有离散谱和完备正交归一本征基。
classification.one_liner: 提出手征系统局部分离判据，并用于构造带加速度、NUT荷和宇宙学常数的Plebański–Demański背景下Einstein–Maxwell微扰的分离方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞/时空微扰可分离性与角向谱问题，未涉及AdS/CFT、全息字典或量子信息。

papers.title: On the Asymptotic Expansion of Massive Fields in Spherically Symmetric Systems
papers.abstract: The behavior of massive real scalar fields, when sourced by a central object, is usually assumed to follow a Yukawa falloff towards radial infinity. In this paper, we show that this is generically not the case, even for minimally coupled fields. Further, while the point-particle action provides a coordinate-invariant definition of the central object's scalar charge, we show that the coefficient one usually extracts at asymptotically large radii in the case of massive scalar fields is neither coordinate invariant nor identical to the scalar charge appearing in the point-particle action. We resolve this issue perturbatively by constructing matched asymptotic expansions and investigate the non-perturbative structure using numerical methods.

classification.title_zh: 球对称系统中大质量场的渐近展开
classification.abstract_zh: 通常认为，由中心物体作为源的大质量实标量场在径向无穷远处按 Yukawa 形式衰减。本文表明，即使对于最小耦合场，这通常也不成立；进一步指出，虽然点粒子作用量给出中心物体标量荷的坐标不变定义，但在大质量标量场情形下，通常从大半径渐近区提取的系数既不是坐标不变量，也不等同于点粒子作用量中的标量荷。作者通过构造匹配渐近展开微扰地解决该问题，并用数值方法研究非微扰结构。
classification.one_liner: 指出大质量标量场在球对称源外通常不呈 Yukawa 衰减，且渐近提取的系数并非坐标不变的标量荷，并用匹配渐近展开与数值方法分析。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论框架下的标量场渐近行为与标量荷定义问题，与用户重点标签中的经典引力支线相关，但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Detectability of Eccentric Intermediate Mass-Ratio Inspiral in the Decihertz Band
papers.abstract: The proposed decihertz gravitational-wave (GW) band $(\sim 10^{-2}-1\,\Hz)$ will observe the late inspiral of intermediate mass-ratio inspirals (IMRIs), binaries with mass ratios $10^2 \lesssim q \lesssim 10^4$ that assemble dynamically in dense stellar environments and are expected to retain measurable eccentricity. Search and parameter-estimation pipelines are predominantly built around circular templates, and we test this assumption. Using black-hole perturbation theory waveforms from \textsc{FastEMRIWaveforms} for a representative IMRI ($M=10^4\,\modot$, $q=100$, observed for its final $10\,\hr$), we compute fitting factors between eccentric signals and circular templates, maximizing over the template's total mass and mass ratio with a differential-evolution search, for the B-DECIGO, LGWA-Si, and IndIGO-D noise curves and a flat PSD. The mismatch grows with initial eccentricity $e_0$ and crosses the standard $3\%$ threshold at $e_0\simeq3\times10^{-2}$, well within the range allowed by the waveform model and expected from dynamical formation. The best-fitting circular templates also bias the total mass and mass ratio by several percent at $e_0=0.1$. Combining the mismatch with the signal-to-noise-dependent distinguishability criterion, we find that for a source at $1\,\mathrm{Gpc}$, eccentricities as small as $e_0\simeq5\times10^{-4}$ (B-DECIGO and IndIGO-D) and $5\times10^{-3}$ (LGWA-Si) are resolvable, one to two orders of magnitude below where detection efficiency degrades. The loss of match arises from the excitation of radial Teukolsky harmonics, which spread power into sidebands that circular templates cannot represent, and from the slower orbital decay of eccentric binaries at fixed initial semi-latus rectum. Robust detection and parameter estimation of IMRIs with DECIGO, LGWA, and IndIGO-D will require eccentric waveform models and template banks.

classification.title_zh: 分赫兹频段偏心中等质量比旋近的可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 拟议的分赫兹引力波频段（约 10^{-2}-1 Hz）将观测中等质量比旋近（IMRI）的晚期旋近；这类双星的质量比为 10^2 ≲ q ≲ 10^4，在致密恒星环境中动力学形成，并预期保留可测量的偏心率。搜寻与参数估计流程主要基于圆轨道模板，本文检验这一假设。使用 FastEMRIWaveforms 中基于黑洞微扰理论的波形，针对一个代表性 IMRI（M=10^4 M⊙，q=100，观测其最后 10 小时），我们在 B-DECIGO、LGWA-Si、IndIGO-D 噪声曲线及平坦 PSD 下，通过差分演化搜索对模板总质量和质量比最大化，计算偏心信号与圆轨道模板之间的拟合因子。失配随初始偏心率 e_0 增大，并在 e_0≃3×10^{-2} 时越过标准 3% 阈值，该值远在波形模型允许且动力学形成预期的范围内。最佳拟合圆轨道模板在 e_0=0.1 时还会使总质量和质量比产生百分之几的偏差。结合失配与依赖信噪比的可分辨判据，我们发现对于 1 Gpc 处的源，小至 e_0≃5×10^{-4}（B-DECIGO 和 IndIGO-D）以及 5×10^{-3}（LGWA-Si）的偏心率可被分辨，比探测效率开始下降处低一至两个数量级。匹配损失源于径向 Teukolsky 谐波的激发，其将功率分散到圆轨道模板无法表示的边带，以及固定初始半通径时偏心双星较慢的轨道衰减。利用 DECIGO、LGWA 和 IndIGO-D 对 IMRI 进行稳健探测与参数估计将需要偏心波形模型和模板库。
classification.one_liner: 利用黑洞微扰波形评估分赫兹频段偏心IMRI与圆轨道模板的失配及可分辨偏心率。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波与黑洞微扰研究方向，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息或量子信息。

papers.title: Maximum entropy reconstruction of the black hole greybody factors from its Korteweg-de Vries integrals
papers.abstract: The dynamics of perturbed non-rotating black holes (BHs) can be described by master wave equations with a potential barrier. Recent work has shown that these equations possess an infinite number of symmetries generated by the Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) hierarchy, leading to conserved quantities (KdV integrals) that fully determine the BH greybody factors via a moment problem. In this paper, we introduce and validate a new method to solve this moment problem using the maximum entropy principle. The method reconstructs, at each order of truncation, the least-biased transmission probability compatible with a finite set of KdV integrals, guaranteeing positivity by construction. We first validate the technique against the exactly solvable P\"oschl-Teller potential. We then apply it to the Regge-Wheeler potential governing axial perturbations of a Schwarzschild BH, where no exact solution is available; the resulting reconstruction agrees closely with the fourth-order Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) approximation across several multipoles. This is the first application of the maximum entropy method to the reconstruction of BH greybody factors, demonstrating that a modest number of KdV integrals is sufficient to recover them accurately.
authors: Carlos F. Sopuerta (Institute of Space Sciences
Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia)

classification.title_zh: 从Korteweg-de Vries积分最大熵重建黑洞灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 扰动非旋转黑洞的动力学可由带势垒的主波方程描述。近期工作表明，这些方程具有由Korteweg-de Vries（KdV）层级生成的无穷多对称性，并给出守恒量（KdV积分），这些积分通过一个矩问题完全决定黑洞灰体因子。本文引入并验证一种利用最大熵原理求解该矩问题的新方法。该方法在每一截断阶重建与有限个KdV积分相容的最小偏置透射概率，并构造上保证正性。作者先用可精确求解的Pöschl-Teller势验证该技术，再将其应用于描述Schwarzschild黑洞轴向扰动的Regge-Wheeler势；此时没有精确解，所得重建在若干多极下与四阶Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin（WKB）近似密切相符。这是最大熵方法首次用于黑洞灰体因子重建，表明少量KdV积分足以准确恢复灰体因子。
classification.one_liner: 用最大熵原理从有限个KdV积分重建黑洞灰体因子，并在Pöschl-Teller与Schwarzschild Regge-Wheeler势上验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典黑洞扰动与灰体因子重建，直接涉及经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或用户其他全息研究支线。

papers.title: Boson Stars with Ay\'{o}n--Beato--Garc\'{i}a nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study spherically symmetric boson star solutions in Einstein gravity minimally coupled to Ay\'{o}n--Beato--Garc\'{i}a nonlinear electrodynamics and a massive complex scalar field. We find that these solutions exist only when the electric charge $q$ is below a critical value. Within this range, solutions with relatively small charges can exhibit a gravitational blueshift, and the radial mass function becomes negative in some regions while the ADM mass remains positive. For larger charges, frozen boson-star solutions emerge as the scalar-field frequency $\omega$ approaches zero. In these configurations, the metric function $1/g_{rr}$ and $-g_{tt}$ become very small near a special position $r_{\mathrm{ch}}$, and the spacetime resembles an extremal black hole from the perspective of an observer at infinity. Moreover, timelike trajectories in these frozen boson stars are strongly deflected near $r_{\mathrm{ch}}$, and particles require a longer coordinate time to traverse the same radial distance than they do in ordinary boson stars.

classification.title_zh: 具有Ayón-Beato-García非线性电动力学的玻色星
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在爱因斯坦引力中最小耦合Ayón-Beato-García非线性电动力学与有质量复标量场的球对称玻色星解。我们发现这些解仅在电荷q低于临界值时存在。在该范围内，较小电荷的解可表现出引力蓝移，径向质量函数在某些区域为负而ADM质量仍为正。对于较大电荷，当标量场频率ω趋近于零时出现冻结玻色星解。在这些位形中，度规函数1/g_rr与-g_tt在特殊位置r_ch附近变得很小，从无穷远观察者看时空类似极端黑洞。此外，这些冻结玻色星中的类时轨迹在r_ch附近强烈偏折，粒子穿越相同径向距离需要比普通玻色星更长的坐标时间。
classification.one_liner: 研究非线性电动力学耦合有质量复标量场中的球对称玻色星解及其冻结构型与极端黑洞相似性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力中的玻色星解研究，非全息研究；但与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Casimir-like wormholes
papers.abstract: We investigate spherically symmetric spacetimes sourced by matter with energy density $\rho \propto 1/r^{4}$ and equation of state $p_r = \omega \rho$. We derive the most general solution of Einstein's equations for this class of sources, obtaining black holes, naked singularities and traversable wormholes, parametrized by the integration constants and $\omega$. We show that only two classes of matter can support traversable wormholes: Casimir-type matter with $\omega > 0$ and phantom matter with $\omega < -1$, while quintessence and conventional dark energy are excluded by the flare-out condition. For the Casimir value $\omega = 3$, the transverse pressure approaches $p_t \to -\rho$ near the central singularity, so the full algebraic structure of the Casimir stress-energy tensor, $\rho \propto -1/r^{4}$, $p_r = 3\rho$, $p_t = -\rho$, is not imposed but emerges from Einstein's equations. Treating the amplitude of the energy density as a free classical parameter, we obtain wormholes with throat radii from microscopic to astrophysical scales. These Casimir-like configurations share the functional form of the Casimir tensor but are not generated by the physical Casimir effect; Garattini's Planck-scale Casimir wormhole is recovered when the quantum Casimir energy scale is imposed. The total amount of exotic matter is finite for arbitrary $\omega$ and scales linearly with the throat radius. Analyzing the traveler's acceleration, tidal forces and transit times, we show that radial free fall satisfies all human traversability conditions for $r_0 \gtrsim 10^{8}$ m. Finally, embedding diagrams illustrate three geometric regimes depending on $\omega$.

classification.title_zh: 类卡西米尔虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 研究由能量密度 ρ∝1/r^4 且径向压强 p_r=ωρ 的物质源产生的球对称时空，给出 Einstein 方程的最一般解，包括黑洞、裸奇点和可穿越虫洞。只有 ω>0 的 Casimir 型物质与 ω<-1 的 phantom 物质能支持可穿越虫洞；ω=3 时横向压强趋于 -ρ，Casimir 应力张量的代数结构由 Einstein 方程涌现而非预先强加。将能量密度幅度视为自由经典参数，喉半径可从微观到天体尺度；这些构型并非由物理 Casimir 效应产生，但可恢复 Garattini 的普朗克尺度 Casimir 虫洞。总奇异物质有限且随喉半径线性增长。分析旅行者加速度、潮汐力和穿越时间后，r0≳10^8 m 时径向自由落体满足人类可穿越条件；嵌入图展示三种几何区域。
classification.one_liner: 在 ρ∝1/r^4 与 p_r=ωρ 的球对称源中，Einstein 方程给出仅 Casimir 型或 phantom 物质支持的可穿越虫洞，并检验其经典可穿越性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Einstein 方程下的经典虫洞解及其可穿越性，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Quasinormal Modes and Environmental Trapping around Charged Letelier Black Holes with Perfect-Fluid Dark Matter and Quintessence
papers.abstract: We compute the massless scalar quasinormal spectra of charged Letelier black holes surrounded by logarithmic perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM) and quintessence, for $\Lambda=0$ and for asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes, together with the test Maxwell spectra for $\Lambda=0$. For $\Lambda=0$, sixth order WKB values with Pad\'e resummation agree with independent time domain evolutions to within $0.06\%$ for the fundamental modes. Stronger string cloud and quintessence lower both the oscillation frequencies and the damping rates, while a larger charge or a larger positive PFDM parameter $\beta$ raises both. In our convention $\beta>0$ means negative PFDM energy density; negative $\beta$ gives a positive density and reverses the shift. The angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent of the unstable circular null orbit reproduce the eikonal trends and approximate the $\ell=2$ WKB frequencies at the percent level. For $\Lambda<0$ the scalar potential diverges at the AdS boundary and the single barrier WKB formula does not apply. We therefore solve the eigenvalue problem with a Chebyshev pseudospectral method in ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates, with regularity at the horizon and a Dirichlet condition at the boundary, and check the modes against time domain evolutions and Schwarzschild-AdS benchmarks. The AdS spectrum contains long-lived modes trapped between the photon sphere barrier and the reflecting boundary, with damping rates spanning about five orders of magnitude. The damping correlates with the ratio of the oscillation frequency to the barrier top frequency, consistent with leakage through the barrier. No growing modes are found in the test field sectors and parameter ranges studied, which does not establish the stability of the fully coupled system.

classification.title_zh: 含完美流体暗物质与精质的带电Letelier黑洞准正规模及环境俘获
classification.abstract_zh: 本文计算了被对数完美流体暗物质（PFDM）和精质包围的带电Letelier黑洞的无质量标量准正规模，覆盖Λ=0与渐近AdS时空，并给出Λ=0时的检验Maxwell谱。对于Λ=0，六阶WKB结合Padé重求和的基频结果与独立时域演化在0.06%以内一致。更强的弦云和精质会降低振荡频率与阻尼率，而更大的电荷或更大的正PFDM参数β会提高二者；按其约定β>0对应负PFDM能量密度，负β给出正密度并反转移动方向。非稳定圆形零测地线的角频率与Lyapunov指数再现了eikonal趋势，并在百分级近似ℓ=2的WKB频率。对于Λ<0，标量势在AdS边界发散，单势垒WKB公式不适用；作者因此在入射Eddington-Finkelstein坐标中用Chebyshev伪谱法求解本征值问题，视界处取正则条件、边界处取Dirichlet条件，并用时域演化和Schwarzschild-AdS基准检验模式。AdS谱包含被光子球势垒与反射边界之间俘获的长寿命模式，阻尼率跨越约五个数量级；阻尼与振荡频率和势垒顶端频率之比相关，符合通过势垒泄漏的图像。在所研究的检验场扇区和参数范围内未发现增长模式，但这并不确立完全耦合系统的稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 计算含PFDM与精质的带电Letelier黑洞标量准正规模，并用WKB、时域演化和Chebyshev伪谱法分析Λ=0与AdS情形下的环境俘获。

papers.title: Black holes in Myrzakulov $F(R,T)$ gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate vacuum black-hole solutions in metric-affine Myrzakulov $F(R,T)$ gravity (MG-I), where $R$ is the affine Ricci scalar and $T$ is a quadratic torsion invariant, not the trace of the matter energy-momentum tensor. For the polynomial model $F(R,T)=\alpha R+\beta T+\gamma T^3$, with $\alpha\neq0$, we first vary the metric and all components of the independent affine connection, and only then specialize to metric-compatible geometry with totally antisymmetric torsion. Nonzero axial torsion admits an exceptional branch $\alpha+\beta+3\gamma T_*^2=0$, on which the metric satisfies the Einstein equations with effective cosmological parameter $\Lambda_*=\gamma T_*^3/\alpha$. We establish a local existence result and construct torsionful Schwarzschild-(anti-)de Sitter representatives that are smooth through a selected future Killing horizon. Within the spherically symmetric axial ansatz, we characterize Ricci-symmetric affine connections by the condition $(fV-U)'=0$ and compare a constant-$W=fV-U$ family with a constant-$U$ family. Although these connections share the same metric and torsion scalar, their affine curvature invariants generally differ. Independent coordinate-level curvature contractions and component tests of the unrestricted metric and connection variations corroborate the identities used in the construction; these checks complement the analytic variational derivation. Finally, we identify null directions of the restricted axial quadratic form and distinguish this degeneracy from a complete metric-affine stability analysis. Our conclusions are local and do not establish global extendibility, physical inequivalence of all torsion profiles, or dynamical stability.

classification.title_zh: Myrzakulov F(R,T) 引力中的黑洞

papers.title: A Stable Vector Bounce
papers.abstract: We construct a geodesically complete bounce in cubic generalised Proca theory with a free canonical scalar as the matter field. The temporal vector evolves along its algebraic constraint and supports the transition from contraction to expansion while matter obeys the null energy condition. This evolution permits nonzero derivative mixing at the bounce. The kinetic coefficients are positive at every finite time for all nonzero comoving wavenumbers, and short-wavelength perturbations are stable throughout the solution. Following the linear equations to both infinite-time limits also shows that local perturbations are bounded for all nonzero comoving wavenumbers.

papers.title: Two-scale system: compactified ambient metrics and Scri/Spi/Ti
papers.abstract: We show that certain geometric constructions, including the Fefferman-Graham ambient metric, Brinkmann spaces, and ultrastatic vacuum spacetimes, admit natural conformal compactifications and can be unified within a single framework arising naturally from conformal geometry. The framework is based on a two-scale system comprising two weight-one conformal scalars satisfying almost-Einstein equations and certain regularity conditions. As a particular instance of this unifying framework, we obtain a new ambient construction for Spi and Ti, the extended spatial and temporal infinities of Ricci-flat spacetimes. A remarkable feature of this construction is that Spi/Ti and the null infinity of the corresponding spacetimes are naturally realised as a boundary face and the corner of the two-scale ambient space, respectively. We also demonstrate how the two-scale system can serve as a background ambient geometry for studying the asymptotic behaviour of (gauge) fields at spatial, temporal, and null infinity.

papers.title: The fate of hidden symmetries under magnetic Harrison transformations
papers.abstract: Solution-generating transformations construct new geometries from known seeds, raising the question of whether and to what extent the resulting solutions inherit the hidden symmetries underlying the seeds' integrability and separability. We have established universal perturbative inheritance laws for CKTs and massless scalar separability directly at the level of magnetic Harrison transformations, encompassing both magnetization of Carter-type seeds and demagnetization of conformal Carter-type seeds. In both magnetized Kerr and demagnetized Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson, this perturbative inheritance coexists with the loss of exact Carter-type separability, while seed-connected conformal Killing-Yano structures are already obstructed at the same perturbative order. These results reveal a hierarchy in the perturbative survival of hidden symmetries and provide a framework for investigating their inheritance in more general theoretical settings and under other solution-generating transformations.

papers.title: Asymptotic stability of axisymmetric perturbations of near-horizon extremal Kerr with a Schwarzian-deformed throat
papers.abstract: We study the asymptotic stability of axisymmetric gravitational perturbations of the near-horizon geometries of (near-)extremal Kerr black holes and consider the family of backgrounds in which the AdS$_{2}$ factor of NHEK is deformed by a Schwarzian mode. Requiring the Killing parameter to be local in the background makes the Gelfand--Dikii polynomials natural solutions of the Killing equation, and that locality requirement brings stationary solutions of the Korteweg-de Vries equation. The hierarchy selects a family of backgrounds, which remain $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})\times \mathfrak{u}(1)$ throughout them: the first level gives NHEK and near-NHEK, the second, solitons that depart from one of these geometries and return to it. We linearize Einstein's equations around this family, where the axisymmetric sector reduces to a wave equation on the nearly-AdS$_{2}$ base, and analyze this equation by energy and virial methods. For NHEK we obtain a conserved energy, an integrated local energy estimate and asymptotic stability in a weighted norm; for a nonconstant Schwarzian the energy becomes a Lyapunov functional whose monotonicity is dictated by the sign of its derivative, yielding uniform bounds for integrable ones, and mild local decay along the KdV soliton. We also find a monotone horizon-localized norm, which is not of Aretakis type, showing that stability properties are directly sensitive to the near-horizon structure encoded in the Schwarzian background. We compute the associated Regge--Teitelboim charges at a late-time corner of the throat using a radial ADM foliation of the spacetime.

papers.title: Holographic Einstein rings of a covariant quantum corrected AdS black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate holographic Einstein rings in a covariant quantum corrected Schwarzschild--AdS$_4$ spacetime using a massless scalar probe. At fixed horizon radius $r_h$, the deformation parameter $\zeta$ leaves the metric mass parameter, coordinate surface gravity, and photon sphere radius unchanged, while increasing the photon potential maximum and the asymptotic lapse coefficient $A=1+\zeta^2$. The critical coordinate impact parameter approaches $A^{-1/2}$ for large black holes, whereas the corresponding incidence angle in the normalized boundary frame approaches $\pi/2$. Ray tracing and local WKB barrier data recover the same geometric scale. Quasinormal spectra computed with AdS boundary conditions provide a comparison at finite multipole number. These results separate the finite radius effect of the deformation from the change in boundary time normalization.

classification.title_zh: 协变量子修正 AdS 黑洞的全息爱因斯坦环

papers.title: Thermodynamics and interior structure of density-responsive regular black holes
papers.abstract: This work studies regular black holes motivated by the scalar sector of density-responsive gravity (DRG). An algebraic prescription with phenomenological local running maps a Gaussian matter profile to a diagnostic density profile. A pressure check shows that this profile does not solve the full static DRG equations. It serves only to select an effective metric family with two horizons. The extremal mass is calibrated to $M_{\min} = \sqrt{1+A/2}\,M_{\mathrm{P}} \simeq 1.006\,M_{\mathrm{P}}$, where $A=0.024$ is the historical scalar response amplitude. A fit to $\rho(r) = \rho_0\exp[-(r/r_c)^n]$ selects $n=2$. The temperature is nonmonotonic, reaching $T_H^{\max}=0.02547\,M_{\mathrm{P}}$ at $M=1.332\,M_{\mathrm{P}}$ before vanishing at $M_{\min}$. The calculation verifies the generic scaling near extremality $\mathcal{Z}_{\mathrm{tr}}\propto(M-M_{\min})^{-1/2}$ of a static lapse diagnostic for $n=2,3,4,6$ and for the Hayward and Bardeen controls. A regulated integral of coordinate time between the horizons provides a static cavity diagnostic, not a prediction of echoes of gravitational waves. The remaining area entropy equals the area entropy already lost at $M_{\mathrm{cross}}/M_0=0.707107\simeq1/\sqrt{2}$. This geometric crossing does not establish a Page curve or unitarity. The endpoint area entropy is below $2.6\%$ of the initial Bekenstein-Hawking entropy for $M_0 = 5\,M_{\mathrm{P}}$ and below $0.03\%$ for $M_0 = 50\,M_{\mathrm{P}}$. An inverse source reconstruction confirms an isotropic core of de Sitter type but retains the pressure mismatch. An exploratory collapse calculation with an imposed bounce factor produces bounded configurations with $1-2m/r<0$ without establishing formation of the calibrated geometry. The robust results are the calibrated thermodynamics and generic scaling near extremality.

classification.title_zh: 密度响应正则黑洞的热力学与内部结构

papers.title: Metric perturbations in Einstein-Hilbert gravity: An alternative perturbative formulation
papers.abstract: We derive the ordinary gauge-fixed quadratic operators of the four-dimensional Einstein--Hilbert action in exponential and inverse-metric-density variables on an arbitrary reference background. With a single nonlinear background-harmonic gauge transported through the exact field map, the density operator is the trace-reversed Lichnerowicz operator, while the exponential operator contains an additional algebraic Ricci-curvature term. This difference arises from the nonlinear transformation of the background tadpole and vanishes on Ricci-flat backgrounds; a cosmological-constant check gives the corresponding cancellation at Einstein saddles. The construction retains the exact determinant contribution and specifies the associated Faddeev--Popov operator. At the first interacting order on a flat background, we show that the two gauge-fixed cubic actions differ by a term proportional to the free field equation, and independently evaluate the same nonzero three-point coefficient in both variables, with its normalization matched to the Einstein-gravity interaction. An exact Schwarzschild configuration satisfies the same background-harmonic gauge and is stationary under unrestricted exterior variations of the gauge-fixed action. Its density and exponential reconstructions are checked together with the bulk and boundary terms; a separate radial variation illustrates the loss of an equation after imposing a restricted ansatz. These results provide an explicit comparison of established field coordinates at the classical and tree levels; quantum loop calculations additionally require a common measure, regulator and source prescription.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Hilbert 引力中的度规微扰：一种替代微扰表述

papers.title: Kalb-Ramond black bounces: throat-blind shadows and throat-sensitive neutrinos
papers.abstract: Regularizing a black hole removes its singularity, but which observations could detect the regularized core? We address this question for a Simpson-Visser black bounce built on the power-law hairy black hole that a Lorentz-violating Kalb-Ramond background produces. Measured in the areal radius, the bounce leaves the metric function untouched and changes only the radial measure. This single fact sorts the observables into two classes. The shadow, the innermost stable orbit, orbital frequencies and gravitational redshifts are blind to the throat. The instability of the photon ring, the brightness of its subrings, the oscillation phase of neutrinos and the energy deposited by neutrino pair annihilation respond to it through one universal factor. We derive an exact law for the subring demagnification that holds for any metric function. We also show that the throat enters the weak-field neutrino phase and the light deflection with different weights, so that combined photon and neutrino lensing can separate the mass from the throat. Ray-traced polarized images of a turbulent thin disk confirm that the direct image hides the throat while the first subring reveals it. For neutrinos emitted near a stellar-mass compact object the throat reshapes the flavor survival pattern and enhances the annihilation energy deposition. Two independent computations reproduce each headline number.

classification.title_zh: Kalb-Ramond 黑洞反弹：对喉部不敏感的影子与对喉部敏感的中微子
classification.abstract_zh: 通过将 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹建立在 Lorentz 破坏的 Kalb-Ramond 背景所产生的幂律毛发黑洞上，研究正则化核心的可观测性。以面积半径衡量，反弹不改变度规函数而只改变径向测度，因此观测量分为两类：影子、最内稳定轨道、轨道频率和引力红移对喉部不敏感；光子环不稳定性、子环亮度、中微子振荡相位以及中微子对湮灭能量沉积则通过一个普适因子响应喉部。文中导出适用于任意度规函数的子环去放大精确规律，并表明喉部以不同权重进入弱场中微子相位和光偏折，因此联合光子与中微子透镜可分离质量与喉部。湍流薄盘的偏振射线追踪确认直接像隐藏喉部，而第一子环揭示它。对于恒星质量致密天体附近发射的中微子，喉部会重塑味存活模式并增强湮灭能量沉积。两个独立计算重现每个主要数值。
classification.one_liner: 黑洞反弹的喉部对影子等观测量不可见，却通过子环和中微子振荡/湮灭留下敏感特征。

papers.title: Self-interacting $p$-forms and the shear-free anisotropic cosmological model
papers.abstract: The cosmological principle may require more than observations demand: what is needed is isotropic expansion without vorticity. Extended Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (eFLRW) cosmologies realise this with a non-vanishing anisotropic spatial curvature that is balanced by an anisotropic stress while the shear vanishes. Thorsrud and others investigated such scenarios for free differential $p$-forms. Here we extend the analysis to non-Abelian $p$-forms ($p=0,\dots,4$) with self interactions. The balance requires the anisotropic stress to decay as $a^{-2}$, $a$ being the cosmological scale factor, which we combine with the gauge-field continuity equation. The general results indicate that, in the presence of a potential, fine-tuning of the same is needed in order to balance the curvature. Notably, this is not the case for a $3$-form field $\underline{H}^a$ with a potential term $V(\underline{H}^2)=A+B\,\underline{H}^2$, where $A$ and $B$ are constants: in Bianchi class A, an uncharged 3-form balances the curvature with this potential without any tuning, and a charged one does so for a suitably chosen connection. This is the only candidate we have found where the potential does not require tuning. It is also an interesting candidate as it can be interpreted as a cosmological constant in combination with a dark-matter sector mimicking curvature.
authors: Centro de Investigacion Cientifica y de Educacion Superior de Ensenada)
Ben D. Normann (Norwegian University of Science and Technology)

classification.title_zh: 自相互作用 p-形式与无剪切各向异性宇宙学模型
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学原理可能要求超过观测所需：需要的是无涡旋的各向同性膨胀。扩展 FLRW 宇宙学通过非零各向异性空间曲率并由各向异性应力平衡、同时剪切为零来实现这一点。Thorsrud 等人研究了自由微分 p-形式情形。本文将分析推广到具有自相互作用的非阿贝尔 p-形式（p=0,...,4）。平衡要求各向异性应力按 a^{-2} 衰减，a 为宇宙尺度因子，并将其与规范场连续性方程结合。一般结果表明，存在势时通常需要微调势以平衡曲率。值得注意的是，对于带势项 V(H^2)=A+B H^2 的 3-形式场 H^a 并非如此：在 Bianchi A 类中，不带电 3-形式可用该势无微调地平衡曲率，带电者通过适当选择联络也可做到。这是作者发现的唯一不需要微调势的候选；它也可解释为宇宙学常数与模仿曲率的暗物质扇区的组合。
classification.one_liner: 研究自相互作用非阿贝尔 p-形式在无剪切各向异性 FLRW/Bianchi A 宇宙学中平衡曲率，并发现特定 3-形式势无需微调。

papers.title: Carroll Double Copy
papers.abstract: We construct a double copy for Carroll gravity as the ``square'' of Carroll Yang-Mills theory at the linearised level. Starting from the convolutional double copy prescription in Lorentzian spacetime, we take the Carrollian limit $c \rightarrow 0$ to establish a double copy dictionary compatible both with symmetries and the corresponding equations of motion. Since this limit yields two distinct sectors, namely the electric and magnetic Carroll theories, we systematically investigate double copy constructions involving all possible combinations of these parent theories. To accommodate the time-independent on-shell configurations of the magnetic Carroll fields, we introduce a suitable regularisation procedure for the convolutional double copy. In addition, the covariance of the double copy under Carroll boosts requires an appropriate dressing of the fields, leading to the inclusion of a Goldstone-type object in the construction. We first develop the formalism using toy models involving scalar fields and then apply it to the double copy between linearised Carroll Yang-Mills theory and Carroll gravity.

classification.title_zh: Carroll 双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在线性化层面构造 Carroll 引力的双拷贝，将其视为 Carroll Yang-Mills 理论的“平方”。从洛伦兹时空中的卷积双拷贝方案出发，取 Carrollian 极限 c→0，建立同时兼容对称性与运动方程的双拷贝字典。由于该极限给出电型和磁型两个不同扇区，作者系统研究这些母理论所有组合的双拷贝构造。为处理磁型 Carroll 场的时无关在壳位形，引入合适的正则化程序；Carroll boost 下双拷贝的协变性要求对场进行适当修饰，从而在构造中引入 Goldstone 型对象。文中先用标量场玩具模型发展形式体系，再应用于线性化 Carroll Yang-Mills 理论与 Carroll 引力之间的双拷贝。
classification.one_liner: 在线性化层面建立 Carroll 引力与 Carroll Yang-Mills 的卷积双拷贝字典，并处理电/磁 Carroll 扇区、正则化与 boost 协变性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 Carrollian/平直时空方向的经典场论双拷贝构造，与经典引力形式体系相关，但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息超流、QNM 或探针膜等用户重点支线。

papers.title: Lifting asymptotic symmetries from metric to tetrad formulation
papers.abstract: Metric solution spaces defined by gauge and boundary conditions are associated with a residual symmetry algebra, consisting of the diffeomorphism generators whose action preserves these conditions. Describing a metric solution space in terms of tetrad variables adds a local Lorentz freedom. When part of this freedom is fixed by additional tetrad gauge and boundary conditions, metric residual symmetries must be supplemented by compensating Lorentz transformations. If a residual Lorentz freedom remains, there is an ambiguity in these compensating transformations. The most direct choices generally fail to realize the metric residual symmetry algebra as a subalgebra of the tetrad one, because of a field-dependent cocycle. We show that a reference tetrad, that is a section of the tetrad solution space seen as a principal bundle over the metric one, always provides a lift free of this cocycle, so that the tetrad residual symmetry algebra is the semi-direct sum of the metric one and the ideal of field-dependent residual Lorentz transformations. The construction is independent of the gauge conditions, of the residual group, of the first-order Lagrangian, and reduces to the Kosmann lift on metric isometry generators. We illustrate it on a Weyl BMS-type solution space with time-dependent boundary metric, described in tetrad variables with a residual U(1) Lorentz freedom, for which the cocycle of a naive lift is computed and then explicitly removed.

classification.title_zh: 从度规到标架表述提升渐近对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 由规范条件和边界条件定义的度规解空间伴随一个残余对称代数，该代数由保持这些条件的微分同胚生成元组成。用标架变量描述度规解空间会引入局部洛伦兹自由度。当部分洛伦兹自由度被额外的标架规范条件和边界条件固定时，度规残余对称性必须由补偿洛伦兹变换来补充。若仍存在残余洛伦兹自由度，则这些补偿变换存在歧义。由于场依赖的 cocycle，最直接的选择通常无法把度规残余对称代数实现为标架残余对称代数的子代数。作者证明，参考标架——即把标架解空间视为度规解空间上的主丛时的一个截面——总能提供一个消除该 cocycle 的提升，使得标架残余对称代数是度规残余代数与场依赖残余洛伦兹变换理想构成的半直和。该构造不依赖于规范条件、残余群和一阶拉格朗日量，并在度规等距生成元上退化为 Kosmann 提升。文中以具有含时边界度规、用带残余 U(1) 洛伦兹自由度的标架变量描述的 Weyl BMS 型解空间为例，计算了朴素提升的 cocycle 并显式将其消除。
classification.one_liner: 构造参考标架截面以消除场依赖 cocycle，从而把度规渐近残余对称代数提升为标架残余对称代数的半直和。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论中的渐近对称性与 BMS 表述，并涉及标架形式；但不是 AdS/CFT 全息对偶或用户列出的其他凝聚态、超流、QNM 等重点支线。

papers.title: Thermal deep inelastic scattering, universality and complex geodesics
papers.abstract: In deep inelastic scattering (DIS), a lepton scatters off a target hadron whose structure is probed by an exchanged photon with large spacelike virtuality. We consider two-point functions of currents in strongly interacting quantum field theories at finite temperature in this kinematic regime and use a holographic description to compute them. At large virtuality, the crossover from vacuum-dominated to thermally dominated physics corresponds to a transition from exponentially suppressed absorption to power-law behavior of the response functions. This regime is related to a particular near-lightcone limit of thermal CFT correlators. We show that the response functions exhibit a large degree of universality: the dependence on the three-point couplings of currents to the stress tensor enters through a channel-dependent coefficient multiplying the kinematic parameter that controls the relative size of vacuum and thermal effects. The same coefficient controls conformal collider bounds; when either bound is saturated, the corresponding response function takes its vacuum form in the near-lightcone limit. Furthermore, the absorption exponent in the low-temperature regime is related to a complex geodesic propagating in the near-lightcone geometry.

classification.title_zh: 热深度非弹性散射、普适性与复测地线
classification.abstract_zh: 在深度非弹性散射中，轻子被靶强子散射，并通过具有大类空虚度的交换光子探测强子结构。本文考虑该运动学区域中有限温度强相互作用量子场论的流双点函数，并用全息描述进行计算。在大虚度下，从真空主导到热主导的跨接对应于响应函数从指数压低的吸收转变为幂律行为；该区域与热CFT关联函数的特定近光锥极限相关。作者表明响应函数具有高度普适性：对流与能动张量三点耦合的依赖通过一个依赖于通道的系数进入，该系数乘在控制真空与热效应相对大小的运动学参数上。同一系数也控制共形对撞机界；当任一界饱和时，相应响应函数在近光锥极限下取真空形式。此外，低温区域中的吸收指数与在近光锥几何中传播的复测地线相关。
classification.one_liner: 用全息方法研究有限温度强耦合QFT中深度非弹性散射的流关联函数，揭示真空/热跨接的普适系数及与复测地线的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论热场论深度非弹性散射的全息关联函数与普适性，未涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、探针膜、相变气泡成核或经典引力等主线。

papers.title: From Quasinormal Mode Poles to Branch Cuts at Finite $N$
papers.abstract: In the strict large-$N$ limit, holographic thermal retarded correlators are typigcally meromorphic, with their late-time behavior determined by isolated quasinormal mode (QNM) poles. We show that the first bulk-loop correction, of order $1/N^2$, qualitatively changes this structure. In a scalar theory on the planar AdS$_5$ black brane, a one-loop bulk diagram generates poles at sums of two QNM frequencies at fixed loop momentum $q$; integration over the continuous momentum turns these QNM-pair poles into branch cuts. At vanishing external spatial momentum, for pairs built from QNM branches with opposite real parts, the leading light-cone contributions cancel at large momentum, and the residual QNM-pair frequency scales as $q^{-1/3}$. Consequently, an infinite family of cuts accumulates at zero frequency, while all tree-level QNM poles remain at finite nonzero frequencies. The first finite-$N$ correction therefore closes the gap set by the classical QNM spectrum. Competition between the decreasing QNM-pair damping and thermal Boltzmann suppression produces a moving saddle and a finite-$N$ contribution $G(t)\sim N^{-2}t^\alpha e^{-Ct^{3/4}},\, C>0,$ which decays more slowly than the leading classical QNM contribution. Thus the large-$N$ expansion is nonuniform at late times, and bulk quantum fluctuations generate a distinct late-time regime beyond the classical QNM decay.

classification.title_zh: 从准正规模极点到有限 N 的分支割
classification.abstract_zh: 在严格的大 N 极限下，全息热延迟关联函数通常是亚纯的，其晚期行为由孤立的准正规模（QNM）极点决定。我们表明，量级为 1/N^2 的首个体圈修正会定性改变这一结构。在平面 AdS5 黑膜上的标量理论中，单圈体图在固定圈动量 q 下产生位于两个 QNM 频率之和处的极点；对连续动量积分后，这些 QNM 对极点变成分支割。对于外部空间动量消失的情形，对于由实部相反的 QNM 分支构成的对，主导光锥贡献在大动量下抵消，残余 QNM 对频率按 q^{-1/3} 标度。因此，无限族割在零频率处累积，而所有树级 QNM 极点仍位于有限非零频率。于是首个有限 N 修正弥合了经典 QNM 谱所设定的间隙。QNM 对阻尼减小与热 Boltzmann 压制之间的竞争产生一个移动鞍点，并给出有限 N 贡献 G(t) ~ N^{-2} t^α e^{-C t^{3/4}}, C>0，它比主导经典 QNM 贡献衰减得更慢。因此，大 N 展开在晚期是非一致的，体量子涨落生成了超出经典 QNM 衰减的独特晚时区域。
classification.one_liner: 首个 1/N^2 体圈修正把 AdS5 黑膜热关联函数的 QNM 极点转化为分支割，并导致比经典 QNM 更慢的有限 N 晚期衰减。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息热相关函数的 QNM 极点及 1/N^2 体圈修正，与用户重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”直接相关，提供了有限 N 下 QNM 谱结构变化的新结果。

papers.title: Quantum chaos from time-dependent CFT states at large central charge
papers.abstract: We provide a first study of the behavior of four probes on heavy, time-dependent background states of conformal field theories at large central charge. Employing the monodromy method and including subleading corrections to the identity block, we compute the correlation function of two light and two middle-heavy operators on such a heavy background, by switching on a small interaction between the light and middle-heavy sectors. Summing the discontinuity contributions and analytically continuing from Euclidean to Lorentzian signature, we show that the out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC) exhibits maximal chaos, that is, the Lyapunov exponent saturates the MSS bound.

classification.title_zh: 大中心荷下含时 CFT 态的量子混沌
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次研究大中心荷共形场论中重且含时背景态上四个探针的行为。采用 monodromy 方法并包含恒等块的次领头修正，在轻场与中等重场扇区之间引入小相互作用，计算了此类重背景上两个轻算符与两个中等重算符的关联函数。通过求和间断贡献并从欧氏解析延拓到洛伦兹号差，我们表明无序时序关联函数（OTOC）表现出最大混沌，即 Lyapunov 指数饱和 MSS 界。
classification.one_liner: 在大中心荷含时重背景上计算 OTOC，发现最大混沌与 MSS 界饱和。

papers.title: Doubly-spinning Black Saturns
papers.abstract: We construct a six-parameter family of stationary, asymptotically flat solutions of five-dimensional vacuum Einstein gravity describing a spherical black hole surrounded by a black ring, with rotation in both independent planes. In a specific regime both horizons can become extremal, thereby providing the first example of a regular asymptotically flat vacuum Einstein solution with two extremal disconnected horizons. We also show that while non-extremal black Saturns can be in thermodynamic equilibrium, the doubly extremal Saturn cannot. The solution admits the doubly spinning Myers-Perry, the Pomeransky-Sen'kov black ring, and the singly spinning black Saturn as regular limits. We also show agreement with earlier blackfold predictions for the phase diagram of these solutions.

classification.title_zh: 双旋黑洞土星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了五维真空爱因斯坦引力的一个六参数、稳态、渐近平直解族，描述一个球形黑洞被一个黑洞环包围，并在两个独立旋转平面上转动。在特定参数区域，两个视界都可以达到极端，从而给出首个具有两个极端不连通视界的规则渐近平直真空爱因斯坦解。我们还表明，非极端黑洞土星可以处于热力学平衡，而双极端土星不能。该解在规则极限下包含双旋 Myers-Perry 黑洞、Pomeransky-Sen'kov 黑洞环以及单旋黑洞土星。我们还表明，其结果与早期 blackfold 对这些解相图的预言一致。
classification.one_liner: 构造了五维双旋黑洞土星解族，并发现首个具有两个极端不连通视界的规则渐近平直真空爱因斯坦解。

papers.title: Holographic Homogeneous Black Branes from Anisotropic Scaling
papers.abstract: We construct homogeneous anisotropic black branes in Einstein gravity and Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton theory in arbitrary spacetime dimensions. By imposing compatibility between radial scaling and the spatial Lie algebra, we reduce the field equations to radial equations and algebraic constraints on the scaling exponents, curvature, and matter fields. We construct neutral, electric, magnetic, and dyonic solutions, including explicit five-dimensional Bianchi geometries and higher-dimensional families supported by Ricci nilsolitons. We investigate the thermodynamics of these solutions, obtaining their Euclidean action, mass, and entropy scaling. We also study the dynamics of a massive probe scalar, deriving an asymptotic mass bound and an exact purely damped quasinormal spectrum for a particular class of scaling geometries. Numerical calculations further explore the mass, dynamical exponent, and momentum dependence of scalar relaxation in Nil, Solv, and Bianchi type VI geometries. Our results establish a framework for studying thermodynamic and dynamical properties of homogeneous anisotropic scaling geometries that are generally not asymptotically locally anti-de Sitter.

classification.title_zh: 由各向异性标度构造的全息均匀黑膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在任意维度的 Einstein 引力与 Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton 理论中构造均匀各向异性黑膜。通过要求径向标度与空间李代数相容，将场方程约化为径向方程以及对标度指数、曲率和物质场的代数约束。我们构造中性、电、磁和双荷（dyonic）解，包括显式的五维 Bianchi 几何和由 Ricci nilsoliton 支持的高维族。我们研究这些解的热力学，得到其欧几里得作用量、质量和熵的标度。我们还研究大质量探针标量的动力学，推导渐近质量界，并针对一类特殊的标度几何给出精确的纯阻尼准正规模谱。数值计算进一步考察 Nil、Solv 和 Bianchi VI 型几何中标量弛豫对质量、动力学指数和动量的依赖。我们的结果建立了研究均匀各向异性标度几何的热力学与动力学性质的框架，这些几何通常并非渐近局部反 de Sitter。
classification.one_liner: 构造均匀各向异性标度黑膜并研究其热力学与探针标量 QNM/弛豫。

papers.title: Phase Structure and Thermodynamic Geometry of STU Black Holes
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamics of four-dimensional STU black holes, a family of charged solutions of gauged N = 8, SO(8) supergravity, from the perspective of geometric thermodynamics. We focus on non-rotating solutions carrying pairwise-equal charges, obtaining closed-form expressions for the thermodynamic quantities directly in terms of the physical charges, and use them to determine the equation of state and associated phase structure. We also construct the Ruppeiner geometry for the STU black hole, taking the temperature and thermodynamic volume as fluctuation variables, and study its renormalized curvature as a probe of the black hole microstructure. We find a rich phase structure with two critical points present whenever the charge ratio is sufficiently large, and identify regions in parameter space associated with attractive and repulsive microscopic interactions.

classification.title_zh: STU黑洞的相结构与热力学几何
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从几何热力学角度研究四维STU黑洞的热力学性质。STU黑洞是规范N=8、SO(8)超引力中的一类带电解。作者聚焦于非旋转且电荷两两相等的解，直接用物理电荷给出热力学量的闭式表达式，并据此确定状态方程与相结构；同时以温度和热力学体积为涨落变量构造Ruppeiner几何，研究其重整化曲率作为黑洞微观结构的探针。结果发现，当电荷比足够大时存在两个临界点的丰富相结构，并识别出参数空间中对应吸引和排斥微观相互作用的区域。
classification.one_liner: 研究STU黑洞的热力学相结构，并用Ruppeiner几何曲率探测其微观相互作用与临界行为。

papers.title: On Thermodynamics of AdS Black Holes in Square-Root Nonlinear Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Inspired by exponential Maxwell models, we propose a new black hole solution in square root nonlinear electrodynamics. Using the analogy between black hole mechanics and thermodynamics, we investigate the corresponding stability, the P-v criticality and the phase transitions. As a result, we find that the obtained black hole exhibits Van der Waals behaviors without additional corrections which typically appear in universal ratio computations.

classification.title_zh: 平方根非线性电动力学中 AdS 黑洞的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 受指数 Maxwell 模型启发，我们提出平方根非线性电动力学中的一种新黑洞解。利用黑洞力学与热力学之间的类比，我们研究相应的稳定性、P-v 临界性和相变。结果表明，所得黑洞无需通常在全息比率计算中出现的额外修正即可表现出范德瓦尔斯行为。

papers.title: Equivariant Localization with Electric Monodromy in M-theory
papers.abstract: We extend equivariant localization for supersymmetric AdS$_3$ backgrounds of M-theory to solutions with nonzero electric flux periods. The associated local electric potential acquires additive monodromy, contributing to the warped volume alongside R-symmetry fixed points and outer boundaries. Using Killing-spinor identities, we relate the electric periods to magnetic flux and, for a class of compact backgrounds, the warped volume to the electric Maxwell charge. We also derive a relation between the gravitational anomaly and the electric flux. We apply these results to AdS$_3$ $\times S^3 \times S^3 \times T^2$ and AdS$_3$ $\times S^3 \times K3 \times S^1$, recovering their central charges and deriving the R-current levels of the former directly from eleven-dimensional supergravity. Finally, we study a noncompact half-BPS AdS$_3$ $\times S^3\times S^3$ geometry fibered over a periodic half-cylinder, where fixed-point, monodromy and outer-boundary contributions coexist.

classification.title_zh: M理论中带电极单值性的等变局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将M理论中超对称AdS3背景的等变局域化推广到具有非零电通量周期的解。相应的局域电势获得加性单值性，并与R对称不动点和外边界一起贡献翘曲体积。利用Killing旋量恒等式，我们将电周期与磁通量联系起来，并对一类紧致背景把翘曲体积与电Maxwell荷联系起来；还导出引力反常与电通量的关系。应用于 AdS3×S3×S3×T2 和 AdS3×S3×K3×S1，恢复中心荷，并从前一背景的十一维超引力直接导出R流能级。最后研究非紧致半BPS AdS3×S3×S3 几何在周期半圆柱上的纤维化，其中不动点、单值性和外边界贡献共存。
classification.one_liner: 将等变局域化推广到含电极单值性的M理论AdS3超对称背景，并用于计算中心荷与R流能级。

papers.title: Negative and Positive Saddle-Selection Ambiguities in the HTEE
papers.abstract: The holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE), computed via complexified extremal surfaces, suffers from a saddle-selection ambiguity: for sufficiently small time intervals (\(\Delta t\to0\)), both a vacuum-connected and a vacuum-disconnected complex extremal surface contribute, and the minimal-real-part criterion and the vacuum-reduction criterion can favor different saddles. We study this ambiguity in strongly coupled field theories whose dual geometries are hyperscaling-violating Lifshitz backgrounds, in which conformal symmetry and Lorentz invariance are broken by the Lifshitz exponent and the hyperscaling-violation parameter. Working in \(2+1\)- and \(3+1\)-dimensional dual field theories, we derive general expressions for the HTEE in the vacuum-connected and vacuum-disconnected saddles, \(s_{v.c.}\) and \(s_{v.d.}\), respectively, and compare their real parts. We find that the two criteria agree everywhere except at the first accidental zero. The ambiguity appears in two distinct forms. In the \emph{negative} family, \(\operatorname{Re}(s_{v.c.})=0\) and \(\operatorname{Re}(s_{v.d.})<0\), whereas in the \emph{positive} family, \(\operatorname{Re}(s_{v.c.})>0\) and \(\operatorname{Re}(s_{v.d.})=0\). The latter shows that the ambiguity survives even in the conformal \(3+1\)-dimensional case. It therefore seems that the saddle-selection ambiguity is a generic feature of the complexified-geometry prescription.

classification.title_zh: HTEE中的负与正鞍点选择歧义
classification.abstract_zh: 全息时间纠缠熵（HTEE）通过复化极值面计算时存在鞍点选择歧义：当时间间隔足够小（Δt→0）时，真空连通与真空不连通的复极值面均可贡献，而最小实部判据与真空约化判据可能偏向不同鞍点。本文在具有hyperscaling-violating Lifshitz对偶几何的强耦合场论中研究该歧义；这些背景因Lifshitz指数和hyperscaling-violation参数而破坏共形对称性与洛伦兹不变性。作者在2+1维和3+1维对偶场论中给出真空连通鞍点与真空不连通鞍点的HTEE一般表达式s_{v.c.}与s_{v.d.}，并比较其实部，发现两种判据除第一个偶然零点外处处一致。歧义表现为两类：负 family 中Re(s_{v.c.})=0且Re(s_{v.d.})<0；正 family 中Re(s_{v.c.})>0且Re(s_{v.d.})=0。后者表明该歧义在共形3+1维情形中仍然存在，因而鞍点选择歧义似乎是复化几何方案的一般特征。
classification.one_liner: 研究全息时间纠缠熵中复化极值面的鞍点选择歧义，并在hyperscaling-violating Lifshitz背景中比较真空连通与真空不连通鞍点的实部。

papers.title: A proof of Nakamura's conjecture
papers.abstract: We prove Nakamura's conjecture on the relation between the 2D Toda model and solutions of the Ernst equation, using the Pfaffian solutions obtained in our previous work arXiv:2610.27420.

classification.title_zh: Nakamura 猜想的证明
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用在先前工作 arXiv:2610.27420 中得到的 Pfaffian 解，证明了 Nakamura 关于 2D Toda 模型与 Ernst 方程解之间关系的猜想。

papers.title: On the Spontaneous symmetry breaking of Conformal Gravity to Weyl and Einstein Gravities
papers.abstract: Does the special-conformal connection remain an auxiliary field when a spontaneously broken conformal gauge theory is promoted to a fully dynamical Yang-Mills-Higgs theory, and under what conditions does its elimination yield Weyl gravity? We address these questions within an $\mathrm{SO}(2,4)$ gauge-theoretic formulation of gravity. Revisiting the gravitational sector selected by spontaneous symmetry breaking through an adjoint $15$-plet, we retain the special-conformal connection as an independent field and demonstrate that, on a source-free projected branch, its algebraic equation of motion determines it in terms of the Schouten tensor. Eliminating this connection yields the four-dimensional Weyl-squared action, up to the Euler density, without imposing the Schouten relation as an additional geometrical constraint. We then extend the analysis to the standard local Yang-Mills-Higgs theory and show that the special-conformal connection remains auxiliary, owing to the structure of the invariant bilinear form of $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$, which prevents the appearance of an independent kinetic operator. The additional gauge and scalar sectors can modify its algebraic solution, so the exact Weyl reduction is restricted to the source-free branch. We further investigate the linearised spectrum of the reduced Weyl theory around de Sitter spacetime, identifying massless and partially massless spin-2 branches, with the latter occurring at $m_{\mathrm{PM}}^2=2\Lambda/3$. Finally, we discuss the subsequent symmetry breaking induced by an antisymmetric scalar $6$-plet and its role in connecting the Weyl-gravity phase to Einstein gravity.

classification.title_zh: 论共形引力自发破缺为外尔引力和爱因斯坦引力
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 SO(2,4) 规范理论框架下研究共形引力。作者将 special-conformal connection 作为独立场保留，并在无源投影分支上证明其代数运动方程可由 Schouten 张量确定；消去该联络后得到四维 Weyl-squared 作用量（至 Euler 密度），而无需额外施加 Schouten 关系。随后将分析推广到标准局域 Yang-Mills-Higgs 理论，指出由于 so(2,4) 不变双线性形式的结构，该联络仍为辅助场，但额外规范场与标量扇区会修改其代数解，因此精确的外尔约化限于无源分支。文章还研究约化外尔理论在 de Sitter 背景附近的线性谱，识别出无质量及部分无质量自旋-2 分支，后者满足 m_PM^2=2Λ/3，并讨论反对称标量 6-plet 引起的后续对称破缺及其连接外尔引力相与爱因斯坦引力的作用。
classification.one_liner: 在 SO(2,4) 规范理论中分析共形引力自发破缺、辅助联络消去得到外尔引力及进一步约化到爱因斯坦引力的条件。

papers.title: Holographic Entanglement after a Global Quench in Noncommutative Yang-Mills Theory
papers.abstract: The time evolution of holographic entanglement entropy and mixed-state correlations following a global quench in four-dimensional N=4 noncommutative Yang-Mills theory is investigated using a Vaidya geometry. For strip-shaped regions extended along a noncommutative direction, two distinct early-time growth regimes emerge, depending on the relation between the shell-crossing and noncommutative scales: logarithmic growth, with a coefficient proportional to the injected energy density and the square of the noncommutative scale, followed by quadratic growth. For sufficiently wide strips, an intermediate linear-growth regime appears, governed by an entanglement velocity that increases with noncommutativity. The approach to equilibrium is also examined, revealing the role of the butterfly velocity in the continuous evolution of extremal surfaces, while competing branches can modify the physical saturation time. For two disjoint strips, the leading width-independent logarithmic contribution cancels in the mutual information, whereas the entanglement wedge cross section exhibits an intermediate linear-growth regime governed by the same entanglement velocity, provided the connected entanglement wedge remains dominant.

classification.title_zh: 非交换 Yang-Mills 理论全局淬火后的全息纠缠
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用 Vaidya 几何研究四维 N=4 非交换 Yang-Mills 理论中全局淬火后全息纠缠熵与混合态关联的时间演化。对于沿非交换方向延展的条带区域，根据壳层穿越尺度与非交换尺度的关系，早期会出现两种不同增长阶段：先是对数增长，其系数与注入能量密度和非交换尺度平方成正比，随后是二次增长。对于足够宽的条带，还存在中间线性增长阶段，由随非交换性增强的纠缠速度控制。文章还考察了趋近平衡的过程，揭示蝴蝶速度在极值面连续演化中的作用，并指出竞争分支可改变物理饱和时间。对于两个不相交条带，互信息中主导的与宽度无关的对数贡献相消，而纠缠楔截面在连通纠缠楔仍占主导时表现出由同一纠缠速度控制的中间线性增长。
classification.one_liner: 用 Vaidya 几何刻画非交换 N=4 SYM 全局淬火后全息纠缠熵、互信息与纠缠楔截面的时间演化。

papers.title: Conditional Principle of Least Action: Gauge Algebra and Noether's Second Theorem
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of a conditional extremum of an action within a class of fields constrained by differential equations. For this setup, we establish the interconnection between the gauge symmetry algebra of the equations constraining the admissible fields and that of the action restricted to this class of fields. Based on this relation between the two gauge algebras, we derive an extension of Noether's second theorem and its converse. The general method is illustrated by the example of linearized gravity with the Einstein-Hilbert action and the class of admissible metrics restricted by the Cotton equation.

classification.title_zh: 条件最小作用量原理：规范代数与诺特第二定理
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在一类受微分方程约束的场中作用量的条件极值问题，建立约束方程规范对称代数与限制到该类场上的作用量规范代数之间的联系；据此推导诺特第二定理及其逆定理的扩展，并以受 Cotton 方程约束的线性化引力及 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量为例说明该方法。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出条件变分框架下规范代数与诺特第二定理的形式推广，并以线性化引力为例说明。

papers.title: Stochastic gauge fixing from the holographic renormalization group
papers.abstract: We extend the dictionary between stochastic quantization and holographic Wilsonian renormalization to Yang-Mills theory in four-dimensional anti-de Sitter space at tree level. The radial component of the bulk gauge field is Zwanziger's gauge-fixing function; radial gauge is Parisi-Wu quantization, whose random walk of gauge modes is the longitudinal bulk propagator. We obtain the triple- and quadruple-trace couplings of gluons at finite cutoff in closed form. On transverse data, their dependence on the bulk gauge resides in a single zero mode, which drops out of the flat-space limit.

classification.title_zh: 从全息重整化群看随机规范固定
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将随机量子化与全息Wilson重整化群之间的字典推广到四维反德西特空间中的Yang-Mills理论（树图阶）。体规范场的径向分量是Zwanziger规范固定函数；径向规范对应Parisi-Wu量子化，规范模的随机游走由纵向体传播子描述。我们以闭式得到有限截断下胶子的三重和四重迹耦合。对横向数据，它们对体规范的依赖集中于单个零模，该零模在平直空间极限下消失。
classification.one_liner: 把随机量子化与全息Wilson重整化群对应推广到AdS4 Yang-Mills，并给出有限截断下胶子多重迹耦合的闭式结果。

papers.title: A Bound on Wormhole Probing Time from Holographic Multi-Entropy
papers.abstract: Bipartite entanglement entropy eventually saturates and therefore cannot track the continued growth of an eternal wormhole. Recently, it was shown that genuine tripartite multi-entropy can probe wormhole growth even after bipartite entanglement entropies have saturated. This naturally raises the question: can increasing the number of parties extend the probing time indefinitely? Adopting the multiway maximin prescription and assuming that its selected representatives are regular spacetime-stationary networks, we prove that the answer is no for nonrotating BTZ black holes. We establish a common finite upper bound on the probing time for every fixed finite boundary partition, independent of the number, sizes, and arrangement of its parties. For any network on any Cauchy slice, there exists a comparison network that assigns the entire central region containing the wormhole interior to a single party. A network longer than this comparison network cannot minimize length on that slice. The central length required by a stationary network connecting the two boundaries grows with time, whereas the central length of the comparison network remains uniformly bounded. At sufficiently late times, such a network therefore cannot minimize length on any Cauchy slice containing it and is excluded from the maximin prescription. Consequently, beyond this bound, no network selected by maximin enters the black-hole interior.

classification.title_zh: 全息多熵给出的虫洞探测时间上界
classification.abstract_zh: 双分纠缠熵最终会饱和，因此无法追踪永恒虫洞的持续增长。最近的工作表明，真正的三分量多熵即使在双分纠缠熵饱和后仍能探测虫洞增长。这自然引出一个问题：增加参与方的数量能否无限延长探测时间？采用 multiway maximin 处方，并假设其选出的代表是规则的时空平稳网络，我们证明对非旋转 BTZ 黑洞答案是否定的。对每个固定的有限边界划分，我们建立一个共同的有限探测时间上界，该上界与参与方的数量、大小和排列无关。对任意 Cauchy 切片上的任意网络，存在一个比较网络，将包含虫洞内部的整个中心区域分配给单一参与方。比该比较网络更长的网络不能在该切片上最小化长度。连接两个边界的平稳网络所需的中心长度随时间增长，而比较网络的中心长度一致有界。因此，在足够晚的时刻，这种网络不能在包含它的任何 Cauchy 切片上最小化长度，并被排除在 maximin 处方之外。 consequently，超过该上界后，maximin 选出的网络不会进入黑洞内部。
classification.one_liner: 对非旋转 BTZ 黑洞，多熵的 multiway maximin 网络存在与边界划分无关的有限虫洞探测时间上界。
