papers.title: Constants and Nonperturbative Corrections in $V^{5,2}$ Theories
papers.abstract: We study perturbative and exponentially small corrections to the on-shell effective twisted superpotentials of two three-dimensional $\mathcal N=2$ theories associated with free and fixed-locus cyclic quotients of the non-toric Sasaki-Einstein manifold $V^{5,2}$. These are the two-node Chern-Simons theory at levels $(k,-k)$ and the one-node flavored theory with $N_f$ fundamental pairs, respectively. At superconformal chemical potentials, we propose the Chern-Simons counterpart of the all-order perturbative expression for the flavored theory and obtain convergent integral representations for the rank-independent constants of both theories. At integer parameters, these constants admit explicit evaluations involving finite sums of Clausen functions and $\zeta(3)$, while their large-parameter expansions Borel sum to the defining integrals. At $k=1,3$ and $N_f=1,3$, we conjecture complete exponential remainders expressed through Eichler integrals of weight-four Eisenstein series. Supported by high-precision Bethe solutions, the resulting completions coincide at unit quotient order but differ at order three. We determine the minimal modular levels of the Eisenstein generators and establish convergence and natural boundaries for their primitives. Within the relative M-theory localization prescription, a complementary bulk analysis recovers the Chern-Simons shifted rank and constant in the $b\to0^+$ limit of the squashed-sphere partition function. We propose a generalization incorporating fixed-locus contributions that yields the corresponding flavored-theory result. The two theories therefore share a modular structure in their nonperturbative coefficient laws, but distinct perturbative shifts and exponential corrections resolve differences invisible in their common leading $N^{3/2}$ behavior.

classification.title_zh: V^{5,2} 理论中的常数与非微扰修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究两个三维 N=2 理论在壳有效扭曲超势的微扰与指数小修正；这两个理论分别对应非环 Sasaki-Einstein 流形 V^{5,2} 的自由循环商与固定轨迹循环商：两节点 Chern-Simons 理论（能级 (k,-k)）和含 N_f 个基本对的一节点风味理论。在超共形化学势下，我们提出风味理论全阶微扰表达式的 Chern-Simons 对应物，并得到两理论 rank 无关常数的收敛积分表示。在整数参数下，这些常数可显式求值为 Clausen 函数有限和与 ζ(3)，其大参数展开 Borel 求和到定义积分。对 k=1,3 和 N_f=1,3，我们猜测以权四 Eisenstein 级数 Eichler 积分表示的完整指数余项。由高精度 Bethe 解支持，所得完备化在单位商阶一致，但在三阶不同。我们确定 Eisenstein 生成元的最小模 level，并建立其原函数的收敛性与自然边界。在相对 M-theory 局域化方案中，补充的体分析在压扁球配分函数的 b→0^+ 极限下恢复 Chern-Simons 移位 rank 与常数。我们提出一个纳入固定轨迹贡献的推广，给出相应风味理论结果。因此两理论在非微扰系数律上共享模结构，但不同的微扰移位与指数修正分辨出共同领头 N^{3/2} 行为中不可见的差异。
classification.one_liner: 比较 V^{5,2} 上两类三维 N=2 Chern-Simons/风味理论的微扰常数与指数小修正，并发现共享模结构但细节不同。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT/M-theory 局域化与三维 N=2 规范理论的形式研究；未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Schwarzschild scattering from CFT
papers.abstract: We show that retarded CFT correlators on $\mathbb{R}\times \mathbb{S}^2$ in a state described by the small black hole in AdS$_4$ can be used to derive asymptotically flat Schwarzschild partial-wave S-matrix elements, including its spectrum of quasinormal modes. This is achieved by identifying a class of operators for which the dual bulk fields behave as plane waves near the AdS boundary for sufficiently high frequencies. For such operators there is a simple analytic relation between CFT correlators and reflection coefficients which behaves gracefully in the flat space limit, $L\to \infty$. These include spin-1, spin-2, and conformally coupled scalars. We provide a simple toy model that captures how dissipative QNMs can appear for short times inside Hermitian systems, closely resembling the small black hole in AdS.

classification.title_zh: 从 CFT 看 Schwarzschild 散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，在 AdS4 中小黑洞所描述的状态下，R×S^2 上的延迟 CFT 关联函数可用于推导渐近平直 Schwarzschild 的分波 S 矩阵元，包括其准正规模谱。这是通过识别一类算符实现的：在足够高频率下，其对偶体场在 AdS 边界附近表现为平面波。对于这类算符，CFT 关联函数与反射系数之间存在简单的解析关系，并在平直空间极限 L→∞ 下表现良好。这些算符包括自旋 1、自旋 2 以及共形耦合标量。我们提供了一个简单玩具模型，捕捉耗散性 QNM 如何在短时间内在厄米系统中出现，并与 AdS 中的小黑洞密切相关。
classification.one_liner: 利用 AdS4 小黑洞态下的 CFT 延迟关联函数推导渐近平直 Schwarzschild 分波 S 矩阵和 QNM 谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要直接给出 QNM 谱与 CFT 关联函数的关系，属于 QNM 相关支线，但未涉及非线性演化或其他重点方向。

papers.title: A dual-moment phenomenological framework for gravitational,electromagnetic and strong interactions
papers.abstract: The unification of fundamental interactions remains an outstanding open problem in fundamental physics. Most existing unification schemes rely on extra dimensions, exotic symmetries, or unobserved dynamical degrees of freedom. Here we construct a minimal classical phenomenological framework built on primitive charges and motion-induced kinetic dual moments. Gravitational, electromagnetic, and strong interactions are coherently formulated within a unified inverse-square-law structure. We postulate a universal coupling relation connecting source-charge couplings and moment-mediated couplings across these interaction sectors. Although weak-charge degrees of freedom can be formally accommodated within the formalism, full quantitative treatment of weak-interaction dynamics is left for future work. The model recovers well-established low-energy limits for planetary orbits, atomic systems, and heavy-quark hadrons. Importantly, it yields distinguishable corrections to light deflection by rapidly spinning compact objects, and three independent experimental schemes are proposed to test these predictions.

classification.title_zh: 引力、电磁与强相互作用的双矩唯象框架
classification.abstract_zh: 基本相互作用的统一仍是基础物理中的未解问题。多数现有统一方案依赖额外维度、奇异对称性或未被观测到的动力学自由度。本文构建一个基于原始荷与运动诱导动能双矩的最小经典唯象框架，将引力、电磁与强相互作用统一表述在平方反比定律结构中。作者假设一个普适耦合关系，联系这些相互作用部门中的源荷耦合与矩介导耦合。弱荷自由度虽可在形式体系中容纳，但弱相互作用动力学的完整定量处理留待未来工作。该模型恢复了行星轨道、原子系统与重夸克强子的既有低能极限；重要的是，它对快速旋转致密天体造成的光偏折给出可区分修正，并提出三种独立实验方案检验这些预言。
classification.one_liner: 提出一个用原始荷与运动诱导双矩统一描述引力、电磁和强相互作用的经典唯象框架，并给出致密天体光偏折的可检验修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论相关唯象研究，涉及引力相互作用与致密天体光偏折检验；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT、量子信息或用户列出的全息凝聚态/超流等主线。

papers.title: SPH methods in the modelling of compact objects
papers.abstract: We review the current status of compact object simulations that are based on the Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) method. The first section of this review is dedicated to SPH as a numerical method for Newtonian, ideal gas dynamics and it should be fairly self-contained. It begins with the basics of the method, but also describes recent advances including various meshless derivatives or methods for treating shocks. A separate chapter summarizes general relativistic SPH, including its special relativistic limit, and it explains in some detail the recent development of full numerical relativity in SPH where matter is evolved together with a dynamical spacetime. The remainder of the review has an astrophysical focus, here we discuss the status of the simulations of white dwarf--white dwarf, neutron star--neutron star and neutron star--black hole systems. For each type of system the emphasis is on gravitational-wave-driven mergers, but we also briefly summarize dynamical collisions that can occur in locations with large stellar densities.

classification.title_zh: 紧致天体建模中的 SPH 方法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文综述基于光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）方法的紧致天体模拟现状。第一部分介绍 SPH 作为牛顿理想气体动力学数值方法的基础，并讨论无网格导数、激波处理等近期进展。另一章总结广义相对论 SPH，包括其狭义相对论极限，并较详细说明 SPH 中完整数值相对论的新发展，即将物质与动力学时空一起演化。综述余下部分聚焦天体物理应用，讨论双白矮星、双中子星和中子星—黑洞系统的模拟现状；对每类系统重点在于引力波驱动的并合，同时简要总结在高恒星密度环境中可能发生的动力学碰撞。
classification.one_liner: 综述 SPH 方法及其在紧致天体、广义相对论流体与引力波并合模拟中的应用。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是紧致天体 SPH 模拟与数值相对论方法综述，属于经典引力/计算天体物理，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Gas-induced gravitational-wave dephasing and accretion periodicities of live post-Newtonian massive black hole binaries: warm disk
papers.abstract: We perform 3D hydrodynamical simulations of an equal-mass quasi-circular live $10^6 {\rm M}_\odot$ massive black hole binary (MBHB) embedded in a prograde, locally isothermal circumbinary disk (CBD) with 0.1 aspect ratio. The binary evolves under the effect of gaseous torques and 2.5 post-Newtonian dynamics. We follow the gravitational-wave (GW) driven inspiral from 53 Schwarzschild radii ($r_s$) down to merger, over 1.5 years. Comparing the GW inspiral rate with the viscous inflow, we find the binary to decouple from the CBD just $\approx 2$ days before merger. We measure gas torques (gravitational and accretion) with and without concurrent GW emission, finding that their sums agree to within $\lesssim 5\%$ down to $25 r_s$. We then measure a gas-induced GW phase shift that peaks at $\approx 5\times10^{-4}$ rad near $45 r_s$, as the gas torque slows the inspiral, and then changes sign as the accreted mass accelerates it. It is LISA-detectable only at $z\lesssim 0.1$. We further characterize the mass accretion rate modulations. All three fundamental periodicities, associated with the "lump" at the inner cavity edge, the binary orbital period, and half of it, are shifted to lower frequencies by precession. We measure the shift at the orbital period, due to relativistic apsidal precession, in an inspiraling binary for the first time, and newly identify the other two as due to the precession of the eccentric cavity. Our results have implications for multi-messenger astronomy, since observation of accretion rate modulation by LSST/Roman surveys and phase-shift by LISA will provide crucial information on the complex environment surrounding MBHBs.

classification.title_zh: 实时演化后牛顿大质量黑洞双星的气体诱导引力波退相与吸积周期性：暖盘
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对一个等质量、准圆轨道、正在演化的10^6 M⊙大质量黑洞双星进行三维流体动力学模拟，该双星嵌入顺行、局部等温、纵横比为0.1的环双星盘。双星在气体力矩和2.5阶后牛顿动力学下演化。我们追踪由引力波驱动的旋近，从53史瓦西半径到并合，历时1.5年。比较引力波旋近率与黏性内流，发现双星在并合前约2天与环双星盘退耦。我们测量有/无同时引力波辐射时的气体力矩（引力与吸积），发现二者总和在至25 r_s范围内一致到≲5%。随后测量气体诱导的引力波相位移动，在45 r_s附近达到约5×10^-4 rad峰值：气体力矩减慢旋近，而吸积质量加速旋近后符号改变。该相移仅在z≲0.1时LISA可探测。我们进一步刻画质量吸积率调制。与内腔边缘“团块”、双星轨道周期及其一半有关的三个基本周期，均因进动移动到较低频率。我们首次在旋近双星中测量轨道周期处由相对论性近星点进动引起的频移，并新识别另外两个周期源于偏心腔的进动。结果对多信使天文学有意义：LSST/Roman观测吸积率调制和LISA观测相移将提供MBHB周围复杂环境的关键信息。
classification.one_liner: 三维流体模拟表明，环双星盘气体使后牛顿大质量黑洞双星产生约10^-4 rad量级的引力波退相，并调制吸积率周期性；LISA仅在低红移可探测相移。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，涉及后牛顿动力学、引力波与吸积盘相互作用；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Pulsar timing arrays: the emerging gravitational-wave landscape
papers.abstract: Pulsar Timing Array (PTA) experiments have found evidence for a nanoHertz gravitational wave (GW) background (GWB). The challenge is now to turn evidence for a GWB into an understanding of the sources and physics that produce it. This review connects the physics of the Hellings--Downs correlation to the interpretation of the GWB spectrum and anisotropy, asking whether supermassive black hole binary populations consistent with electromagnetic observations can explain the signal. Searches for individual binaries take these questions further: multi-messenger observations and pulsar terms can reveal the evolution of these binary systems. Realizing this potential requires reliable noise models and candidate validation. We explain how pulsar noise, unresolved sources, and incomplete sky coverage limit these inferences. The same PTA observations also probe cosmic strings and ultralight dark matter, while fitted timing parameters extend GW searches to picohertz frequencies and enable measurements of Galactic acceleration. Rapid data combination and the larger, more precisely timed arrays expected from the Square Kilometre Array Observatory and Deep Synoptic Array will increase the sensitivity of these searches and measurements, sharpening our view of the emerging GW landscape.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列：正在显现的引力波图景
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）实验已发现纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）的证据。当前的挑战是将GWB的证据转化为对其来源和产生物理的理解。本综述将Hellings–Downs相关性的物理与GWB频谱和各向异性的解释联系起来，追问与电磁观测一致的超大质量黑洞双星种群能否解释该信号。对单个双星的搜寻进一步推进这些问题：多信使观测和脉冲星项可以揭示这些双星系统的演化。实现这一潜力需要可靠的噪声模型和候选体验证。我们解释脉冲星噪声、未分辨源和不完整的天空覆盖如何限制这些推断。同样的PTA观测还可探测宇宙弦和超轻暗物质，而拟合的计时参数将引力波搜寻扩展到皮赫兹频率，并使得银河系加速度的测量成为可能。快速的数据联合以及Square Kilometre Array Observatory和Deep Synoptic Array预期提供的更大、计时更精确的阵列将提高这些搜寻和测量的灵敏度，从而锐化我们对正在显现的引力波图景的看法。
classification.one_liner: 综述脉冲星计时阵列纳赫兹引力波背景的证据、源解释、噪声限制及未来阵列前景。
classification.relevance_reason: 不涉及AdS/CFT或全息理论；主题为PTA引力波天文与经典引力/天体物理，与用户全息重点关联低。

papers.title: Kerr metric perturbations in Lorenz gauge via numerical relativity methods
papers.abstract: Gravitational self-force calculations are needed to accurately describe the motion of a small body in a spinning (Kerr) black hole spacetime, which is vital to predict gravitational wave signals from asymmetric-mass compact binaries. Accurate calculations for the upcoming LISA mission require a minimum of second perturbative order in the mass ratio, which has thus far only been achieved for nonspinning (Schwarzschild) black holes due to nonlinear complexities of the Einstein equations. In this work, we calculate Kerr metric perturbations with a new computational approach based on numerical relativity methods, extending recent scalar self-force results to full general relativity. We formulate the perturbative Lorenz-gauge Einstein equations in terms of azimuthal $m$-modes in the frequency domain and solve the resulting elliptic partial differential equations using a spectral discontinuous Galerkin discretization, adaptive mesh refinement, and preconditioned iterative solvers. With our new method, we achieve exponentially convergent first-order gravitational self-force calculations for circular equatorial orbits in Kerr spacetime up to spin $|a|/M=0.998$ (the Thorne limit). Our framework is designed to carry over to second order by delivering accurate and well-behaved first-order data for nonlinear source construction, and as a solver for the second-order metric perturbations themselves.

classification.title_zh: 利用数值相对论方法计算Lorenz规范下的Kerr度规微扰
classification.abstract_zh: 引力自力计算需要精确描述小质量天体在旋转Kerr黑洞时空中的运动，这对预测非对称质量致密双星的引力波信号至关重要。为满足LISA任务需求，质量比至少需计算到二阶微扰，但由于Einstein方程的非线性复杂性，此前仅在非旋转Schwarzschild黑洞情形实现。本文提出一种基于数值相对论方法的新计算途径，将近期标量自力结果推广到完整广义相对论，计算Kerr度规微扰。作者在频域中以方位角m模表述Lorenz规范微扰Einstein方程，并使用谱间断Galerkin离散、自适应网格加密和预条件迭代求解器求解所得椭圆型偏微分方程。该方法对Kerr时空中圆赤道轨道实现了指数收敛的一阶引力自力计算，自旋达到|a|/M=0.998（Thorne极限）。该框架设计为可推广到二阶：既能为非线性源构造提供准确且性态良好的一阶数据，也可作为二阶度规微扰本身的求解器。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于数值相对论方法的Lorenz规范Kerr度规一阶微扰求解器，用于引力自力计算并可扩展至二阶。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究Kerr黑洞时空中的经典度规微扰、Einstein方程与引力自力计算，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: High-cadence GW astrometry in the $\mu$Hz gap
papers.abstract: We forecast the sensitivity of a dedicated, fast-spinning astrometric survey to a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) in the microhertz gap between pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and LISA. Spinning the satellite faster samples each star more often, raising the Nyquist frequency and opening higher frequencies at no cost in noise: the shorter, noisier exposures are exactly compensated by their number, so the white-noise floor of each position stream is independent of cadence. High frequencies are where astrometry is most competitive, because the deflection measures the strain directly: its strain noise is white, whereas the equivalent noise of pulsar timing grows as $f^2$. With a cross-correlation estimator over $N$ reference stars and the astrometric overlap computed in the distant-source limit, we find that a Gaia-like satellite scanning the ecliptic poles, with $N\sim10^4$ bright stars over $10$~yr, falls short of the background measured by PTAs by a factor $\sim\!60$. A larger, $8$-m-class aperture, or a constellation of satellites covering the whole sky, reaches it, while extending the reach continuously across the $\mu$Hz band.

classification.title_zh: μHz 间隙中的高采样率引力波天体测量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们预测了一种专用、快速旋转的天体测量巡天对位于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）与 LISA 之间微赫兹间隙中的随机引力波背景（SGWB）的灵敏度。更快旋转卫星可更频繁地采样每颗恒星，提高奈奎斯特频率并在不增加噪声成本的情况下打开更高频率：更短但噪声更大的曝光恰好被其数量补偿，因此每个位置流的白噪声基底与采样率无关。高频是天体测量最具竞争力的频段，因为偏转直接测量应变：其应变噪声为白色，而脉冲星计时的等效噪声随 f^2 增长。利用对 N 颗参考星的互相关估计量以及在远源极限下计算的天体测量重叠，我们发现一颗类似 Gaia 的卫星扫描黄极，在 10 年中对 N~10^4 颗亮星进行观测，仍比 PTA 测得的背景低约 60 倍。更大口径的 8 米级望远镜或覆盖全天区的卫星星座可以达到该灵敏度，同时将探测范围连续扩展到整个 μHz 频段。
classification.one_liner: 评估快速旋转天体测量巡天在 μHz 间隙探测随机引力波背景的灵敏度，并指出需更大口径或卫星星座才能达到 PTA 水平。

papers.title: MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data
papers.abstract: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBurst search. The observed total source-frame masses, extracted from official gravitational wave transient catalogues, are in the $14-236 M_{\odot}$ range with a median of $69 M_{\odot}$, and a median SNR of 16. We note that the recovered fraction of confident detections rises with mass: for LIGO detectors network SNR $>10$ the pipeline recovers $8.1\%$ of confident catalog events below $30 M_{\odot}$, $39.8\%$ between $30$ and $100 M_{\odot}$, and $53.3\%$ above $100 M_{\odot}$, corresponding to $33.3\%$, $45.5\%$ and $53.3\%$ of the events detected by coherent WaveBurst in the same bins. These results suggest that anomaly detection pipelines can serve as an independent detection channel complementary to matched filtering in the high-mass high-SNR regime.

classification.title_zh: MADGRAV：一种用于引力波搜索的多级异常检测流程，并应用于LIGO数据
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示MADGRAV的结果，这是一种基于深度学习的高质量紧凑双星并合搜索，应用于LIGO干涉仪在第三次观测运行以及第四次观测运行第一和第二部分收集的数据。MADGRAV流程由一系列顺序卷积神经网络组成，执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性检验和信号排序。通过1秒Q变换窗口研究Hanford和Livingston LIGO探测器的数据（包括单独和相干分析）。在通过流程每一阶段的候选中，48个达到显著性阈值，我们报告47个引力波探测，其虚警率低于1/yr，天体物理起源概率p_astro>0.9。47个探测中有44个与最小模型相干WaveBurst搜索共享。从官方引力波瞬变目录提取的观测源帧总质量在14-236 M_sun范围，中位数为69 M_sun，中位信噪比为16。我们注意到恢复的置信探测比例随质量上升：对于LIGO探测器网络SNR>10，流程在30 M_sun以下恢复8.1%的置信目录事件，在30至100 M_sun之间恢复39.8%，在100 M_sun以上恢复53.3%，对应相同区间内相干WaveBurst探测事件的33.3%、45.5%和53.3%。这些结果表明异常检测流程可作为高质量高信噪比区域中匹配滤波的独立互补探测通道。
classification.one_liner: MADGRAV多级深度学习异常检测流程在LIGO O3/O4数据中报告47个高质量紧凑双星并合引力波探测，并与相干WaveBurst搜索互补。

papers.title: Optical and Dynamical Signatures of Pad\'{e} Approximated Wormholes in $f(T)$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct traversable wormhole solutions in the linear teleparallel model $f(T) = \alpha T + \beta$, adopting Pad\'e approximants of order [1/0] and [0/1] as shape functions together with the redshift function $\Phi(r) = -M/r$, and derive the corresponding source terms from the modified field equations. We assess the physical viability of both configurations through the energy conditions, Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equilibrium, the volume integral quantifier, thin-shell junction matching to an exterior Schwarzschild geometry, embedding diagrams, proper radial distance, the gravitational energy and the active mass. We then examine the observational signatures of each geometry by analysing equatorial null geodesics and the photon-sphere structure, computing shadow maps and radial intensity profiles, ray-tracing relativistic images of a geometrically thin accretion disc, and integrating timelike rosette orbits. Finally, we study the dynamical stability of both wormholes through a third-order WKB quasinormal-mode analysis across scalar, electromagnetic, and axial gravitational perturbations, cross-checked against time-domain evolution and the eikonal photon-sphere correspondence, and examine the parameter dependence of the mode spectrum together with the possibility of trapped-mode echoes.

classification.title_zh: f(T)引力中Padé近似虫洞的光学与动力学特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在线性远平行模型 f(T)=αT+β 中构造可穿越虫洞解，采用[1/0]和[0/1]阶Padé近似作为形状函数，并取红移函数 Φ(r)=-M/r，由修改场方程导出相应源项。我们通过能量条件、Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff平衡、体积积分量、与外部Schwarzschild几何的薄壳匹配、嵌入图、固有径向距离、引力能和有效质量评估两种构型的物理可行性。随后分析赤道零测地线和光子球结构，计算阴影图和径向强度分布，对几何薄吸积盘相对论像进行光线追踪，并积分类时玫瑰轨道，以考察观测特征。最后通过标量、电磁和轴向引力扰动的三阶WKB准正规模分析研究两种虫洞的动力学稳定性，并用时域演化和eikonal光子球对应进行交叉检验，考察模谱的参数依赖以及囚禁模回声的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 该文在f(T)远平行引力中构造Padé近似可穿越虫洞，并系统研究其能量条件、光学阴影、吸积盘像与QNM稳定性。

papers.title: The Einstein Tensor from UV-regulated Field Correlations
papers.abstract: It is known that the spacetime metric can be recovered from quantum field correlators. We extend this programme by showing that the Einstein tensor can be directly written in terms of UV-regulated field correlations. The same correlation structure also directly determines the Ricci tensor, while higher coincidence derivatives recover the connection and Riemann tensor. We further show that the renormalized stress-energy tensor can be formulated within this framework, up to the standard finite renormalization freedom. These results provide a correlation-based organization of the semiclassical Einstein equations and advance the programme of formulating spacetime geometry in terms of quantum field correlations.

classification.title_zh: 来自紫外正规化场关联的爱因斯坦张量
classification.abstract_zh: 已知时空度规可从量子场关联子中恢复。本文进一步证明，爱因斯坦张量可直接写成紫外正规化场关联的函数；同一关联结构也直接决定里奇张量，而更高阶重合导数可恢复联络和黎曼张量。作者还表明，重整化应力能量张量可在该框架内表述，只差标准的有限重整化自由度。这些结果给出了半经典爱因斯坦方程的关联子组织形式，并推进了用量子场关联表述时空几何的计划。
classification.one_liner: 用紫外正规化量子场关联直接构造爱因斯坦张量、里奇张量与半经典爱因斯坦方程的关联子表述。

papers.title: A Buchdahl solution generator for Einstein-sigma gravity and multiscalar-tensor gravity
papers.abstract: Buchdahl transformations provide a geometric route from vacuum spacetimes to scalar-field solutions. We formulate this mechanism as a target-covariant solution generator for Einstein gravity coupled to nonlinear sigma models in $D>3$ dimensions. On any connected region in which a Ricci-flat seed admits a non-null hypersurface-orthogonal cyclic coordinate with fixed-sign nonzero norm, the logarithm of that norm defines a Buchdahl potential $\Sigma$. A one-parameter redistribution of the cyclic norm then generates the exact Ricci source $R_{AB}=C_D(\beta)\partial_A\Sigma\partial_B\Sigma$, with $C_D(\beta)=\frac{D-2}{D-3}(1-\beta^2)$, while $\Sigma$ remains harmonic in the deformed metric. Composing $\Sigma$ with an affinely parametrized geodesic of a non-degenerate target metric whose squared speed is $C_D(\beta)$ therefore yields an exact Einstein--sigma-model solution. For positive-definite targets, the corresponding pullback condition also implies that the nontrivial scalar map has one-dimensional image; for indefinite targets, the geodesic ansatz remains a sufficient solution-generating sector but need not exhaust all possible realizations of the same rank-one spacetime source. Through the Einstein/Jordan-frame correspondence, the construction gives vacuum tensor-multiscalar solutions as well. We illustrate the unified generator with flat, spherical, hyperbolic and axion-dilaton targets and with Tangherlini, Weyl, Kasner, Rosen-wave, Gowdy, Kaluza-Klein bubble and C-metric seeds. The result separates cleanly the geometric Buchdahl source from its target-space realization and extends this rank-one cyclic sector across static, cosmological, wave and accelerating geometries.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-sigma引力与多标量-张量引力的Buchdahl解生成器
classification.abstract_zh: Buchdahl变换提供了从真空时空到标量场解的几何途径。本文将这一机制表述为D>3维中Einstein引力耦合非线性sigma模型的目标协变解生成器。在Ricci平坦种子时空的任一连通区域上，若存在一个非零法向、超曲面正交的循环坐标且其范数符号固定且非零，则该范数的对数定义Buchdahl势Σ。对循环范数作单参数重分配后，可生成精确Ricci源R_AB=C_D(β)∂_AΣ∂_BΣ，其中C_D(β)=(D-2)/(D-3)(1-β^2)，且Σ在变形度规中保持调和。将Σ与一个非退化目标度规的仿射参数化测地线复合，且其速度平方为C_D(β)，即可得到精确的Einstein-sigma模型解。对于正定目标度规，相应的拉回条件还意味着非平凡标量映射具有一维像；对于不定目标度规，测地线拟设仍是充分的解生成扇区，但未必穷尽同一秩一时空源的全部实现。通过Einstein/Jordan框架对应，该构造也可给出真空张量-多标量解。文中用平直、球面、双曲和轴子-膨胀子目标以及Tangherlini、Weyl、Kasner、Rosen波、Gowdy、Kaluza-Klein气泡和C度规种子说明了统一生成器。该结果清晰分离了几何Buchdahl源与其目标空间实现，并将该秩一循环扇区推广到静态、宇宙学、波和加速几何。
classification.one_liner: 提出一个目标协变的Buchdahl解生成器，从Ricci平坦种子时空构造Einstein-sigma与多标量-张量引力中的精确解。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Green's Function Decomposition for a Kerr black hole: I. Equatorial ISCO Plunge
papers.abstract: We present a decomposition of the Kerr Green's function in the time domain, motivated by the frequency-domain split previously studied in the Schwarzschild limit. We show that the identification of a quasinormal-mode contribution, a direct part, and a late-time tail is still available, where the split times are determined by the black hole spin and positions of the emitter and receiver. We have checked this Green's function with time-domain Teukolsky numerical simulations and find excellent agreement. We also apply this decomposed Green's function in the time domain to a model problem with a test particle plunging into a Kerr black hole. The dynamically excited direct wave and quasinormal modes are obtained by convoluting the Green's function with the particle's source term, which may be viewed as the first order in mass ratio of a spinning black hole ringdown.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞Green函数分解产生的引力波：I. 赤道ISCO落入
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在时域给出Kerr Green函数的一种分解，其动机来自此前在Schwarzschild极限下研究的频域拆分。我们表明，仍可识别出准正规模贡献、直接部分和晚期尾，且拆分时间由黑洞自旋以及发射点和接收点的位置决定。我们用Teukolsky时域数值模拟检验该Green函数，发现吻合很好。我们还将这一时域分解Green函数应用于一个模型问题：试验粒子沿赤道ISCO落入Kerr黑洞。通过将Green函数与粒子源项卷积，得到被动力学激发的直接波和准正规模；这可视为旋转黑洞ringdown在质量比一阶的体现。
classification.one_liner: 时域分解Kerr Green函数并用于赤道ISCO plunge的引力波计算，分离直接波、QNM和晚期尾。

papers.title: Static spheres in black hole spacetimes: pairing, energy conditions, and an upper bound on the innermost radius
papers.abstract: Static spheres---spherical surfaces, located outside the event horizon, on which massive test particles can remain at rest with zero angular momentum relative to asymptotic static observers---have recently attracted some attention. In this work, we investigate their existence, relation to the energy conditions, and radial bounds in general static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat black hole spacetimes within general relativity. By analyzing the behavior of a radial function constructed from the mass and radial pressure functions, we prove that, under the weak energy condition (WEC), a static sphere necessarily requires negative radial pressure (tension). Furthermore, for non-extremal black holes satisfying the WEC, we show that any exterior static spheres, if present and non-degenerate, occur in pairs, each consisting of an inner unstable sphere and an outer stable one. Assuming the WEC holds throughout the exterior, the inner static sphere is characterized by a violation of the strong energy condition (SEC), with $\rho+p+2p_T<0$, where $\rho$, $p$, and $p_T$ denote the energy density, radial pressure, and tangential pressure, respectively; the SEC is restored ($\rho+p+2p_T>0$) at the outer sphere; a degenerate static sphere satisfies $\rho+p+2p_T=0$. In addition, focusing on the innermost static sphere and assuming that the WEC holds while the SEC is uniformly violated between the event horizon and this sphere, we derive a rigorous upper bound on its radius. These results establish a direct, analytic link between the energy conditions and the existence of static spheres, and provide a quantitative constraint on the matter environment of black holes possessing such orbits.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞时空中的静态球面：配对、能量条件及最内半径的上界
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究广义相对论中一般静态、球对称、渐近平直黑洞时空里静态球面的存在性、其与能量条件的关系以及径向界限。静态球面是位于事件视界之外、巨质量试验粒子可相对渐近静态观测者保持零角动量静止的球面。作者通过分析由质量函数和径向压力函数构造的径向函数，证明在弱能量条件（WEC）下静态球面必然要求负的径向压力（张力）；对于满足 WEC 的非极端黑洞，若外部存在非退化静态球面，则成对出现，由内层不稳定球面和外层稳定球面组成。若外部处处满足 WEC，内层静态球面以强能量条件（SEC）破坏为特征，即 ρ+p+2p_T<0，外层球面恢复 SEC（ρ+p+2p_T>0），退化静态球面满足 ρ+p+2p_T=0。进一步，针对最内层静态球面，在假定 WEC 成立且事件视界到该球面之间 SEC 均匀破坏的情况下，导出了其半径的严格上界。
classification.one_liner: 该文在广义相对论框架下证明黑洞外静态球面的能量条件特征与成对结构，并给出最内静态球面半径的严格上界。

papers.title: The Fifth RIT Catalog of Binary Black Hole Simulations: Multiple-Resolution Studies of Eccentric Orbits
papers.abstract: This fifth release of the RIT public catalog of numerical relativity binary black hole waveforms http://ccrg.rit.edu/~RITCatalog introduces an additional 248 configurations, prioritizing 197 newly simulated eccentric orbits. This update brings the catalog to a total of 2129 cases. All waveforms are corrected for center-of-mass drift and extrapolated to future null infinity. To rigorously estimate waveform errors, we conduct multiple-resolution convergence studies on 10 eccentric simulations (up to 33 orbits to merger) using three global resolutions increasing by factors of 1.2, plus a comprehensive six-resolution study for a single 18-orbit configuration. We evaluate waveform accuracy by computing mismatches against theoretical infinite-resolution extrapolations. Additionally, we analyze the convergence properties of key physical observables: merger times, number of orbits, final masses, final spins, recoil velocities, and the peak amplitude, frequency, and luminosity of the gravitational radiation.

classification.title_zh: 第五版 RIT 双黑洞模拟目录：偏心轨道的多分辨率研究
classification.abstract_zh: 这是 RIT 公开数值相对论双黑洞波形目录的第五版，新增 248 个构型，其中优先加入 197 个新模拟的偏心轨道，使目录总数达到 2129 个案例。所有波形都经过质心漂移修正，并外推到未来零无穷。为严格估计波形误差，作者对 10 个偏心模拟（最长到并合前 33 圈）进行多分辨率收敛研究，使用三种整体分辨率、每级提高 1.2 倍；并对一个 18 圈构型进行六分辨率综合研究。他们通过计算与理论无限分辨率外推结果的失配来评估波形精度，并分析关键物理量的收敛性质：并合时间、轨道圈数、最终质量、最终自旋、反冲速度，以及引力辐射的峰值振幅、频率和光度。

papers.title: Short Gravitational-Wave Transients as Probes of Cosmic Domain Walls
papers.abstract: GW190521 and GW231123 have been reported as short-duration gravitational-wave transients consistent with very massive binary black hole (BBH) coalescences whose inferred parameters, i.e., exceptionally high total masses and spin magnitudes, challenge standard isolated binary stellar evolution. We test a topological dark matter (TDM) interpretation invoking cosmic domain walls by fitting a physically motivated domain wall template to the LIGO Hanford and Livingston strain data. The BBH hypothesis is individually favored, with $\log_{10}\mathcal{B}_{\rm BBH/TDM}=12.2$ and $11.3$ for GW231123 and GW190521, respectively. However, these values are lower than those typically recovered from matched maximum a posteriori BBH waveforms injected into nearby noise segments. We further perform, for the first time, a joint fit in which domain wall signals from a single underlying scalar field are constrained simultaneously by both events. Although not favored over BBH signals, we find the two events are consistent with a common scalar field, with shared TDM parameters agreeing across independent noise realizations and sky locations. We further find that injected TDM transients are systematically recovered under the BBH hypothesis with large spin parameters, revealing a morphological degeneracy that could mask genuine domain wall signals. This analysis demonstrates that multi-event parameter consistency tests provide a new discriminant for domain wall dark matter searches in upcoming observing runs.

classification.title_zh: 短时标引力波暂现事件作为宇宙畴壁探针
classification.abstract_zh: GW190521 与 GW231123 被报告为短持续时间引力波暂现事件，与极大质量双黑洞并合一致，其推断的总质量和自旋幅度对标准孤立双星恒星演化构成挑战。本文通过将物理动机明确的宇宙畴壁模板拟合到 LIGO Hanford 和 Livingston 的应变数据，检验一种引入宇宙畴壁的拓扑暗物质解释。双黑洞假设在单个事件上更受青睐，对 GW231123 和 GW190521 的 log10 贝叶斯因子分别为 12.2 和 11.3。然而，这些值低于将匹配的最大后验双黑洞波形注入邻近噪声段时通常恢复的值。作者首次进行联合拟合，用两个事件同时约束来自单一底层标量场的畴壁信号。尽管该解释不如双黑洞信号受青睐，但两个事件与共同标量场一致，共享的拓扑暗物质参数在独立噪声实现和天区位置上相符。进一步发现，注入的拓扑暗物质暂现事件会在大自旋参数的双黑洞假设下被系统性恢复，揭示出一种可能掩盖真实畴壁信号的形态简并。该分析表明，多事件参数一致性检验为未来观测运行中的畴壁暗物质搜寻提供了新的判别手段。
classification.one_liner: 用 LIGO 双黑洞暂现事件检验宇宙畴壁拓扑暗物质解释，并展示多事件参数一致性可作为新判别手段。

papers.title: Polarized Anisotropic Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background Search with Ground-Based Detector Networks
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves admit a Stokes decomposition into intensity ($I$), circular polarization ($V$), and linear polarization ($Q$, $U$), analogous to Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) polarimetry. We implement a full-Stokes maximum-likelihood SGWB map-making analysis for ground-based detector networks, promoting the standard cross-correlation data products used in existing pipelines to a joint reconstruction of $I$, $V$, $Q$, $U$. Applied to LVK O3 data, we constrain the polarized angular spectra $C^{VV}_\ell$, $C^{EE}_\ell$, $C^{BB}_\ell$ and $|C^{IV}_\ell|$. We show that an intensity-only model is biased when polarized sky components are present, since the detector-network Fisher inner product does not generally make the Stokes responses orthogonal. For transient CBC foregrounds, polarized shot noise is not parametrically suppressed relative to ordinary CBC intensity shot noise. The full Stokes framework separates the Stokes sectors while providing access to polarized anisotropies invisible to conventional intensity-only searches.

classification.title_zh: 基于地面探测器网络的偏振各向异性随机引力波背景搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波可类似 CMB 偏振测量，通过 Stokes 分解为强度 I、圆偏振 V 和线偏振 Q、U。本文为地面探测器网络实现全 Stokes 最大似然随机引力波背景制图分析，将现有流程中的标准互相关数据产物推广为 I、V、Q、U 的联合重建。应用于 LVK O3 数据，给出对偏振角谱 C^VV_l、C^EE_l、C^BB_l 和 |C^IV_l| 的限制。作者表明，当存在偏振天空成分时，仅强度模型会产生偏差，因为探测器网络 Fisher 内积一般不能使 Stokes 响应正交。对于瞬态 CBC 前景，偏振散粒噪声相对于普通 CBC 强度散粒噪声并非参数化 suppressed。全 Stokes 框架可分离 Stokes 扇区，并提供常规仅强度搜索不可见的偏振各向异性。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出并应用全 Stokes 最大似然随机引力波背景制图，从地面探测器网络数据中联合重建强度与偏振各向异性并约束偏振角谱。

papers.title: Optical Magnus effect on gravitational lensing
papers.abstract: The optical Magnus effect refers to a transverse shift of a trajectory of light caused by its polarization and arises as a correction to geometrical optics at the linear order in wavelength. Here, we start from Maxwell's equations in a curved spacetime to derive the equations of motion for a wave packet of circularly polarized light, which confirm the known results involving the helicity-dependent anomalous velocity with some generalization and clarification. We then study possible consequences of the optical Magnus effect on gravitational lensing in the Schwarzschild spacetime as well as in an expanding spacetime with a weak gravitational potential. Among others, by formulating a lens equation modified to incorporate the optical Magnus effect, the Einstein ring is found impossible to emerge from a point source for any axially symmetric thin lens. Analytic solutions to the modified lens equation are also obtained for simple lens models, illuminating how image formation is affected by the optical Magnus effect.

classification.title_zh: 光学马格努斯效应对引力透镜的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从弯曲时空中的麦克斯韦方程出发，推导圆偏振光波包的运动方程，确认并澄清了已知的与螺旋度相关的反常速度结果。随后研究光学马格努斯效应在 Schwarzschild 时空以及具有弱引力势的膨胀时空中对引力透镜的可能影响。作者构造了包含光学马格努斯效应的修正透镜方程，发现对于任意轴对称薄透镜，点源不可能形成爱因斯坦环；并对简单透镜模型给出修正透镜方程的解析解，说明光学马格努斯效应如何影响成像。
classification.one_liner: 从弯曲时空麦克斯韦方程推导圆偏振光波包运动，并研究光学马格努斯效应对 Schwarzschild 与膨胀时空引力透镜及爱因斯坦环的影响。

papers.title: Regular black hole sourced by the Dehnen-type distribution of matter: The sound of the event horizon
papers.abstract: We compute the fundamental and overtone quasinormal modes of a regular, asymptotically flat black hole supported by a Dehnen-type matter halo. Gravitational perturbations in this background split into two distinct axial sectors, and our analysis confirms that the presence of the halo parameter $a$ separates the spectra of the two axial matter-perturbation prescriptions, which coincide in vacuum. The dependence of the quasinormal spectrum on $a$ is moderate for the fundamental modes and even weaker for the overtones, which approach one another in the complex-frequency plane as the halo parameter increases. We have found that no pronounced overtone outburst is observed at least for the first several overtones, indicating that the halo does not induce the type of strong near-horizon effects characteristic of quantum-corrected or exotic compact objects. Overall, our results show that the dark-matter halo introduces controlled and comparatively mild modifications to the ringdown spectrum while preserving its qualitative structure.

classification.title_zh: 由Dehnen型物质分布支持的规则黑洞：事件视界之声
classification.abstract_zh: 本文计算由Dehnen型物质晕支持的渐近平直规则黑洞的基频与泛音准正规模。该背景中的引力扰动分为两个不同的轴向扇区；分析表明，晕参数 a 使两种轴向物质扰动方案的谱发生分离，而在真空中二者重合。准正规模谱对 a 的依赖在基频时中等，在泛音时更弱；随着晕参数增大，泛音在复频率平面上彼此接近。作者发现至少对于前几个泛音并未出现明显的泛音爆发，这表明该晕不会引发量子修正或奇异致密天体所特有的强近视界效应。总体而言，暗物质晕对 ringdown 谱引入受控且相对温和的修改，同时保持其定性结构。
classification.one_liner: 研究Dehnen型物质晕支持的规则黑洞的准正规模，发现暗物质晕对ringdown谱产生温和且受控的修正。

papers.title: A Gravitomagnetic Bootstrap: from Newtonian gravity to general relativity via localizing rotational and conformal symmetries
papers.abstract: Newtonian gravity, in the light of the Equivalence Principle, is best understood as a localization of Galilean inertial structure --- or at least, of the part of Galilean inertial structure that defines rectilinear acceleration. I consider what kind of theory can be constructed if we also localize rotational inertia and spatial and temporal scales. The resultant theory, given weak assumptions, is unique up to a constant with the dimensions of velocity and an overall sign. For an appropriate choice of these, it coincides with the first post-Newtonian approximation to general relativity, so that this construction gives a method to bootstrap from Newtonian gravity to general relativity without explicitly presupposing special relativity.

classification.title_zh: 引力磁 bootstrap：通过局域化旋转与共形对称性从牛顿引力到广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 在等效原理视角下，牛顿引力最好被理解为伽利略惯性结构的局域化，至少是其中定义直线加速度的部分。本文考虑若进一步局域化旋转惯性以及空间和时间标度，可以构造出何种理论。在较弱的假设下，所得理论除一个具有速度量纲的常数和整体符号外是唯一的。对于这些参数的适当选择，该理论与广义相对论的一阶后牛顿近似一致，因此该构造提供了一种不显式预设狭义相对论、从牛顿引力 bootstrap 到广义相对论的方法。
classification.one_liner: 通过局域化旋转惯性与时空标度构造出唯一至速度常数和符号的引力磁理论，并在适当选择下与广义相对论一阶后牛顿近似一致，从而不预设狭义相对论地从牛顿引力 bootstrap 到广义相对论。

papers.title: Testing General Relativity by Reconstructing Dark Energy and the Growth Index with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We extend the Cosmo-PINN, a physics-informed neural network for model-independent cosmological reconstruction, to reconstruct the dark energy equation of state parameter $w_{\mathrm{DE}}(z)$ and the growth index $\gamma (z)$ of matter perturbations. The reconstruction is performed through three modules: the background module, the matter growth module, and the growth index module. The background module learns the dark energy density $\rho _{\mathrm{DE}}(z)$ from cosmological observations, and $w_{\mathrm{DE}}(z)$ is reconstructed through the residual of the conservation equation. The reconstructed background is then passed to the other two modules, which reconstruct the observables $f(z)$ and $f\sigma _{8}(z)$ either directly from the linear perturbation equation of General Relativity or through an independently reconstructed growth index $\gamma (z)$. Comparing the two reconstructions on the same background provides a consistency test of the underlying physical framework. The network is trained on the DESI DR2 Baryon Acoustic Oscillations, Cosmic Chronometers, Type Ia Supernovae, and redshift-space distortion data. Posterior uncertainties for the reconstructed cosmological parameters and functions are obtained through Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling. For the different data combinations, the posterior median of the present-day dark energy equation of state lies within the range $w_{\mathrm{DE,0}}\in \lbrack -0.930,-0.867]$, while the phantom divide crossing takes place at $z\simeq 0.41$--$0.53$. The posterior median of the present-day growth index reconstructed from the data lies within $\gamma _{0}\simeq 0.60$--$0.62$, indicating suppression of the growth of cosmic structure.

classification.title_zh: 利用物理信息神经网络重建暗能量与增长指数以检验广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将用于模型无关宇宙学重建的Cosmo-PINN扩展至重建暗能量状态方程参数w_DE(z)与物质扰动的增长指数γ(z)。重建通过背景模块、物质增长模块和增长指数模块三个模块完成：背景模块从宇宙学观测学习暗能量密度ρ_DE(z)，并由守恒方程残差重建w_DE(z)；重建的背景随后输入另外两个模块，分别直接由广义相对论的线性扰动方程或通过独立重建的增长指数γ(z)来重建观测量f(z)与fσ8(z)。在同一背景上比较两种重建可对 underlying 物理框架进行一致性检验。网络使用DESI DR2重子声学振荡、宇宙钟、Ia型超新星和红移空间畸变数据训练，并通过哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样获得重建宇宙学参数与函数的后验不确定性。对不同数据组合，当前暗能量状态方程的后验中位数位于w_DE,0∈[-0.930,-0.867]，phantom divide穿越发生在z≃0.41--0.53。由数据重建的当前增长指数后验中位数为γ0≃0.60--0.62，表明宇宙结构增长受到抑制。
classification.one_liner: 用Cosmo-PINN从BAO、宇宙钟、SNIa和RSD数据重建w_DE(z)与γ(z)，并通过两种增长重建的一致性检验广义相对论。

papers.title: Cosmography with gravitational waves II: Pad\'e approximants in an extended redshift regime
papers.abstract: We evaluate the capability of next-generation gravitational-wave detectors, including LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and DECIGO, to probe cosmographic parameters using electromagnetically bright standard sirens. Adopting Pad\'e approximants, we extend the cosmographic analysis to substantially higher redshifts and constrain the parameters $H_0$, $q_0$, $j_0$, $s_0$, and $l_0$. We examine the constraints primarily as a function of the number of detections and, in a complementary analysis, across correlated SNR--redshift regimes. LISA provides percent-level constraints on $H_0$, while the Einstein Telescope and DECIGO reach subpercent precision as the catalogue size increases. The parameter $q_0$ can be constrained at the tens-of-percent level, whereas the higher-order parameters $j_0$, $s_0$, and $l_0$ remain progressively less determined. Compared with the low-redshift Taylor analysis, the Pad\'e approach extends the usable redshift range, increases the accessible event population and enables a higher-order reconstruction of the expansion history.

classification.title_zh: 引力波宇宙学 II：扩展红移区间中的 Padé 近似
classification.abstract_zh: 我们评估包括 LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和 DECIGO 在内的下一代引力波探测器，利用电磁明亮标准汽笛探测宇宙学参数的能力。采用 Padé 近似，我们将宇宙学分析扩展到显著更高的红移，并约束参数 H0、q0、j0、s0 和 l0。我们主要考察约束随探测数目的变化，并在补充分析中考察相关 SNR–红移区间。随着目录规模增加，LISA 对 H0 给出百分级约束，而爱因斯坦望远镜和 DECIGO 达到亚百分精度。q0 可被约束到数十百分点水平，而高阶参数 j0、s0 和 l0 的可确定性逐渐降低。与低红移 Taylor 分析相比，Padé 方法扩展了可用红移范围，增加了可及事件数量，并使得膨胀历史的高阶重构成为可能。
classification.one_liner: 用 Padé 近似和未来引力波标准汽笛，在更高红移上约束宇宙学参数。

papers.title: Black Hole Superradiance and the Gravitational Auger Effect
papers.abstract: Black hole superradiance is a powerful probe of nature's light degrees of freedom. In the vicinity of a spinning black hole, it exponentially amplifies ultralight bosons from vacuum fluctuations to a macroscopic cloud of enormous occupation number. Observational superradiance effects - modified black-hole spins, gravitational-wave and coherent boson emission - are known to depend sensitively on bosonic self-interactions as induced by a quartic, $\lambda \phi^4$. Here we point out that purely gravitational interactions within the cloud significantly modify superradiance dynamics, through an analog of the Auger effect. Moreover, we identify nontrivial evolution of the superradiant levels beyond the first, driven by scattering into even higher levels and their radial overtones. For the QCD axion, the irreducible gravitational coupling rapidly dissipates the first superradiant level after it reaches saturation, through scalar emission and absorption by the black hole, while truncating the growth of higher levels. This can dramatically suppress the observability of continuous gravitational-wave signals or signatures in late binary inspirals. Black hole spin-down remains more robust, but for higher modes begins earlier and proceeds more slowly, requiring revision of existing limits.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞超辐射与引力俄歇效应
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞超辐射可将超轻玻色子从真空涨落指数放大为占据数巨大的宏观云。已知观测效应（黑洞自旋改变、引力波与相干玻色子辐射）对四次自相互作用 λφ^4 敏感。本文指出，云内纯引力相互作用会通过类似俄歇效应的机制显著改变超辐射动力学，并发现第一激发态之外能级由散射到更高能级及其径向量子数过模驱动的非平凡演化。对 QCD 轴子，不可约引力耦合会在第一超辐射能级饱和后迅速耗散它，通过标量辐射和被黑洞吸收，同时截断更高能级的增长。这可能大幅压低连续引力波信号或晚双星并合特征的可见性。黑洞自旋减慢更稳健，但对更高模式开始更早、进行更慢，需修正现有限制。
classification.one_liner: 纯引力相互作用通过类俄歇机制改变黑洞超辐射能级演化，并可能显著影响 QCD 轴子云的观测特征。

papers.title: Global Fit Inference for LISA with samsara++
papers.abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will observe a superposition of gravitational-wave signals, requiring joint inference of an unknown number of sources, parameters, and instrumental noise. To disentangle these contributions, that overlap in both time and frequency, a Global Fit (GF) analysis is needed. We present samsara++, a C++/CUDA sampler designed to address this trans-dimensional GF problem. Building on the continuous-time MCMC framework of samsara, the algorithm combines birth-death processes for adding and removing sources, with mutation moves for parameter estimation. Birth and death are selected through posterior-dependent rates. Shared-memory parallelism, incremental likelihood updates, and indexed storage reduce the computational and memory costs, while parallel tempering improves the exploration of multimodal posteriors. We assess the performance using simulated one-year LISA datasets containing Galactic double white dwarf binaries and stationary Gaussian instrumental noise. Analyses of populations containing 143 and 866 binaries start from empty source models, without preliminary searches or proposals tailored to the injected population. These tests demonstrate source reconstruction and catalog generation, highlighting, at the same time, the importance of source-count, overlapping signals, and incomplete mixing on joint source and noise inference. Then we perform a separate stress test, initialized at the injected parameters, exploring a population of 16,435 binaries, corresponding to 131,480 source parameters. This run completes 15 million iterations in approximately 16 hours using about 3 GB of RAM. All together, these benchmarks show the computational feasibility of birth-death sampling for large Galactic-binary populations, and provide a foundation for extending samsara++ toward a comprehensive LISA global fit.

classification.title_zh: samsara++：面向 LISA 的全局拟合推断
classification.abstract_zh: LISA 将观测到多个引力波信号的叠加，需要对未知数量的源、源参数以及仪器噪声进行联合推断。为分离在时间和频率上重叠的贡献，需要进行全局拟合（Global Fit, GF）分析。本文提出 samsara++，一个用于该跨维 GF 问题的 C++/CUDA 采样器。它基于 samsara 的连续时间 MCMC 框架，结合用于增删源的生灭过程与用于参数估计的变异移动，生灭移动的选择由后验依赖的速率决定。共享内存并行、增量似然更新和索引存储降低了计算与内存开销，并行回火改善了多峰后验的探索。作者使用包含银河系双白矮星双星和稳态高斯仪器噪声的模拟一年期 LISA 数据集评估性能。对包含 143 和 866 个双星的整体分析从空源模型开始，不使用预搜索或针对注入总体定制的提议；这些测试展示了源重建和星表生成，同时强调源计数、信号重叠和不完全混合对源与噪声联合推断的重要性。随后进行压力测试，从注入参数初始化，探索包含 16,435 个双星、对应 131,480 个源参数的总体；该运行在约 16 小时内用约 3 GB 内存完成 1500 万次迭代。这些基准测试表明，生灭采样对于大规模银河系双星总体在计算上是可行的，并为将 samsara++ 扩展为全面的 LISA 全局拟合提供了基础。
classification.one_liner: 提出并基准测试 samsara++ 跨维 MCMC 采样器，用于 LISA 引力波全局拟合中的源数与参数联合推断。

papers.title: Separation of gravitational perturbations of Myers-Perry black holes
papers.abstract: We study linearized gravitational perturbations of five-dimensional asymptotically flat Myers--Perry black holes with two unequal spins. We construct separated solutions for the five coupled gauge-invariant polarizations for arbitrary azimuthal mode numbers. The key observation is that the Killing--Yano symmetry induces a first-order angular operator that, together with a commuting second-order operator, determines the angular profiles of all five gravitational polarizations. The Carter interchange relates the scalar angular and radial equations, and the five tidal components of each separated solution share a single radial amplitude. We prove completeness of the angular harmonics at real frequencies and show that the resulting physical perturbations admit local metric reconstruction. In the singly spinning limit, we recover Santos's angular operators and radial equation for perturbations with $m_\psi=0$ and even parity under $\psi\to-\psi$. These results provide a framework for studying quasinormal modes and gravitational stability of five-dimensional rotating black holes with two independent spins.

classification.title_zh: Myers-Perry黑洞引力扰动的分离
classification.abstract_zh: 研究五维渐近平直、具有两个不相等自旋的Myers-Perry黑洞的线性化引力扰动。针对五个耦合的规范不变极化分量，构造任意方位角模数下的分离变量解；核心是利用Killing-Yano对称性诱导的一阶角向算符及与其对易的二阶算符确定所有极化的角向剖面。Carter互换联系标量角向与径向方程，每个分离解的五个体潮分量共享单一径向振幅。证明实频率下角向谐波的完备性，并表明所得物理扰动可进行局部度规重构。单自旋极限下恢复Santos的角向算符和径向方程。该框架可用于研究五维双自旋旋转黑洞的准正规模与引力稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 构造五维双自旋Myers-Perry黑洞线性引力扰动的分离变量解，为QNM与稳定性分析提供框架。

papers.title: Pulsar timing response and observational constraints on continuous-spin gravity
papers.abstract: Continuous-spin particles form the most general massless integer-helicity irreducible representations of the Poincar\'e group, characterized by a dimensionful continuous-spin scale $\rho_g$ set by a nonzero Pauli--Lubanski invariant. A single continuous-spin representation contains an infinite tower of integer helicities $h\in\mathbb Z$ that mix under Lorentz boosts. Since continuous-spin effects are controlled by $\alpha\equiv\rho_g/(\hbar\omega)$ at gravitational-wave angular frequency $\omega$, nanohertz pulsar timing arrays are naturally sensitive to ultralow values of $\rho_g$. Starting from the gauge-invariant worldline coupling of linearized continuous-spin gravity, we derive the one-way pulsar timing redshift response and the overlap reduction function of an isotropic stochastic background for arbitrary integer helicity. We show that while photon propagation is modulated across all helicities, only the vector modes ($h=\pm1$) perturb the four-velocity of a static observer, and that the tensor modes ($h=\pm2$) smoothly recover the Hellings--Downs correlation of general relativity as $\rho_g/(\hbar\omega)\to 0$. Modeling an unpolarized $h=\pm2$ background in the solar-system barycentric frame and jointly fitting the NANOGrav 15-year data with pulsar red noise, we obtain the $95\%$ upper limits $\rho^{{U}}_g<7.03\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}$ and $\rho^{\log {U}}_g<4.79\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}$ under uniform and log-uniform priors, respectively. Under the uniform prior, we obtain $\gamma_{\mathrm{GW}} = 4.89^{+0.85}_{-0.96}$, which brings the spectral index closer to the canonical value $\gamma_{\rm GW}=13/3$ expected for circular SMBHBs than standard General Relativity.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时响应与连续自旋引力的观测限制
classification.abstract_zh: 连续自旋粒子是庞加莱群最一般的无质量整数螺旋度不可约表示，由非零Pauli–Lubanski不变量给出的有量纲连续自旋标度ρ_g刻画。单一连续自旋表示包含无限整数螺旋度塔，并在洛伦兹助推下混合。由于连续自旋效应由α≡ρ_g/(ℏω)控制，纳赫兹脉冲星计时阵列天然对超低ρ_g敏感。本文从线性化连续自旋引力的规范不变世界线耦合出发，推导任意整数螺旋度的单向脉冲星计时红移响应及各向同性随机背景的重叠约化函数。结果表明，光子传播受所有螺旋度调制，但只有矢量模(h=±1)扰动静态观测者的四速度，而张量模(h=±2)在ρ_g/(ℏω)→0时平滑恢复广义相对论的Hellings–Downs关联。本文在太阳系质心系中建模未极化h=±2背景，并联合拟合NANOGrav 15年数据与脉冲星红噪声，在均匀和对数均匀先验下分别得到95%上限ρ_g^U<7.03×10^{-23}eV和ρ_g^{log U}<4.79×10^{-23}eV；均匀先验下得到γ_GW=4.89^{+0.85}_{-0.96}，使谱指数比标准广义相对论更接近圆轨道超大质量黑洞双星预期的γ_GW=13/3。

papers.abstract: The purpose of the paper is to review the Hamiltonian formulation for several actions related to general relativity that can be written in terms of differential forms. As we will show the powerful ideas of Cartan geometry can be used to simplify the Hamiltonian analysis and arrive at a coherent and comprehensive geometrical understanding of it.

papers.title: Simultaneous tests of post-Newtonian inspiral using GW250114 and GW250207
papers.abstract: We perform the one of the most general tests of post-Newtonian (PN) inspiral in binary black holes to date by allowing all eight phase coefficients up to 3.5PN order to vary simultaneously from their general-relativistic values. Using two of the loudest binary black hole events observed to date, GW250114 and GW250207, we carry out Bayesian inference with the IMRPhenomXPHM_SpinTaylor waveform model augmented by parametrized deviations in the post-Newtonian phasing. We then identify the combinations of phase coefficients most strongly constrained by the data through a principal component analysis of the eight-dimensional deformation space. We find that the data constrain the three leading principal components beyond their priors, and that all three are consistent with the predictions of general relativity. These results demonstrate that exceptionally loud gravitational-wave events enable robust, high-dimensional tests of inspiral dynamics and provide direct access to the measurable subspace of post-Newtonian deformations.

classification.title_zh: 利用 GW250114 和 GW250207 同时检验后牛顿旋进

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of Kerr--de Sitter black holes in semi-open systems
papers.abstract: We investigate the gravitational quasinormal mode spectrum of Kerr--de Sitter black holes with a partially reflective inner boundary near the event horizon, by reducing the angular and radial Teukolsky equations to Heun equations. We vary different parameters and study the $s=-2$, $\ell=m=2$ modes numerically. As the reflectivity $\mathcal{R}_0$ increases, QNMs develop echo branches approaching the real axis with approximately regular spacing, while others approach $\operatorname{Re}\omega=m\Omega(r_+)$. As the rotation $a$ increases, some QNMs approach the real axis or retain finite damping, while others exhibit approximately horizontal shifts with real parts tracking $m\Omega(r_+)$. Two mechanisms driving the instabilities are identified in complementary regimes, namely superradiant amplification and energy injection from the reflective wall. We derive the ratio between Teukolsky amplitude and energy reflectivities, finding that the latter can diverge at $m\Omega(r_+)$ even when the former is small, which accounts for an active wall in this regime. We also find that formulating the reflective boundary condition in terms of asymptotic amplitudes gives rise to resonances near each pole of the ingoing connection coefficient, extending to arbitrarily large positive imaginary parts. An exact finite radius Robin condition imposed on the Sasaki--Nakamura variable removes these pole-born frequencies. These results show how the inner boundary prescription controls the spectrum structure and stability of semi-open Kerr--de Sitter systems.

classification.title_zh: 半开放系统中Kerr–de Sitter黑洞的准正模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过将角向和径向Teukolsky方程约化为Heun方程，研究具有事件视界附近部分反射内边界的Kerr–de Sitter黑洞的引力准正模谱。作者改变参数并数值研究s=-2、ℓ=m=2模式。随着反射率R0增大，QNMs出现回波分支，靠近实轴并具有近似规则间距，而另一些趋近Reω=mΩ(r+)。随着旋转a增大，一些QNMs靠近实轴或保持有限阻尼，另一些呈近似水平移动且实部跟踪mΩ(r+)。在互补区域识别出两种驱动不稳定性机制：超辐射放大和反射壁的能量注入。推导Teukolsky振幅反射率与能量反射率之比，发现后者在mΩ(r+)处即使前者很小也可发散，解释该区域中的主动壁。还发现用渐近振幅表述反射边界条件会在入射连接系数的每个极点附近产生共振，并延伸至任意大的正虚部；对Sasaki–Nakamura变量施加精确有限半径Robin条件可移除这些极点产生的频率。这些结果表明内边界规定如何控制半开放Kerr–de Sitter系统的谱结构和稳定性。

papers.title: Repeated Gravitational-Wave Lensing from Binary Black Holes on Eccentric and Precessing Orbits around Spinning Supermassive Black Holes
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) from a stellar-mass binary black hole (BBH) orbiting a supermassive black hole (SMBH) can experience repeated gravitational lensing as the BBH passes behind the SMBH. Our previous studies of orbit-induced GW modulation motivate this investigation of repeated lensing in evolving hierarchical triple systems. We investigate how eccentricity, inclination, and relativistic precession of the outer orbit affect successive lensing events and parameter inference. The outer orbit follows post-Newtonian dynamics, and the inspiral waveform includes moving-source effects and de Sitter precession. An event-local point-mass lensing model tracks the changing source--lens alignment and GW frequency. For a one-year LISA observation, we examine lensing-event identification, Fisher-matrix estimates of parameter uncertainties, and waveform residuals when lensing is omitted. Our results show that outer-orbit evolution changes the timing and amplification of successive lensing events and can bring initially unfavorable configurations into the lensing region. A fixed circular, nonprecessing approximation misses all lensing events for a substantial fraction of the selected lensed systems. The median fractional reductions in uncertainty are largest for the outer-orbit inclination and SMBH spin. For some systems above the adopted detection threshold, lensing-induced waveform differences persist after local adjustments to the parameters of the unlensed model. Repeated lensing can thus provide complementary constraints on SMBH properties and outer-orbit geometry in LISA observations of hierarchical BBHs.

classification.title_zh: 偏心且进动的双黑洞绕自旋超大质量黑洞轨道运动产生的重复引力波透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 恒星质量双黑洞绕超大质量黑洞运行时，当双黑洞经过超大质量黑洞后方，其引力波可发生重复引力透镜效应。本文研究分级三体系统中外轨道的偏心率、倾角和相对论进动如何影响连续透镜事件及参数推断。外轨道采用后牛顿动力学，inspiral波形包含移动源效应和de Sitter进动；事件局域点质量透镜模型追踪变化的源—透镜对准和引力波频率。针对一年期LISA观测，考察透镜事件识别、Fisher矩阵参数不确定性估计以及忽略透镜时的波形残差。结果表明，外轨道演化会改变连续透镜事件的时间和放大率，并可使初始不利构型进入透镜区域；固定圆轨道、非进动近似在相当一部分选定透镜系统中会漏掉所有透镜事件。不确定度的中位分数缩减对外轨道倾角和超大质量黑洞自旋最大。对于部分高于探测阈值的系统，即使对未透镜模型参数做局域调整，透镜导致的波形差异仍会保留。因此，重复透镜可在LISA对分级双黑洞的观测中为超大质量黑洞性质和外形几何提供补充限制。

papers.title: Probing superradiant cloud level transitions in stellar-mass black hole binaries with milli-Hertz and multiband gravitational wave observations
papers.abstract: We investigate superradiant cloud level transitions in stellar-mass black hole binaries with milli-Hertz and multiband gravitational-wave observations. Under the adopted cloud formation and survival conditions, the $\lvert322\rangle\rightarrow\lvert31-1\rangle$ fine transition can imprint phase corrections in the LISA band, while Bohr transitions occurring after the milli-Hertz band observation can be probed through shifts in the merger time. Modeling the coupled cloud-orbit evolution, we find that cloud depletion can begin before resonance and that ionization can advance rather than delay coalescence. For a representative nearby binary, a vacuum injection-recovery analysis yields a cloud-mass-fraction posterior concentrated at $M_c^i/M\lesssim10^{-6}$. Comparing the LISA-predicted coalescence time with a subsequent ground-based measurement provides a complementary test of later cloud evolution. These results motivate complementary searches for ultralight bosons with milli-Hertz and multiband gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 利用毫赫兹与多波段引力波观测探测恒星级黑洞双星中的超辐射云能级跃迁

papers.title: A hybrid log-likelihood-ratio statistic for single-detector SPIIR gravitational-wave searches
papers.abstract: Periods with only one detector operating accounted for 13.3 percent of the third LIGO-Virgo observing run (O3) and 29.7 percent of the first part of the fourth observing run (O4a). We present the first dedicated single-detector implementation of the Summed Parallel Infinite Impulse Response (SPIIR) pipeline for binary neutron star (BNS) and neutron star-black hole (NSBH) merger searches. Our hybrid log-likelihood ratio combines signal-consistency models for non-Gaussian glitches with a profile likelihood ratio for the signal-to-noise ratio under a Gaussian-noise model. We calibrate the glitch model by source category and trigger-rate class. We assign false alarm rates (FARs) using the measured background from the same detector and analysis chunk, extrapolating its high-ranking tail. We check the FAR assignments by comparing observed and expected cumulative background counts for BNS in O3a and NSBH in O3b at LIGO Hanford (H1) and LIGO Livingston (L1). Using O3 data and the GWTC-3 injection set, we find that, at a threshold of one false alarm per two months, the BNS sensitive distances are $136.5^{+2.9}_{-3.0}$ Mpc in L1 and $120.2^{+3.1}_{-3.3}$ Mpc in H1. These central estimates are approximately 24 and 38 percent higher, respectively, than the GWTC-3 GstLAL values of $110.5^{+3.2}_{-3.4}$ Mpc and $87.2^{+3.6}_{-3.9}$ Mpc over the same data and injection parameter ranges. GstLAL provides the only published single-detector results in GWTC-3. For NSBH, SPIIR reaches $164.1^{+6.7}_{-7.3}$ Mpc in L1 and $134.9^{+6.3}_{-7.0}$ Mpc in H1, compared with $165.1^{+6.7}_{-7.3}$ Mpc and $156.0^{+5.9}_{-6.4}$ Mpc for GWTC-3 GstLAL, respectively. Targeted searches recover triggers associated with GW190425, GW200105_162426, and GW230529_181500 with assigned FARs below the same threshold.

classification.title_zh: 用于单探测器SPIIR引力波搜索的混合对数似然比统计量
classification.abstract_zh: 在第三次LIGO-Virgo观测运行（O3）中，仅有单台探测器工作的时段占13.3%，在第四次观测运行第一阶段（O4a）占29.7%。我们首次给出用于双中子星（BNS）和中子星-黑洞（NSBH）并合搜索的Summed Parallel Infinite Impulse Response（SPIIR）流程的专用单探测器实现。我们的混合对数似然比将针对非高斯glitch的信号一致性模型与高斯噪声模型下信噪比的profile likelihood ratio结合起来。我们按源类别和触发率类别校准glitch模型。我们使用同一探测器和分析chunk的实测背景分配误报率（FAR），并外推其高排名尾部。我们通过比较O3a中BNS和O3b中NSBH在LIGO Hanford（H1）和LIGO Livingston（L1）的观测与期望累积背景计数来检验FAR分配。使用O3数据和GWTC-3注入集，在每两个月一次误报的阈值下，BNS敏感距离在L1为136.5^{+2.9}_{-3.0} Mpc，在H1为120.2^{+3.1}_{-3.3} Mpc；这些中心估计分别比同一数据和注入参数范围内GWTC-3 GstLAL值110.5^{+3.2}_{-3.4} Mpc和87.2^{+3.6}_{-3.9} Mpc高约24%和38%。GstLAL是GWTC-3中唯一已发表的单探测器结果。对于NSBH，SPIIR在L1达到164.1^{+6.7}_{-7.3} Mpc，在H1达到134.9^{+6.3}_{-7.0} Mpc，而GWTC-3 GstLAL分别为165.1^{+6.7}_{-7.3} Mpc和156.0^{+5.9}_{-6.4} Mpc。定向搜索找回了与GW190425、GW200105_162426和GW230529_181500相关的触发，其分配的FAR低于同一阈值。

papers.title: Multi-throat generalized Ellis--Bronnikov wormholes with asymptotic string-cloud behavior
papers.abstract: We study an ultrastatic, spherically symmetric family of traversable wormholes obtained by locally deforming a generalized Ellis--Bronnikov areal-radius profile in a spacetime with an asymptotic angular deficit. Depending on the deformation parameters, the same analytic family contains one, two, three, or four throats. The corresponding bifurcation curves are obtained in dimensionless form, and the resulting geometries are regular and asymptotically conical. We also reconstruct a source in General Relativity using a canonical scalar, a shift-symmetric phantom scalar, and a magnetic nonlinear electromagnetic field coupled to the canonical scalar. In the reference multi-throat geometry, the coupling removes a branch obstruction of an uncoupled single-valued nonlinear electrodynamics (NED); the same obstruction occurs whenever equal values of the magnetic invariant require different values of $\mathcal G_F$. For $\mathcal G(F)=F+\lambda\sqrt F$, the NED sector carries the leading asymptotic stress, which scales as $r^{-2}$ and approaches the string-cloud equation of state. The total stress tensor satisfies pointwise energy conditions in finite belly-centered regions of representative two- and four-throat solutions, while the throats violate the radial null energy condition (NEC) and the violation extends into integrable asymptotic tails. The Nandi--Zhang--Kumar covariant volume integral of $\rho+p_r$ is quadratic in the deformation amplitude; its zero is distinct from the bifurcation curves. Away from saddle-node boundaries, each throat supports a radially unstable background-metric light ring, and each intermediate belly supports a radially stable one, with an internally trapped null family in the double-throat case. These results place the topology, source reconstruction, integrated NEC content, and background-metric circular-orbit structure in a common parameter-space description.

classification.title_zh: 多喉广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞与渐近弦云行为
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一族超静态、球对称可穿越虫洞，通过在具有渐近角缺陷的时空中对广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 面积半径剖面进行局部变形得到。根据变形参数，同一解析族包含一个、两个、三个或四个喉部。相应的分岔曲线以无量纲形式给出，所得几何是正则且渐近锥形的。我们还在广义相对论中利用正则标量场、位移对称 phantom 标量场以及与正则标量场耦合的磁非线性电磁场重构源。在参考多喉几何中，耦合移除了未耦合单值非线性电动力学(NED)的分支障碍；当磁不变量取相同值却需要不同 G_F 时会出现这一障碍。对于 G(F)=F+λ√F，NED 扇区携带主导渐近应力，其按 r^{-2} 标度并趋近弦云状态方程。总应力张量在代表性双喉和四喉解的有限腹部区域满足点态能量条件，而喉部违反径向零能量条件(NEC)，且违反延伸到可积渐近尾部。Nandi-Zhang-Kumar 协变体积积分 ρ+p_r 是变形振幅的二次函数；其零点与分岔曲线不同。远离鞍结点边界时，每个喉部支持一个径向不稳定的背景度规光环，每个中间腹部支持一个径向稳定的光环，双喉情形中存在内部捕获的零测地线族。这些结果把拓扑、源重构、积分NEC含量和背景度规圆轨道结构放在共同的参数空间描述中。

papers.title: Scalar charge of neutron stars and accreting black holes in Starobinsky gravity: quasi-universal relations, the trace anomaly and gravitational-wave sensitivity
papers.abstract: The Starobinsky scalaron is sourced by the trace of the stress--energy, so its exterior charge is set by the matter around an object and not by the object's vacuum geometry. We derive a master formula for that charge for any static, spherically symmetric source, evaluate it first for neutron stars, where the interior is known, and then for accreting black holes, where it is not. For a star the pressure subtracts: on the interior metric with the Eardley sensitivity, and the charge is a quasi-universal function of the compactness. Six realistic equations of state confirm the relation but lie above the coefficient calibrated on polytropes; the refit reproduces their mean to 0.007. The trace $\rho-3p$ changes sign in the cores of massive stars, and the charge also tracks the tidal deformability and the moment of inertia to a few parts in 1000 and 100. Solving the Einstein-frame structure equations self-consistently moves a star along this relation and leaves its charge at fixed compactness within 4 per cent of the test-field value. We compare the charge with NICER radii and the GW170817 tidal deformability, and use the published massless dipole constraint from GW230529 to calibrate a Fisher estimate of the sensitivity of a similar binary to a finite scalaron range, projected to the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer; the range is a free parameter, and the laboratory bound on pure $R+\alpha R^2$ is confronted explicitly. A vacuum black hole has q=0; a hole with a disc has $q=\sinh(m_\phi r_d)/(m_\phi r_d)$, controlled by the disc's outer edge, which makes it the counterpart in which the same integral is dominated by matter far from the centre; light is blind to the charge at leading order, and the correction beyond it is negligible for any self-consistent disc.

classification.title_zh: Starobinsky引力中中子星与吸积黑洞的标量荷：准普适关系、迹反常与引力波灵敏度
classification.abstract_zh: Starobinsky标量子由能量-动量张量的迹作为源，因此其外部标量荷由天体周围物质决定，而非由天体的真空几何决定。本文推导任意静态球对称源的标量荷主公式，先用于内部已知的中子星，再用于内部未知的吸积黑洞。对恒星，压力项相减；在带有Eardley敏感度的内部度规上，标量荷是致密度的准普适函数。六种现实状态方程确认该关系，但位于多项式标定系数之上；重拟合后其平均值可复现到0.007。大质量恒星核心的迹ρ-3p变号，标量荷也在千分之几和百分之百量级上分别追踪潮汐形变与转动惯量。自洽求解Einstein框架结构方程会使恒星沿该关系移动，并在固定致密度下使标量荷与测试场值相差4%以内。作者将标量荷与NICER半径、GW170817潮汐形变比较，并利用GW230529已发表的无质量偶极约束来标定Fisher估计，以评估类似双星对有限标量子范围的灵敏度，并投影到Einstein Telescope和Cosmic Explorer；该范围是自由参数，且显式面对纯R+αR^2的实验室限制。真空中黑洞q=0；带吸积盘的黑洞q=sinh(m_φ r_d)/(m_φ r_d)，由盘外缘控制，使其成为同一积分由远离中心物质主导的对应情形；光在领头阶对电荷不敏感，且超出领头阶的修正对任何自洽吸积盘都可忽略。
classification.one_liner: 在Starobinsky引力中推导中子星与吸积黑洞的标量荷及其准普适关系，并评估引力波探测灵敏度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究Starobinsky修改引力下中子星和吸积黑洞的标量荷、准普适关系及引力波探测，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，并涉及黑洞经典时空与致密星观测。

papers.title: Relativistic precession around rotating neutron stars. I. Slow rotation: Hartle--Thorne spacetimes, particle orbits and the QPOs of atoll and Z sources
papers.abstract: We study the relativistic precession model (RPM) of quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in the spacetimes of slowly rotating neutron stars computed from the equation of state (EOS). For four EOSs (WFF1, G3, FSUGarnet and IOPB-I) we solve the Hartle--Thorne equations to second order in the angular velocity and compute the orbital and epicyclic frequencies of the exterior metric without expanding in the spin or the quadrupole. At $1.9\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ the spin-induced quadrupole is 2--4 times that of a black hole with the same spin; it lowers the nodal precession frequency by up to 25 per cent near the innermost stable circular orbit and limits the nodal frequency that any spin can produce. An eccentric, tilted geodesic around a $1.92\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ star spinning at 363~Hz precesses at the epicyclic rates, and the power spectrum of a hot spot on it peaks at the orbital, periastron and nodal precession frequencies. Applied to the atoll sources 4U 1636$-$53 and 4U 1728$-$34, the RPM gives masses of 2.02--$2.15\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ and 1.88--$1.92\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$. For 4U 1728$-$34 the low-frequency QPO favours stars with large moments of inertia, $I\simeq2.5\times10^{45}$~g\,cm$^{2}$. Without an EOS the QPOs give $M=1.920^{+0.014}_{-0.012}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$, $j=0.162^{+0.023}_{-0.011}$ and $\bar Q=2.2^{+1.1}_{-0.8}$; a Kerr spacetime with the same nodal frequency would underestimate the moment of inertia by 22 per cent. For the Z sources GX 5$-$1 and GX 340+0 the horizontal-branch oscillations cannot be twice the nodal precession frequency for any of the four EOSs: the fits are driven to spins of 730--745~Hz and to the maximum mass.

classification.title_zh: 绕转中子星周围的相对论进动 I. 慢转动：Hartle-Thorne 时空、粒子轨道与 atoll/Z 源 QPO
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究慢转动中子星时空中的准周期振荡相对论进动模型。针对 WFF1、G3、FSUGarnet 和 IOPB-I 四类状态方程，作者在角速度二阶求解 Hartle-Thorne 方程，并在不展开自旋或四极矩的情况下计算外部度规的轨道频率与周转频率。对于 1.9 太阳质量中子星，自旋诱导四极矩为同自旋黑洞的 2–4 倍，在 ISCO 附近可将节点进动频率降低最多 25%，并限制任意自旋可产生的节点频率。绕 1.92 太阳质量、363 Hz 自转星的偏心倾斜测地线按周转频率进动，其热点功率谱在轨道、近星点和节点进动频率处出现峰值。应用于 atoll 源 4U 1636-53 和 4U 1728-34 时，RPM 给出质量范围分别约为 2.02–2.15 和 1.88–1.92 太阳质量；对 4U 1728-34，低频 QPO 偏好大转动惯量。无状态方程时 QPO 拟合给出质量、自旋和四极矩参数；同节点频率的 Kerr 时空会低估转动惯量 22%。对 Z 源 GX 5-1 和 GX 340+0，四类状态方程下水平分支振荡均不能为节点进动频率的两倍，拟合被推向 730–745 Hz 自旋和最大质量。
classification.one_liner: 用 Hartle-Thorne 慢转动中子星时空与相对论进动模型拟合 QPO，给出 atoll/Z 源的质量、自旋和转动惯量约束。

papers.title: Polarized equatorial emission around regular compact objects
papers.abstract: We study the polarization properties of regular compact objects motivated by quantum gravity. These geometries include static spherically symmetric non-singular black holes which undergo a continuous transition to regular particle-like spacetimes in certain regions of the parametric space. Applying a phenomenological model of a magnetized fluid ring orbiting in the equatorial plane, we search for characteristic signatures in the direct polarized images which could distinguish them from black holes in general relativity. At low inclinations the regular compact objects lead to a very similar polarization pattern as the Schwarzschild black hole. At high inclinations we observe a characteristic signature for the particle-like geometries. A second direct image of the fluid ring is formed which is absent for black holes. It may possess with three orders of magnitude higher polarization intensity and a specific polarization direction making it observationally significant. We elucidate the physical mechanism for the formation of the second direct image and pinpoint the plasma configurations which lead to amplification of its polarized emission.

classification.title_zh: 规则致密天体周围的偏振赤道辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究量子引力启发的规则致密天体的偏振性质。这些几何包括静态球对称非奇异黑洞，它们在参数空间的某些区域连续过渡为规则粒子样时空。采用赤道面磁化流体环的唯象模型，我们寻找直接偏振图像中可区分它们与广义相对论黑洞的特征。低倾角下，规则致密天体的偏振图样与Schwarzschild黑洞非常相似；高倾角下，粒子样几何出现特征信号：形成流体环的第二直接像，而黑洞中不存在该像。该像的偏振强度可高约三个量级，且偏振方向特殊，具有观测意义。我们阐明第二直接像的形成机制，并指出导致其偏振辐射增强的等离子体构型。
classification.one_liner: 研究量子引力启发的规则致密天体赤道磁化流体环的偏振图像，发现高倾角下粒子样几何可产生黑洞所无的第二直接像及显著偏振信号。

papers.title: Optical Appearances and Multiple Lensed Rings of Self-Interacting Boson Stars with a Double-Well Potential
papers.abstract: As horizon-scale imaging opens a new era of strong-field gravity tests, self-interacting boson stars have emerged as compelling dark matter candidates and natural black hole mimickers. We systematically investigate the optical appearances and multiple lensed rings of such horizonless objects illuminated by a geometrically thin accretion disk. To overcome the severe numerical stiffness caused by the slowly decaying scalar tail, we introduce a robust hybrid metric reconstruction framework---seamlessly bridging an interior 6-parameter Pad\'e approximant to the exact exterior Schwarzschild spacetime via a globally $C^2$-continuous cubic spline. This ensures high-precision ray-tracing across the entire domain. For the adopted double-well potential, we identify a strict upper bound ($\phi_0 \lesssim 0.317$) for the existence of regular static solutions. Crucially, we uncover a striking non-monotonic evolution in the shadow size, driven by a macroscopic mass-amplitude turnover that is fundamentally rooted in the microphysical competition between attractive and repulsive self-interactions. Within the most compact configurations, extreme gravitational lensing generates prominent nested higher-order photon rings and distinctly separated secondary images. Furthermore, exploring the scalar potential parameter space ($\Lambda, \Gamma$) reveals a distinct diagonal gradient in the shadow size. Our findings demonstrate that next-generation VLBI observations can move beyond merely identifying horizonless objects, offering a novel geometric avenue to directly probe the microphysical couplings of dark matter scalar fields.

classification.title_zh: 双阱势自相互作用玻色子星的光学外观与多重透镜环
classification.abstract_zh: 随着视界尺度成像开启强场引力检验的新时代，自相互作用玻色子星成为有吸引力的暗物质候选者和天然的黑洞模拟体。我们系统研究了此类无视界天体在被几何薄吸积盘照亮时的光学外观与多重透镜环。为克服缓慢衰减标量尾导致的严重数值刚性，我们引入稳健的混合度规重构框架：通过全局 C^2 连续三次样条，将内部 6 参数 Padé 近似无缝连接到外部精确 Schwarzschild 时空，从而保证全区域高精度光线追踪。对于所采用的双阱势，我们确定了正则静态解存在的严格上界（φ0 ≲ 0.317）。关键的是，我们发现阴影尺寸呈现显著的非单调演化，其由宏观质量-振幅转折驱动，并根本源于吸引与排斥自相互作用之间的微观物理竞争。在最致密的位形中，极端引力透镜会产生显著的嵌套高阶光子环和明显分离的次级像。此外，探索标量势参数空间（Λ, Γ）揭示了阴影尺寸中明显的对角梯度。我们的结果表明，下一代 VLBI 观测不仅能识别无视界天体，还提供了一种新颖的几何途径来直接探测暗物质标量场的微观耦合。
classification.one_liner: 该文用混合度规重构和光线追踪研究双阱势自相互作用玻色子星的阴影与多重透镜环，并指出VLBI可探测其标量场微观耦合。

papers.title: Gravitational and Maxwell--Proca-Type Structures in a Variational Metric-Affine Framework
papers.abstract: We study Einstein's nonsymmetric metric-affine Lagrangian density with a generally nonsymmetric metric and an affine connection treated as independent variational variables. The resulting connection equation belongs to the classical Einstein--Hlavat\'y--Tonnelat framework, while the unrestricted metric Euler--Lagrange equation is analyzed without a divergence constraint on the antisymmetric metric density. Its symmetric part takes the form of Einstein-type gravitational equations with geometrically induced source terms and reduces to the vacuum Einstein equations in the torsion-free limit. The antisymmetric part becomes a geometric constitutive relation based on the irreducible decomposition of torsion. Its contracted four-divergence yields a general vector-field equation with geometric source and response terms. Under a trace--axial reduction, $Q=0$ gives a source-free Maxwell-type equation, whereas constant nonzero $Q$ gives a Proca-type equation. Independently, a trace of the generalized Bianchi identities yields the homogeneous Maxwell-type pair associated with the torsion trace, while the connection equation implies a Lorenz-type condition. Thus gravitational, constitutive, Maxwell--Proca-type, and Lorenz-type structures arise as compatible consequences of one metric-affine variational system. The antisymmetric dynamical level is generated by the contracted four-divergence of its constitutive level. No independent electromagnetic or matter field is introduced.

classification.title_zh: 变分度量-仿射框架中的引力与Maxwell-Proca型结构
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究爱因斯坦非对称度量-仿射拉格朗日密度，其中度规一般非对称，仿射联络作为独立变分变量处理。所得联络方程属于经典Einstein-Hlavatý-Tonnelat框架；在不对反对称度规密度施加散度约束的情况下分析无限制度规Euler-Lagrange方程。其对称部分呈爱因斯坦型引力方程形式，含几何诱导源项，并在无挠极限下约化为真空爱因斯坦方程；反对称部分则基于挠率不可约分解成为几何本构关系。其缩并四维散度给出带几何源项和响应项的一般矢量场方程。在迹-轴 reductions 下，Q=0给出无源Maxwell型方程，而常数非零Q给出Proca型方程。广义Bianchi恒等式的迹给出与挠率迹相关的齐次Maxwell型方程对，联络方程则蕴含Lorenz型条件。因此引力、本构、Maxwell-Proca型与Lorenz型结构作为一个度量-仿射变分系统的相容结果出现；反对称动力学层级由其本构层级的缩并四维散度产生，且未引入独立电磁场或物质场。
classification.one_liner: 在非对称度量-仿射变分框架中，几何挠率与度规结构自然导出了引力、本构关系以及Maxwell-Proca型和Lorenz型方程。

papers.title: Holographic Butterfly Velocity and Heavy-Quark Drag in a Doubly Anisotropic Magnetized QGP
papers.abstract: We investigate butterfly velocity and heavy-quark energy loss in a strongly coupled quark-gluon plasma with two distinct sources of anisotropy, generated by collision geometry and an external magnetic field, within a five-dimensional holographic model exhibiting magnetic catalysis. In contrast to studies restricted to isotropic or singly anisotropic media, we analyze the butterfly velocity and heavy-quark drag force along all three orthogonal spatial directions at finite temperature and chemical potential in the deconfined phase. We find that the collision-induced anisotropy plays a dominant role in the directional dependence of both butterfly velocity and heavy-quark drag. It governs the directional splitting of the butterfly velocity, and significantly enhances the parallel drag force while suppressing the transverse components. For butterfly velocity, a strong magnetic field primarily suppresses the longitudinal butterfly velocity while leaving the transverse components nearly unchanged. For the drag force, the magnetic field breaks the transverse symmetry, yet it does not alter the overall monotonic increase of the drag force with heavy-quark velocity, temperature, and chemical potential. Most importantly, by bridging the Einstein and string frames via the Weyl transformation, we extract the frame-dependent drag-chaos relation. Generalizing it to the doubly anisotropic plasma, we demonstrate that despite the underlying frame-dependent chaos, the normalized directional drag exhibits a direction-dependent geometric correction at order $\mathcal{O}(v^{3})$. These results establish a direction-resolved connection between heavy-quark dissipation, information scrambling, and the underlying anisotropic geometry of magnetized QGP.

classification.title_zh: 双各向异性磁化QGP中的全息蝴蝶速度与重夸克阻力
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在具有磁催化的五维全息模型中，研究同时由碰撞几何与外部磁场引入两种各向异性的强耦合夸克-胶子等离子体中的蝴蝶速度和重夸克能量损失。不同于仅处理各向同性或单各向异性介质的工作，作者在退禁闭相、有限温度和化学势下，沿三个正交空间方向分析蝴蝶速度与重夸克阻力。结果表明，碰撞诱导的各向异性主导蝴蝶速度和重夸克阻力的方向依赖：它控制蝴蝶速度的方向劈裂，并显著增强平行阻力、压低横向分量；强磁场主要压低纵向蝴蝶速度，而横向分量几乎不变；对阻力，磁场破坏横向对称性，但不改变阻力随重夸克速度、温度和化学势整体单调增加的趋势。作者进一步通过Weyl变换联系Einstein标架与弦标架，提取标架依赖的阻力-混沌关系，并推广到双各向异性等离子体，证明在标架依赖的混沌背景下，归一化方向阻力在 O(v^3) 阶出现方向依赖的几何修正。这些结果建立了重夸克耗散、信息扰乱与磁化QGP各向异性几何之间的方向分辨联系。
classification.one_liner: 在双各向异性磁化全息QGP中，碰撞各向异性主导蝴蝶速度与重夸克阻力的方向依赖，并给出O(v^3)方向修正的阻力-混沌关系。

papers.title: Little Red Dots from Small-Scale Primordial Black Hole Clustering
papers.abstract: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations have identified a class of compact galaxies at high redshifts ($4 \lesssim z \lesssim 8$), dubbed "little red dots" (LRDs). The supermassive black holes (SMBHs) of $10^{5-8}{\rm\,M}_{\odot}$ in LRDs favor a heavy-seed origin. We propose a mechanism for their formation: Clusters of primordial black holes, formed through long-short mode coupling on small scales in the early Universe, undergo sequential mergers over extended timescales. This mechanism can evade cosmic microwave background distortions and result in heavy-seed SMBHs via runaway mergers. We employ Monte Carlo simulations to solve the Smoluchowski coagulation equation and determine the runaway merging timescale. The resulting stochastic gravitational wave background offers a distinctive signature of this process, and our model suggests highly spinning SMBHs at their formation if they inherit the spin residual of the cluster from tidal fields.

classification.title_zh: 小尺度原初黑洞成团形成的小红点
classification.abstract_zh: JWST 观测发现高红移（4≲z≲8）的一类致密星系，称为“小红点”(LRDs)。LRDs 中 10^{5-8} M⊙ 的超大质量黑洞倾向于重种子起源。我们提出其形成机制：早期宇宙小尺度上通过长短模式耦合形成的原初黑洞团簇，在较长时间尺度上经历序贯并合。该机制可规避 CMB 畸变，并通过失控并合产生重种子 SMBH。我们采用 Monte Carlo 模拟求解 Smoluchowski 凝聚方程，确定失控并合时标。由此产生的随机引力波背景为这一过程提供独特特征；若团簇从潮汐场继承自旋残余，我们的模型表明形成的 SMBH 具有高自旋。
classification.one_liner: 小尺度原初黑洞成团经失控并合形成 LRD 中的重种子超大质量黑洞，并给出随机引力波背景特征。

papers.title: Accretion onto a moving black hole for stiff equations of state
papers.abstract: We revisit accretion of an asymptotically uniform fluid onto a moving Schwarzschild black hole, the relativistic analog of Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton accretion. Expanding on previous treatments, we focus on relativistic accretion of stiff fluids with adiabatic indices $\Gamma \geq 5/3$, which is particularly relevant for the treatment of primordial black holes captured by neutron stars. We perform numerical simulations to systematically explore the dependence of the steady-state accretion and drag rates on the asymptotic sound speed $a_\infty$ and relative speed $v_\infty$, and identify different regimes, both subsonic and supersonic, in which these rates either increase or decrease with respect to the spherical accretion rate for $v_\infty = 0$. We propose simple analytical approximations that capture the qualitative features observed in the dependence of the accretion and drag rates on $a_\infty$ and $v_\infty$.

classification.title_zh: 运动黑洞对刚性物态方程物质的吸积
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新研究运动 Schwarzschild 黑洞对渐近均匀流体的吸积，即相对论性 Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton 吸积。作者重点考察绝热指数 Γ≥5/3 的刚性流体，并用数值模拟系统研究稳态吸积率和阻力率随渐近声速与相对速度的变化，区分亚声速和超声速区域，提出能刻画主要定性特征的简单解析近似。
classification.one_liner: 数值研究运动 Schwarzschild 黑洞对刚性流体的相对论 BHL 吸积与阻力规律。
