papers.title: Constraints on ultralight bosons from merging binary and remnant black holes observed during the second and third parts of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run
papers.abstract: We present constraints on ultralight bosons using binary black hole mergers observed in the second and third parts of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run. Directed searches are conducted for long-transient gravitational waves from ultralight vector boson clouds around merger remnants, using a hidden-Markov-model (HMM) tracking scheme. We target the remnant black holes formed in the binary coalescences that produced GW250114 and GW250207. We find no evidence for such signals from either target. Estimating our search sensitivity at a threshold corresponding to a 1% false alarm probability, we thus disfavor vector boson masses in the range of $[2.80, 3.95]\times 10^{-13}$ eV with greater than 90% confidence. In addition, we derive constraints on ultralight scalar and vector bosons from the inferred high spins of the constituent black holes in three binaries, using events GW240515, GW241113, and GW241225_08. The excluded mass ranges in this approach depend on the assumed black-hole ages. At $10^5$ years, corresponding to typical dynamically formed binaries, we exclude scalar and vector bosons in the ranges $[1.39, 6.94]\times 10^{-13}$ eV and $[0.32, 14.4]\times 10^{-13}$ eV at 90% confidence, respectively.

classification.title_zh: 来自第四轮 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行第二、三部分双黑洞并合及残余黑洞对超轻玻色子的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用第四轮 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行第二和第三部分观测到的双黑洞并合，给出对超轻玻色子的限制。针对并合残余黑洞周围的超轻矢量玻色子云产生的长时标暂现引力波，使用隐马尔可夫模型跟踪方案进行定向搜索。目标是由 GW250114 和 GW250207 所对应的双星并合形成的残余黑洞。两个目标均未发现此类信号。在对应于 1% 虚警概率的阈值下估计搜索灵敏度，因此我们在大于 90% 置信度下排除 [2.80, 3.95]×10^-13 eV 范围内的矢量玻色子质量。此外，我们利用三个双星系统（事件 GW240515、GW241113 和 GW241225_08）中组成黑洞推断出的高自旋，给出对超轻标量和矢量玻色子的限制。该方法排除的质量范围依赖于所假设的黑洞年龄。在 10^5 年（对应于典型动力学形成的双星）时，我们分别在 90% 置信度下排除 [1.39, 6.94]×10^-13 eV 和 [0.32, 14.4]×10^-13 eV 范围内的标量和矢量玻色子。

papers.title: Dendro-GR at high mass ratios with high spins
papers.abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) launches in less than a decade; it will detect spinning high-mass-ratio binary black hole inspirals annually, alongside other third-generation gravitational wave detectors. High-mass-ratio systems occupy a regime where numerical-relativity simulations remain computationally expensive and technically demanding, especially with high spins at precessing orientations. This portion of parameter space thus remains undersampled, leading to significant bias in parameter estimation. We must close these gaps. Here we report key progress in Dendro-GR toward reducing the computational cost of high-mass-ratio binaries with spin. We evolve the first Dendro-GR binaries at mass ratio $q=24$ (nonspinning) and at $q=12$ with spins up to $\chi=0.8$ on both black holes, spanning various configurations. These proof-of-concept runs show strong evidence that Dendro-GR can simulate in this regime and beyond. The simulations resolve the expected multipolar hierarchy in the gravitational waveforms through multipole modes up to $\ell=8$, remain stable, keep constraint violations low and largely constant, conserve horizon mass, and have high computational efficiency with relatively low wall-hour cost. These results establish our starting line for systematic exploration of the high-mass-ratio, high-spin binary black hole systems that are needed for gravitational wave analysis.

classification.title_zh: 高 mass ratio 与高自旋条件下的 Dendro-GR 数值相对论模拟
classification.abstract_zh: LISA 及第三代引力波探测器将探测自旋的高 mass ratio 双黑洞并合。该参数区域，尤其是高自旋进动取向情形，数值相对论模拟计算昂贵且技术困难，样本不足并导致参数估计偏差。本文报告 Dendro-GR 在降低带自旋高 mass ratio 双黑洞计算成本方面的进展：首次演化 q=24 无自旋以及 q=12、两个黑洞自旋达 χ=0.8 的多种构型。概念验证运行显示 Dendro-GR 能在该区域及更极端情形模拟，波形分辨到 ℓ=8 的多极模式，模拟稳定，约束违反低且基本恒定，视界质量守恒，计算效率高、墙钟小时成本较低。这些结果为系统探索引力波分析所需的高 mass ratio、高自旋双黑洞系统奠定起点。
classification.one_liner: Dendro-GR 首次在高 mass ratio 与高自旋双黑洞并合中展示稳定、高效且多极分辨率良好的数值相对论模拟能力。

papers.title: Joule-Thomson Effect and Geodesic Structure of Charged AdS Black Holes in f(R,T) Coupled with Nonlinear Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We herein study both the Joule-Thomson (JT) expansion process and the geodesic properties of a charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole arising in modified gravity with nonlinear electrodynamic (NLED) sources. Our thermodynamic study reveals that the black hole charge has the most pronounced impact on the JT behaviour. The nonlinear electromagnetic sector together with the modified gravity parameters introduces further corrections to the inversion temperature and the associated cooling characteristics. At astrophysically relevant distances, the geometry closely reproduces expected outcomes.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T)与非线性电动力学耦合下带电AdS黑洞的焦耳-汤姆孙效应与测地线结构
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由非线性电动力学源产生的修正引力中带电反德西特（AdS）黑洞的焦耳-汤姆孙（JT）膨胀过程与测地线性质。热力学研究表明，黑洞电荷对JT行为影响最显著。非线性电磁部分与修正引力参数进一步修正反转温度及相应冷却特征。在天体物理相关距离上，几何结构很好地重现预期结果。

papers.title: The inclination cross-check: binary-pulsar timing and gravitational-wave polarimetry
papers.abstract: Radio timing and gravitational-wave (GW) polarimetry provide independent measurements of a binary's inclination. We study their consistency through $\eps=s_{\rm Shapiro}-s_{\rm GW}$, where $s_{\rm Shapiro}$ is the Shapiro-delay shape and $s_{\rm GW}$ is inferred from the tensor polarization amplitudes. We combine a time-dependent, finite-arm detector response with radio timing averaged over each integration, retaining the amplitude--inclination covariance and the nonlinear orientation posteriors. For hypothetical 15-minute binaries at 5 kpc and $65^\circ$ inclination, four years of GW data and a 125-h radio campaign give $\sigma_\eps=5.4\times10^{-3}$ for a double neutron star and $1.0\times10^{-3}$ for a pulsar--black-hole binary when two static timing harmonics are fitted. An apsidally evolving radio model with $e=0.01$ and a free apsidal rate gives $4.5\times10^{-3}$ and $0.94\times10^{-3}$, respectively, with the circular GW covariance held fixed. Changes in the relative tensor amplitudes can be absorbed by the GW fit as an apparent inclination shift and revealed by the radio measurement. An inaccurate detector response can produce a similar discrepancy even when its Fisher errors are nearly unchanged. These forecasts use the $n=2$ GW harmonic and assume a fixed orbital plane, sustained radio visibility, and the specified timing precision; additional harmonics can provide further orientation information.

classification.title_zh: 倾角交叉检验：双脉冲星计时与引力波偏振测量
classification.abstract_zh: 射电计时与引力波偏振测量可独立测量双星系统的倾角。我们通过 ε = s_Shapiro - s_GW 研究二者的一致性，其中 s_Shapiro 是 Shapiro 延迟形状，s_GW 由张量偏振振幅推断。我们结合含时有限臂探测器响应与按每次积分平均的射电计时，保留振幅-倾角协方差及非线性取向后验。对于位于 5 kpc、倾角 65° 的假想 15 分钟双星，四年引力波数据和 125 小时射电观测 campaign，在拟合两个静态计时谐波时，双中子星给出 σ_ε=5.4×10^-3，脉冲星-黑洞双星给出 1.0×10^-3。具有 e=0.01 和自由近星点进动率的近星点演化射电模型分别给出 4.5×10^-3 和 0.94×10^-3，同时圆形引力波协方差保持固定。相对张量振幅的变化可被引力波拟合吸收为表观倾角偏移，并由射电测量揭示。即使 Fisher 误差几乎不变，不准确的探测器响应也可产生类似差异。这些预报使用 n=2 引力波谐波，并假设固定轨道平面、持续射电可见性和指定计时精度；额外谐波可提供更多取向信息。
classification.one_liner: 通过比较 Shapiro 延迟形状与张量偏振推断倾角，评估双脉冲星计时与引力波偏振测量的一致性及系统误差可探测性。

papers.title: Probing (sub-)solar-mass black holes and superspinars with current and next-generation gravitational-wave observatories
papers.abstract: We investigate the detectability and parameter estimation prospects of (sub-)solar-mass collapsed binaries with current and next-generation gravitational wave detectors, allowing the dimensionless component spins to extend phenomenologically beyond the Kerr bound, $(|\chi|>1$) (where $\chi$ is the spin parameter). Using the inspiral-only TaylorF2 waveform and a Fisher-matrix analysis, we study binaries with component masses in the range $0.1\!-\!2\,M_\odot$ and compare the performance of Advanced LIGO with that of a third-generation network consisting of Cosmic Explorer and the Einstein Telescope. We find that third-generation detectors substantially improve the signal-to-noise ratio and the measurement of intrinsic binary parameters, particularly the component spins, while also providing significantly improved sky localization. For favorable configurations, the primary spin can be measured with precision $\Delta\chi_{1z}\sim10^{-3}-10^{-2}$, demonstrating enhanced sensitivity to potential Kerr-bound violations. However, strong anti-correlations between the component spins limit the interpretation of small marginalized spin uncertainties as definitive evidence for superspinars. We also examine formation scenarios for (sub-)solar-mass collapsed binaries and show that dense dark-matter environments, particularly the Galactic Centre, can significantly enhance their formation and merger rates. Our results demonstrate the potential of future gravitational wave observations to probe low-mass collapsed objects and possible departures from the Kerr bound, while highlighting the need for physically consistent superspinar waveform models and Bayesian model comparison for a definitive interpretation.

classification.title_zh: 用当前与下一代引力波天文台探测（亚）太阳质量黑洞与超自旋星
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究当前和下一代引力波探测器对（亚）太阳质量坍缩双星的探测能力与参数估计前景，并允许无量纲自旋在现象学上超过Kerr界限（|χ|>1）。作者使用仅包含旋近阶段的TaylorF2波形和Fisher矩阵分析，考察组分质量在0.1–2 M⊙范围内的双星，并比较Advanced LIGO与由Cosmic Explorer和Einstein Telescope组成的第三代网络的性能。结果表明，第三代探测器可显著提高信噪比、内禀双星参数（尤其是组分自旋）的测量精度，并大幅改善天区定位；在有利构型下，主自旋精度可达Δχ1z∼10^-3–10^-2，从而增强对Kerr界限违反的敏感性。不过，组分自旋之间的强反相关限制了将小的边缘化自旋不确定度直接解释为超自旋星证据。文章还讨论了（亚）太阳质量坍缩双星的形成情景，指出致密暗物质环境（尤其是银河系中心）可显著提高其形成与并合率。结论强调未来引力波观测探测低质量坍缩天体和Kerr界限偏离的潜力，同时指出需要物理自洽的超自旋星波形模型和贝叶斯模型比较才能给出确定性解释。

papers.title: Bardeen spacetime as quantum corrected black hole: Grey-body factors and quasinormal modes of gravitational perturbations
papers.abstract: We study axial gravitational perturbations of the asymptotically flat Bardeen spacetime interpreted as a string-T-duality-inspired quantum-corrected Schwarzschild black hole. Starting from the anisotropic-fluid background, we derive the Regge--Wheeler-type master equation and the corresponding effective potential, and compute quasinormal modes with high-order WKB--Pad\'e and time-domain methods. We show that increasing the quantum-correction scale $\ell_0$ raises and shifts the barrier inward, causing the black hole to ring at higher frequencies and decay more slowly. The same deformation suppresses low-frequency transmission, shifts the onset of grey-body factors to larger frequencies, and reorganizes the partial and total absorption cross-sections. Overall, the results identify a clear and consistent imprint of short-distance regularization on both ringdown and scattering observables.

classification.title_zh: 作为量子修正黑洞的Bardeen时空：引力扰动的灰体因子与准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究渐近平直Bardeen时空的轴向引力扰动，并将其解释为受弦论T对偶启发得到的量子修正Schwarzschild黑洞。从各向异性流体背景出发，我们推导Regge-Wheeler型主方程及相应有效势，并用高阶WKB-Padé方法和时域方法计算准正规模。结果表明，增大量子修正尺度ℓ0会抬高势垒并将其向内移动，使黑洞以更高频率振荡且衰减更慢。同一形变还抑制低频透射，使灰体因子的起始频率向更高频移动，并重新组织分波与总吸收截面。总体而言，这些结果确认了短距离正则化在铃宕与散射可观测量上的清晰且一致的印记。

papers.title: Inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ gravity: equivalence to $k$-inflation and ghost instabilities
papers.abstract: We study slow-roll inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ gravity, focusing on whether non-minimal matter--geometry couplings can support viable inflation. We show that the separable class linear in $Q$, $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=-\alpha Q+g(\mathcal{L}_m)$, is equivalent, up to a boundary term, to General Relativity minimally coupled to a $k$-essence scalar field. Thus, it introduces no additional gravitational degrees of freedom, and its inflationary predictions coincide with those of the corresponding $k$-inflation model. For the separable models considered, the observables depend on a single effective parameter combination, yielding a nonzero lower bound on the tensor-to-scalar ratio. While these models may marginally satisfy Planck 2018 constraints alone, they are strongly disfavored by the combined Planck 2018, baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO), and BICEP/Keck 2018 (BK18) constraints. This marginal agreement also requires a sizeable negative effective vacuum-energy contribution, driving the expanding background to $H=0$ shortly after inflation. For representative non-separable models with genuine $Q$-$\mathcal{L}_m$ couplings, including terms proportional to $\gamma QV$ and $\gamma QX$, we derive the quadratic perturbation action and find that two additional scalar degrees of freedom propagate on regular rolling backgrounds satisfying the relevant non-degeneracy conditions. Under these conditions, the kinetic matrix has at least one negative eigenvalue, indicating a ghost instability. Hence, background-level observational predictions alone cannot establish the physical viability of these models. Overall, for the classes considered, inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ gravity either reduces to $k$-inflation in General Relativity or exhibits ghost instabilities on regular, non-degenerate backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: f(Q,L_m) 引力中的暴胀：与 k-暴胀的等价性及鬼不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 f(Q,L_m) 引力中的慢滚暴胀，重点考察非最小物质—几何耦合能否支持可行暴胀。作者表明，对 Q 线性的可分离类 f(Q,L_m)=-αQ+g(L_m)，在相差一个边界项的意义下等价于广义相对论最小耦合一个 k-essence 标量场；因此不引入额外引力自由度，其暴胀预言与相应 k-暴胀模型一致。对所考虑的可分离模型，观测量依赖单一有效参数组合，并给出张标比的非零下界。这些模型单独看可能勉强满足 Planck 2018 限制，但被 Planck 2018、BAO 与 BK18 的联合限制强烈排除；这种勉强符合还要求相当大的负有效真空能贡献，使膨胀背景在暴胀后不久达到 H=0。对于具有真实 Q-L_m 耦合的代表性不可分离模型，包括正比于 γQV 和 γQX 的项，作者推导了二阶扰动作用量，发现在满足相关非退化条件的正则滚动背景上有两个额外标量自由度传播；在这些条件下，动能矩阵至少有一个负本征值，表明存在鬼不稳定性。因此，仅靠背景层面的观测预言不能确立这些模型的物理可行性。总体而言，对所考虑的类别，f(Q,L_m) 引力中的暴胀要么约化为广义相对论中的 k-暴胀，要么在正则、非退化背景上表现出鬼不稳定性。

papers.title: Nonlinear evolution of the spin-2 black hole superradiant instability
papers.abstract: Massive spin-2 fields, which arise in proposed extensions of the standard model of particle physics and general relativity, give rise to a superradiant instability around spinning black holes. We study the nonlinear evolution of this instability in quadratic gravity, where quadratic curvature terms are added to the Einstein-Hilbert action. In this theory, we find that as the massive spin-2 field grows, the black hole's spin increases, accelerating the growth rate, and eventually leading to a superextremal horizon. This sharply contrasts with the spin-down and eventual saturation that occurs due to the backreaction of the superradiant instability of a minimally coupled massive spin-0 or spin-1 field.

classification.title_zh: 自旋-2黑洞超辐射不稳定性的非线性演化
classification.abstract_zh: 在粒子物理标准模型与广义相对论的若干扩展中出现的质量自旋-2场，会在旋转黑洞周围引起超辐射不稳定性。我们在二次引力（在Einstein-Hilbert作用量中加入二次曲率项）中研究该不稳定性的非线性演化。在此理论中，我们发现随着质量自旋-2场增长，黑洞自旋增加，从而加速增长率，并最终导致超极端视界。这与最小耦合质量自旋-0或自旋-1场超辐射不稳定性的反作用所导致的减速并最终饱和形成鲜明对比。

papers.title: Consistent solution of Einstein-Cartan equations with torsion outside matter
papers.abstract: The Einstein-Cartan equations in first-order action of torsion are considered. From Belinfante-Rosenfeld equation special consistence conditions are derived for the torsion parameters relating them to the metric. Inside matter the torsion is given by the spin which leads to an extended Oppenhaimer-Volkov equation. Outside matter a second solution is found besides the torsion-free Schwarzschild one with the torsion completely determined by the metric and vice-versa. This solution is shown to be of non-spherical origin and its uniqueness with respect to the consistence is demonstrated. Unusual properties are discussed in different coordinate systems where the cosmological constant assumes the role of the Friedman parameter in Friedman-Lama\^itre-Robertson-Walker cosmoses. Parameters are specified where wormholes are possible. Transformations are presented to explore and map regions of expanding and contracting universes to the form of static metrics. The autoparallel equations are solved exactly and compared with geodesic motion. The Weyl tensor reveals that the here found solution is of Petrov-D type.

classification.title_zh: 物质外带挠率的爱因斯坦-嘉当方程的一致解
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑一阶作用量形式下带挠率的爱因斯坦-嘉当方程。由Belinfante-Rosenfeld方程导出挠率参数与度规相关的特殊一致性条件。在物质内部，挠率由自旋给出，并导致扩展的Oppenheimer-Volkov方程；在物质外部，除无挠Schwarzschild解外还发现第二个解，其中挠率完全由度规决定，反之亦然。该解被证明具有非球对称起源，并展示了其相对于一致性条件的唯一性。文中在不同坐标系下讨论了其不寻常性质，其中宇宙学常数扮演FRW宇宙中Friedman参数的角色，并给出允许虫洞存在的参数范围。文章还给出将膨胀和收缩宇宙区域映射为静态度规形式的变换，精确求解了自平行方程并与测地线运动比较；Weyl张量表明该解属于Petrov-D型。
classification.one_liner: 研究物质外爱因斯坦-嘉当挠率方程的一致解，给出除Schwarzschild外由度规决定挠率的新解及其宇宙学与虫洞性质。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Einstein-Cartan挠率方程、经典时空解及宇宙学/虫洞性质，符合用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave hierarchical inference from population samples
papers.abstract: Standard approaches to gravitational-wave population inference require evaluating the probability density of the population model. While appropriate for models composed of exact functional forms, this approach is not compatible with state-of-the-art astrophysical predictions from population-synthesis codes, which simulate samples from astrophysical models whose densities are unknown. We present an approach that solely requires samples and never density evaluations of the targeted population model. Key technical ingredients include efficient surrogates for the single-event likelihoods and detection probability, together with an efficient sampling strategy. Using detections up to GWTC-5.0, we validate the method against standard inference with a parametric model, showcase its flexibility on a simulated population including hierarchical mergers, and present a realistic application to a grid of astrophysical population-synthesis simulations with five formation channels. This work paves the way toward a direct comparison of astrophysical models and gravitational-wave data.

classification.title_zh: 基于族群样本的引力波层级推断
classification.abstract_zh: 标准引力波族群推断需要计算族群模型的概率密度。对于由精确函数形式构成的模型这合适，但与最先进的天体物理族群合成代码预测不兼容，因为这些代码从密度未知的模型模拟样本。我们提出一种仅需样本、从不评估目标族群模型密度的方法。关键技术包括单事件似然和探测概率的高效代理模型，以及高效采样策略。利用截至 GWTC-5.0 的探测事件，我们用参数化模型的标准推断验证该方法，在包含层级并合的模拟族群上展示灵活性，并给出对包含五个形成通道的天体物理族群合成模拟网格的实际应用。该工作为直接比较天体物理模型与引力波数据铺路。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种仅依赖样本、无需族群模型密度评估的引力波族群层级推断方法，并用 GWTC-5.0 验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波族群推断与天体物理模型比较方法，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子信息或量子引力等用户重点方向。

papers.title: The Gravitational Wave Foreground from Galactic Cataclysmic Variables in LISA
papers.abstract: Electromagnetic observations have been the primary medium for studying cataclysmic variable (CV) systems, capitalizing on the invaluable opportunity they present to study binary stellar evolution and accretion. The launch of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) mission, however, will enable a multi-messenger perspective of the population. We extend previous work to explore the gravitational wave (GW) spectra sourced by a local and Galactic population of CVs. Using the Bayesian LISA Inference Package (BLIP), we simulate LISA data containing these CV populations to understand their impact and our ability to jointly model CV and double white dwarf (DWD) GW spectra. While we find that a local CV population has negligible effect on the LISA datastream, a Galactic CV population will have a signal-to-noise ratio of approximately 76, depending on the characteristics of the DWD population present, and will bias existing DWD spectral models if ignored. Current approaches struggle to accurately recover both populations' respective spectra, calling for the creation of multi-component spectral models that include GW contributions from both CVs and DWDs. These results point toward a promising future for the study of CVs with LISA.

classification.title_zh: LISA中银河系激变变星产生的引力波前景
classification.abstract_zh: 该文研究激变变星（CV）群体在LISA频段产生的引力波谱，并用贝叶斯LISA推断软件包模拟包含CV与双白矮星（DWD）群体的LISA数据，分析二者联合建模的能力。结果显示，本地CV群体对LISA数据流影响可忽略，而银河系CV群体信噪比约为76，且若被忽略会偏置现有DWD谱模型；当前方法难以准确恢复两个群体的谱，需要包含CV与DWD引力波贡献的多分量谱模型。
classification.one_liner: 模拟表明银河系激变变星会形成可观的LISA引力波前景，并可能偏置双白矮星谱推断。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波天体物理与LISA数据模拟，不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Holographically motivated Hubble-running dark energy: Phantom-divide crossing in VCDM and observational constraints
papers.abstract: Motivated by power-law dependences on the expansion scale in holographic dark-energy constructions, we study the Hubble-running equation of state $w_{\rm DE}=w_0(H/H_0)^q$ (HoloEoS), where $H$ is the Hubble expansion rate, $H_0$ and $w_0$ are the present values of $H$ and $w_{\rm DE}$, and $q$ is a constant dimensionless exponent controlling the running. We embed this history in VCDM, a type-II minimally modified gravity theory that propagates only the two tensor modes of general relativity. For regular expanding histories with standard matter, we reconstruct the potential $V(\phi)$ of its nondynamical auxiliary scalar field, providing a Lagrangian description of both the homogeneous background and cosmological perturbations. This framework allows HoloEoS to realize a smooth late-time crossing of the phantom divide $w_{\rm DE}=-1$. We confront this VCDM realization with SPT, Planck, and ACT CMB data, updated DESI DR2 distances, and optionally DESY5 supernovae with Dovekie recalibration, comparing it with $\Lambda$CDM and the Chevallier--Polarski--Linder parameterization embedded in the same gravitational framework (CPL-VCDM). For the full data combination, the posterior medians and central $68\%$ credible intervals are $w_0=-0.881^{+0.040}_{-0.038}$ and $q=0.453^{+0.143}_{-0.133}$, with a crossing redshift $z_\times=0.476^{+0.106}_{-0.081}$ conditional on $0<z_\times<6$. For this data combination, physical-likelihood optimization by Metropolis--Hastings (MH) simulated annealing gives Akaike information criterion differences of $\Delta\mathrm{AIC}\simeq-3.40$ for HoloEoS and $-4.10$ for CPL-VCDM relative to $\Lambda$CDM. Thus, a Hubble-scale-motivated dark-energy history realized within a specified gravitational theory achieves fitting performance comparable to CPL-VCDM while naturally allowing phantom-divide crossing.

classification.title_zh: 全息启发的哈勃跑动暗能量：VCDM中的幻影分界穿越与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 受全息暗能量构造中膨胀尺度幂律依赖的启发，研究哈勃跑动状态方程 w_DE=w0(H/H0)^q。将该历史嵌入VCDM——一种仅传播广义相对论两个张量模式的II型最小修改引力理论——并重构其非动力学辅助标量场的势，给出均匀背景和宇宙学扰动的拉格朗日描述。该框架可使HoloEoS实现晚期平滑穿越幻影分界 w_DE=-1。利用SPT、Planck和ACT CMB数据、更新的DESI DR2距离以及可选的DESY5超新星（Dovekie重校准）进行约束，并与同一引力框架中的ΛCDM和CPL参数化比较。
classification.one_liner: 在全息启发暗能量方程态中嵌入VCDM修改引力，实现幻影分界穿越并用CMB/BAO/SNe数据约束。

papers.title: Composition-dependent ultralight dark matter detection with a tetrahedral superconducting gravity gradiometer
papers.abstract: Tetrahedral superconducting gravity gradiometers designed as full-tensor gravitational-wave detectors, such as the ground-based mSOGRO design and the proposed lunar LANGO observatory, reconstruct the acceleration-gradient tensor from four test masses. We show that giving the four test masses two compositions in a $2+2$ arrangement adds a composition-dependent ultralight dark matter (ULDM) channel to that same tensor readout, with no separate dark-matter sensor and no dark-matter-specific readout. A coherently oscillating scalar accelerates each mass in proportion to its dilaton charge, and the tensor reconstruction leaves the charges only in a mean, rejected with the common mode, and a single vector $\qv$ proportional to the charge contrast $\Delta\abaralpha_{AB}$ between the two materials. The response is the rank-one tensor $\K_{\ULDM}(t)=\gv_\phi(t)\otimes\qv$, whose amplitude is set by the halo, independent of $m_\phi$. The axis of $\qv$ is fixed in advance by the material assignment, so the response obeys the null condition $\K_{\ULDM}(\mathbf{I}-\Pq)=0$ at every instant, for any $\gv_\phi$ including a virialized field with a stochastic gradient---an exact tensor discriminator against gravitational-wave signals; for a single composition $\qv=0$. With the gravitational-wave noise model, the coupling sensitivity for copper and lead test masses reaches $d_{\hat m}-d_g\simeq3.4\times10^{-8}$ for the baseline instrument and $4.9\times10^{-10}$ with upgraded accelerometers. The rank-one factorization and the null condition are summarized in a companion Letter; the present paper gives the derivations and the detector-level analysis.

classification.title_zh: 利用四面体超导重力梯度仪进行组分依赖的超轻暗物质探测
classification.abstract_zh: 四面体超导重力梯度仪被设计为全张量引力波探测器，例如地面 mSOGRO 方案和拟议的月球 LANGO 天文台，它们从四个检验质量重建加速度梯度张量。作者表明，将四个检验质量按 2+2 安排赋予两种材料组分，可在同一张量读出中增加一个组分依赖的超轻暗物质通道，而无需单独的暗物质传感器或专用读出。相干振荡标量场按每个质量的伸缩子荷加速质量；张量重建后，荷只保留在共同模中被排除的均值和一个正比于两种材料荷差 Δα_AB 的矢量 q 中。响应为秩一张量 K_ULDM(t)=g_phi(t)⊗q，其幅度由暗物质晕决定，与 m_phi 无关。q 的轴由材料指派预先固定，因此响应在任意时刻满足零条件 K_ULDM(I-P)=0，对任意 g_phi（包括具有随机梯度的维里化场）成立，从而构成对引力波信号的精确张量判别；单一组分时 q=0。采用引力波噪声模型，铜和铅检验质量的耦合灵敏度在基线仪器达到 d_m-d_g≈3.4×10^-8，升级加速度计后达到 4.9×10^-10。论文给出推导和探测器层面分析，秩一分解和零条件在配套快报中总结。
classification.one_liner: 在四面体超导重力梯度仪中用两种材料检验质量的 2+2 布局，将同一张量读出转化为组分依赖的超轻暗物质探测通道，并给出对引力波信号的精确张量判别。

papers.title: Notes on the singularity theorems of general relativity
papers.abstract: The notes begin with an exploration of the local geometry of spacetime and proceed with an investigation of its global causal structure. The results obtained are used to present a proof of the Hawking cosmological and the Penrose black hole singularity theorems. The aim is to give a pedagogical, but still technical, proof of the statements. The notes include a large number of drawings to aid the understanding of the material and many examples to explain key concepts. Some of the mathematical tools utilised in the proof of the singularity theorems are also illustrated. These include an extensive description of the topological and analytic properties of curves and their spaces, of the Arzel\'a-Ascoli theorem and of the properties of semi-continuous functions. The Hopf-Rinow theorem, which describes the conditions for geodesic completeness in the context of Riemannian manifolds, is also partially demonstrated.

classification.title_zh: 关于广义相对论奇点定理的笔记
classification.abstract_zh: 这些笔记从时空的局部几何出发，进而研究其整体因果结构。所得结果用于给出霍金宇宙学奇点定理和彭罗斯黑洞奇点定理的证明。目标是提供一种教学式但仍然技术性的证明。笔记包含大量图示以帮助理解材料，并有许多例子解释关键概念。证明奇点定理所使用的某些数学工具也得到了说明。这些包括对曲线及其空间的拓扑和分析性质的广泛描述、Arzelà-Ascoli 定理以及半连续函数的性质。还部分演示了 Hopf-Rinow 定理，该定理描述了黎曼流形中测地完备性的条件。
classification.one_liner: 教学式但技术性地证明霍金宇宙学奇点定理与彭罗斯黑洞奇点定理，并介绍所需的因果结构与数学工具。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于经典广义相对论与黑洞奇点定理，适合经典引力/广义相对论支线；但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of dyonic axion black holes with nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We study quasinormal modes (QNMs) of static charged black holes with a massless axion and nonlinear electrodynamics (NED). Without NED corrections, we compute the complex QNM frequencies of five oscillatory mode families in the system of five dynamical degrees of freedom. These families are continued from the fundamental Reissner--Nordstr\"om (RN) modes. Axion coupling generically breaks gravitational and electromagnetic parity isospectrality. At representative nonzero couplings, all five frequencies are distinct even on purely electric RN backgrounds without axion hair. Adding magnetic charge sources axion hair, couples all five perturbations, and modifies their oscillation frequencies and damping rates. Additional purely imaginary growing modes occur in some strong-coupling benchmarks. The known electromagnetic--scalar spectral degeneracy at $Q/M=\sqrt{7}/4$ for $\ell=2$ in the decoupled RN limit explains the linear frequency splitting induced by a small axion coupling. We include two quartic NED interactions obtained by squaring the two standard electromagnetic invariants. With the axion decoupled and equal quartic coefficients, electromagnetic duality makes the first-order NED frequency shift of each individual gravitational or electromagnetic branch independent of electric--magnetic charge composition at fixed $Q/M$. For unequal coefficients, duality instead constrains the sum of the first-order NED frequency shifts within each isolated RN parity pair. Depending on the coefficients, NED increases or decreases the damping rates by about one percent in representative backgrounds, while the quartic terms remain small compared with the local Maxwell energy density throughout the exterior. The QNM frequencies and NED shifts obtained with the spectral method agree with independent integration-and-matching results at representative parameter values.

classification.title_zh: 含非线性电动力学的双荷轴子黑洞准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究带有无质量轴子和非线性电动力学（NED）的静态带电黑洞的准正规模（QNMs）。在没有 NED 修正时，我们计算五个动力学自由度系统中五个振荡模族的复 QNM 频率；这些模族由 Reissner–Nordström（RN）基频模延续而来。轴子耦合通常会破坏引力与电磁宇称等谱性。在代表性的非零耦合下，即使在没有轴子毛的纯电 RN 背景上，五个频率也彼此不同。引入磁荷会源生轴子毛，耦合五个微扰，并改变其振荡频率和阻尼率。在某些强耦合基准中还会出现额外的纯虚增长模。解耦 RN 极限下 ℓ=2、Q/M=√7/4 处已知的电磁—标量谱简并解释了小轴子耦合导致的线性频率劈裂。我们纳入由两个标准电磁不变量平方得到的两种四次 NED 相互作用。当轴子解耦且四次项系数相等时，电磁对偶使每个单独的引力或电磁分支的一阶 NED 频率移动在固定 Q/M 下不依赖于电磁荷组成；对于不等系数，对偶性转而约束每个孤立 RN 宇称对内一阶 NED 频率移动之和。取决于系数，NED 在代表性背景中使阻尼率增加或减少约百分之一，同时在整个外部区域四次项相对于局域 Maxwell 能量密度仍很小。用谱方法得到的 QNM 频率和 NED 移动在代表性参数值与独立积分—匹配结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 研究含轴子与非线性电动力学的双荷黑洞准正规模，分析宇称等谱性破缺、磁荷效应及四次 NED 修正。

papers.title: Axial gravitational-wave propagation and mass--gravity identifiability in conformal scalar--tensor lensing
papers.abstract: We investigate tensor-wave propagation in a specified massless, unscreened conformal scalar--tensor theory using a static Einstein--scalar exterior matched to a weakly self-gravitating matter lens. The odd-parity gravitational master potential has a scalar-charge correction at radial order $R^{-4}$ for fixed Einstein-frame mass. Its next $R^{-5}$ coefficient depends on $\ell(\ell+1)-9$, reversing sign between the quadrupole and higher multipoles; we test the expansion against the exact exterior potential. We connect this result to the locally normalized post-Newtonian light-deflection parameter and distinguish the Schwarzschild baseline at fixed Einstein-frame mass from that at fixed measured matter mass. A finite-radius WKB expansion reveals cancellation of the leading frequency-dependent potential moment for the quadrupole at fixed multipole, whereas a separate fixed-impact-parameter limit recovers an achromatic geometrical-optics action and a subleading axial contribution. Independent null-geodesic bending and numerical quadrature check these limits. For a point lens, achromatic observables constrain an effective mass rather than the lens mass and scalar coupling separately. An illustrative two-image Fisher calculation quantifies differential-phase identifiability after arrival-time and constant-phase nuisance parameters are released. The phenomenological phase experiment is separated from action-derived propagation quantities; model-specific dispersive observations require a complete matched image transfer function.

classification.title_zh: 共形标量-张量透镜中的轴模引力波传播与质量-引力可辨识性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在指定的无质量、未屏蔽共形标量-张量理论中的张量波传播，采用与弱自引力物质透镜匹配的静态 Einstein-scalar 外部解。对于固定 Einstein 标架质量，奇宇称引力主势在径向 R^{-4} 阶出现标量荷修正；其下一阶 R^{-5} 系数依赖 ell(ell+1)-9，并在四极与更高多极之间改变符号；作者用精确外部势检验该展开。文章将此结果与局部归一化的后牛顿光偏折参数联系，并区分固定 Einstein 标架质量与固定测量物质质量下的 Schwarzschild 基线。有限半径 WKB 展开显示，在固定多极下四极的主导频率依赖势矩发生抵消，而另一个固定碰撞参数极限恢复消色散几何光学作用量及次领头轴模贡献。独立零测地线弯折与数值求积检验了这些极限。对于点透镜，消色散可观测量约束的是有效质量，而非分别约束透镜质量与标量耦合。一个示意性的双像 Fisher 计算在释放到达时间与常数相位 nuisance 参数后量化了差分相位可辨识性。唯象相位实验与由作用量导出的传播量被区分开；模型特定的色散观测需要完整的匹配像传递函数。
classification.one_liner: 研究共形标量-张量透镜中轴模引力波传播及其对质量与标量耦合可辨识性的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/修改引力、引力波传播与透镜研究，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息或量子信息，因此对全息主线相关性有限。

papers.title: Binary neutron stars in the next-generation era: multimessenger detection prospects and constraints on the equation of state, mass distribution, and cosmology
papers.abstract: Next-generation gravitational-wave (GW) observatories will provide crucial insights into the nature of neutron star (NS) matter and the cosmological expansion history. We estimate the number of multimessenger detections of binary neutron stars (BNS) with the Einstein Telescope (ET) and Cosmic Explorer (CE) and project the resulting constraints on the equation of state (EOS), BNS mass distribution, and cosmology using joint hierarchical Bayesian inference. Our results rely on specific assumptions for the merger rate, EOS, and mass distribution; we consider two different mass functions, a narrow one centred around 1.4 $M_\odot$ and a wide one ranging from 1.1 to 2 $M_\odot$, and a merger rate with a local value of 107 Gpc$^{-3}$ yr$^{-1}$. Under this setup, our mock follow-up algorithm results in between $\sim40$ and $\sim100$ short-term electromagnetic counterparts per year for ET, depending on the detector layout and mass distribution. In a joint network with CE, this number ranges from $\sim 100$ to $\sim500$. Additionally, we project tens to hundreds of late-time afterglow detections from gamma-ray bursts or kilonovae (KNe). Based on the generated multimessenger events, we perform an injection campaign to hierarchically recover the EOS, mass distribution, and cosmology in a fully Bayesian framework. Focusing on KN events from ET alone, the multimessenger data from our largest analysed catalogue with 78 events can constrain the canonical NS radius $R_{1.4}$ to $\lesssim 0.2$ km and the Hubble constant $H_0$ to $\lesssim 1$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$, at least in absence of systematic modelling offsets. By comparing inference results that are solely based on GW data and those incorporating light-curve information, we find that while the latter has negligible impact on the EOS constraints, it can benefit the inference of cosmological parameters.

classification.title_zh: 下一代时代下的双中子星：多信使探测前景及对状态方程、质量分布和宇宙学的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 下一代引力波天文台将为中子星物质性质和宇宙膨胀历史提供关键信息。本文估计爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）和宇宙探索者（CE）对双中子星的多信使探测数量，并采用联合分层贝叶斯推断预测对状态方程、双中子星质量分布和宇宙学的限制。结果依赖于并合率、状态方程和质量分布的具体假设；作者考虑窄质量函数（约1.4太阳质量）和宽质量函数（1.1至2太阳质量），以及局部并合率107 Gpc^{-3} yr^{-1}。在此设定下，模拟后续观测算法对ET给出每年约40至100个短时标电磁对应体，具体取决于探测器布局和质量分布；与CE组成联合网络时约为100至500个。此外还预测数十至数百个来自伽马射线暴或千新星的晚期余辉探测。基于生成的多信使事件，作者进行注入活动，在完全贝叶斯框架中分层恢复状态方程、质量分布和宇宙学参数。仅使用ET的千新星事件时，最大分析目录含78个事件，可将典型中子星半径R_{1.4}限制到≲0.2 km，将哈勃常数H0限制到≲1 km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}，至少在没有系统建模偏差时如此。比较仅用引力波数据与加入光变曲线信息的推断结果发现，后者对状态方程限制影响可忽略，但可有利于宇宙学参数推断。
classification.one_liner: 评估ET/CE时代双中子星多信使探测率，并预测联合贝叶斯推断对中子星状态方程、质量分布和哈勃常数的限制能力。

papers.title: Inhomogeneous Cosmologies with Bumpy Structure from Superfluid Pionic Vortices and the propagation of electromagnetic field
papers.abstract: In this work we introduce exact cosmological solutions in General Relativity in (3+1) dimensions which take into account both the usual fluid component as well as a superfluid component describing superfluid Pionic vortices. Such superfluid vortices are source of inhomogeneities which can be treated exactly, no perturbation theory is required. These analytic solutions are relevant to obtain a non-perturbative description of inhomogeneities in cosmology. We discuss the peculiar effects of these hadronic inhomogeneities on the propagation of electromagnetic fields on such cosmological backgrounds analyzing possible observable effects. Finally, the properties that the effective superfluid satisfy for such solutions to exist are discussed, together with possible extensions of this family of solutions.

classification.title_zh: 来自超流π介子涡旋的具有凹凸结构的非均匀宇宙学与电磁场传播
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在(3+1)维广义相对论中引入精确宇宙学解，其中同时包含通常流体组分和描述超流π介子涡旋的超流组分。这些超流涡旋是非均匀性的来源，且可被精确处理，不需要微扰论。这些解析解有助于对宇宙学中的非均匀性作非微扰描述。文章讨论了这些强子非均匀性对电磁场在此类宇宙学背景上传播的特殊效应，并分析可能的可观测效应。最后讨论了有效超流为存在这类解所需满足的性质，以及该解族的可能推广。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出含超流π介子涡旋源的广义相对论精确非均匀宇宙学解，并研究电磁场传播与可观测效应。

papers.title: Living on the Edge of Effective Field Theory: Near-Extremal Black Holes in Quadratic Gravity
papers.abstract: Near-extremal black holes can amplify higher-derivative corrections to general relativity, making them sharp probes of the perturbative control of gravitational effective field theory. We study this question in quadratic gravity with a dynamical scalar degree of freedom, focusing on dynamical Chern-Simons and scalar Gauss-Bonnet gravity. Using pseudospectral methods, we construct rapidly rotating exterior solutions at fixed surface gravity and fixed horizon angular velocity, and follow this controlled family toward extremality. In dynamical Chern-Simons gravity, the sequence approaches an asymptotically flat extremal exterior whose near-horizon limit agrees with the dynamical-Chern-Simons-deformed near-horizon extremal Kerr geometry and inherits its enhanced $SO(2,1)\times U(1)$ symmetry. In scalar Gauss-Bonnet gravity, the same limiting procedure behaves differently: the scalar develops an unavoidable logarithmic singularity at the horizon, the exterior metric develops a small boundary layer near the horizon, and the scalar-Gauss-Bonnet-deformed near-horizon extremal solution is not connected to a regular asymptotically flat exterior. We then use curvature invariants and tidal forces to diagnose the breakdown of the perturbative effective-field-theory expansion. We find that scalar curvature invariants can remain finite at the horizon even when tidal forces measured by infalling observers diverge as inverse powers of the surface gravity. These results separate distinct notions of effective-field-theory breakdown near extremality and provide a perturbative validity estimate that can be compared with current bounds on the dynamical Chern-Simons and scalar-Gauss-Bonnet couplings.

classification.title_zh: 在有效场论的边缘生存：二次引力中的近极端黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞会放大广义相对论的高阶导数修正，使其成为检验引力有效场论微扰控制性的敏锐探针。我们在含动力学标量自由度的二次引力中研究这一问题，重点考察动力学 Chern-Simons 引力和标量 Gauss-Bonnet 引力。利用伪谱方法，我们构造固定表面引力和固定视界角速度的快速旋转外部解，并沿这一受控解族趋近极端性。在动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中，该序列趋近一个渐近平坦的极端外部解，其近视界极限与动力学 Chern-Simons 形变的近视界极端 Kerr 几何一致，并继承其增强的 SO(2,1)×U(1) 对称性。在标量 Gauss-Bonnet 引力中，同样的极限过程表现不同：标量在视界处出现不可避免的对数奇点，外部度规在视界附近形成小的边界层，且标量 Gauss-Bonnet 形变的近视界极端解无法与规则渐近平坦外部解相连。随后我们用曲率不变量和潮汐力诊断微扰有效场论展开的失效。我们发现，即使由下落观测者测得的潮汐力以表面引力的逆幂发散，标量曲率不变量仍可在视界处保持有限。这些结果区分了近极端处有效场论失效的不同概念，并给出了可与当前动力学 Chern-Simons 和标量 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合界比较的微扰有效性估计。
classification.one_liner: 该文构造二次引力中近极端旋转黑洞外部解，揭示 dCS 与 sGB 在极端极限下有效场论失效方式不同，并用曲率不变量和潮汐力区分诊断。

papers.title: Domain walls through different cosmologies
papers.abstract: We study properties of domain walls (DWs) arising in the model with a double well potential assuming different early universe cosmologies: from dust through stiff matter domination to the limit of effective Minkowski space. Using lattice simulations we demonstrate that evolution of DW networks exhibits an approximate universality with respect to the cosmological equation of state (EoS). Namely, the wall area inside a given large volume is mainly determined by the particle horizon, while details of cosmic expansion play a subdominant role. As it follows, particle horizon rather than the inverse Hubble rate is pivotal in DW evolution defining the network correlation length and hence its phenomenology, e.g., the characteristic wavelength of emitted gravitational waves (GWs). Formation of closed DWs is shown to be very sensitive to the cosmological EoS and hence violate the universality, but their contribution to the total network is too small to change the overall picture. The universality breaking is also observed in the spectral properties of GWs from annihilating (biased) DWs: i) the IR slope of the spectrum depends on the EoS parameter; ii) there is a plateau in the UV part of the spectrum, which gets more pronounced as one stiffens the EoS. However, the dependence on the EoS is rather weak in the near peak region, which is most relevant from the viewpoint of pulsar timing arrays and other searches for the stochastic GW background. For a selection of primordial cosmologies, we provide fitting formulae for the spectra near the peak.

classification.title_zh: 不同宇宙学中的畴壁
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究双阱势模型中产生的畴壁，并假设不同的早期宇宙宇宙学：从尘埃主导、刚性物质主导到有效闵可夫斯基空间极限。利用格点模拟，作者发现畴壁网络的演化对宇宙学状态方程具有近似普适性：给定大体积内的壁面积主要由粒子视界决定，宇宙膨胀细节起次要作用。封闭畴壁的形成对状态方程很敏感并破坏普适性，但其贡献太小，不改变整体图像。对于湮灭（偏置）畴壁产生的引力波，谱性质也出现普适性破缺：红外斜率依赖状态方程参数，紫外部分出现平台且随状态方程变硬更明显；但在最接近峰值的区域依赖较弱，而该区域对脉冲星计时阵列等随机引力波背景搜寻最重要。作者还针对若干原初宇宙学给出了峰值附近谱的拟合公式。
classification.one_liner: 格点模拟表明不同早期宇宙状态方程下畴壁网络演化近似普适，粒子视界而非哈勃倒数起关键作用，并给出引力波谱峰附近的拟合公式。

papers.title: Affine ANEC selects the closed FRW branch for geodesically complete cosmology
papers.abstract: Using the affinely parameterized averaged null energy condition (ANEC) along radial null geodesics, we prove that, within the globally nondegenerate Friedmann--Robertson--Walker (FRW) class with $a(t)>0$ for all cosmic times, non-static flat models and all open models cannot be both null geodesically complete and ANEC-satisfying. Bounded oscillatory or cyclic flat/open models obey the same obstruction; in non-static periodic cases the negative affine-ANEC contribution accumulates over infinitely many cycles, giving $I_{\rm ANEC}=-\infty$. The sign obstruction is absent in closed $(k=+1)$ FRW geometry, where positive curvature can offset the negative expansion contribution to the affine ANEC, allowing nonsingular, geodesically complete cosmologies with ordinary NEC-respecting matter. We construct closed-FRW scalar-field models and contrast them with their flat realizations, which require NEC-violating support. We show that neglecting small positive curvature in a flat reconstruction of the expansion history can produce an apparent phantom equation of state, with a percent-level shift at $z=1$. Our main result is a curvature classification of ANEC-compatible eternal FRW cosmologies within this class: non-static flat and all open models are obstructed, while the closed branch admits explicit complete realizations, with global de Sitter as the vacuum representative.

classification.title_zh: 仿射 ANEC 为测地完备宇宙学选择闭合 FRW 分支
classification.abstract_zh: 利用沿径向零测地线的仿射参数化平均零能量条件（ANEC），论文证明：在全局非退化且所有宇宙时刻 a(t)>0 的 FRW 类中，非静态平直模型和所有开放模型不能同时满足零测地完备与 ANEC。有界振荡或循环的平直/开放模型也受同样阻碍；在非静态周期情形，负的仿射 ANEC 贡献会随无限多个周期累积，给出 I_ANEC=-∞。闭合 k=+1 FRW 几何不存在该符号阻碍，正曲率可以抵消膨胀对仿射 ANEC 的负贡献，从而允许由遵守普通 NEC 的物质支撑的无奇点、测地完备宇宙学。作者构造了闭合 FRW 标量场模型，并与需要 NEC 破坏支撑的平直实现对比；还表明在平直重构膨胀历史时忽略小正曲率可产生表观 phantom 状态方程，在 z=1 处有百分级移动。主要结果是在该类中对 ANEC 兼容永恒 FRW 宇宙学作曲率分类：非静态平直和所有开放模型受阻碍，闭合分支允许显式完备实现，全局 de Sitter 作为真空代表。
classification.one_liner: 在非退化 FRW 中，仿射 ANEC 排除非静态平直和开放测地完备模型，而闭合分支可容纳普通 NEC 物质的无奇点完备宇宙。

papers.title: Perturbative and non-linear analyses of gravitational turbulence in spacetimes with stable light rings
papers.abstract: Some black hole mimickers, as well as black strings and other higher-dimensional spacetimes, exhibit stable light rings-regions where light or high-frequency gravitational waves can be trapped. In these regions, linear perturbations decay slowly, raising the possibility of nonlinear instability mechanisms. In this work, we study the cubic nonlinear wave equation as a proxy for Einstein's equations, using a four-dimensional model geometry that allows stable trapping. By employing a perturbative approach, we show that the nonlinear wave equation on the sphere with dissipative terms captures several features of the full nonlinear problem. This framework allows us to confirm a previous conjecture: all higher-order energy norms grow for arbitrarily small initial fluctuation amplitudes. Additionally, we analyze the system's mode spectrum at late times, revealing an inertial range dominated by a direct energy cascade. These findings further support the notion that spacetimes with stable light rings develop weak, high-frequency radiation hair, which will not generically lead to instabilities.

classification.title_zh: 具有稳定光环时空中引力湍流的微扰与非线性分析
classification.abstract_zh: 一些黑洞模仿者、黑洞弦及其他高维时空具有稳定光环，即光或高频引力波可被捕获的区域。在这些区域，线性扰动衰减缓慢，从而可能引发非线性不稳定性。本文研究三次非线性波动方程，作为爱因斯坦方程的代理，采用一个允许稳定捕获的四维模型几何。通过微扰方法，作者表明球面上带耗散项的非线性波动方程能够捕捉完整非线性问题的若干特征。该框架确认了此前的猜想：对任意小的初始涨落振幅，所有高阶能量范数都会增长。此外，作者分析了系统晚期的模式谱，揭示出一个由直接能量级联主导的惯性区间。这些结果进一步支持如下观点：具有稳定光环的时空会发展出弱的高频辐射毛，但通常不会导致不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 用三次非线性波动方程作为爱因斯坦方程代理，研究稳定光环时空的引力湍流与非线性稳定性，发现直接能量级联和高频辐射毛但通常不导致不稳定。

papers.title: Carrollian minimal massive gravity and the fate of third-way consistency
papers.abstract: We construct the Carrollian limit of minimal massive gravity. The limit is singular for the algebra and regular for the Chern-Simons-like data. The one divergent bracket points along the null direction of the contracted bilinear form. The Lagrangian is therefore finite while the brackets are not. The contracted curvature still obeys a cubic closure condition, forced on shell rather than identically. The third-way coupling itself, however, is removable. For generic parameters an invertible redefinition of the auxiliary field and the boost connection takes it to Carrollian topologically massive gravity up to a boundary term. The same redefinition fails before the limit. We solve for an anti-de Sitter vacuum and a Carrollian black hole, whose rotation parameter leaves the frame and survives only in the boost connection. The degenerate vector flavor metric obstructs the standard charge formula, which we replace by a canonical one. The boundary charges, obtained in two independent ways, carry no trace of the deformation. A Dirac analysis gives nine first-class constraints and no local degrees of freedom on any background. The massive graviton is removed. The asymptotic symmetry algebra is bms_3, with central charges carried by the Einstein and Lorentz-Chern-Simons terms. The black hole has two sets of thermodynamic data, each with its own first law. One obeys the Bekenstein-Hawking area law, the other keeps the Chern-Simons entropy.

classification.title_zh: Carrollian 最小大质量引力与第三路一致性的命运
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造最小大质量引力的 Carrollian 极限。该极限对代数是奇异的，而对 Chern-Simons 型数据是正则的。唯一发散的括号沿收缩双线性型的零方向。因此拉格朗日量有限而括号并非如此。收缩后的曲率仍满足三次闭合条件，但该条件是壳上强加的而非恒等成立。然而 third-way 耦合本身可被移除。对于一般参数，通过辅助场与 boost 联络的可逆重定义，可将它在上至边界项的意义下化为 Carrollian 拓扑大质量引力。同一重定义在取极限前失效。我们求解了 AdS 真空和 Carrollian 黑洞；其转动参数离开标架，仅保留在 boost 联络中。退化的矢量味度规阻碍标准电荷公式，我们以正则公式替代。用两种独立方法得到的边界电荷不带有形变痕迹。Dirac 分析给出九个第一类约束，且在任何背景上都没有局域自由度。大质量引力子被移除。渐近对称代数為 bms_3，中心荷由 Einstein 项和 Lorentz-Chern-Simons 项携带。该黑洞有两套热力学数据，各自满足自己的第一定律；一套服从 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积律，另一套保留 Chern-Simons 熵。
classification.one_liner: 构造最小大质量引力的 Carrollian 极限，证明 third-way 耦合可移除，并给出 AdS 真空、Carrollian 黑洞、BMS3 渐近对称性与双套黑洞热力学。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes, complex null geodesics and singularity resolution in regular AdS black holes
papers.abstract: The black hole singularity is hidden behind its horizon, and it is difficult to determine whether it is resolved by quantum gravity or stringy effects. For an AdS-Schwarzschild black hole, it is known that the two-point function of the dual conformal field theory has a singularity associated with a null geodesic that bounces off the black hole singularity. In this paper, we investigate how the resolution of the black hole singularity is encoded in the dual conformal field theory by considering regular AdS black holes as regularized geometries. Using WKB analysis, we compute the quasinormal modes of regular AdS black holes and read off the dual two-point functions from the modes. We find that the singularity corresponding to the bouncing null geodesic for singular black holes is replaced by a smooth bump associated with a complex, rather than real, null geodesic. The location of the complex geodesic singularity is supported by analyzing the structure of the operator product expansion for the two-point function. Our results provide a holographic signature of black hole singularity resolution and clarify how information about the regular interior is encoded in boundary correlation functions.

classification.title_zh: 正则AdS黑洞中的准正规模、复零测地线与奇点解决
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞奇点隐藏在视界之后，难以判断它是否被量子引力或弦效应解决。对于AdS-Schwarzschild黑洞，已知对偶共形场论的两点函数具有与从黑洞奇点反弹的零测地线相关的奇异性。本文通过将正则AdS黑洞视为正则化几何，研究黑洞奇点解决如何编码在对偶共形场论中。我们使用WKB分析计算正则AdS黑洞的准正规模，并从这些模式读出对偶两点函数。我们发现，对于奇异黑洞对应于反弹零测地线的奇异性，被替换为与复而非实零测地线相关的平滑隆起。复测地线奇异性的位置通过分析两点函数算符乘积展开的结构得到支持。我们的结果为黑洞奇点解决提供了全息特征，并阐明了关于正则内部的信息如何编码在边界关联函数中。
classification.one_liner: 通过正则AdS黑洞的准正规模和复零测地线，揭示奇点解决在对偶CFT两点函数中的全息印记。

papers.title: TQFT gravity dual to the orbifold groupoid of Narain code CFTs over $\mathbb{Z}_4$
papers.abstract: In a companion paper arXiv:2610.26610, we classified the Narain CFTs obtained by gluing copies of the $A_3$ root and weight lattices along their $\mathbb{Z}_4$ discriminant group; for two hyperbolic pairs, this gives 22 even self-dual codes forming seven inequivalent theories at $c=\bar{c}=6$. Here we develop their physical interpretation and connections to 3d topological field theory. All 22 codes are topological boundary conditions of a single abelian Chern-Simons theory, whose invertible symmetries, including fractional $B$-field shifts, organize them into three orbits: free, mixed and torsion. Boundaries in different orbits are related only by gauging. We determine all gaugings of order at most four between the seven theories, by $\mathbb{Z}_2$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$ and $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$, with explicit twisted partition functions, and follow their effect on the spectrum and current algebra. We classify the topological surface operators of the bulk theory and identify those implementing these gaugings. Codes of the same group type are related by an invertible bulk surface; for different group types, every relating surface is non-invertible, and we find the minimal quantum dimension of such a surface. We give the fusion rules of the condensation defects, and show that theories self-dual under gauging carry non-invertible duality defects. Finally, we apply the TQFT gravity sum over topologies at genus one. We give a direct proof of the handlebody sum for any number of hyperbolic pairs, and closed-form weights for the handlebody and torsion contributions. For two pairs, the handlebody sum is the uniform average over the free theories and the torsion topology contributes the torsion theory, together reproducing the uniform average over all gluing codes. For three or more pairs, the handlebody sum alone is not a positive combination of code boundary states.

classification.title_zh: Z4 上 Narain 码 CFT 的轨形群胚的 TQFT 引力对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 在配套论文 arXiv:2610.26610 中，我们分类了通过沿其 Z4 判别群粘合 A3 根格与权格的副本得到的 Narain CFT；对两个双曲对，这给出 22 个偶自对偶码，在 c=c̄=6 处形成七个不等价理论。这里我们发展它们的物理解释以及与 3d 拓扑场论的联系。所有 22 个码都是单一阿贝尔 Chern-Simons 理论的拓扑边界条件，其可逆对称性（包括分数 B 场移位）将它们组织成三个轨道：free、mixed 和 torsion。不同轨道的边界仅通过 gauging 相联系。我们确定七个理论之间所有阶数至多为四的 gauging，通过 Z2、Z4 和 Z2×Z2，并给出显式扭曲配分函数，追踪它们对谱和流代数的影响。我们分类体理论的拓扑表面算子，并识别实现这些 gauging 的算子。同一群类型的码由可逆体表面相联系；对不同群类型，每个联系表面都是非可逆的，我们找到这种表面的最小量子维度。我们给出凝聚缺陷的融合规则，并证明在 gauging 下自对偶的理论携带非可逆对偶缺陷。最后，我们应用亏格一的 TQFT 引力对拓扑的求和。我们给出对任意数量双曲对的 handlebody 求和的直接证明，以及 handlebody 和 torsion 贡献的闭式权重。对两个双曲对，handlebody 求和是对 free 理论的均匀平均，torsion 拓扑贡献 torsion 理论，两者共同再现对所有粘合码的均匀平均。对三个或更多双曲对，仅 handlebody 求和不是码边界态的正组合。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Z4 上 Narain 码 CFT 的 3d 拓扑引力对偶，分类其 Chern-Simons 拓扑边界条件、gauging、拓扑表面算子与亏格一 TQFT 引力求和。

papers.title: Holographic SU(3) color superconductivity from color-octet condensation in AdS$_4$
papers.abstract: We present a holographic model of $SU(3)$ color superconductivity in asymptotically AdS$_4$ in which scalar and vector color-octet condensates form at finite baryon chemical potential. At $\mu_b=0$, a channel scan within consistent truncations shows that the favored sector reproduces the known $SU(2)$ s+p competition. At finite $\mu_b$, the s-wave order generalizes to an $S_1+iS_2$ structure. In the probe limit, the $S_+$ critical temperature grows linearly with $\mu_b/\mu_3$, while the p-wave critical temperature is independent of $\mu_b$. Once backreaction is included, the p-wave critical temperature decreases with $\mu_b$ and the p-wave phase disappears beyond a critical value of $\mu_b$. At high $\mu_b$, the balanced $S_+$ phase (with $S_1=S_2$) is the dominant color-superconducting phase, while the $S_-$ condensate, which signals the imbalance between $S_1$ and $S_2$, appears only at low temperature and low baryon density. Our results provide a holographic laboratory for color-octet condensation and non-Abelian color dynamics in dense matter such as neutron-star interiors.

classification.title_zh: AdS4 中由色八重态凝聚产生的全息 SU(3) 色超导
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个渐近 AdS4 中的 SU(3) 色超导全息模型，其中在有限重子化学势下形成标量和矢量色八重态凝聚。在 μ_b=0 时，一致截断内的通道扫描表明优选扇区再现已知的 SU(2) s+p 竞争。在有限 μ_b 下，s 波序推广为 S1+iS2 结构。在探针极限下，S+ 临界温度随 μ_b/μ3 线性增长，而 p 波临界温度与 μ_b 无关。计入 backreaction 后，p 波临界温度随 μ_b 降低，并在超过临界 μ_b 后 p 波相消失。在高 μ_b 下，平衡的 S+ 相（S1=S2）是主导的色超导相，而指示 S1 与 S2 不平衡的 S- 凝聚只出现在低温和低重子密度。我们的结果为致密物质（如中子星内部）中的色八重态凝聚和非阿贝尔色动力学提供了全息实验室。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4 全息模型中研究有限重子化学势下 SU(3) 色八重态标量/矢量凝聚及 s+p 多分量色超导相结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于全息超导/色超导，涉及多分量 s+p 序参量、临界温度与 backreaction，与全息超流超导及 p 波/多分量序参量支线高度相关。

papers.title: Holographic metals at finite volume
papers.abstract: We construct the electron star solution in asymptotically global AdS spacetime, and investigate its thermodynamic stability properties, both globally with respect to the Reissner-Nordstr\"om and thermal AdS spacetimes, and under local perturbations of the thermodynamic variables. The solution is sourced with a perfect fluid at finite temperature, which implies that the ``suspended electron cloud'' previously reported in the literature does not appear as an equilibrium phase. We interpret the resulting system as that of a holographic metal confined to a finite volume. The corresponding grand canonical phase diagram reveals a rich structure of transitions involving three dominant phases, which depend strongly on the fluid parameters characterizing the star. Finally, we identify a quantum critical point at finite chemical potential, around which these different phases are organized.

classification.title_zh: 有限体积下的全息金属
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在渐近全局 AdS 时空中构造电子星解，并研究其热力学稳定性：既相对于 Reissner-Nordström 和热 AdS 时空做全局稳定性分析，也考察热力学变量局域扰动下的稳定性。该解由有限温度完美流体作为源，这意味着文献中先前报道的“悬浮电子云”不会作为平衡相出现。我们将所得系统解释为限制在有限体积中的全息金属。相应的大正则相图显示出涉及三个主导相的丰富相变结构，且强烈依赖于刻画电子星的流体参数。最后，我们识别出有限化学势处的量子临界点，不同相围绕它组织。
classification.one_liner: 在全局 AdS 中构造有限体积电子星并给出其热力学相图与量子临界点。

papers.title: Sparse Modular Forms, Lattices, and Codes
papers.abstract: Motivated by sparseness conditions for holographic CFTs, we investigate sparseness of modular forms, lattices, and codes. For this we investigate the free energy of such objects as their weight, dimension or size goes to infinity. We construct families of modular forms that are sparse, such as the Eisenstein series $E_{2k}(\tau)$. We then investigate lattices that come from codes and introduce a sparseness condition for such lattices. We investigate the limit of lattices constructed from self-dual Reed-Muller codes and prove that they are sparse in this sense.

classification.title_zh: 稀疏模形式、格与码
classification.abstract_zh: 受全息 CFT 的稀疏性条件启发，我们研究模形式、格与码的稀疏性。为此，我们考察这些对象的自由能在其权重、维数或尺寸趋于无穷时的行为。我们构造了稀疏的模形式族，例如 Eisenstein 级数 E_{2k}(τ)。随后我们研究由码得到的格，并为这类格引入稀疏性条件。我们研究由自对偶 Reed-Muller 码构造的格的极限，并证明它们在此意义下是稀疏的。
classification.one_liner: 受全息 CFT 稀疏性条件启发，研究模形式、格与码的稀疏性，并证明自对偶 Reed-Muller 码构造的格满足稀疏条件。

papers.title: Killing Spinors for Finite Temperature Euclidean Solutions at the BPS Bound
papers.abstract: In a recent paper [arXiv:2308.00038], Anupam, Chowdhury, and Sen conjectured that the finite temperature Euclidean five-dimensional Cvetic-Youm solution saturating the BPS bound is supersymmetric. In this paper, we explicitly construct Killing spinors for this solution in five-dimensional minimal supergravity. We also expand on the previous discussions of Killing spinors for the finite temperature Euclidean Kerr-Newman solution saturating the BPS bound. For both these cases, we show that the total charge gets divided into two harmonic sources on three-dimensional flat base space.

classification.title_zh: BPS 界上有限温度欧几里得解的 Killing 旋量
classification.abstract_zh: 在最近一篇论文 [arXiv:2308.00038] 中，Anupam、Chowdhury 和 Sen 猜想：饱和 BPS 界的有限温度五维欧几里得 Cvetic-Youm 解是超对称的。本文在五维最小超引力中显式构造该解的 Killing 旋量。我们还扩展了此前关于饱和 BPS 界的有限温度欧几里得 Kerr-Newman 解 Killing 旋量的讨论。对于这两种情况，我们表明总电荷在三维修平坦基底空间上被分成两个调和源。
classification.one_liner: 在五维最小超引力中构造有限温度欧几里得 BPS 黑洞解的 Killing 旋量，验证其超对称性并讨论电荷的调和源分解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于精确超引力/BPS 黑洞解的经典引力分析，与用户的全息研究主线无直接联系，但可对应‘经典引力/广义相对论’支线。

papers.title: Separability of coupled gravitational perturbations in Pleba\'nski--Demia\'nski spacetimes
papers.abstract: Recently, a major breakthrough in the separability of gravitational perturbations of the Kerr--Newman rotating charged black hole was achieved by Hintz [arxiv:2609.33661], and extended to non-zero cosmological constant Kerr--Newman-(A)dS black holes by Yoshida [arxiv:2610.20500] and Zhao [arxiv:2610.22274]. This method removes the need for the freezing approximation, wherein coupling to the electromagnetic degrees of freedom are ignored, at the price of a coupled set of equations in the gravitational radiative degrees of freedom. The key insight is to transform the coupled system of equations into a chiral form which is amenable to a modified matrix $R$-separation of variables. In this work we extend the construction to the most general type D electro-vacuum solution to the Einstein-Maxwell equations, with aligned matter and cosmological constant. The construction makes use of the conformal properties of the equations and we find a symmetry operator underlying the decoupling of the chiral system.

classification.title_zh: Plebański–Demiański 时空中耦合引力扰动的可分离性
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，Hintz 在 Kerr–Newman 旋转带电黑洞引力扰动可分离性方面取得突破，并由 Yoshida 和 Zhao 推广到非零宇宙学常数的 Kerr–Newman-(A)dS 黑洞。该方法不再需要冻结近似，即忽略与电磁自由度的耦合，但代价是引力辐射自由度满足一组耦合方程。关键思想是将耦合方程组变换为手征形式，从而适用于改进的矩阵 R-分离变量。本文将这一构造推广到 Einstein–Maxwell 方程最一般的 type D 电真空解，包含对齐物质和宇宙学常数。构造利用了方程的共形性质，并找到了一个支配手征系统解耦的对称算符。
classification.one_liner: 将耦合引力扰动的可分离性构造推广到最一般的 type D 电真空 Einstein–Maxwell 时空。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Plebański–Demiański 时空中耦合引力扰动的可分离性，属于经典广义相对论与黑洞引力扰动理论，直接匹配经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Toward a Holographic Representation Theory of the Bosonic de Sitter Discrete Series
papers.abstract: We propose a program toward a holographic representation theory of the non-scalar bosonic discrete series $\Pi^\pm_{p,q}$, $p,q\in\mathbb{N}$, $1\leqslant q\leqslant p$, of the de Sitter ($\mathrm{dS}_{4}$) group $G=\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$. The proposal exploits two complementary realizations of the same unitary irreducible representation (UIR): a bounded-domain realization on an open ball $\mathbb{B}$ modeling the hyperbolic space $G/\mathrm{SO}(4)$, with $\partial\mathbb{B}\simeq\mathbb{S}^{3}$, and a covariant spacetime realization on $\mathrm{dS}_{4}$, with conformal boundaries $\mathscr{I}^{\pm}\simeq\mathbb{S}^{3}$, in which the physical UIR is obtained through the corresponding gauge reduction. This leads to two boundary constructions and an explicit compatibility problem, \begin{align*} \mathbb{B} \;\overset{?\mathrm{hol}}{\longleftrightarrow}\; \partial\mathbb{B}\simeq\mathbb{S}^{3} \quad\overset{?}{\simeq}\quad \mathscr{I}^{\pm}\simeq\mathbb{S}^{3} \;\overset{?\mathrm{hol}}{\longleftrightarrow}\; \mathrm{dS}_{4} \,. \end{align*} The two outer problems seek explicit intertwiners between the bulk and boundary realizations, with their invariant norms, constraints, and physical quotients properly identified. The middle problem asks how to construct and normalize a unitary intertwiner between the two boundary realizations once both have been shown to carry the same UIR. The bounded picture exposes the unitary and harmonic structure of the representation, while the spacetime picture makes its covariant and gauge-theoretic structure manifest, allowing the two constructions to constrain and illuminate one another. The established scalar family $\Pi_{p,0}$, $p\in\mathbb{N}$, with its spherical realization on $\mathbb{S}^{3}$, provides the guiding prototype. Particular attention is given to ...

classification.title_zh: 迈向玻色 de Sitter 离散系列的全息表示论
classification.abstract_zh: 论文提出一个研究计划，旨在为 de Sitter 群 G=SO0(1,4) 的非标量玻色离散系列 Π±_{p,q}（p,q∈N，1≤q≤p）建立全息表示论。该计划利用同一酉不可约表示的两个互补实现：一是开球 B 上的有界域实现，用于建模双曲空间 G/SO(4)，其边界 ∂B≃S3；二是 dS4 上的协变时空实现，其共形边界 I±≃S3，物理酉不可约表示通过相应规范约化得到。由此产生两个边界构造以及一个显式相容性问题，即体-边界实现与两类 S3 边界实现之间的全息对应和 intertwiner 构造问题。两个外部问题寻求体与边界实现之间的显式 intertwiner，并正确识别不变范数、约束与物理商；中间问题则询问在证明两个边界实现携带同一酉不可约表示后，如何构造并归一化它们之间的酉 intertwiner。有界图像揭示表示的酉结构与调和结构，时空图像使协变与规范理论结构显明，使两种构造相互约束和阐明。已建立的标量族 Π_{p,0} 及其在 S3 上的球面实现提供指导性原型。摘要在此处截断。
classification.one_liner: 提出 dS4 非标量玻色离散系列的全息表示论计划，核心是体-边界与两类 S3 边界实现之间 intertwiner 的构造与相容性。

papers.title: Geometric Quantization of the Giant Graviton Master Moduli Space
papers.abstract: We describe a remarkable reorganization of the space of gauge invariant operators of free or twisted $U(N)$ gauge theories as combinations of single-trace and determinant operators modulo certain "open loop equations". The reorganization has a transparent holographic interpretation, describing how states at finite $N$ can be reproduced by imposing certain $N$-independent gauge constraints on the combination of the closed strings Fock space and a geometric quantization of the moduli space of Giant Graviton D-branes, with quantization parameter $N^{-1}$. The moduli space of Giant Graviton D-branes is reproduced from tachyon condensation of auxiliary D-brane/anti-D-brane pairs which are "Koszul dual" to the D-brane system which supports the original gauge theory. We describe how to impose the open loop equations via certain BRST complexes and conjecture that their homology recovers the finite $N$ BPS Hilbert space in the limit of large auxiliary rank. The BRST construction conjecturally categorifies Murthy's Giant Graviton Expansion of indices counting $U(N)$-invariant BPS operators.

classification.title_zh: 巨引力子主模空间的几何量子化
classification.abstract_zh: 论文重新组织自由或扭曲 U(N) 规范理论中的规范不变算符，将其表示为单迹与行列式算符在“开环方程”下的组合，并给出全息解释：有限 N 态可由闭弦 Fock 空间与巨引力子 D-膜模空间的几何量子化（量子化参数 N^{-1}）在 N 无关规范约束下重现。巨引力子模空间由辅助 D-膜/反 D-膜对的快子凝聚给出，开环方程用 BRST 复形实现；作者猜想其同调在大辅助秩极限下恢复有限 N BPS Hilbert 空间，并范畴化 Murthy 的巨引力子展开。
classification.one_liner: 用巨引力子 D-膜模空间的几何量子化和 BRST 复形重构有限 N 规范理论 BPS 算符空间。

papers.title: The Spectral Anatomy of Complex-Time Singularities
papers.abstract: The properties of the bulk spacetime in a holographic theory may be probed by the analytic structure of the boundary correlator $G(t,x)$. In this letter, we analyse the singularities of $G(t,x)$ by deriving them from Fourier space. We show that the quasinormal modes are characterised by two distinct momentum scaling regimes. The first regime is defined by a finite $k/\omega^\gamma$ for some characteristic exponent $\gamma$ which is extracted from the singularity, and probes $G(t,0)$, reproducing the bouncing geodesic analysis. The second regime is defined by a finite $k/\omega$, and probes the complexified bulk away from the singularity, which allows us to study the singularities of $G(t,x\neq 0)$. We extract coefficients and exponents of the singularities for general spacetime dimensions, and allow for more exotic interiors. The heavy reliance of our computation on quasinormal modes opens the doors to a similar analysis being done on spacetimes that are accessible only numerically.

classification.title_zh: 复时奇点的谱解剖
classification.abstract_zh: 在全息理论中，体时空性质可通过边界关联函数 G(t,x) 的解析结构探测。本文从傅里叶空间推导 G(t,x) 的奇点并分析其性质，表明准正规模由两个不同的动量标度区刻画：第一个由有限的 k/ω^γ 定义，γ 从奇点提取，探测 G(t,0)，重现弹跳测地线分析；第二个由有限 k/ω 定义，探测远离奇点的复化体时空，从而研究 G(t,x≠0) 的奇点。对一般时空维度和更奇异的内部，提取奇点的系数与指数。计算对 QNM 的依赖为数值可及时空的类似分析开辟道路。
classification.one_liner: 从傅里叶空间解析边界关联函数奇点，揭示 QNM 的两个动量标度区并联系弹跳测地线与复化体时空。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究全息边界关联函数的奇点与准正规模动量标度，契合 QNM 标签；但不涉及超流、相变、探针膜或经典引力主线。

papers.title: Exploring M-theory on AdS$_7\times$S$^4$: Mellin amplitudes with composite operators
papers.abstract: We bootstrap mixed correlators in M-theory on AdS$_7\times$S$^4$, focusing on tree-level correlation functions involving one double-particle operator and three single-particle operators. Combining inputs from AdS/CFT, the chiral algebra, and the OPE at large central charge, we uniquely determine the Mellin amplitude for $\langle [{\cal O}_{2}{\cal O}_{q}]{\cal O}_{2}{\cal O}_{p}{\cal O}_{p+q-2}\rangle$ for generic $p$ and $q$. While our main focus is the $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ SCFT in six dimensions, we also derive the analogous result in AdS$_5\times$S$^5$, applying the same bootstrap approach to $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. Despite their different dynamics, the resulting Mellin amplitudes exhibit a strikingly similar structure, with non-trivial OPE predictions for low-twist protected operators providing a key input. Our work is motivated by recent developments in the study of Kaluza-Klein correlators in bubbling geometries, where four-point functions involving single- and multi-particle operators are computed as response functions to smooth deformations of the vacuum geometry. While well tested in AdS$_5\times$S$^5$, we aim to extend this framework to M-theory.

classification.title_zh: 探索 AdS$_7\times$S$^4$ 上的 M 理论：含复合算符的 Mellin 振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 AdS$_7\times$S$^4$ 的 M 理论中 bootstrap 混合关联函数，重点研究包含一个双粒子算符和三个单粒子算符的树级关联函数。结合 AdS/CFT、手征代数和中心荷很大时的 OPE 输入，我们唯一确定了一般 $p,q$ 下 $\langle [{\cal O}_{2}{\cal O}_{q}]{\cal O}_{2}{\cal O}_{p}{\cal O}_{p+q-2}\rangle$ 的 Mellin 振幅。主要对象是六维 $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ SCFT，同时用相同 bootstrap 方法在 AdS$_5\times$S$^5$ 中对 $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 得到类似结果。尽管动力学不同，所得 Mellin 振幅结构惊人相似，低 twist 保护算符的非平凡 OPE 预言是关键输入。工作受 bubbling geometries 中 Kaluza-Klein 关联函数研究启发，那里单粒子与多粒子算符的四点函数被作为真空几何光滑形变的响应函数计算；作者旨在将该框架推广到 M 理论。
classification.one_liner: 用 bootstrap、手征代数和 OPE 确定 AdS$_7\times$S$^4$ M 理论中含双粒子复合算符的树级 Mellin 振幅，并推广比较 AdS$_5\times$S$^5$。

papers.title: Modular Structure of the ADHM Effective Twisted Superpotential
papers.abstract: The Cardy limit of M2-brane indices retains nonperturbative information through the effective twisted superpotential, including corrections exponentially suppressed at large rank. We investigate the flavor dependence of these corrections in the three-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ $\mathrm U(N)$ ADHM theory at the universal twist. For $N_f=1,2,4$ fundamental hypermultiplets, we conjecture that the full exponential remainder of the selected Bethe critical value is an absolutely convergent divisor sum obtained by applying a first-order differential operator to an Eichler integral of a weight-four Eisenstein form. Resolving this remainder requires the additive constant, which we evaluate from its known integral representation as finite Clausen sums for every positive integer $N_f$. Expanding the integral together with the shifted-rank power determines the type-IIA coefficients of the perturbative contribution at arbitrary genus and their factorial growth. With this subtraction fixed, the proposed sums reproduce independently computed Bethe critical values at up to $800$-digit accuracy, including low ranks that test the continuation beyond the reconstructed sectors. The flavor-one expression agrees with level-one ABJM, whereas the two- and four-flavor completions have distinct divisor laws related by exact dissection identities to finite combinations of ABJM functions. The comparison supports a shared weight-four organization of nonperturbative Bethe data beyond the mirror pair, with arithmetic that distinguishes the theories. Through the finite-rank Cardy relation, the proposed completion predicts the entire $1/\omega$ coefficient of the selected vacuum contribution to the superconformal index, retaining these theory-dependent corrections in its leading exponent.

classification.title_zh: ADHM 有效扭曲超势的模结构
classification.abstract_zh: M2-brane 指标的 Cardy 极限通过有效扭曲超势保留非微扰信息，包括在大秩下指数压低的修正。本文研究三维 N=4 U(N) ADHM 理论在普适 twist 下这些修正的味道依赖性。对于 N_f=1,2,4 个基本超多重态，作者猜想所选 Bethe 临界值的完整指数余项是一个绝对收敛的除子和，可由一阶微分算子作用于 weight-four Eisenstein 形式的 Eichler 积分得到。解析该余项需要加性常数，作者从其已知积分表示出发，对每个正整数 N_f 将其计算为有限 Clausen 和。将积分与移位秩的幂一同展开，可确定微扰贡献在任意亏格下的 type-IIA 系数及其阶乘增长。固定该减除后，所提出的和以最高 800 位精度重现独立计算的 Bethe 临界值，包括检验重构扇区之外延拓的低秩情形。单味道表达式与 level-one ABJM 一致，而两味道和四味道完备具有不同的除子律，并通过精确 dissection 恒等式与 ABJM 函数的有限组合相联系。比较支持非微扰 Bethe 数据在镜像对之外具有共享的 weight-four 组织，而其算术区分不同理论。通过有限秩 Cardy 关系，所提出的完备化预测超共形指标中所选真空贡献的整个 1/ω 系数，并在其领头指数中保留这些依赖理论的修正。
classification.one_liner: 用 weight-four 模形式与除子和刻画三维 N=4 ADHM 理论 Cardy 极限中的非微扰 Bethe 数据，并预测超共形指标的 1/ω 系数。

papers.title: Spectrum of a 2D QFT analogue of the SYK model
papers.abstract: We study the spectrum of the two-dimensional generalisation of the SYK model proposed by Turiaci and Verlinde, in which chiral Majorana fermions with a topological kinetic term interact through random $2q$-fermion couplings. We compute the four-point function at order $1/N$ in the conformal limit. In addition to the conformal Casimir, the ladder kernels commute with the operator that exchanges a single lightcone coordinate. As a result, the four-point function splits into an even and an odd sector, which the kernels do not mix. In each sector we construct a complete eigenbasis of the Casimir, find the eigenvalues of the kernels in closed form and sum the ladder diagrams. The poles in the ladder sum lie on a spectral curve in the plane of the two conformal weights. A conformal solution in the IR limit breaks the symmetries of the model under chiral reparametrisations and local Lorentz transformations, and the kernel has eigenvalue one on the corresponding modes. The reparametrisation modes, with conformal weights $(2,0)$ and $(0,2)$, are non-normalisable, whereas the Lorentz mode of the odd sector, with weights $(1,1)$, is normalisable. We determine the region where the sum of ladders can be represented in a contour form analogous to that of the one-dimensional SYK model.

classification.title_zh: 二维 QFT 中 SYK 模型类比物的谱
classification.abstract_zh: 研究 Turiaci 与 Verlinde 提出的二维 SYK 模型推广的谱。该模型中，带拓扑动能项的手征 Majorana 费米子通过随机 2q 费米子耦合相互作用。我们在共形极限下以 1/N 阶计算四点函数。除共形 Casimir 外，梯形核还与交换单个光锥坐标的算符对易，因此四点函数分成偶、奇两个扇区，且核不混合。在每个扇区中，我们构造 Casimir 的完备本征基，闭式求出核的本征值并求和梯形图。梯形和的极点位于两个共形权平面中的一条谱曲线上。红外极限下的共形解破坏模型的手征重参数化对称性和局域 Lorentz 变换对称性，核在相应模式上的本征值为一。共形权为 (2,0) 与 (0,2) 的重参数化模式不可归一，而奇扇区中权重为 (1,1) 的 Lorentz 模式可归一。我们确定了一个区域，在其中梯形和可写成类似一维 SYK 模型的围道形式。
classification.one_liner: 在二维 Turiaci–Verlinde SYK 类比模型中解析计算 1/N 四点函数与梯形谱，并识别破坏手征重参数化与 Lorentz 对称性的零模。

papers.title: Gravitational form factors of $\rho$ and $a_1$ mesons in V-QCD
papers.abstract: We compute the gravitational form factors and mechanical properties of the $\rho$ and $a_1$ mesons in V-QCD, a holographic model of QCD with backreacting flavor and dynamical chiral symmetry breaking. The parameters of the model are taken from an earlier fit to meson spectra and are not adjusted to form factor data. Both mesons are described by a single spin-1 field, and the six form factors are identified from the matrix element of the energy-momentum tensor with two spin-1 states, following the holographic dictionary. We find that $A_0 = J$ and $A_1 = 0$ hold identically in the model, and show that the remaining form factors $E$, $D_0$ and $D_1$ are regular at zero momentum transfer. We compare the form factors of $\rho$ with results from the Nambu--Jona-Lasinio model, a light-cone constituent quark model and the hard-wall holographic model. From the form factors, we compute the monopole and quadrupole distributions of energy, pressure and shear force in the Breit frame. The D-term, defined for spin-1 hadrons as the forward value of the combination $\mathcal{D}_0(t)$ of form factors, is found to be $-2.98$ for the $\rho$ and $-7.43$ for the $a_1$ meson. The mass and mechanical radii are $0.81$~fm and $0.89$~fm for $\rho$, and $0.73$~fm and $0.80$~fm for $a_1$.

classification.title_zh: V-QCD中ρ和a1介子的引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在V-QCD（具有反作用味和动态手征对称性破缺的全息QCD模型）中计算ρ和a1介子的引力形状因子及力学性质。模型参数取自此前对介子谱的拟合，未针对形状因子数据调整。两种介子均由单一自旋1场描述，我们依照全息字典从能量-动量张量在双自旋1态间的矩阵元识别六个形状因子。发现A0=J和A1=0在模型中恒成立，并表明其余E、D0、D1在零动量转移处正则。我们将ρ的形状因子与NJL模型、光锥组分夸克模型和硬壁全息模型结果比较。由形状因子计算Breit系中能量、压强和剪力的单极与四极分布。对自旋1强子定义的D-term为ρ的-2.98和a1的-7.43。质量和力学半径分别为ρ的0.81 fm和0.89 fm，a1的0.73 fm和0.80 fm。

papers.title: Phases of deformed sine dilaton gravity and JT limit
papers.abstract: We study the implications of marginal deformation in sine dilaton gravity (sDG). We investigate the thermodynamic properties of deformed sine dilaton gravity (dsDG) and examine the phase stability of black holes in two space-time dimensions. We found that the deformation parameter ($\lambda$) sets a critical temperature threshold ($T_0$). Below this critical value ($T<T_0$), the system enters an unphysical phase characterized by a fractional density of states and a negative Wald entropy. Above the critical temperature ($T>T_0$), we obtain a physical black hole phase with positive entropy and negative free energy. Furthermore, we evaluate the Komar integral, derive the Casimir function for dsDG, and establish the first law of black hole thermodynamics. Finally, we explore the infrared (IR) limit of dsDG which we identify as Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity accompanied by marginal deformation. We also perform a detailed analysis of various thermodynamic entities pertinent to this deformed JT solution.

classification.title_zh: 变形正弦膨胀子引力的相与 JT 极限
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究正弦膨胀子引力（sDG）中边缘变形的影响，考察变形正弦膨胀子引力（dsDG）的热力学性质及二维黑洞的相稳定性。研究发现，变形参数 λ 设定临界温度 T0：当 T<T0 时，系统进入非物理相，具有分数态密度和负 Wald 熵；当 T>T0 时，得到物理黑洞相，熵为正、自由能为负。进一步计算 Komar 积分，导出 dsDG 的 Casimir 函数，并建立黑洞热力学第一定律。最后讨论 dsDG 的红外极限，将其识别为带边缘变形的 Jackiw-Teitelboim（JT）引力，并分析该变形 JT 解的相关热力学量。

papers.title: Dynamical Gauss--Bonnet Sum Rules and Global Consistency in Five-Dimensional Braneworld Cosmology
papers.abstract: We derive an exact dynamical consistency relation for a smooth, periodically compactified five-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet cosmology sourced by a real, minimally coupled canonical scalar field. For a spatially flat Friedmann--Lemaitre--Robertson--Walker slicing and a generally time-dependent warp factor, a contraction of the bulk equations eliminates both the scalar potential and the bulk cosmological constant. A direct orthonormal-curvature reconstruction gives the independent diagonal and mixed field equations and verifies the contracted Gauss--Bonnet identity. The integrated relation separates an exact total derivative from the dynamically active Lovelock sector. Importantly, satisfying the integrated sum rule alone does not imply a solution of the complete system. We prove that, for positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling, a smooth periodic time-independent warp factor and a canonical scalar exclude all exact expanding power-law scale factors $a(t)\propto t^p$ with $p>0$. This strengthens the previously established de Sitter sign obstruction and removes an earlier interpretation of $p=1/2$ as an admissible sign-compatible physical branch. For time-dependent warping, we reformulate bouncing conditions using proper time and the physical scale factor on each constant-$y$ hypersurface. We compare the common $w=-1$ geometric member with the perturbative weighted construction of Dias, Hoff da Silva, and da Rocha. At the level of the unexpanded Ricci-trace rearrangement, the curvature-only tensor contribution differs from the full Lanczos contraction by a definite scalar-curvature term. This distinction, and the additional independent field equations, delimit the physical conclusions that may be drawn from a necessary integrated condition.
authors: Paulo Michel Longo Tavares da Silva

classification.title_zh: 动力学Gauss--Bonnet求和规则与五维膜世界宇宙学的全局一致性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了一个精确的动力学一致性关系，用于由实最小耦合正则标量场作为源的光滑、周期紧致化五维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet宇宙学。对于空间平坦FRW切片和一般随时间变化的翘曲因子，体方程的缩并消去标量势和体宇宙学常数。直接的正交曲率重构给出独立的对角与混合场方程，并验证缩并的Gauss--Bonnet恒等式。积分关系将精确全导数与动力学活跃的Lovelock部分分开。重要的是，仅满足积分求和规则并不意味完整系统的解。我们证明，对于正Gauss-Bonnet耦合、光滑周期时间无关翘曲因子和正则标量，所有精确膨胀幂律标度因子 a(t)∝t^p (p>0) 被排除。这强化了先前de Sitter符号障碍，并移除p=1/2作为可容许符号相容物理分支的早期解释。对于含时翘曲，我们用固有时和每个常y超曲面上的物理标度因子重新表述反弹条件。我们比较常见w=-1几何成员与Dias, Hoff da Silva, da Rocha的微扰加权构造。在未展开Ricci迹重排层面，仅曲率张量贡献与完整Lanczos缩并相差一个确定的标量曲率项。这一区别以及额外独立场方程界定了可从必要积分条件得出的物理结论。

papers.title: Entanglement-to-Stress Relation from an Effective Holographic Description of the Transverse-Field Ising Model
papers.abstract: We investigate an effective holographic description of the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM). We reconstruct the spatial metric from its entanglement entropy and determine the temporal metric using the Einstein-scalar equations, ultraviolet time normalization, and a smooth, horizonless center. Holographic renormalization then gives an enthalpy density that can be expressed through the entropy curvature at half the system size. This relation is a prediction of the effective gravity for the microscopic theory. We test it against the exact finite-size TFIM stress, which is not used in the reconstruction. Away from criticality, the gravity prediction agrees closely with the exact stress in the near-critical scaling regime. This result suggests an entanglement-to-stress relation in the massive Ising field theory, whose field-theoretic derivation remains open. We also find that the reconstructions for different system sizes and couplings share a common scalar potential, up to finite-size deviations near the center that move away as the size increases. This supports the view that the reconstructed geometries are solutions of a single effective Einstein-scalar theory.

classification.title_zh: 横场Ising模型有效全息描述中的纠缠-应力关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究横场Ising模型（TFIM）的有效全息描述。由纠缠熵重构空间度规，并利用Einstein-标量方程、紫外时间归一化以及光滑无视界中心确定时间度规。全息重整化随后给出焓密度，它可用半系统尺寸处的熵曲率表示。该关系是有效引力对微观理论的预言。我们用未用于重构的精确有限尺寸TFIM应力检验它。在临界点之外，引力预言在近临界标度区与精确应力密切吻合。这表明大质量Ising场论中存在纠缠-应力关系，其场论推导仍待完成。我们还发现不同系统尺寸和耦合的重构共享一个标量势，直到中心附近的有限尺寸偏差随尺寸增大而退去。这支持重构几何是单一有效Einstein-标量理论解的观点。

papers.title: Hidden Geometric Structure Beyond Conformal Flatness
papers.abstract: We uncover a hidden geometric structure in holographic correlators of M-theory, despite the absence of conformal flatness. We study two-point functions of $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS local operators in the presence of a $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS surface defect in six-dimensional $(2,0)$ theory, dual to an M2-brane in $\mathrm{AdS}_7\times$S$^4$. We find that the infinite tower of tree-level supergravity correlators can be generated from a single lowest-weight correlator. After a simple reorganization of the rational terms, the generating function takes the form of a weighted average over the internal S$^4$, acting through additive shifts of the spacetime cross ratios. This reveals a remarkably simple geometric organization underlying the holographic defect correlators.

classification.title_zh: 超越共形平坦性的隐藏几何结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在M理论的全息关联子中发现了一种隐藏的几何结构，尽管共形平坦性并不存在。我们研究六维(2,0)理论中在1/2-BPS面缺陷存在下1/2-BPS局域算符的两点函数，其对偶为AdS7×S4中的M2膜。我们发现，无穷塔的树级超引力关联子可以由单个最低权重关联子生成。对有理项进行简单重排后，生成函数呈现为对内部S4的加权平均，并通过时空交叉比的加性平移起作用。这揭示了全息缺陷关联子背后极其简单的几何组织。
classification.one_liner: 发现M理论全息缺陷关联子可由单个最低权重关联子生成，并表现为对内部S4的加权平均。
